  }]

ASSESSMENTS: Score every dimension on a 0-100 scale (one decimal place, e.g. 83.7). Your score reflects your overall judgment of how well the codebase serves a developer on that dimension. Assessments drive the codebase health score directly.

FINDINGS: Specific DEFECTS to fix. Every finding must describe something that needs to change — never positive observations. Return [] if no issues are worth flagging. Findings illustrate and support your score — they are the "here is what I saw" behind your judgment.

GLOBAL ANCHORS — what each score range means:
- 100: exemplary. A developer working here would find this quality reliably strong with no material issues.
- 90: strong. A developer would trust what they see, with only minor friction or isolated rough edges.
- 80: solid but uneven. A developer would mostly be well-served but would hit recurring friction — moments of "why is this different?" or "I wouldn't have expected that."
- 70: mixed. A developer would encounter enough inconsistency or friction that they can't fully trust patterns they've seen elsewhere in the codebase.
- 60: significant drag. A developer would need to read each area individually because the quality on this dimension is not reliable.
- 40: poor. This quality actively works against the developer — misleading, unpredictable, or fragile in ways that regularly impede work.
- 20: severely problematic. A developer would struggle to work here safely on this dimension.

DIMENSION ANCHORS (0-100):
- naming_quality:
  100 = a developer can read names and correctly predict behavior without checking the implementation.
  90 = names are mostly precise; a few generic or slightly misleading names require a second look.
  80 = a developer regularly encounters names that don't communicate intent — generic verbs, vocabulary drift, name/behavior mismatches slow them down.
  60 = names are routinely ambiguous or misleading; the developer must read implementations to understand what things do.
- logic_clarity:
  100 = control flow is direct and necessary; a developer can trace logic without surprises.
  90 = mostly clear with isolated simplification opportunities.
  80 = a developer regularly encounters redundant branches, dead paths, or avoidable complexity that obscures intent.
  60 = control flow is frequently opaque or misleading; a developer cannot trust that the code does what it appears to do.
- type_safety:
  100 = a developer can trust type annotations as accurate documentation of runtime behavior.
  90 = generally accurate with a few soft spots that don't cause real confusion.
  80 = a developer regularly encounters annotations that don't match reality — Optional where null is impossible, missing annotations on public APIs, type:ignore without context.
  60 = type annotations are unreliable; a developer must verify runtime behavior independently.
- contract_coherence:
  100 = a developer can trust that functions do what their signatures, names, and docs promise.
  90 = minor local mismatches with low downstream impact.
  80 = a developer regularly finds that APIs surprise them — return types that lie, side effects hidden behind getter names, doc/signature divergence.
  60 = contracts are often surprising or contradictory; the developer must read implementations to know what to expect.
- error_consistency:
  100 = a developer can predict how errors propagate and are handled across the codebase.
  90 = mostly coherent with occasional inconsistencies that don't cause real confusion.
  80 = a developer encounters mixed strategies across related code paths — some throw, some return null, some swallow — making error behavior hard to predict.
  60 = error behavior is unpredictable; failures are hard to trace and the developer cannot write reliable error handling against this code.
- abstraction_fitness:
  100 = abstractions clearly reduce complexity; a developer benefits from every layer of indirection.
  90 = generally strong with a few layers that feel overbuilt but don't materially slow the developer down.
  80 = a developer regularly navigates indirection that doesn't pay for itself — pass-through wrappers, single-implementation interfaces, wide option bags.
  60 = abstraction cost routinely outweighs value; the developer spends more time navigating layers than solving problems.
- ai_generated_debt:
  100 = code is purpose-driven with no ceremony; a developer's attention is spent on logic, not noise.
  90 = mostly clean with small pockets of boilerplate or restating patterns.
  80 = a developer regularly wades through defensive overengineering, restating comments, or formulaic patterns that obscure the real logic.
  60 = generated-style noise is pervasive; the developer must mentally filter significant boilerplate to understand what the code actually does.
- high_level_elegance:
  100 = a developer can explain why each top-level package exists and what owns what.
  90 = clear ownership with minor boundary blur that doesn't cause real confusion.
  80 = a developer would struggle to explain the decomposition to a new team member — mixed responsibilities, unclear ownership boundaries.
  60 = purpose and ownership are muddled; a developer cannot predict where to find or put things.
- mid_level_elegance:
  100 = handoffs across module boundaries are explicit, minimal, and unsurprising.
  90 = mostly good seams with minor friction at a few boundaries.
  80 = a developer regularly encounters awkward boundary translations, tangled orchestration, or glue-code entropy between modules.
  60 = seam design is tangled; a developer making a cross-module change must understand surprising implicit contracts.
- low_level_elegance:
  100 = function and class internals are concise, precise, and proportionate.
  90 = mostly clean craft with isolated rough edges.
  80 = a developer regularly encounters local complexity — deep nesting, over-extraction, defensive sprawl — that makes individual functions harder to follow than they should be.
  60 = local implementation quality routinely impedes understanding; a developer must work hard to follow individual functions.
- cross_module_architecture:
  100 = a developer can trust that dependency direction and boundaries are coherent and intentional.
  90 = mostly coherent with isolated boundary drift.
  80 = a developer encounters recurring boundary violations, coupling hotspots, or hub modules that make changes ripple unexpectedly.
  60 = structural boundary debt is widespread; a developer cannot make changes without worrying about distant breakage.
- initialization_coupling:
  100 = a developer can import any module without worrying about boot-order dependencies or side effects.
  90 = mostly stable with limited boot-order fragility.
  80 = a developer encounters import-time side effects, global singletons with order dependencies, or environment reads at module scope that create fragility.
  60 = boot behavior is routinely fragile; a developer must carefully sequence imports or risk subtle failures.
- convention_outlier:
  100 = a developer can see a pattern in one area and trust it holds everywhere.
  90 = mostly consistent with minor style islands that don't cause real confusion.
  80 = a developer encounters noticeable convention drift across major areas — different naming styles, organization patterns, or behavioral protocols in sibling modules.
  60 = conventions are fragmented; a developer cannot rely on patterns they've learned and must re-learn conventions per area.
- dependency_health:
  100 = the dependency set is cohesive, current, and purposeful.
  90 = mostly healthy with minor overlap or weight concerns.
  80 = a developer encounters duplicate libraries for the same purpose, heavy deps for light use, or other signs the dependency set has drifted.
  60 = dependency choices materially hinder evolution; the developer faces conflicts, bloat, or redundancy that slows work.
- test_strategy:
  100 = a developer can make changes confidently knowing the test portfolio validates what matters.
  90 = generally strong with small strategic gaps that don't undermine confidence.
  80 = a developer would worry about making changes in certain areas — important paths lack coverage, tests are brittle, or the strategy has blind spots.
  60 = meaningful risk goes unvalidated; a developer cannot trust that their changes won't break things in untested areas.
- api_surface_coherence:
  100 = a developer can predict API shape and behavior from seeing one example.
  90 = mostly coherent with minor inconsistency across endpoints.
  80 = a developer encounters recurring irregularities — inconsistent parameter ordering, mixed sync/async, overloaded interfaces.
  60 = APIs are hard to predict; a developer must read each endpoint's implementation to use it safely.
- authorization_consistency:
  100 = a developer can trust that auth patterns are uniformly applied across all protected resources.
  90 = mostly consistent with limited, documented exceptions.
  80 = a developer encounters recurring gaps — sibling routes with inconsistent auth, magic permission strings, mixed trust boundaries.
  60 = auth posture is inconsistent; a developer reviewing security cannot trust that coverage is complete.
- incomplete_migration:
  100 = migrations are complete or intentionally bounded with clear documentation.
  90 = mostly complete with minor legacy residue that doesn't cause confusion.
  80 = a developer encounters old and new patterns coexisting — making it unclear which to follow or extend.
  60 = migration drift is pervasive; a developer regularly encounters stale shims, deprecated-but-called code, and dual-path confusion.
- package_organization:
  100 = a developer can predict where to find and where to put things based on directory structure alone.
  90 = mostly coherent with minor placement outliers.
  80 = a developer encounters structural mismatches — files that don't belong where they are, flat directories mixing unrelated concerns, ambiguous folder names.
  60 = organization regularly obscures ownership; a developer must search rather than navigate.
- design_coherence:
  100 = a developer finds functions focused, abstractions earned, and structural patterns consistent.
  90 = mostly focused with minor multi-responsibility functions or parameter sprawl.
  80 = a developer regularly encounters functions doing too many things, parameters that should be grouped, or repeated patterns that should be data-driven.
  60 = design decisions routinely obscure intent; a developer must untangle responsibilities to understand or modify code.

IMPORT GUARD: any assessment score below 100 must include explicit feedback for that same dimension (finding with suggestion or dimension_notes evidence). For scores below 85, include at least one defect finding for that same dimension.

1→/**
     2→ * Best-effort clipboard write that never throws.
     3→ * Returns true when the write succeeds.
     4→ */
     5→export async function writeClipboardTextSafe(
     6→  text: string,
     7→  options: { allowExecCommandFallback?: boolean } = {},
     8→): Promise<boolean> {
     9→  if (!text) {
    10→    return false;
    11→  }
    12→
    13→  if (typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && navigator.clipboard?.writeText) {
    14→    try {
    15→      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
    16→      return true;
    17→    } catch {
    18→      // fall through to optional fallback
    19→    }
    20→  }
    21→
    22→  if (!options.allowExecCommandFallback || typeof document === 'undefined') {
    23→    return false;
    24→  }
    25→
    26→  let textarea: HTMLTextAreaElement | null = null;
    27→  try {
    28→    textarea = document.createElement('textarea');
    29→    textarea.value = text;
    30→    textarea.style.position = 'fixed';
    31→    textarea.style.left = '-9999px';
    32→    document.body.appendChild(textarea);
    33→    textarea.select();
    34→    return document.execCommand('copy') === true;
    35→  } catch {
    36→    return false;
    37→  } finally {
    38→    if (textarea?.parentNode) {
    39→      textarea.parentNode.removeChild(textarea);
    40→    }
    41→  }
    42→}
    43→

     9→function getRequestUrl(input: URL | RequestInfo): string {

    22→export function composeAbortSignals(timeoutSignal: AbortSignal, callerSignal?: AbortSignal): ComposedSignalResult {
    23→  if (!callerSignal) {
    24→    return {
    25→      signal: timeoutSignal,
    26→      cleanup: () => {},
    27→    };
    28→  }
    29→
    30→  const composedController = new AbortController();
    31→  const abort = () => {
    32→    if (!composedController.signal.aborted) {

    34→    }
    35→  };

    42→    };
    43→  }

    46→  timeoutSignal.addEventListener('abort', onAbort, { once: true });
    47→  callerSignal.addEventListener('abort', onAbort, { once: true });
    48→
    49→  return {
    50→    signal: composedController.signal,
    51→    cleanup: () => {
    52→      timeoutSignal.removeEventListener('abort', onAbort);
    53→      callerSignal.removeEventListener('abort', onAbort);
    54→    },
    55→  };

    58→function toAbortError(reason: unknown): Error {

    61→  }
    62→
    63→  const message = typeof reason === 'string'

    66→

    68→    return new DOMException(message, 'AbortError');

1→export const fileToDataURL = (file: File): Promise<string> =>
     2→  new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
     3→    const reader = new FileReader();
     4→    reader.onload = () => resolve(reader.result as string);
     5→    reader.onerror = (error) => reject(error);
     6→    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
     7→  });
     8→
     9→export const dataURLtoFile = (
    10→  dataUrl: string,
    11→  filename: string,
    12→  fileType?: string
    13→): File | null => {
    14→  try {
    15→    const [metadata, payload] = dataUrl.split(',');
    16→    if (!metadata || !payload) {
    17→      throw new Error('Invalid Data URL format');
    18→    }
    19→
    20→    const mimeMatch = metadata.match(/:(.*?);/);
    21→    const mimeType =
    22→      fileType ||
    23→      (mimeMatch && mimeMatch[1]) ||
    24→      'application/octet-stream';
    25→    const decodedPayload = atob(payload);
    26→    const bytes = new Uint8Array(decodedPayload.length);
    27→
    28→    for (let i = 0; i < decodedPayload.length; i += 1) {
    29→      bytes[i] = decodedPayload.charCodeAt(i);
    30→    }
    31→
    32→    return new File([bytes], filename, { type: mimeType });
    33→  } catch {
    34→    return null;
    35→  }
    36→};

    29→function resolveTaskScopeProjectId(projectId: string | null): string | null {
    30→  if (projectId && projectId.trim().length > 0) {
    31→    return projectId;
    32→  }
    33→  const selectedProjectId = getProjectSelectionFallbackId();
    34→  if (selectedProjectId && selectedProjectId.trim().length > 0) {
    35→    return selectedProjectId;
    36→  }
    37→  return null;
    38→}
    39→
    40→/**
    41→ * Preload task mappings for a batch of generations in the background.
    42→ */
    43→export async function preloadGenerationTaskMappings(
    44→  queryClient: QueryClient,
    45→  generationIds: string[],
    46→  projectId: string | null,
    47→  options: PreloadGenerationTaskMappingsOptions = {},
    48→) {
    49→  const supabase = getSupabaseClient();
    50→  const effectiveProjectId = resolveTaskScopeProjectId(projectId);
    51→  const {
    52→    batchSize = 5,
    53→    delayBetweenBatches = 200,
    54→    preloadFullTaskData = false,
    55→  } = options;
    56→
    57→  for (let i = 0; i < generationIds.length; i += batchSize) {
    58→    const batch = generationIds.slice(i, i + batchSize);
    59→
    60→    const mappings = await getPrimaryTaskMappingsForGenerations(batch, { projectId: effectiveProjectId ?? undefined });
    61→    let reportedBatchQueryFailure = false;
    62→
    63→    const prefetchTasks: Array<Promise<unknown>> = [];
    64→
    65→    batch.forEach((generationId) => {
    66→      const mapping = mappings.get(generationId);
    67→      const cacheEntry = toGenerationTaskMappingCacheEntry(mapping);
    68→      queryClient.setQueryData<GenerationTaskMappingCacheEntry>(
    69→        taskQueryKeys.generationMapping(generationId),
    70→        cacheEntry,
    71→      );
    72→
    73→      if (!reportedBatchQueryFailure && cacheEntry.status === 'query_failed' && cacheEntry.queryError) {
    74→        reportedBatchQueryFailure = true;
    75→        normalizeAndPresentError(new Error(cacheEntry.queryError), {
    76→          context: 'GenerationTaskCache',
    77→          showToast: false,
    78→        });
    79→      }
    80→
    81→      if (preloadFullTaskData && effectiveProjectId && cacheEntry.taskId && cacheEntry.status === 'ok') {
    82→        prefetchTasks.push(queryClient.prefetchQuery({
    83→          [REDACTED](cacheEntry.taskId, effectiveProjectId),
    84→          queryFn: async () => {
    85→            const { data, error } = await supabase
    86→              .from('tasks')
    87→              .select('*')
    88→              .eq('id', cacheEntry.taskId)
    89→              .eq('project_id', effectiveProjectId)
    90→              .single();
    91→
    92→            if (error) throw error;
    93→            if (!isTaskDbRow(data)) {
    94→              throw new Error('Task row has unexpected shape');
    95→            }
    96→            return mapTaskDbRowToTask(data);
    97→          },
    98→          staleTime: 2 * 60 * 1000,
    99→        }));
   100→      }
   101→    });
   102→
   103→    if (prefetchTasks.length > 0) {
   104→      await Promise.all(prefetchTasks);
   105→    }
   106→
   107→    if (i + batchSize < generationIds.length) {
   108→      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, delayBetweenBatches));
   109→    }
   110→  }
   111→}
   112→
   113→export function mergeGenerationsWithTaskData(
   114→  generations: GenerationRow[],
   115→  queryClient: QueryClient,
   116→  projectId: string | null,
   117→): GenerationWithTaskData[] {
   118→  const effectiveProjectId = resolveTaskScopeProjectId(projectId);
   119→
   120→  return generations.map((generation) => {
   121→    const generationId = generation.generation_id ?? generation.id;
   122→    const cachedMapping = queryClient.getQueryData<GenerationTaskMappingCacheEntry>(
   123→      taskQueryKeys.generationMapping(generationId),
   124→    );
   125→    const taskId = cachedMapping?.taskId || null;
   126→    const taskData = (taskId && effectiveProjectId)
   127→      ? queryClient.getQueryData<Task>(taskQueryKeys.single(taskId, effectiveProjectId))
   128→      : null;
   129→    const taskMappingStatus = cachedMapping?.status ?? (taskId ? 'ok' : 'not_loaded');
   130→
   131→    return {
   132→      ...generation,
   133→      taskId,
   134→      taskData,
   135→      taskMappingStatus,
   136→      ...(cachedMapping?.queryError ? { taskMappingError: cachedMapping.queryError } : {}),
   137→    };
   138→  });
   139→}

     3→export function dedupeActiveLoras(loras: ActiveLora[]): ActiveLora[] {
     4→  const uniqueMap = new Map<string, ActiveLora>();
     5→  loras.forEach((lora) => {
     6→    if (!uniqueMap.has(lora.id)) {
     7→      uniqueMap.set(lora.id, lora);
     8→    }
     9→  });
    10→  return Array.from(uniqueMap.values());
    11→}

    92→
    93→  for (let i = 0; i < groupCount; i++) {
    94→    const particleCount = 3 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 13);
    95→    const spreadRadius = 20 + Math.random() * 80;
    96→
    97→    const particles = Array.from({ length: particleCount }, () => {
    98→      const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
    99→      const distance = Math.random() * spreadRadius;
   100→
   101→      return {
   102→        offsetX: Math.cos(angle) * distance,
   103→        offsetY: Math.sin(angle) * distance,
   104→        size: 0.5 + Math.random() * 2.5,
   105→        phase: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
   106→      };
   107→    });
   108→
   109→    const speed = 0.15 + Math.random() * 0.6;
   110→
   111→    groups.push({
   112→      cx: Math.random() * width,
   113→      cy: Math.random() * height,
   114→      vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed,
   115→      vy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed,
   116→      targetVx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed,
   117→      targetVy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed,
   118→      speed,
   119→      particles,
   120→      opacity: Math.random() * 0.3,
   121→      targetOpacity: 0.15 + Math.random() * 0.25,
   122→      fadeSpeed: 0.0005 + Math.random() * 0.001,
   123→      nextDirectionChange:
   124→        now + DIRECTION_CHANGE_MIN_MS + Math.random() * DIRECTION_CHANGE_RANGE_MS,
   125→      nextFadeChange: now + FADE_CHANGE_MIN_MS + Math.random() * FADE_CHANGE_RANGE_MS,
   126→    });
   127→  }
   128→
   129→  return groups;
   130→}
   131→
   132→function initializeStars(width: number, height: number): Star[] {
   133→  const starCount = Math.floor((width * height) / STAR_AREA_PER_STAR);
   134→  const stars = Array.from({ length: starCount }, () => createRegularStar(width, height));
   135→  stars.push(createClaudeStar(width, height));
   136→  return stars;
   137→}
   138→
   139→function drawStar(
   140→  ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D,
   141→  star: Star,
   142→  pulseOpacity: number,
   143→  isClaudeStar: boolean
   144→): void {
   145→  ctx.beginPath();
   146→
   147→  if (isClaudeStar) {
   148→    const glowSize = star.size + Math.sin(performance.now() * star.twinkleSpeed) * 0.5;
   149→    const gradient = ctx.createRadialGradient(star.x, star.y, 0, star.x, star.y, glowSize * 3);
   150→    gradient.addColorStop(0, `rgba(255, 126, 95, ${pulseOpacity})`);
   151→    gradient.addColorStop(0.3, `rgba(255, 146, 115, ${pulseOpacity * 0.6})`);
   152→    gradient.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255, 166, 135, 0)');
   153→
   154→    ctx.fillStyle = gradient;
   155→    ctx.arc(star.x, star.y, glowSize * 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
   156→    ctx.fill();
   157→
   158→    ctx.beginPath();
   159→    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 126, 95, ${pulseOpacity})`;
   160→    ctx.arc(star.x, star.y, star.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
   161→    ctx.fill();
   162→    return;
   163→  }
   164→
   165→  ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 255, 255, ${pulseOpacity})`;
   166→  ctx.arc(star.x, star.y, star.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
   167→  ctx.fill();
   168→}
   169→
   170→function updateAndDrawStars(
   171→  ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D,
   172→  canvas: HTMLCanvasElement,
   173→  stars: Star[],
   174→  parallaxX: number,
   175→  parallaxY: number,
   176→  time: number
   177→): void {
   178→  stars.forEach((star, index) => {
   179→    const isClaudeStar = index === stars.length - 1;
   180→
   181→    star.baseX = wrapPosition(star.baseX + star.vx, canvas.width, 50);
   182→    star.baseY = wrapPosition(star.baseY + star.vy, canvas.height, 50);
   183→
   184→    const depth = star.size * 0.5;
   185→    star.x = star.baseX - parallaxX * depth;
   186→    star.y = star.baseY - parallaxY * depth;
   187→
   188→    const pulseOpacity = Math.max(
   189→      0,
   190→      Math.min(1, star.opacity + Math.sin(time * star.twinkleSpeed + star.twinklePhase) * 0.3)
   191→    );
   192→
   193→    drawStar(ctx, star, pulseOpacity, isClaudeStar);
   194→  });
   195→}
   196→
   197→function calculateWanderingMasterOpacity(startTime: number, now: number): number {
   198→  const timeSinceStart = now - startTime;
   199→  if (timeSinceStart < WANDERING_FADE_DELAY_MS) {
   200→    return 0;
   201→  }
   202→
   203→  return Math.min(1, (timeSinceStart - WANDERING_FADE_DELAY_MS) / WANDERING_FADE_DURATION_MS);
   204→}
   205→
   206→function updateAndDrawWanderingGroups(
   207→  ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D,
   208→  canvas: HTMLCanvasElement,
   209→  groups: WanderingGroup[],
   210→  now: number,
   211→  time: number,
   212→  masterOpacity: number
   213→): void {
   214→  for (const group of groups) {
   215→    group.vx += (group.targetVx - group.vx) * 0.01;
   216→    group.vy += (group.targetVy - group.vy) * 0.01;
   217→
   218→    group.cx = wrapPosition(group.cx + group.vx, canvas.width, 100);
   219→    group.cy = wrapPosition(group.cy + group.vy, canvas.height, 100);
   220→
   221→    if (now > group.nextDirectionChange) {
   222→      group.targetVx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * group.speed;
   223→      group.targetVy = (Math.random() - 0.5) * group.speed;
   224→      group.nextDirectionChange =
   225→        now + DIRECTION_CHANGE_MIN_MS + Math.random() * DIRECTION_CHANGE_RANGE_MS;
   226→    }
   227→
   228→    group.opacity += (group.targetOpacity - group.opacity) * group.fadeSpeed * 16;
   229→
   230→    if (now > group.nextFadeChange) {
   231→      group.targetOpacity = Math.random() < 0.3 ? 0.05 : 0.15 + Math.random() * 0.25;
   232→      group.nextFadeChange = now + FADE_CHANGE_MIN_MS + Math.random() * FADE_CHANGE_RANGE_MS;
   233→    }
   234→
   235→    for (const particle of group.particles) {
   236→      const particleX = group.cx + particle.offsetX;
   237→      const particleY = group.cy + particle.offsetY;
   238→
   239→      if (
   240→        particleX < -50 ||
   241→        particleX > canvas.width + 50 ||
   242→        particleY < -50 ||
   243→        particleY > canvas.height + 50
   244→      ) {
   245→        continue;
   246→      }
   247→
   248→      const twinkle = 0.8 + Math.sin(time * 0.001 + particle.phase) * 0.2;
   249→      const particleOpacity = group.opacity * twinkle * masterOpacity;
   250→
   251→      ctx.beginPath();
   252→      ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 255, 255, ${particleOpacity})`;
   253→      ctx.arc(particleX, particleY, particle.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
   254→      ctx.fill();
   255→    }
   256→  }
   257→}
   258→
   259→function useConstellationAnimation(canvasRef: RefObject<HTMLCanvasElement>): void {
   260→  const starsRef = useRef<Star[]>([]);
   261→  const wanderingGroupsRef = useRef<WanderingGroup[]>([]);
   262→  const wanderingFadeInRef = useRef({ startTime: 0 });
   263→  const animationFrameRef = useRef<number>();
   264→  const mouseRef = useRef({ x: 0, y: 0 });
   265→  const smoothMouseRef = useRef({ x: 0, y: 0 });
   266→  const dimensionsRef = useRef({ width: 0, height: 0 });
   267→
   268→  useEffect(() => {
   269→    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
   270→    if (!canvas) return;
   271→
   272→    const context = canvas.getContext('2d');
   273→    if (!context) return;
   274→
   275→    const initializeScene = () => {
   276→      canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
   277→      canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
   278→
   279→      dimensionsRef.current = { width: canvas.width, height: canvas.height };
   280→      mouseRef.current = { x: canvas.width / 2, y: canvas.height / 2 };
   281→      smoothMouseRef.current = { x: canvas.width / 2, y: canvas.height / 2 };
   282→
   283→      starsRef.current = initializeStars(canvas.width, canvas.height);
   284→      wanderingGroupsRef.current = createWanderingGroups(
   285→        canvas.width,
   286→        canvas.height,
   287→        performance.now()
   288→      );
   289→      wanderingFadeInRef.current = { startTime: performance.now() };
   290→    };
   291→
   292→    const handleMouseMove = (event: MouseEvent) => {
   293→      mouseRef.current = { x: event.clientX, y: event.clientY };
   294→    };
   295→
   296→    const drawFrame = (time: number) => {
   297→      context.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
   298→
   299→      const lerpFactor = 0.05;
   300→      smoothMouseRef.current.x += (mouseRef.current.x - smoothMouseRef.current.x) * lerpFactor;
   301→      smoothMouseRef.current.y += (mouseRef.current.y - smoothMouseRef.current.y) * lerpFactor;
   302→
   303→      const parallaxX =
   304→        (smoothMouseRef.current.x - dimensionsRef.current.width / 2) * 0.02;
   305→      const parallaxY =
   306→        (smoothMouseRef.current.y - dimensionsRef.current.height / 2) * 0.02;
   307→
   308→      updateAndDrawStars(
   309→        context,
   310→        canvas,
   311→        starsRef.current,
   312→        parallaxX,
   313→        parallaxY,
   314→        time
   315→      );
   316→
   317→      const now = performance.now();
   318→      const masterOpacity = calculateWanderingMasterOpacity(
   319→        wanderingFadeInRef.current.startTime,
   320→        now
   321→      );
   322→
   323→      if (masterOpacity > 0) {
   324→        updateAndDrawWanderingGroups(
   325→          context,
   326→          canvas,
   327→          wanderingGroupsRef.current,
   328→          now,
   329→          time,
   330→          masterOpacity
   331→        );
   332→      }
   333→
   334→      animationFrameRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(drawFrame);
   335→    };
   336→
   337→    initializeScene();
   338→
   339→    window.addEventListener('resize', initializeScene);
   340→    window.addEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove);
   341→    animationFrameRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(drawFrame);
   342→
   343→    return () => {
   344→      window.removeEventListener('resize', initializeScene);
   345→      window.removeEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove);
   346→
   347→      if (animationFrameRef.current) {
   348→        cancelAnimationFrame(animationFrameRef.current);
   349→      }
   350→    };
   351→  }, [canvasRef]);
   352→}
   353→
   354→export const ConstellationCanvas = () => {
   355→  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);
   356→
   357→  useConstellationAnimation(canvasRef);
   358→
   359→  return (
   360→    <canvas
   361→      ref={canvasRef}
   362→      className="fixed inset-0 pointer-events-none"
   363→      style={{
   364→        zIndex: 3,
   365→        mixBlendMode: 'screen',
   366→        opacity: 0.6,
   367→      }}
   368→    />
   369→  );
   370→};
   371→

     2→
     3→type SettingsScopeIdentifier = 'user' | 'project' | 'shot';
     4→type SettingsScopeTableName = 'users' | 'projects' | 'shots';
     5→
     6→export function resolveSettingsScopeTable(scope: SettingsScopeIdentifier): SettingsScopeTableName {
     7→  switch (scope) {
     8→    case 'user':
     9→      return 'users';
    10→    case 'project':
    11→      return 'projects';
    12→    case 'shot':
    13→      return 'shots';
    14→  }
    15→
    16→  throw new Error(`Invalid settings scope: ${String(scope)}`);
    17→}
    18→
    19→export function selectSettingsForScope(scope: SettingsScopeIdentifier, id: string) {
    20→  const tableName = resolveSettingsScopeTable(scope);
    21→  return getSupabaseClient()
    22→    .from(tableName)
    23→    .select('settings')
    24→    .eq('id', id)
    25→    .single();
    26→}
    27→
    28→export function callUpdateToolSettingsAtomicRpc(
    29→  tableName: SettingsScopeTableName,
    30→  id: string,
    31→  toolId: string,
    32→  settings: Record<string, unknown>,
    33→) {
    34→  return getSupabaseClient().rpc('update_tool_settings_atomic', {
    35→    p_table_name: tableName,
    36→    p_id: id,
    37→    p_tool_id: toolId,
    38→    p_settings: settings,

   115→    const variantParams = activeVariant?.params as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;

   126→

     4→interface ComposedSignalResult {
     5→  signal: AbortSignal;
     6→  cleanup: () => void;
     7→}
     8→
     9→function getRequestUrl(input: URL | RequestInfo): string {
    10→  if (typeof input === 'string') {
    11→    return input;
    12→  }
    13→  if (input instanceof URL) {
    14→    return input.toString();
    15→  }
    16→  if (input instanceof Request) {

    18→  }
    19→  return String(input);
    20→}

    22→export function composeAbortSignals(timeoutSignal: AbortSignal, callerSignal?: AbortSignal): ComposedSignalResult {
    23→  if (!callerSignal) {
    24→    return {
    25→      signal: timeoutSignal,
    26→      cleanup: () => {},
    27→    };
    28→  }
    29→
    30→  const composedController = new AbortController();
    31→  const abort = () => {
    32→    if (!composedController.signal.aborted) {
    33→      composedController.abort();
    34→    }
    35→  };
    36→
    37→  if (timeoutSignal.aborted || callerSignal.aborted) {
    38→    abort();
    39→    return {
    40→      signal: composedController.signal,
    41→      cleanup: () => {},
    42→    };
    43→  }
    44→
    45→  const onAbort = () => abort();
    46→  timeoutSignal.addEventListener('abort', onAbort, { once: true });
    47→  callerSignal.addEventListener('abort', onAbort, { once: true });
    48→
    49→  return {
    50→    signal: composedController.signal,
    51→    cleanup: () => {
    52→      timeoutSignal.removeEventListener('abort', onAbort);
    53→      callerSignal.removeEventListener('abort', onAbort);
    54→    },
    55→  };
    56→}
    57→
    58→function toAbortError(reason: unknown): Error {
    59→  if (reason instanceof Error) {
    60→    return reason;
    61→  }
    62→
    63→  const message = typeof reason === 'string'
    64→    ? reason
    65→    : 'The operation was aborted.';
    66→
    67→  if (typeof DOMException !== 'undefined') {
    68→    return new DOMException(message, 'AbortError');
    69→  }
    70→
    71→  return new Error(message);
    72→}
    73→
    74→export function fetchWithTimeout(input: URL | RequestInfo, init: RequestInit = {}): Promise<Response> {
    75→  const url = getRequestUrl(input);
    76→  const isEdgeFunction = url.includes('/functions/v1/');
    77→  const isStorageUpload = url.includes('/storage/v1/object/');
    78→
    79→  if (!isEdgeFunction && !isStorageUpload) {
    80→    return fetch(input, init);
    81→  }
    82→
    83→  const callerSignal = init.signal instanceof AbortSignal ? init.signal : undefined;
    84→  if (callerSignal?.aborted) {
    85→    return Promise.reject(toAbortError(callerSignal.reason));
    86→  }
    87→
    88→  const controller = new AbortController();
    89→  const timeoutMs = isEdgeFunction ? EDGE_FUNCTION_TIMEOUT_MS : STORAGE_UPLOAD_TIMEOUT_MS;
    90→  const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), timeoutMs);
    91→  const { signal, cleanup } = composeAbortSignals(
    92→    controller.signal,
    93→    callerSignal,
    94→  );
    95→
    96→  return fetch(input, { ...init, signal }).finally(() => {
    97→    clearTimeout(timeoutId);
    98→    cleanup();
    99→  });
   100→}

   191→function useSharedMakeMainVariantState(params: {

   213→  const canMakeMainVariantFromChild = !!sourceGenerationData && !!media.location;

   312→// --- Presentation state (navigation, layout, effective media, button groups) ---
   313→
   314→function useLightboxNavigationModel(
   315→  core: SharedLightboxCoreProps,
   316→  navigation: SharedLightboxNavigationProps,
   317→) {
   318→  const { onClose, readOnly } = core;
   319→  const {
   320→    hasNext = false,
   321→    hasPrevious = false,
   322→    handleSlotNavNext,
   323→    handleSlotNavPrev,
   324→    swipeDisabled,
   325→    showNavigation,
   326→  } = navigation;
   327→  const { safeClose, activateClickShield } = useLightboxNavigation({
   328→    onNext: handleSlotNavNext,
   329→    onPrevious: handleSlotNavPrev,
   330→    onClose,
   331→  });
   332→  const swipeNavigation = useSwipeNavigation({
   333→    onSwipeLeft: () => {
   334→      if (hasNext) handleSlotNavNext();
   335→    },
   336→    onSwipeRight: () => {
   337→      if (hasPrevious) handleSlotNavPrev();
   338→    },
   339→    disabled: swipeDisabled || readOnly || !showNavigation,
   340→    hasNext,
   341→    hasPrevious,
   342→    threshold: 50,
   343→    velocityThreshold: 0.3,
   344→  });
   345→
   346→  return {
   347→    safeClose,
   348→    activateClickShield,
   349→    swipeNavigation,
   350→  };
   351→}
   352→
   353→function useSharedButtonGroupState(params: {
   354→  core: SharedLightboxCoreProps;
   355→  actions: SharedLightboxButtonGroupProps;
   356→  localStarred: boolean;
   357→  handleToggleStar: () => void;
   358→  toggleStarPending: boolean;
   359→  isAddingToReferences: boolean;
   360→  addToReferencesSuccess: boolean;
   361→  handleAddToReferences: () => Promise<void>;
   362→  handleAddToJoin: () => void;
   363→  isAddingToJoin: boolean;
   364→  addToJoinSuccess: boolean;
   365→  handleGoToJoin: () => void;
   366→}) {
   367→  const {
   368→    core,
   369→    actions,
   370→    localStarred,
   371→    handleToggleStar,
   372→    toggleStarPending,
   373→    isAddingToReferences,
   374→    addToReferencesSuccess,
   375→    handleAddToReferences,
   376→    handleAddToJoin,
   377→    isAddingToJoin,
   378→    addToJoinSuccess,
   379→    handleGoToJoin,
   380→  } = params;
   381→  const { media, onClose } = core;
   382→  const {
   383→    showDownload,
   384→    isDownloading,
   385→    onDelete,
   386→    isDeleting,
   387→    isUpscaling,
   388→    handleUpscale,
   389→  } = actions;
   390→  const handleDelete = useCallback(async () => {
   391→    if (!onDelete) return;
   392→    await invokeLightboxDelete(onDelete, media.id, 'MediaLightbox.delete');
   393→  }, [onDelete, media.id]);
   394→
   395→  return useMemo<LightboxButtonGroupProps>(() => ({
   396→    topRight: {
   397→      showDownload: !!showDownload,
   398→      isDownloading,
   399→      onDelete,
   400→      handleDelete,
   401→      isDeleting,
   402→      onClose,
   403→    },
   404→    bottomLeft: {
   405→      isUpscaling,
   406→      handleUpscale: async () => {
   407→        await Promise.resolve(handleUpscale());
   408→      },
   409→      localStarred,
   410→      handleToggleStar,
   411→      toggleStarPending,
   412→    },
   413→    bottomRight: {
   414→      isAddingToReferences,
   415→      addToReferencesSuccess,
   416→      handleAddToReferences,
   417→      handleAddToJoin,
   418→      isAddingToJoin,
   419→      addToJoinSuccess,
   420→      onGoToJoin: handleGoToJoin,
   421→    },
   422→  }), [
   423→    showDownload,
   424→    isDownloading,
   425→    onDelete,
   426→    handleDelete,
   427→    isDeleting,
   428→    onClose,
   429→    isUpscaling,
   430→    handleUpscale,
   431→    localStarred,
   432→    handleToggleStar,
   433→    toggleStarPending,
   434→    isAddingToReferences,
   435→    addToReferencesSuccess,
   436→    handleAddToReferences,
   437→    handleAddToJoin,
   438→    isAddingToJoin,
   439→    addToJoinSuccess,
   440→    handleGoToJoin,
   441→  ]);
   442→}
   443→
   444→function usePresentationState(
   445→  input: UseSharedLightboxStateInput,
   446→  variantsState: VariantsStateResult,
   447→  interactionState: InteractionState,
   448→) {
   449→  const navigation = useLightboxNavigationModel(input.core, input.navigation);
   450→  const { effectiveVideoUrl, effectiveMediaUrl, effectiveImageDimensions } = useEffectiveMedia({
   451→    isVideo: input.core.isVideo,
   452→    activeVariant: variantsState.activeVariant,
   453→    effectiveImageUrl: input.media.effectiveImageUrl,
   454→    imageDimensions: input.media.imageDimensions,
   455→    projectAspectRatio: input.media.projectAspectRatio,
   456→  });
   457→  const layout = useLayoutMode({
   458→    isMobile: input.core.isMobile,
   459→    showTaskDetails: input.layout.showTaskDetails ?? false,
   460→    isSpecialEditMode: input.layout.isSpecialEditMode,
   461→    isVideo: input.core.isVideo,
   462→    isInpaintMode: input.layout.isInpaintMode ?? false,
   463→    isMagicEditMode: input.layout.isMagicEditMode ?? false,
   464→  });
   465→  const buttonGroupProps = useSharedButtonGroupState({
   466→    core: input.core,
   467→    actions: input.actions,
   468→    localStarred: interactionState.star.localStarred,
   469→    handleToggleStar: interactionState.star.handleToggleStar,
   470→    toggleStarPending: interactionState.star.toggleStarMutation.isPending,
   471→    isAddingToReferences: interactionState.references.isAddingToReferences,
   472→    addToReferencesSuccess: interactionState.references.addToReferencesSuccess,
   473→    handleAddToReferences: interactionState.references.handleAddToReferences,
   474→    handleAddToJoin: interactionState.references.handleAddToJoin,
   475→    isAddingToJoin: interactionState.references.isAddingToJoin,
   476→    addToJoinSuccess: interactionState.references.addToJoinSuccess,
   477→    handleGoToJoin: interactionState.references.handleGoToJoin,
   478→  });
   479→
   480→  return {
   481→    variants: variantsState.section,
   482→    intendedActiveVariantIdRef: variantsState.intendedActiveVariantIdRef,
   483→    navigation,
   484→    effectiveMedia: {
   485→      videoUrl: effectiveVideoUrl,
   486→      mediaUrl: effectiveMediaUrl,
   487→      imageDimensions: effectiveImageDimensions,
   488→    },
   489→    layout: {
   490→      isTabletOrLarger: layout.isTabletOrLarger,
   491→      isTouchLikeDevice: layout.isTouchLikeDevice,
   492→      shouldShowSidePanel: layout.shouldShowSidePanel,
   493→      isUnifiedEditMode: layout.isUnifiedEditMode,
   494→      isPortraitMode: layout.isPortraitMode,
   495→    },
   496→    buttonGroupProps,
   497→  };
   498→}
   499→
   500→// --- Main orchestrator ---
   501→
   502→export function useSharedLightboxState(input: UseSharedLightboxStateInput): UseSharedLightboxStateReturn {
   503→  const variantsState = useSharedVariantsState(input.core);
   504→  const interactionState = useInteractionState(input, variantsState);
   505→  const presentationState = usePresentationState(input, variantsState, interactionState);
   506→
   507→  return {
   508→    variants: presentationState.variants,
   509→    intendedActiveVariantIdRef: presentationState.intendedActiveVariantIdRef,
   510→    navigation: presentationState.navigation,
   511→    star: interactionState.star,
   512→    references: interactionState.references,
   513→    lineage: interactionState.lineage,
   514→    shots: interactionState.shots,
   515→    sourceGeneration: interactionState.sourceGeneration,
   516→    makeMainVariant: interactionState.makeMainVariant,
   517→    effectiveMedia: presentationState.effectiveMedia,
   518→    layout: presentationState.layout,
   519→    buttonGroupProps: presentationState.buttonGroupProps,
   520→  };
   521→}

     2→import { installVisuals } from './visuals';
     3→
     4→interface InstallScenarioInput {
     5→  installMethod: InstallMethod;

    10→}
    11→
    12→function getInstallModalTitle({
    13→  platform,
    14→  browser,
    15→  isAppInstalled,
    16→}: Pick<InstallScenarioInput, 'platform' | 'browser' | 'isAppInstalled'>): string {
    17→  if (isAppInstalled) {
    18→    return 'Reigh is already installed!';
    19→  }

    22→  }

    25→  }

    27→}
    28→
    29→type InstallVisual = (typeof installVisuals)[keyof typeof installVisuals];
    30→
    31→interface InstallVisualRule {

    35→
    36→const installVisualRules: InstallVisualRule[] = [

    39→    Visual: installVisuals.mobileHomeIcon,

    47→    Visual: installVisuals.safariFileMenu,

    49→  {
    50→    matches: ({ installMethod, deviceType, browser }) => (
    51→      installMethod === 'safari-home-screen'
    52→      && deviceType === 'tablet'
    53→      && browser === 'chrome'
    54→    ),
    55→    Visual: installVisuals.ipadChromeShare,
    56→  },
    57→  {

    61→      && browser === 'edge'
    62→    ),
    63→    Visual: installVisuals.ipadEdgeShare,
    64→  },
    65→  {
    66→    matches: ({ installMethod, deviceType }) => (
    67→      installMethod === 'safari-home-screen'
    68→      && deviceType === 'tablet'
    69→    ),
    70→    Visual: installVisuals.ipadSafariShare,
    71→  },
    72→  {
    73→    matches: ({ installMethod, browser }) => (
    74→      installMethod === 'safari-home-screen'
    75→      && browser === 'chrome'
    76→    ),
    77→    Visual: installVisuals.chromeIosShare,
    78→  },
    79→  {
    80→    matches: ({ installMethod, browser }) => (
    81→      installMethod === 'safari-home-screen'
    82→      && browser === 'edge'
    83→    ),
    84→    Visual: installVisuals.edgeIosShare,
    85→  },
    86→  {
    87→    matches: ({ installMethod }) => installMethod === 'safari-home-screen',
    88→    Visual: installVisuals.safariShare,
    89→  },
    90→  {
    91→    matches: ({ platform }) => platform === 'android',
    92→    Visual: installVisuals.androidInstallPrompt,
    93→  },
    94→  {
    95→    matches: ({ browser }) => browser === 'chrome',
    96→    Visual: installVisuals.chromeInstall,
    97→  },
    98→  {
    99→    matches: ({ browser }) => browser === 'edge',
   100→    Visual: installVisuals.edgeAppAvailable,
   101→  },
   102→];
   103→
   104→function resolveInstallVisual(input: InstallScenarioInput): InstallVisual | null {
   105→  for (const rule of installVisualRules) {
   106→    if (rule.matches(input)) {
   107→      return rule.Visual;
   108→    }
   109→  }
   110→  return null;
   111→}
   112→
   113→interface InstallScenarioPresentation {
   114→  title: string;
   115→  Visual: InstallVisual | null;
   116→}
   117→
   118→export function resolveInstallScenarioPresentation(
   119→  input: InstallScenarioInput,
   120→): InstallScenarioPresentation {
   121→  const title = getInstallModalTitle(input);
   122→  const Visual = resolveInstallVisual(input);
   123→  return {
   124→    title,
   125→    Visual,
   126→  };
   127→}

1→const FRAME_QUANTIZATION_STEP = 4;
     2→const FRAME_QUANTIZATION_OFFSET = 1;
     3→
     4→export function quantizeTotalFrames(total: number, minTotal: number = 17): number {
     5→  const quantized =
     6→    Math.round((total - FRAME_QUANTIZATION_OFFSET) / FRAME_QUANTIZATION_STEP) *
     7→      FRAME_QUANTIZATION_STEP +
     8→    FRAME_QUANTIZATION_OFFSET;
     9→  return Math.max(minTotal, quantized);
    10→}
    11→
    12→export function getQuantizedGap(
    13→  desiredGap: number,
    14→  context: number,
    15→  minTotal: number = 17
    16→): number {
    17→  const total = context * 2 + desiredGap;
    18→  const quantizedTotal = quantizeTotalFrames(total, minTotal);
    19→  const gap = quantizedTotal - context * 2;
    20→
    21→  if (gap >= 1) {
    22→    return gap;
    23→  }
    24→
    25→  const minimumTotalWithPositiveGap = context * 2 + 1;
    26→  const validTotal = quantizeTotalFrames(minimumTotalWithPositiveGap, minTotal);
    27→  return validTotal - context * 2;
    28→}
    29→

    23→export function useAutoTopupState({ initialPurchaseAmount }: UseAutoTopupStateProps): UseAutoTopupStateReturn {

    33→  const [hasInitialized, setHasInitialized] = useState(false);
    34→
    35→  // Debounce timer for threshold changes
    36→  const thresholdDebounceRef = useRef<NodeJS.Timeout | null>(null);
    37→
    38→  // Initialize from server preferences
    39→  useEffect(() => {
    40→    if (autoTopupPreferences && !hasInitialized) {
    41→      setLocalAutoTopupEnabled(autoTopupPreferences.enabled);
    42→      setLocalAutoTopupThreshold(autoTopupPreferences.threshold || 10);
    43→
    44→      if (autoTopupPreferences.amount && autoTopupPreferences.amount !== 50) {
    45→        setPurchaseAmount(autoTopupPreferences.amount);
    46→      }
    47→
    48→      setHasInitialized(true);
    49→    }
    50→  }, [autoTopupPreferences, hasInitialized]);
    51→
    52→  // Auto-update threshold for new users when purchase amount changes
    53→  useEffect(() => {
    54→    if (hasInitialized && autoTopupPreferences && autoTopupPreferences.threshold === 10 && purchaseAmount !== 50) {
    55→      const defaultThreshold = Math.max(1, Math.floor(purchaseAmount / 5));
    56→      setLocalAutoTopupThreshold(defaultThreshold);
    57→    }
    58→  }, [purchaseAmount, hasInitialized, autoTopupPreferences]);

    61→  useEffect(() => {
    62→    return () => {
    63→      if (thresholdDebounceRef.current) {
    64→        clearTimeout(thresholdDebounceRef.current);
    65→      }
    66→    };
    67→  }, []);
    68→
    69→  // Computed auto-top-up state
    70→  const autoTopupState = useMemo((): AutoTopupState => {

    72→
    73→    const { setupCompleted } = autoTopupPreferences;
    74→    const enabled = localAutoTopupEnabled;
    75→
    76→    if (enabled && setupCompleted) return 'active';
    77→    if (!enabled && setupCompleted) return 'setup-but-disabled';
    78→    if (enabled && !setupCompleted) return 'enabled-but-not-setup';

    99→    }

   273→/**
   274→ * Shared delete mutation factory for generations and variants.
   275→ * @internal
   276→ */
   277→function useDeleteFromTable(table: 'generations' | 'generation_variants', entityLabel: string) {
   278→  return useMutation({
   279→    mutationFn: async (input: ScopedGenerationInput | ScopedVariantInput) => {
   280→      const projectId = ensureProjectScope(
   281→        input.projectId,
   282→        `useGenerationMutations.useDeleteFromTable.${table}.projectScope`,
   283→      );
   284→
   285→      if (table === 'generations') {
   286→        await verifyGenerationScope(
   287→          input.id,
   288→          projectId,
   289→          `useGenerationMutations.useDeleteFromTable.${table}.scopeValidation`,
   290→        );
   291→
   292→        const { data, error } = await deleteGenerationByScope({
   293→          id: input.id,
   294→          projectId,
   295→        });
   296→
   297→        if (error) {
   298→          normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(error, {
   299→            context: `useGenerationMutations.useDeleteFromTable.${table}`,
   300→            showToast: false,
   301→            logData: { id: input.id, projectId, entityLabel },
   302→          });
   303→        }
   304→
   305→        if (!data || data.length === 0) {
   306→          normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(new Error('No rows deleted while enforcing generation scope'), {
   307→            context: `useGenerationMutations.useDeleteFromTable.${table}.noRows`,
   308→            showToast: false,
   309→            logData: { id: input.id, projectId, entityLabel },
   310→          });
   311→        }
   312→
   313→        return;
   314→      }
   315→
   316→      const variantScope = await verifyVariantScope(
   317→        input.id,
   318→        projectId,
   319→        `useGenerationMutations.useDeleteFromTable.${table}.scopeValidation`,
   320→      );
   321→      const { data, error } = await deleteGenerationVariantByScope({
   322→        id: input.id,
   323→        generationId: variantScope.generationId,
   324→      });
   325→
   326→      if (error) {
   327→        normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(error, {
   328→          context: `useGenerationMutations.useDeleteFromTable.${table}`,
   329→          showToast: false,
   330→          logData: { id: input.id, projectId, entityLabel, generationId: variantScope.generationId },
   331→        });
   332→      }
   333→
   334→      if (!data || data.length === 0) {
   335→        normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(new Error('No rows deleted while enforcing variant scope'), {
   336→          context: `useGenerationMutations.useDeleteFromTable.${table}.noRows`,
   337→          showToast: false,
   338→          logData: { id: input.id, projectId, entityLabel, generationId: variantScope.generationId },
   339→        });
   340→      }
   341→    },
   342→    onError: (error: Error) => {
   343→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, {
   344→        context: `useDelete${entityLabel.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + entityLabel.slice(1)}`,
   345→        toastTitle: `Failed to delete ${entityLabel}`,
   346→      });
   347→    },
   348→  });
   349→}
   350→
   351→export function useDeleteGeneration() {
   352→  return useDeleteFromTable('generations', 'generation');
   353→}
   354→
   355→/**
   356→ * Delete a variant from generation_variants table.
   357→ * Use this for edit tools (edit-images, edit-video, character-animate) that create variants.
   358→ */
   359→export function useDeleteVariant() {
   360→  return useDeleteFromTable('generation_variants', 'variant');

   366→      return updateGenerationLocation({ id, location, thumbUrl, projectId });

     6→    target_project_id: targetProjectId,
     7→    target_shot_id: targetShotId,
     8→  });

    10→
    11→export function deleteProjectByIdForUser(projectId: string, userId: string) {
    12→  return getSupabaseClient().from('projects')
    13→    .delete()
    14→    .eq('id', projectId)
    15→    .eq('user_id', userId);
    16→}
    17→
    18→export function insertDefaultShotForProject(
    19→  projectId: string,
    20→  name: string,
    21→  settings: Record<string, Json | undefined>,
    22→) {
    23→  return getSupabaseClient().from('shots')
    24→    .insert({

    26→      project_id: projectId,
    27→      settings,
    28→    })
    29→    .select('id')
    30→    .single();

1→/**
     2→ * InlineSegmentVideo - Individual segment thumbnail in the output strip.
     3→ *
     4→ * The component routes render behavior through focused view modules:
     5→ * - SegmentPlaceholder: no child generation yet
     6→ * - SegmentProcessing: child exists but no output
     7→ * - SegmentPreview: full thumbnail/hover preview UI
     8→ */
     9→
    10→import type React from 'react';
    11→import { SegmentPlaceholder } from './inline-segment-video/SegmentPlaceholder';
    12→import { SegmentPreview } from './inline-segment-video/SegmentPreview';
    13→import { SegmentProcessing } from './inline-segment-video/SegmentProcessing';
    14→import type { InlineSegmentVideoProps } from './inline-segment-video/types';
    15→import { useLayoutProps } from './inline-segment-video/useLayoutProps';
    16→import { useSegmentBadge } from './inline-segment-video/useSegmentBadge';
    17→
    18→export const InlineSegmentVideo: React.FC<InlineSegmentVideoProps> = ({
    19→  slot,
    20→  pairIndex,
    21→  onClick,
    22→  projectAspectRatio,
    23→  isMobile = false,
    24→  leftPercent,
    25→  widthPercent,
    26→  layout = 'absolute',
    27→  compact = false,
    28→  onOpenPairSettings,
    29→  onDelete,
    30→  isDeleting = false,
    31→  isPending = false,
    32→  hasSourceChanged = false,
    33→  isScrubbingActive = false,
    34→  onScrubbingStart,
    35→  scrubbingContainerRef,
    36→  scrubbingContainerProps,
    37→  scrubbingProgress,
    38→  readOnly = false,
    39→}) => {
    40→  const layoutProps = useLayoutProps(layout, compact, isMobile, leftPercent, widthPercent);
    41→
    42→  const isPlaceholder = slot.type === 'placeholder';
    43→  const child = slot.type === 'child' ? slot.child : null;
    44→
    45→  const {
    46→    badgeData,
    47→    showNewBadge,
    48→    isNewWithNoVariants,
    49→    unviewedCount,
    50→    onMarkAllViewed,
    51→  } = useSegmentBadge(child);
    52→
    53→  if (isPlaceholder) {
    54→    return (
    55→      <SegmentPlaceholder
    56→        layoutProps={layoutProps}
    57→        isPending={isPending}
    58→        readOnly={readOnly}
    59→        pairIndex={pairIndex}
    60→        onOpenPairSettings={onOpenPairSettings}
    61→      />
    62→    );
    63→  }
    64→
    65→  if (!child || !child.location) {
    66→    return (
    67→      <SegmentProcessing
    68→        layoutProps={layoutProps}
    69→        isPending={isPending}
    70→        pairIndex={pairIndex}
    71→        onOpenPairSettings={onOpenPairSettings}
    72→      />
    73→    );
    74→  }
    75→
    76→  return (
    77→    <SegmentPreview
    78→      layoutProps={layoutProps}
    79→      child={child}
    80→      pairIndex={pairIndex}
    81→      onClick={onClick}
    82→      projectAspectRatio={projectAspectRatio}
    83→      onDelete={onDelete}
    84→      isDeleting={isDeleting}
    85→      isPending={isPending}
    86→      hasSourceChanged={hasSourceChanged}
    87→      scrubbing={{
    88→        isActive: isScrubbingActive,
    89→        onStart: onScrubbingStart,
    90→        containerRef: scrubbingContainerRef,
    91→        containerProps: scrubbingContainerProps,
    92→        progress: scrubbingProgress,
    93→      }}
    94→      badge={{
    95→        data: badgeData ?? null,
    96→        showNew: showNewBadge,
    97→        isNewWithNoVariants,
    98→        unviewedCount,
    99→        onMarkAllViewed,
   100→      }}
   101→    />
   102→  );
   103→};
   104→

1→/**
     2→ * Best-effort clipboard write that never throws.
     3→ * Returns true when the write succeeds.
     4→ */
     5→export async function writeClipboardTextSafe(
     6→  text: string,
     7→  options: { allowExecCommandFallback?: boolean } = {},
     8→): Promise<boolean> {
     9→  if (!text) {
    10→    return false;
    11→  }
    12→
    13→  if (typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && navigator.clipboard?.writeText) {
    14→    try {
    15→      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
    16→      return true;
    17→    } catch {
    18→      // fall through to optional fallback
    19→    }
    20→  }
    21→
    22→  if (!options.allowExecCommandFallback || typeof document === 'undefined') {
    23→    return false;
    24→  }
    25→
    26→  let textarea: HTMLTextAreaElement | null = null;
    27→  try {
    28→    textarea = document.createElement('textarea');
    29→    textarea.value = text;
    30→    textarea.style.position = 'fixed';
    31→    textarea.style.left = '-9999px';
    32→    document.body.appendChild(textarea);
    33→    textarea.select();
    34→    return document.execCommand('copy') === true;
    35→  } catch {
    36→    return false;
    37→  } finally {
    38→    if (textarea?.parentNode) {
    39→      textarea.parentNode.removeChild(textarea);
    40→    }
    41→  }
    42→}
    43→

1→export const fileToDataURL = (file: File): Promise<string> =>
     2→  new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
     3→    const reader = new FileReader();
     4→    reader.onload = () => resolve(reader.result as string);
     5→    reader.onerror = (error) => reject(error);
     6→    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
     7→  });
     8→
     9→export const dataURLtoFile = (
    10→  dataUrl: string,
    11→  filename: string,
    12→  fileType?: string
    13→): File | null => {
    14→  try {
    15→    const [metadata, payload] = dataUrl.split(',');
    16→    if (!metadata || !payload) {
    17→      throw new Error('Invalid Data URL format');
    18→    }
    19→
    20→    const mimeMatch = metadata.match(/:(.*?);/);
    21→    const mimeType =
    22→      fileType ||
    23→      (mimeMatch && mimeMatch[1]) ||
    24→      'application/octet-stream';
    25→    const decodedPayload = atob(payload);
    26→    const bytes = new Uint8Array(decodedPayload.length);
    27→
    28→    for (let i = 0; i < decodedPayload.length; i += 1) {
    29→      bytes[i] = decodedPayload.charCodeAt(i);
    30→    }
    31→
    32→    return new File([bytes], filename, { type: mimeType });
    33→  } catch {
    34→    return null;
    35→  }
    36→};
    37→

    40→/**
    41→ * Preload task mappings for a batch of generations in the background.

    43→export async function preloadGenerationTaskMappings(
    44→  queryClient: QueryClient,

    46→  projectId: string | null,

    57→  for (let i = 0; i < generationIds.length; i += batchSize) {
    58→    const batch = generationIds.slice(i, i + batchSize);
    59→
    60→    const mappings = await getPrimaryTaskMappingsForGenerations(batch, { projectId: effectiveProjectId ?? undefined });
    61→    let reportedBatchQueryFailure = false;

    63→    const prefetchTasks: Array<Promise<unknown>> = [];
    64→
    65→    batch.forEach((generationId) => {
    66→      const mapping = mappings.get(generationId);

    74→        reportedBatchQueryFailure = true;

    76→          context: 'GenerationTaskCache',
    77→          showToast: false,

    84→          queryFn: async () => {

   101→    });
   102→
   103→    if (prefetchTasks.length > 0) {
   104→      await Promise.all(prefetchTasks);
   105→    }
   106→
   107→    if (i + batchSize < generationIds.length) {
   108→      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, delayBetweenBatches));
   109→    }
   110→  }
   111→}
   112→
   113→export function mergeGenerationsWithTaskData(
   114→  generations: GenerationRow[],
   115→  queryClient: QueryClient,
   116→  projectId: string | null,
   117→): GenerationWithTaskData[] {
   118→  const effectiveProjectId = resolveTaskScopeProjectId(projectId);
   119→
   120→  return generations.map((generation) => {
   121→    const generationId = generation.generation_id ?? generation.id;
   122→    const cachedMapping = queryClient.getQueryData<GenerationTaskMappingCacheEntry>(
   123→      taskQueryKeys.generationMapping(generationId),
   124→    );
   125→    const taskId = cachedMapping?.taskId || null;
   126→    const taskData = (taskId && effectiveProjectId)
   127→      ? queryClient.getQueryData<Task>(taskQueryKeys.single(taskId, effectiveProjectId))
   128→      : null;
   129→    const taskMappingStatus = cachedMapping?.status ?? (taskId ? 'ok' : 'not_loaded');
   130→
   131→    return {
   132→      ...generation,
   133→      taskId,
   134→      taskData,
   135→      taskMappingStatus,
   136→      ...(cachedMapping?.queryError ? { taskMappingError: cachedMapping.queryError } : {}),
   137→    };
   138→  });
   139→}

1→import { getSupabaseClient } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
     2→
     3→type SettingsScopeIdentifier = 'user' | 'project' | 'shot';
     4→type SettingsScopeTableName = 'users' | 'projects' | 'shots';
     5→
     6→export function resolveSettingsScopeTable(scope: SettingsScopeIdentifier): SettingsScopeTableName {
     7→  switch (scope) {
     8→    case 'user':
     9→      return 'users';
    10→    case 'project':
    11→      return 'projects';
    12→    case 'shot':
    13→      return 'shots';
    14→  }
    15→
    16→  throw new Error(`Invalid settings scope: ${String(scope)}`);
    17→}
    18→
    19→export function selectSettingsForScope(scope: SettingsScopeIdentifier, id: string) {
    20→  const tableName = resolveSettingsScopeTable(scope);
    21→  return getSupabaseClient()
    22→    .from(tableName)
    23→    .select('settings')
    24→    .eq('id', id)
    25→    .single();
    26→}
    27→
    28→export function callUpdateToolSettingsAtomicRpc(
    29→  tableName: SettingsScopeTableName,
    30→  id: string,
    31→  toolId: string,
    32→  settings: Record<string, unknown>,
    33→) {
    34→  return getSupabaseClient().rpc('update_tool_settings_atomic', {
    35→    p_table_name: tableName,
    36→    p_id: id,
    37→    p_tool_id: toolId,
    38→    p_settings: settings,
    39→  });
    40→}
    41→

   398→export function useInlineEditState(
   399→  media: GenerationRow,
   400→  onNavigateToGeneration?: (generationId: string) => Promise<void>,
   401→): InlineEditStateResult {
   402→  const env = useInlineEditEnvironment(media);
   403→  const persistence = useInlineEditPersistence(env.actualGenerationId, env.selectedProjectId);
   404→  const activeVariant = persistence.variants.activeVariant;
   405→  const effectiveImageUrl = activeVariant?.location || env.effectiveImageUrl;
   406→  useEffect(() => {
   407→    env.setUpscaleActiveVariant(activeVariant?.location, activeVariant?.id);
   408→  }, [env, activeVariant?.location, activeVariant?.id]);
   409→  const { data: availableLoras } = usePublicLoras();
   410→  const { inpainting, magic } = useInlineEditInpaintingAndMagic(media, env, persistence);
   411→  const reposition = useInlineEditReposition(media, env, inpainting, persistence);
   412→  const img2img = useInlineEditImg2Img(media, env, persistence, availableLoras);
   413→  useInlineEditSettingsSync(env.actualGenerationId, persistence.editSettings, inpainting);
   414→  const { sourceGenerationData } = useSourceGeneration({
   415→    media,
   416→    onOpenExternalGeneration: onNavigateToGeneration
   417→      ? async (id) => onNavigateToGeneration(id)
   418→      : undefined,

1→/** @publicContract Supabase browser runtime entrypoint. */
     2→
     3→import {
     4→  type SupabaseClientAccessResult,
     5→  getSupabaseRuntimeClientResult,
     6→  initializeSupabaseClientRuntime,
     7→  normalizeSupabaseError,
     8→} from '@/integrations/supabase/runtime/supabaseRuntime';
     9→
    10→export type { SupabaseClientAccessResult };
    11→
    12→export interface SupabaseClientRegistry {
    13→  getClientResult: () => SupabaseClientAccessResult;
    14→}
    15→
    16→/** Runtime bootstrap entrypoint for app startup. */
    17→export function initializeSupabase() {
    18→  return initializeSupabaseClientRuntime();
    19→}
    20→
    21→export function initializeSupabaseResult(): SupabaseClientAccessResult {
    22→  try {
    23→    const client = initializeSupabase();
    24→    return { ok: true, client };
    25→  } catch (error) {
    26→    return { ok: false, error: normalizeSupabaseError(error) };
    27→  }
    28→}
    29→
    30→/** Runtime accessor that never throws; callers can branch on initialization state. */
    31→export function getSupabaseClientResult(): SupabaseClientAccessResult {
    32→  const result = getSupabaseRuntimeClientResult();
    33→  return result.ok ? result : { ok: false, error: normalizeSupabaseError(result.error) };
    34→}
    35→
    36→export const supabaseClientRegistry: SupabaseClientRegistry = {
    37→  getClientResult: getSupabaseClientResult,
    38→};
    39→
    40→/** Runtime accessor for initialized app runtime. Throws if bootstrap has not run. */
    41→export function getSupabaseClient() {
    42→  const result = supabaseClientRegistry.getClientResult();
    43→  if (!result.ok) {
    44→    throw result.error;
    45→  }
    46→  return result.client;
    47→}

1→import { useMemo } from 'react';
     2→import { useGetTask } from '@/shared/hooks/tasks/useTasks';
     3→import { deriveInputImages } from '@/shared/lib/taskParamsUtils';
     4→import { Task } from '@/types/tasks';
     5→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
     6→
     7→interface UseGenerationDetailsOptions {
     8→  taskId?: string;
     9→  task?: Task;
    10→  inputImages?: string[];
    11→  projectId?: string | null;
    12→}
    13→
    14→interface UseGenerationDetailsResult {
    15→  task: Task | undefined;
    16→  inputImages: string[];
    17→  isLoading: boolean;
    18→  isError: boolean;
    19→}
    20→
    21→/**
    22→ * Hook for fetching and preparing task data for GenerationDetails
    23→ *
    24→ * Handles:
    25→ * - Fetching task data by ID if provided
    26→ * - Using directly provided task if available
    27→ * - Deriving input images from task params
    28→ */
    29→export function useGenerationDetails({
    30→  taskId,
    31→  task: taskProp,
    32→  inputImages: inputImagesProp,
    33→  projectId,
    34→}: UseGenerationDetailsOptions): UseGenerationDetailsResult {
    35→  // Fetch task data if taskId is provided and no task prop
    36→  const { data: fetchedTask, isLoading, isError } = useGetTask(taskId || '', projectId);
    37→
    38→  // Use provided task or fetched task
    39→  const task = taskProp || fetchedTask;
    40→
    41→  // Derive input images from task if not explicitly provided
    42→  const inputImages = useMemo(() => {
    43→    if (inputImagesProp && inputImagesProp.length > 0) {
    44→      return inputImagesProp;
    45→    }
    46→    if (!task?.params) return [];
    47→    // Parse params if needed
    48→    let params: Record<string, unknown>;
    49→    try {
    50→      params = typeof task.params === 'string' ? JSON.parse(task.params) : task.params;
    51→    } catch (error) {
    52→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, {
    53→        context: 'useGenerationDetails.parseTaskParams',
    54→        showToast: false,
    55→        logData: { taskId: task?.id, hasStringParams: typeof task?.params === 'string' },
    56→      });
    57→      return [];
    58→    }
    59→    return deriveInputImages(params);
    60→  }, [inputImagesProp, task]);
    61→
    62→  return {
    63→    task,
    64→    inputImages,
    65→    isLoading: taskId ? isLoading && !taskProp : false,
    66→    isError: taskId ? isError && !taskProp : false,
    67→  };
    68→}
    69→

1→/**
     2→ * useAdjustedTaskDetails - Fetches variant source task and computes adjusted task details
     3→ *
     4→ * For variants created by tasks, shows the variant's source task params
     5→ * instead of the original generation's task. Preserves onApplySettingsFromTask.
     6→ */
     7→
     8→import { useMemo } from 'react';
     9→import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
    10→import { getSupabaseClient as supabase } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
    11→import { taskQueryKeys } from '@/shared/lib/queryKeys/tasks';
    12→import { VARIANT_TYPE } from '@/shared/constants/variantTypes';
    13→import {
    14→  getSourceTaskIdLegacyCompatible,
    15→  hasOrchestratorDetails,
    16→} from '@/shared/lib/taskIdHelpers';
    17→import type { TaskDetailsData } from '../types';
    18→import type { Task } from '@/types/tasks';
    19→
    20→// Helper to derive input images from task params
    21→function deriveInputImages(params: Record<string, unknown>): string[] {
    22→  const images: string[] = [];
    23→
    24→  // Check various param locations for input images
    25→  const orchestratorDetails = params.orchestrator_details as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
    26→
    27→  // Direct input_images array
    28→  if (Array.isArray(params.input_images)) {
    29→    images.push(...params.input_images.filter((img): img is string => typeof img === 'string'));
    30→  }
    31→
    32→  // Orchestrator details input_images
    33→  if (orchestratorDetails && Array.isArray(orchestratorDetails.input_images)) {
    34→    images.push(...orchestratorDetails.input_images.filter((img): img is string => typeof img === 'string'));
    35→  }
    36→
    37→  // Start/end image URLs
    38→  if (typeof params.start_image_url === 'string') images.push(params.start_image_url);
    39→  if (typeof params.end_image_url === 'string') images.push(params.end_image_url);
    40→
    41→  // Orchestrator start/end
    42→  if (orchestratorDetails) {
    43→    if (typeof orchestratorDetails.start_image_url === 'string') images.push(orchestratorDetails.start_image_url);
    44→    if (typeof orchestratorDetails.end_image_url === 'string') images.push(orchestratorDetails.end_image_url);
    45→  }
    46→
    47→  return [...new Set(images)]; // Dedupe
    48→}
    49→
    50→interface UseAdjustedTaskDetailsProps {
    51→  projectId?: string | null;
    52→  activeVariant: {
    53→    id: string;
    54→    params?: Record<string, unknown> | null;
    55→    variant_type?: string | null;
    56→    created_at?: string;
    57→    is_primary?: boolean | null;
    58→  } | null;
    59→  taskDetailsData: TaskDetailsData | undefined;
    60→  isLoadingVariants: boolean;
    61→  initialVariantId: string | undefined;
    62→}
    63→
    64→interface UseAdjustedTaskDetailsReturn {
    65→  adjustedTaskDetailsData: TaskDetailsData | undefined;
    66→  isLoadingVariantTask: boolean;
    67→}
    68→
    69→export function useAdjustedTaskDetails({
    70→  projectId,
    71→  activeVariant,
    72→  taskDetailsData,
    73→  isLoadingVariants,
    74→  initialVariantId,
    75→}: UseAdjustedTaskDetailsProps): UseAdjustedTaskDetailsReturn {
    76→  // Extract source_task_id and check if variant already has orchestrator_details
    77→  const { variantSourceTaskId, variantHasOrchestratorDetails } = useMemo(() => {
    78→    const variantParams = activeVariant?.params as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
    79→    return {
    80→      variantSourceTaskId: getSourceTaskIdLegacyCompatible(variantParams),
    81→      variantHasOrchestratorDetails: hasOrchestratorDetails(variantParams),
    82→    };
    83→  }, [activeVariant?.params]);
    84→
    85→  // Fetch the variant's source task when it differs from taskDetailsData
    86→  // Skip fetch if variant already has orchestrator_details (e.g., clip_join variants)
    87→  // NOTE: Uses ['tasks', 'single', taskId] query key to share cache with usePrefetchTaskData
    88→  const { data: variantSourceTask, isLoading: isLoadingVariantTask } = useQuery({
    89→    [REDACTED](variantSourceTaskId ?? '', projectId ?? null),
    90→    queryFn: async () => {
    91→      if (!variantSourceTaskId || !projectId) return null;
    92→      const { data, error } = await supabase().from('tasks')
    93→        .select('*')
    94→        .eq('id', variantSourceTaskId)
    95→        .eq('project_id', projectId)
    96→        .single();
    97→      if (error) {
    98→        console.error('[VariantTaskDetails] Error fetching source task:', error);
    99→        return null;
   100→      }
   101→      return data;
   102→    },
   103→    // Don't fetch if: no task ID, already have matching taskDetailsData, or variant has orchestrator_details
   104→    enabled: !!variantSourceTaskId
   105→      && !!projectId
   106→      && variantSourceTaskId !== taskDetailsData?.taskId
   107→      && !variantHasOrchestratorDetails,
   108→    staleTime: Infinity, // Task data is immutable - cache forever (matches prefetch)
   109→  });
   110→
   111→  // For variants, show the variant's source task params instead of the original task
   112→  // But ALWAYS preserve onApplySettingsFromTask so the Apply button shows
   113→  const adjustedTaskDetailsData = useMemo(() => {
   114→    // Check if we're viewing a variant that was created by a task (has source_task_id in params)
   115→    const variantParams = activeVariant?.params as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
   116→    const isTaskCreatedVariant = activeVariant && variantParams && (
   117→      variantParams.source_task_id ||
   118→      variantParams.created_from ||
   119→      (activeVariant.variant_type && activeVariant.variant_type !== VARIANT_TYPE.ORIGINAL)
   120→    );
   121→
   122→    if (isTaskCreatedVariant && variantParams) {
   123→      // Check if taskDetailsData already has the correct task (e.g., when opened from TasksPane)
   124→      const sourceTaskId = typeof variantParams.source_task_id === 'string' ? variantParams.source_task_id : undefined;
   125→      const hasMatchingTaskData = taskDetailsData?.taskId === sourceTaskId && taskDetailsData?.task?.params;
   126→
   127→      // Determine the best source of task params:
   128→      // 1. If taskDetailsData matches, use its params (already have full data)
   129→      // 2. If we fetched the source task, use its params
   130→      // 3. Fall back to variant params (may be incomplete)
   131→      // IMPORTANT: Use variant_type for display (e.g., 'clip_join'), NOT tool_type
   132→      // tool_type is the tool that launched the task (e.g., 'travel-between-images'),
   133→      // which is different from what kind of variant this is
   134→      let effectiveParams = variantParams;
   135→      const effectiveTaskType = activeVariant.variant_type || 'variant';
   136→
   137→      if (hasMatchingTaskData) {
   138→        effectiveParams = (taskDetailsData.task?.params ?? variantParams) as Record<string, unknown>;
   139→      } else if (!variantParams.orchestrator_details && variantSourceTask?.params) {
   140→        // Only use fetched task params if variant doesn't already have orchestrator_details
   141→        // clip_join variants store orchestrator_details directly, so we don't want to overwrite
   142→        try {
   143→          effectiveParams = typeof variantSourceTask.params === 'string'
   144→            ? JSON.parse(variantSourceTask.params)
   145→            : variantSourceTask.params;
   146→        } catch {
   147→          // Keep variantParams as fallback on parse failure
   148→        }
   149→      }
   150→      // Otherwise keep variantParams which may already have orchestrator_details (e.g., clip_join)
   151→
   152→      // Extract input images using shared utility
   153→      // This handles segment tasks (only segment images) vs full timeline tasks
   154→      const variantInputImages = deriveInputImages(effectiveParams);
   155→
   156→      return {
   157→        task: {
   158→          id: activeVariant.id,
   159→          taskType: effectiveTaskType,
   160→          params: effectiveParams,
   161→          status: 'Complete' as Task['status'],
   162→          createdAt: activeVariant.created_at || new Date().toISOString(),
   163→          projectId: '',
   164→        } as Task,
   165→        isLoading: isLoadingVariantTask,
   166→        error: null,
   167→        inputImages: variantInputImages,
   168→        taskId: sourceTaskId ?? activeVariant.id,
   169→        // ALWAYS preserve onApplySettingsFromTask so Apply button shows for all variants
   170→        onApplySettingsFromTask: taskDetailsData?.onApplySettingsFromTask,
   171→      };
   172→    }
   173→
   174→    // If variants are still loading AND we don't have task data yet, show loading
   175→    // But if we already have task data cached, show it immediately rather than blocking on variants
   176→    // This provides better UX when task data is prefetched/cached
   177→    // ALSO check if we're waiting for initialVariantId to be applied (clicked a specific variant)
   178→    const waitingForInitialVariant = initialVariantId &&
   179→      (!activeVariant || activeVariant.id !== initialVariantId);
   180→
   181→    // Only override to loading if:
   182→    // 1. Waiting for a specific variant (user clicked a variant)
   183→    // 2. Variants loading AND no active variant AND task details still loading
   184→    //    (If task details finished - either has task or knows there's none - don't block on variants)
   185→    const shouldShowLoading = waitingForInitialVariant ||
   186→      (isLoadingVariants && !activeVariant && taskDetailsData?.isLoading);
   187→
   188→    if (shouldShowLoading) {
   189→      return taskDetailsData ? { ...taskDetailsData, isLoading: true } : taskDetailsData;
   190→    }
   191→
   192→    // For all other cases, use the generation's task details as-is
   193→    return taskDetailsData;
   194→  }, [taskDetailsData, activeVariant, variantSourceTask, isLoadingVariantTask, isLoadingVariants, initialVariantId]);
   195→
   196→  return {
   197→    adjustedTaskDetailsData,
   198→    isLoadingVariantTask,
   199→  };
   200→}
   201→
