1→import type { AppError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/errors';
     2→import {
     3→  reportError,
     4→  type ErrorReportOptions,
     5→} from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/coreReporter';
     6→import { presentRuntimeError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeErrorPresenter';
     7→
     8→export interface RuntimeErrorOptions extends ErrorReportOptions {
     9→  toastTitle?: string;
    10→  showToast?: boolean;
    11→}
    12→
    13→/** Normalize unknown errors and route them through the shared presenter. */
    14→export function normalizeAndPresentError(error: unknown, options: RuntimeErrorOptions): AppError {
    15→  const { context, logData, onError, toastTitle, showToast } = options;
    16→  const appError = reportError(error, { context, logData, onError });
    17→
    18→  const shouldShowToast = showToast ?? appError.showToast;
    19→  if (shouldShowToast) {
    20→    presentRuntimeError(appError, toastTitle);
    21→  }
    22→
    23→  return appError;
    24→}
    25→
    26→/** Normalize, present, then throw for caller-level control-flow stops. */
    27→export function normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(error: unknown, options: RuntimeErrorOptions): never {
    28→  throw normalizeAndPresentError(error, options);
    29→}

    18→export function useAuthReferralFinalize() {

    48→      context: 'useAuthReferralFinalize.finalize',

    54→          p_fingerprint: referralFingerprint,

    56→        if (error) {

    58→        }
    59→        removeStorageItems(REFERRAL_KEYS, 'useAuthReferralFinalize.cleanup');
    60→        return { finalized: true };
    61→      },

    63→  }, []);

     9→
    10→export type { SupabaseClientAccessResult };
    11→
    12→export interface SupabaseClientRegistry {
    13→  getClientResult: () => SupabaseClientAccessResult;
    14→}
    15→
    16→/** Runtime bootstrap entrypoint for app startup. */
    17→export function initializeSupabase() {
    18→  return initializeSupabaseClientRuntime();
    19→}
    20→
    21→export function initializeSupabaseResult(): SupabaseClientAccessResult {
    22→  try {
    23→    const client = initializeSupabase();
    24→    return { ok: true, client };
    25→  } catch (error) {
    26→    return { ok: false, error: normalizeSupabaseError(error) };
    27→  }
    28→}
    29→
    30→/** Runtime accessor that never throws; callers can branch on initialization state. */
    31→export function getSupabaseClientResult(): SupabaseClientAccessResult {
    32→  const result = getSupabaseRuntimeClientResult();
    33→  return result.ok ? result : { ok: false, error: normalizeSupabaseError(result.error) };
    34→}
    35→
    36→export const supabaseClientRegistry: SupabaseClientRegistry = {
    37→  getClientResult: getSupabaseClientResult,
    38→};
    39→
    40→/** Runtime accessor for initialized app runtime. Throws if bootstrap has not run. */
    41→export function getSupabaseClient() {
    42→  const result = supabaseClientRegistry.getClientResult();
    43→  if (!result.ok) {
    44→    throw result.error;
    45→  }
    46→  return result.client;
    47→}

     4→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
     5→import {

     7→  operationSuccess,
     8→  type OperationResult,
     9→} from '@/shared/lib/operationResult';
    10→
    11→type OAuthIntentCacheResult = OperationResult<{ cached: boolean }>;
    12→
    13→function cacheOAuthIntentFlag(): OAuthIntentCacheResult {
    14→  try {
    15→    localStorage.setItem('oauthInProgress', 'true');
    16→    return operationSuccess({ cached: true }, { policy: 'best_effort' });
    17→  } catch (error) {
    18→    return operationFailure(error, {
    19→      policy: 'degrade',
    20→      recoverable: true,
    21→      errorCode: 'oauth_intent_cache_failed',
    22→      message: 'Unable to cache OAuth intent in local storage.',
    23→      cause: error,
    24→    });
    25→  }
    26→}
    27→
    28→export function useDiscordSignIn() {
    29→  return useCallback(async () => {
    30→    const supabaseResult = getSupabaseClientResult();
    31→    if (!supabaseResult.ok) {
    32→      return operationFailure(supabaseResult.error, {
    33→        policy: 'degrade',
    34→        recoverable: true,
    35→        errorCode: 'supabase_runtime_uninitialized',
    36→        message: 'Supabase runtime is not initialized yet.',
    37→      });
    38→    }
    39→    const supabase = supabaseResult.client;
    40→    const intentCacheResult = cacheOAuthIntentFlag();
    41→    if (!intentCacheResult.ok) {
    42→      normalizeAndPresentError(intentCacheResult.error, {
    43→        context: 'useDiscordSignIn.cacheOauthIntent',
    44→        showToast: false,
    45→        logData: {
    46→          errorCode: intentCacheResult.errorCode,
    47→          policy: intentCacheResult.policy,
    48→          recoverable: intentCacheResult.recoverable,
    49→        },
    50→      });
    51→    }
    52→
    53→    const oauthStartResult = await runAuthSupabaseOperation({
    54→      context: 'useDiscordSignIn.startOAuth',
    55→      errorCode: 'discord_oauth_start_failed',
    56→      showToast: true,
    57→      toastTitle: 'Failed to start Discord sign-in. Please try again.',
    58→      run: async () => {
    59→        const { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithOAuth({
    60→          provider: 'discord',
    61→          options: {
    62→            redirectTo: window.location.origin,
    63→          },
    64→        });
    65→
    66→        if (error) {
    67→          throw error;
    68→        }
    69→
    70→        return { started: true as const };
    71→      },
    72→    });
    73→
    74→    if (!oauthStartResult.ok) {

    78→    return operationSuccess(

    81→        oauthIntentCached: intentCacheResult.ok,
    82→      },
    83→      {
    84→        policy: intentCacheResult.ok ? oauthStartResult.policy : 'degrade',
    85→      },
    86→    );
    87→  }, []);

1→const EDGE_FUNCTION_TIMEOUT_MS = 60_000;
     2→const STORAGE_UPLOAD_TIMEOUT_MS = 30_000;
     3→
     4→interface ComposedSignalResult {
     5→  signal: AbortSignal;
     6→  cleanup: () => void;
     7→}
     8→
     9→function getRequestUrl(input: URL | RequestInfo): string {
    10→  if (typeof input === 'string') {
    11→    return input;
    12→  }
    13→  if (input instanceof URL) {
    14→    return input.toString();
    15→  }
    16→  if (input instanceof Request) {
    17→    return input.url;
    18→  }
    19→  return String(input);
    20→}
    21→
    22→export function composeAbortSignals(timeoutSignal: AbortSignal, callerSignal?: AbortSignal): ComposedSignalResult {
    23→  if (!callerSignal) {
    24→    return {
    25→      signal: timeoutSignal,
    26→      cleanup: () => {},
    27→    };
    28→  }
    29→
    30→  const composedController = new AbortController();
    31→  const abort = () => {
    32→    if (!composedController.signal.aborted) {
    33→      composedController.abort();
    34→    }
    35→  };
    36→
    37→  if (timeoutSignal.aborted || callerSignal.aborted) {
    38→    abort();
    39→    return {
    40→      signal: composedController.signal,
    41→      cleanup: () => {},
    42→    };
    43→  }
    44→
    45→  const onAbort = () => abort();
    46→  timeoutSignal.addEventListener('abort', onAbort, { once: true });
    47→  callerSignal.addEventListener('abort', onAbort, { once: true });
    48→
    49→  return {
    50→    signal: composedController.signal,
    51→    cleanup: () => {
    52→      timeoutSignal.removeEventListener('abort', onAbort);
    53→      callerSignal.removeEventListener('abort', onAbort);
    54→    },
    55→  };
    56→}
    57→
    58→function toAbortError(reason: unknown): Error {
    59→  if (reason instanceof Error) {
    60→    return reason;
    61→  }
    62→
    63→  const message = typeof reason === 'string'
    64→    ? reason
    65→    : 'The operation was aborted.';
    66→
    67→  if (typeof DOMException !== 'undefined') {
    68→    return new DOMException(message, 'AbortError');
    69→  }
    70→
    71→  return new Error(message);
    72→}
    73→
    74→export function fetchWithTimeout(input: URL | RequestInfo, init: RequestInit = {}): Promise<Response> {
    75→  const url = getRequestUrl(input);
    76→  const isEdgeFunction = url.includes('/functions/v1/');
    77→  const isStorageUpload = url.includes('/storage/v1/object/');
    78→
    79→  if (!isEdgeFunction && !isStorageUpload) {
    80→    return fetch(input, init);
    81→  }
    82→
    83→  const callerSignal = init.signal instanceof AbortSignal ? init.signal : undefined;
    84→  if (callerSignal?.aborted) {
    85→    return Promise.reject(toAbortError(callerSignal.reason));
    86→  }
    87→
    88→  const controller = new AbortController();
    89→  const timeoutMs = isEdgeFunction ? EDGE_FUNCTION_TIMEOUT_MS : STORAGE_UPLOAD_TIMEOUT_MS;
    90→  const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), timeoutMs);
    91→  const { signal, cleanup } = composeAbortSignals(
    92→    controller.signal,
    93→    callerSignal,
    94→  );
    95→
    96→  return fetch(input, { ...init, signal }).finally(() => {
    97→    clearTimeout(timeoutId);
    98→    cleanup();
    99→  });
   100→}
   101→

     3→import { requireContextValue } from './contextGuard';
     4→
     5→export type AIInputMode = "voice" | "text"
     6→
     7→interface AIInputModeContextValue {
     8→  mode: AIInputMode
     9→  setMode: (mode: AIInputMode) => void
    10→  isLoading: boolean
    11→}
    12→
    13→const AIInputModeContext = React.createContext<AIInputModeContextValue | null>(null)
    14→
    15→export function AIInputModeProvider({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
    16→  const { value, update, isLoading } = useUserUIState('aiInputMode', { mode: 'voice' })
    17→
    18→  const setMode = React.useCallback((mode: AIInputMode) => {
    19→    update({ mode })
    20→  }, [update])
    21→
    22→  // Memoize context value to prevent unnecessary re-renders of consumers
    23→  const contextValue = React.useMemo(() => ({
    24→    mode: value.mode,
    25→    setMode,
    26→    isLoading
    27→  }), [value.mode, setMode, isLoading])
    28→
    29→  return (
    30→    <AIInputModeContext.Provider value={contextValue}>
    31→      {children}
    32→    </AIInputModeContext.Provider>
    33→  )
    34→}
    35→
    36→export function useAIInputMode() {
    37→  return requireContextValue(
    38→    React.useContext(AIInputModeContext),
    39→    'useAIInputMode',
    40→    'AIInputModeProvider',
    41→  );
    42→}

    16→export function isAutoGeneratedShortPrompt(
    17→  shortPrompt: string | undefined,
    18→  previousFullPrompt: string,
    19→): boolean {
    20→  const normalizedShortPrompt = shortPrompt?.trim() ?? '';
    21→  if (!normalizedShortPrompt) {

    41→      notifyPaginatedTaskFetchSuccess(cacheProjectKey);
    42→      return result;
    43→    } catch (error) {
    44→      notifyPaginatedTaskFetchFailure(cacheProjectKey, error);
    45→      normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(error, {
    46→        context: 'useTasks.fetchPaginatedTasks',
    47→        showToast: false,
    48→        logData: { cacheProjectKey },
    49→      });
    50→    }
    51→  };
    52→}
    53→
    54→// Helper to convert DB row (snake_case) to Task interface (camelCase)
    55→// Exported for use in prefetch utilities
    56→export { mapDbTaskToTask };
    57→
    58→// Hook to get a single task by ID
    59→// Uses IMMUTABLE_PRESET since task data rarely changes after creation
    60→function resolveTaskProjectScope(projectId?: string | null): string | null {
    61→  if (projectId && projectId.trim().length > 0) {
    62→    return projectId;
    63→  }
    64→  const selectedProjectId = getProjectSelectionFallbackId();
    65→  if (selectedProjectId && selectedProjectId.trim().length > 0) {
    66→    return selectedProjectId;
    67→  }
    68→  return null;
    69→}
    70→
    71→export const useGetTask = (taskId: string, projectId?: string | null) => {
    72→  const effectiveProjectId = resolveTaskProjectScope(projectId);
    73→
    74→  return useQuery<Task | null, Error>({
    75→    [REDACTED](taskId, effectiveProjectId),
    76→    queryFn: async () => {
    77→      const supabaseResult = getSupabaseClientResult();
    78→      if (!supabaseResult.ok) {
    79→        normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(supabaseResult.error, {
    80→          context: 'useTasks.useGetTask',
    81→          showToast: false,
    82→          logData: { taskId, projectId: effectiveProjectId },
    83→        });
    84→      }
    85→
    86→      const { data, error } = await supabaseResult.client
    87→        .from('tasks')
    88→        .select('*')
    89→        .eq('id', taskId)
    90→        .eq('project_id', effectiveProjectId!)
    91→        .maybeSingle();
    92→
    93→      if (error) {
    94→        normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(error, {
    95→          context: 'useTasks.useGetTask',
    96→          showToast: false,
    97→          logData: { taskId, projectId: effectiveProjectId },
    98→        });
    99→      }
   100→
   101→      if (!data) {
   102→        return null;
   103→      }
   104→
   105→      return mapDbTaskToTask(data);
   106→    },
   107→    enabled: !!taskId && !!effectiveProjectId,
   108→    // Task data is essentially immutable once created - cache aggressively
   109→    ...QUERY_PRESETS.immutable,
   110→  });
   111→};
   112→
   113→// Hook to list tasks with pagination - GALLERY PATTERN
   114→export const usePaginatedTasks = (params: PaginatedTasksParams) => {
   115→  const { projectId, status, limit = 50, offset = 0, taskType, allProjects, allProjectIds } = params;
   116→  const page = Math.floor(offset / limit) + 1;
   117→  const effectiveProjectId: string | null = projectId ?? null;
   118→  const cacheProjectKey = allProjects ? 'all' : effectiveProjectId;
   119→  const safeCacheProjectKey = cacheProjectKey ?? '__no-project__';
   120→  const visibleTaskTypes = getVisibleTaskTypes();
   121→  const smartPollingConfig = useSmartPollingConfig(taskQueryKeys.paginated(safeCacheProjectKey));
   122→
   123→  const query = useQuery<PaginatedTasksResponse, Error>({
   124→    queryKey: [...taskQueryKeys.paginated(safeCacheProjectKey), page, limit, status, taskType],
   125→    queryFn: createPaginatedTasksQueryFn({
   126→      allProjects,
   127→      allProjectIds,
   128→      effectiveProjectId,
   129→      status,
   130→      taskType,
   131→      visibleTaskTypes,
   132→      limit,
   133→      offset,
   134→      page,
   135→    }, safeCacheProjectKey),
   136→    enabled: allProjects ? !!allProjectIds?.length : !!effectiveProjectId,
   137→    placeholderData: keepPreviousData,
   138→    ...QUERY_PRESETS.realtimeBacked,
   139→    ...smartPollingConfig,
   140→    refetchIntervalInBackground: true,
   141→    retry: STANDARD_RETRY,
   142→    retryDelay: STANDARD_RETRY_DELAY,
   143→  });
   144→
   145→  useProcessingRefetchGuard(status, query);
   146→
   147→  return query;
   148→};
   149→

     7→
     8→import { BatchImageGenerationTaskParams } from '@/shared/lib/tasks/imageGeneration';
     9→import { joinPromptParts } from '@/shared/lib/promptAssembly';
    10→import { PromptEntry, HiresFixConfig, ReferenceApiParams } from '../types';
    11→import { toShortPrompt } from './promptUtils';
    12→
    13→interface BuildBatchTaskParamsInput {
    14→  projectId: string;
    15→  prompts: PromptEntry[];
    16→  imagesPerPrompt: number;
    17→  shotId: string | null;
    18→  beforePromptText: string;
    19→  afterPromptText: string;
    20→  styleBoostTerms: string; // Appended to prompts, NOT sent to API
    21→  isLocalGenerationEnabled: boolean;
    22→  hiresFixConfig: HiresFixConfig;
    23→  modelName: string; // Model name for task type mapping (e.g., 'qwen-image', 'qwen-image-2512', 'z-image')
    24→  // Reference params grouped together - snake_case to match API directly
    25→  referenceParams: Partial<ReferenceApiParams>;
    26→}
    27→
    28→export function buildBatchTaskParams(input: BuildBatchTaskParamsInput): BatchImageGenerationTaskParams {
    29→  const styleBoostTerms = input.styleBoostTerms?.trim() ?? '';
    30→  const effectiveAfterText = joinPromptParts(
    31→    [input.afterPromptText, styleBoostTerms],
    32→    'legacy_batch_comma',
    33→  );
    34→  const referenceParams = {
    35→    ...(input.referenceParams.style_reference_image !== undefined && {
    36→      style_reference_image: input.referenceParams.style_reference_image,
    37→    }),
    38→    ...(input.referenceParams.subject_reference_image !== undefined && {
    39→      subject_reference_image: input.referenceParams.subject_reference_image,
    40→    }),
    41→    ...(input.referenceParams.style_reference_strength !== undefined && {
    42→      style_reference_strength: input.referenceParams.style_reference_strength,
    43→    }),
    44→    ...(input.referenceParams.subject_strength !== undefined && {
    45→      subject_strength: input.referenceParams.subject_strength,
    46→    }),
    47→    ...(input.referenceParams.subject_description !== undefined && {
    48→      subject_description: input.referenceParams.subject_description,
    49→    }),
    50→    ...(input.referenceParams.in_this_scene !== undefined && {
    51→      in_this_scene: input.referenceParams.in_this_scene,
    52→    }),
    53→    ...(input.referenceParams.in_this_scene_strength !== undefined && {
    54→      in_this_scene_strength: input.referenceParams.in_this_scene_strength,
    55→    }),
    56→    ...(input.referenceParams.reference_mode !== undefined && {
    57→      reference_mode: input.referenceParams.reference_mode,
    58→    }),
    59→  };
    60→
    61→  return {
    62→    project_id: input.projectId,
    63→    prompts: input.prompts.map(p => {
    64→      const combinedFull = joinPromptParts(
    65→        [input.beforePromptText, p.fullPrompt, effectiveAfterText],
    66→        'batch_comma',
    67→      );
    68→      return {
    69→        id: p.id,
    70→        fullPrompt: combinedFull,
    71→        shortPrompt: p.shortPrompt || toShortPrompt(combinedFull),
    72→      };
    73→    }),
    74→    imagesPerPrompt: input.imagesPerPrompt,
    75→    loras: [],
    76→    shot_id: input.shotId || undefined,
    77→    model_name: input.modelName,
    78→    steps: input.isLocalGenerationEnabled ? input.hiresFixConfig.base_steps : undefined,
    79→    // Reference params - passthrough explicit values only (already snake_case)
    80→    ...referenceParams,
    81→    // Resolution scaling params - always sent regardless of local generation mode
    82→    resolution_scale: input.hiresFixConfig.resolution_scale,
    83→    resolution_mode: input.hiresFixConfig.resolution_mode,
    84→    custom_aspect_ratio: input.hiresFixConfig.custom_aspect_ratio,
    85→    // Phase 1 params - only for local generation
    86→    ...(input.isLocalGenerationEnabled && {

    92→      hires_steps: input.hiresFixConfig.hires_steps,
    93→      hires_denoise: input.hiresFixConfig.hires_denoise,
    94→      lightning_lora_strength_phase_2: input.hiresFixConfig.lightning_lora_strength_phase_2,
    95→      // phaseLoraStrengths is UI structure, transform to API format
    96→      additional_loras: Object.fromEntries(
    97→        (input.hiresFixConfig.phaseLoraStrengths ?? []).map(lora => [
    98→          lora.loraPath,
    99→          `${lora.pass1Strength};${lora.pass2Strength}`
   100→        ])
   101→      ),
   102→    }),
   103→  };
   104→}

     3→type SettingsScopeIdentifier = 'user' | 'project' | 'shot';
     4→type SettingsScopeTableName = 'users' | 'projects' | 'shots';
     5→
     6→export function resolveSettingsScopeTable(scope: SettingsScopeIdentifier): SettingsScopeTableName {
     7→  switch (scope) {
     8→    case 'user':
     9→      return 'users';
    10→    case 'project':
    11→      return 'projects';
    12→    case 'shot':
    13→      return 'shots';
    14→  }

    19→export function selectSettingsForScope(scope: SettingsScopeIdentifier, id: string) {
    20→  const tableName = resolveSettingsScopeTable(scope);
    21→  return getSupabaseClient()
    22→    .from(tableName)
    23→    .select('settings')
    24→    .eq('id', id)
    25→    .single();
    26→}

    29→  tableName: SettingsScopeTableName,
    30→  id: string,

    32→  settings: Record<string, unknown>,

    37→    p_tool_id: toolId,

   180→function applyPromptAffixes(settings: EffectiveSettings, prompt: string): string {
   181→  return joinPromptParts(
   182→    [settings.textBeforePrompts, prompt, settings.textAfterPrompts],
   183→    'segment_space',
   184→  );
   185→}
   186→
   187→async function createTaskOrThrow(taskParams: ReturnType<BuildTaskParams>): Promise<string> {
   188→  const result = await createIndividualTravelSegmentTask(taskParams);
   189→  if (!result.task_id) {
   190→    throw new Error('Failed to create task');
   191→  }
   192→  return result.task_id;
   193→}
   194→
   195→async function saveEnhancedPromptMetadata(
   196→  runtime: SubmitSegmentRuntime,
   197→  task: SegmentTaskContext,
   198→  queryClient: QueryClient,
   199→  enhancedPromptResult: string,
   200→  promptToEnhance: string,
   201→  basePrompt: string,
   202→): Promise<void> {
   203→  if (!task.pairShotGenerationId || enhancedPromptResult === promptToEnhance) {
   204→    return;
   205→  }
   206→
   207→  const pairShotGenerationId = task.pairShotGenerationId;
   208→  const { data: current, error: fetchError } = await supabase().from('shot_generations')
   209→    .select('metadata')
   210→    .eq('id', pairShotGenerationId)
   211→    .single();
   212→
   213→  if (fetchError) {
   214→    runtime.reportNonFatalError?.('metadata_fetch', fetchError);
   215→    normalizeAndPresentError(fetchError, {
   216→      context: `${runtime.errorContext}.fetchMetadata`,
   217→      showToast: false,
   218→    });
   219→    return;
   220→  }
   221→
   222→  const currentMetadata = (current?.metadata as Record<string, unknown>) || {};
   223→  const { error: updateError } = await supabase().from('shot_generations')
   224→    .update({
   225→      metadata: {
   226→        ...currentMetadata,
   227→        enhanced_prompt: enhancedPromptResult,
   228→        base_prompt_for_enhancement: basePrompt,
   229→      },
   230→    })
   231→    .eq('id', pairShotGenerationId);
   232→
   233→  if (updateError) {
   234→    runtime.reportNonFatalError?.('metadata_update', updateError);
   235→    normalizeAndPresentError(updateError, {
   236→      context: `${runtime.errorContext}.saveEnhancedPrompt`,
   237→      showToast: false,
   238→    });
   239→    return;
   240→  }
   241→
   242→  queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED](pairShotGenerationId) });
   243→}
   244→
   245→async function maybeSaveSettings(runtime: SubmitSegmentRuntime): Promise<void> {
   246→  if (runtime.shouldSaveSettings) {
   247→    const didSave = await runtime.saveSettings();
   248→    if (!didSave) {
   249→      throw new Error('Failed to save segment settings before task submission');
   250→    }
   251→  }
   252→}
   253→
   254→async function submitStandardSegmentTask(runtime: SubmitSegmentRuntime): Promise<string> {
   255→  await maybeSaveSettings(runtime);
   256→  const finalPrompt = applyPromptAffixes(runtime.effectiveSettings, runtime.effectiveSettings.prompt?.trim() || '');
   257→  const taskParams = runtime.buildParams(finalPrompt);
   258→  return createTaskOrThrow(taskParams);
   259→}
   260→
   261→async function enhanceSegmentPrompt(
   262→  runtime: SubmitSegmentRuntime,
   263→  promptToEnhance: string,
   264→  defaultNumFrames: number,
   265→): Promise<string> {
   266→  const { data: enhanceResult, error: enhanceError } = await supabase().functions.invoke('ai-prompt', {
   267→    body: {
   268→      task: 'enhance_segment_prompt',
   269→      prompt: promptToEnhance,
   270→      temperature: 0.7,
   271→      numFrames: runtime.effectiveSettings.numFrames || defaultNumFrames,
   272→    },
   273→  });
   274→
   275→  if (enhanceError) {
   276→    runtime.reportNonFatalError?.('enhance_prompt', enhanceError);
   277→    normalizeAndPresentError(enhanceError, {
   278→      context: `${runtime.errorContext}.enhancePrompt`,
   279→      showToast: false,
   280→    });
   281→  }
   282→
   283→  return enhanceResult?.enhanced_prompt?.trim() || promptToEnhance;
   284→}
   285→
   286→async function submitEnhancedSegmentTask(
   287→  runtime: SubmitSegmentRuntime,
   288→  promptToEnhance: string,
   289→  defaultNumFrames: number,
   290→): Promise<string> {
   291→  await maybeSaveSettings(runtime);
   292→
   293→  const enhancedPromptResult = await enhanceSegmentPrompt(runtime, promptToEnhance, defaultNumFrames);
   294→  const originalPrompt = runtime.effectiveSettings.prompt?.trim() || '';
   295→  const originalPromptWithAffixes = applyPromptAffixes(runtime.effectiveSettings, originalPrompt);
   296→  const enhancedPromptWithAffixes = applyPromptAffixes(runtime.effectiveSettings, enhancedPromptResult);
   297→
   298→  await saveEnhancedPromptMetadata(
   299→    runtime,
   300→    runtime.task,
   301→    runtime.queryClient,
   302→    enhancedPromptResult,
   303→    promptToEnhance,
   304→    originalPrompt,
   305→  );
   306→
   307→  const taskParams = runtime.buildParams(originalPromptWithAffixes, enhancedPromptWithAffixes);
   308→  return createTaskOrThrow(taskParams);
   309→}
   310→
   311→/**
   312→ * Submit a segment task, handling both enhanced and standard prompt paths.
   313→ * Uses the task placeholder runner for lifecycle management.
   314→ * Returns immediately — task creation runs in the background (fire-and-forget).
   315→ */
   316→export function submitSegmentTask(input: SubmitSegmentTaskInput): void {
   317→  const {
   318→    taskLabel,
   319→    errorContext,
   320→    getSettings,
   321→    saveSettings,
   322→    shouldSaveSettings,
   323→    shouldEnhance,
   324→    enhancedPrompt,
   325→    defaultNumFrames,
   326→    images,
   327→    task,
   328→    run,
   329→    queryClient,
   330→    onGenerateStarted,
   331→    onNonFatalError,
   332→  } = input;
   333→
   334→  const effectiveSettings = getSettings();
   335→  const promptToEnhance = enhancedPrompt?.trim() || effectiveSettings.prompt?.trim() || '';
   336→  const buildParams = buildSubmitParamsBuilder(effectiveSettings, task, images);
   337→
   338→  // Notify parent for optimistic UI
   339→  onGenerateStarted?.();
   340→
   341→  const runtime: SubmitSegmentRuntime = {
   342→    errorContext,
   343→    shouldSaveSettings,
   344→    saveSettings,
   345→    effectiveSettings,
   346→    task,
   347→    queryClient,
   348→    buildParams,
   349→    reportNonFatalError: onNonFatalError,
   350→  };
   351→
   352→  // Fire and forget — run() handles add/resolve/refetch/remove/error lifecycle
   353→  void run({
   354→    taskType: 'individual_travel_segment',
   355→    label: taskLabel,
   356→    context: errorContext,
   357→    toastTitle: 'Failed to create task',
   358→    create: async () => {
   359→      if (shouldEnhance && promptToEnhance) {
   360→        return submitEnhancedSegmentTask(runtime, promptToEnhance, defaultNumFrames);
   361→      }
   362→      return submitStandardSegmentTask(runtime);
   363→    },
   364→  });
   365→}

    11→    }

    14→  }
    15→
    16→  return 1;

    14→export function usePromptHandlers(input: PromptHandlersInput) {

    16→
    17→  const handleAddPrompt = useCallback(() => {
    18→    markAsInteracted();
    19→    const newPrompt = {

    21→      fullPrompt: '',
    22→      shortPrompt: `Prompt ${prompts.length + 1}`,
    23→    };
    24→

    26→  }, [markAsInteracted, generatePromptId, prompts.length, setPrompts]);
    27→
    28→  const handleUpdatePrompt = useCallback(
    29→    (id: string, field: 'fullPrompt' | 'shortPrompt', value: string) => {
    30→      markAsInteracted();
    31→

    33→        prev.map((prompt) => {
    34→          if (prompt.id !== id) {
    35→            return prompt;
    36→          }
    37→
    38→          const updatedPrompt = { ...prompt, [field]: value };
    39→          if (
    40→            field === 'fullPrompt' &&
    41→            isAutoGeneratedShortPrompt(updatedPrompt.shortPrompt, prompt.fullPrompt)
    42→          ) {
    43→            updatedPrompt.shortPrompt = toShortPrompt(value);
    44→          }
    45→
    46→          return updatedPrompt;
    47→        })
    48→      );
    49→    },
    50→    [markAsInteracted, setPrompts]
    51→  );
    52→
    53→  const handleRemovePrompt = useCallback(
    54→    (id: string) => {
    55→      markAsInteracted();
    56→
    57→      if (prompts.length <= 1) {
    58→        toast.error('Cannot remove the last prompt.');
    59→        return;
    60→      }
    61→
    62→      setPrompts((prev) => prev.filter((prompt) => prompt.id !== id));
    63→    },

    66→

    71→

    90→      });
    91→
    92→      setPrompts(sanitizedPrompts);
    93→    },
    94→    [markAsInteracted, generatePromptId, setPrompts]
    95→  );
    96→
    97→  return {
    98→    handleAddPrompt,
    99→    handleUpdatePrompt,

   102→    handleSavePromptsFromModal,
   103→  };
   104→}

   252→      reject(new ToolSettingsError('cancelled', 'Request was cancelled', {
   253→        recoverable: true,
   254→      }));
   255→    };
   256→    const cleanup = () => {
   257→      signal.removeEventListener('abort', onAbort);
   258→    };
   259→    signal.addEventListener('abort', onAbort, { once: true });
   260→    promise.then(
   261→      (value) => {
   262→        cleanup();
   263→        resolve(value);
   264→      },
   265→      (error) => {
   266→        cleanup();
   267→        reject(error);
   268→      },
   269→    );
   270→  });
   271→}
   272→/** Fetch settings from all three scopes (user, project, shot) in parallel. */
   273→function fetchAllScopes(
   274→  supabaseClient: ReturnType<typeof getSupabaseClient>,
   275→  userId: string,
   276→  ctx: ToolSettingsContext,
   277→  signal?: AbortSignal,
   278→): Promise<[SettingsRow, SettingsRow, SettingsRow]> {
   279→  const userQuery = maybeAttachAbortSignal(
   280→    supabaseClient
   281→      .from('users')
   282→      .select('settings')
   283→      .eq('id', userId)
   284→      .maybeSingle(),
   285→    signal,
   286→  );
   287→  const projectQuery = ctx.projectId
   288→    ? maybeAttachAbortSignal(
   289→        supabaseClient
   290→          .from('projects')
   291→          .select('settings')
   292→          .eq('id', ctx.projectId)
   293→          .maybeSingle(),
   294→        signal,
   295→      )
   296→    : Promise.resolve({ data: null, error: null });
   297→  const shotQuery = ctx.shotId
   298→    ? maybeAttachAbortSignal(
   299→        supabaseClient
   300→          .from('shots')
   301→          .select('settings')
   302→          .eq('id', ctx.shotId)
   303→          .maybeSingle(),
   304→        signal,
   305→      )
   306→    : Promise.resolve({ data: null, error: null });
   307→  return Promise.all([
   308→    userQuery,
   309→    projectQuery,
   310→    shotQuery,
   311→  ]) as Promise<[SettingsRow, SettingsRow, SettingsRow]>;
   312→}
   313→/** Extract tool-specific settings from scope results and merge in priority order. */
   314→function extractAndMergeSettings(
   315→  userResult: SettingsRow,
   316→  projectResult: SettingsRow,
   317→  shotResult: SettingsRow,
   318→  toolId: string,
   319→  ctx: ToolSettingsContext,
   320→): SettingsFetchResult {
   321→  if (userResult.error) {
   322→    throw new ToolSettingsError(
   323→      'scope_fetch_failed',
   324→      `Failed to load user settings: ${getErrorMessage(userResult.error)}`,
   325→      { recoverable: true, cause: userResult.error, metadata: { scope: 'user' } },
   326→    );
   327→  }
   328→  if (ctx.projectId && projectResult.error) {
   329→    throw new ToolSettingsError(
   330→      'scope_fetch_failed',
   331→      `Failed to load project settings: ${getErrorMessage(projectResult.error)}`,
   332→      { recoverable: true, cause: projectResult.error, metadata: { scope: 'project', projectId: ctx.projectId } },
   333→    );
   334→  }
   335→  if (ctx.shotId && shotResult.error) {
   336→    throw new ToolSettingsError(
   337→      'scope_fetch_failed',
   338→      `Failed to load shot settings: ${getErrorMessage(shotResult.error)}`,
   339→      { recoverable: true, cause: shotResult.error, metadata: { scope: 'shot', shotId: ctx.shotId } },
   340→    );
   341→  }
   342→  const userSettingsData = userResult.data?.settings as Record<string, unknown> | null;
   343→  const projectSettingsData = projectResult.data?.settings as Record<string, unknown> | null;
   344→  const shotSettingsData = shotResult.data?.settings as Record<string, unknown> | null;
   345→  const userSettings = (userSettingsData?.[toolId] as Record<string, unknown>) ?? {};
   346→  const projectSettings = (projectSettingsData?.[toolId] as Record<string, unknown>) ?? {};
   347→  const shotSettings = (shotSettingsData?.[toolId] as Record<string, unknown>) ?? {};
   348→  const defaultSettings = (toolDefaultsRegistry[toolId] as Record<string, unknown> | undefined) ?? {};
   349→  const hasShotSettings = shotSettings && Object.keys(shotSettings).length > 0;
   350→  const merged = deepMerge(
   351→    {},
   352→    defaultSettings,
   353→    userSettings,
   354→    projectSettings,
   355→    shotSettings
   356→  );
   357→  return { settings: merged, hasShotSettings };
   358→}
   359→/**
   360→ * Fetch and merge tool settings from all scopes using direct Supabase calls.
   361→ *
   362→ * Pipeline: dedup → auth → fetchAllScopes → extractAndMerge.
   363→ * Uses single-flight deduplication for concurrent identical requests.
   364→ *
   365→ * @returns `{ settings, hasShotSettings }` wrapper
   366→ */
   367→export async function fetchToolSettingsSupabase(
   368→  toolId: string,
   369→  ctx: ToolSettingsContext,
   370→  signal?: AbortSignal
   371→): Promise<OperationResult<SettingsFetchResult>> {
   372→  try {
   373→    reportUnknownSettingsId(toolId);
   374→    if (signal?.aborted) {
   375→      return toOperationFailure(new ToolSettingsError('cancelled', 'Request was cancelled', {
   376→        recoverable: true,
   377→      }));
   378→    }
   379→    const { data: { user } } = await resolveAndCacheUserId();
   380→    if (!user) {
   381→      return toOperationFailure(new ToolSettingsError('auth_required', 'Authentication required'));
   382→    }
   383→    const userId = user.id;
   384→    const singleFlightKey = JSON.stringify({
   385→      toolId,
   386→      projectId: ctx.projectId ?? null,
   387→      shotId: ctx.shotId ?? null,
   388→      userId,
   389→    });
   390→    const existingPromise = inflightSettingsFetches.get(singleFlightKey);
   391→    if (existingPromise) {
   392→      const value = await raceWithAbort(existingPromise as Promise<SettingsFetchResult>, signal);
   393→      return operationSuccess(value);
   394→    }
   395→    const promise = (async (): Promise<SettingsFetchResult> => {
   396→      throwIfAborted(signal);
   397→      throwIfAborted(signal);
   398→      const supabaseClient = getSupabaseClient();
   399→      const [userResult, projectResult, shotResult] = await fetchAllScopes(supabaseClient, userId, ctx, signal);
   400→      throwIfAborted(signal);
   401→      const { data: { user: latestUser } } = await resolveAndCacheUserId();
   402→      if (!latestUser || latestUser.id !== userId) {
   403→        throw new ToolSettingsError('cancelled', 'Request was cancelled due to auth state change', {
   404→          recoverable: true,
   405→          metadata: { expectedUserId: userId, latestUserId: latestUser?.id ?? null },
   406→        });
   407→      }
   408→      return extractAndMergeSettings(userResult, projectResult, shotResult, toolId, ctx);
   409→    })();
   410→    inflightSettingsFetches.set(singleFlightKey, promise);
   411→    promise.finally(() => {
   412→      inflightSettingsFetches.delete(singleFlightKey);
   413→    }).catch(() => {});
   414→    const value = await raceWithAbort(promise, signal);
   415→    return operationSuccess(value);
   416→  } catch (error: unknown) {
   417→    if (isToolSettingsError(error) && error.code === 'cancelled') {
   418→      return toOperationFailure(error);
   419→    }
   420→    if (isCancellationError(error)) {
   421→      return toOperationFailure(new ToolSettingsError('cancelled', 'Request was cancelled', {
   422→        recoverable: true,
   423→        cause: error,
   424→      }));
   425→    }
   426→    const errorMsg = getErrorMessage(error);
   427→    const contextInfo = {
   428→      visibilityState: typeof document !== 'undefined' ? document.visibilityState : 'unknown',
   429→      hidden: typeof document !== 'undefined' ? document.hidden : false,
   430→      online: typeof navigator !== 'undefined' ? navigator.onLine : true,
   431→    };
   432→    if (errorMsg.includes('Auth timeout') || errorMsg.includes('Auth request was cancelled')) {
   433→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, {
   434→        context: 'fetchToolSettingsSupabase.authTimeout',
   435→        showToast: false,
   436→        logData: contextInfo,
   437→      });
   438→      return toOperationFailure(new ToolSettingsError(
   439→        'network',
   440→        'Authentication check timed out. Please retry.',
   441→        {
   442→          recoverable: true,
   443→          cause: error,
   444→          metadata: { ...contextInfo, reason: 'auth_timeout' },
   445→        },
   446→      ));
   447→    }
   448→    if (errorMsg.includes('Failed to fetch')) {
   449→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'fetchToolSettingsSupabase.network', showToast: false, logData: contextInfo });
   450→      return toOperationFailure(new ToolSettingsError(
   451→        'network',
   452→        'Network connection issue. Please check your internet connection.',
   453→        {
   454→          recoverable: true,
   455→          cause: error,
   456→          metadata: contextInfo,
   457→        },
   458→      ));
   459→    }
   460→    normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'fetchToolSettingsSupabase', showToast: false, logData: contextInfo });
   461→    return toOperationFailure(classifyToolSettingsError(error));
   462→  }
   463→}
   464→/**
   465→ * Fetch tool settings and throw `ToolSettingsError` on failure.
   466→ *
   467→ * Use this from hook boundaries that already model errors as thrown exceptions
   468→ * (for example React Query query functions and mutation pipelines) so read/write
   469→ * settings flows share the same error contract.
   470→ */
   471→export async function fetchToolSettingsSupabaseOrThrow(
   472→  toolId: string,
   473→  ctx: ToolSettingsContext,
   474→  signal?: AbortSignal,
   475→): Promise<SettingsFetchResult> {
   476→  const result = await fetchToolSettingsSupabase(toolId, ctx, signal);
   477→  if (!result.ok) {
   478→    throw toToolSettingsErrorFromOperationFailure(result);
   479→  }
   480→  return result.value;
   481→}
   482→

     2→import {
     3→  isMobileUA as isMobileUaSignal,
     4→  useIsMobile as useIsMobileSignal,

    10→export const isMobileUA = isMobileUaSignal;
    11→
    12→/** App-facing mobile signal with a defensive fallback for non-browser runtimes. */
    13→export function useIsMobile() {
    14→  const detected = useIsMobileSignal();
    15→  if (typeof window === 'undefined') {
    16→    return false;
    17→  }
    18→  return detected ?? window.innerWidth < 768;
    19→}
    20→
    21→/** App-facing tablet signal with a defensive fallback for non-browser runtimes. */
    22→export function useIsTablet() {
    23→  const detected = useIsTabletSignal();
    24→  if (typeof window === 'undefined') {
    25→    return false;
    26→  }
    27→  return detected ?? (window.innerWidth >= 768 && window.innerWidth < 1024);
    28→}
    29→
    30→/** App-facing touch capability signal with runtime fallback for browser environments. */
    31→export function useIsTouchDevice() {
    32→  const detected = useIsTouchDeviceSignal();
    33→  if (typeof window === 'undefined') {
    34→    return false;
    35→  }
    36→  if (detected !== undefined) {
    37→    return detected;
    38→  }
    39→  return 'ontouchstart' in window || navigator.maxTouchPoints > 0;
    40→}
    41→
    42→/** Composite device view model with normalized base signals from this public module. */
    43→export function useDeviceInfo() {
    44→  const viewModel = useDeviceInfoSignal();
    45→  const isMobile = useIsMobile();
    46→  const isTablet = useIsTablet();
    47→  const isTouchDevice = useIsTouchDevice();
    48→
    49→  return useMemo(() => ({
    50→    ...viewModel,
    51→    isTablet,
    52→    isPhone: isMobile && !isTablet,
    53→    isTouchDevice,
    54→  }), [viewModel, isMobile, isTablet, isTouchDevice]);

1→import { useEffect } from 'react';
     2→import type { MutableRefObject } from 'react';
     3→import type { PromptEntry } from '../../types';
     4→import type { PromptRoutingResult } from './types';
     5→
     6→interface PromptIdDedupInput {
     7→  prompts: PromptEntry[];
     8→  setPrompts: PromptRoutingResult['setPrompts'];
     9→  promptIdCounter: MutableRefObject<number>;
    10→}
    11→
    12→export function usePromptIdDedupEffect(input: PromptIdDedupInput): void {
    13→  const { prompts, setPrompts, promptIdCounter } = input;
    14→
    15→  useEffect(() => {
    16→    let nextId = prompts.reduce((max, prompt) => {
    17→      const match = /^prompt-(\d+)$/.exec(prompt.id || '');
    18→      if (!match) {
    19→        return max;
    20→      }
    21→
    22→      const numericId = parseInt(match[1], 10) + 1;
    23→      return numericId > max ? numericId : max;
    24→    }, 1);
    25→
    26→    const seenIds = new Set<string>();
    27→    let hadDuplicates = false;
    28→
    29→    const dedupedPrompts = prompts.map((prompt) => {
    30→      if (!seenIds.has(prompt.id)) {
    31→        seenIds.add(prompt.id);
    32→        return prompt;
    33→      }
    34→
    35→      hadDuplicates = true;
    36→      const newId = `prompt-${nextId++}`;
    37→      seenIds.add(newId);
    38→      return { ...prompt, id: newId };
    39→    });
    40→
    41→    if (hadDuplicates) {
    42→      setPrompts(dedupedPrompts);
    43→    }
    44→
    45→    if (nextId > promptIdCounter.current) {
    46→      promptIdCounter.current = nextId;
    47→    }
    48→  }, [prompts, setPrompts, promptIdCounter]);
    49→}
    50→

     3→import type { useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
     4→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
     5→import {
     6→  operationFailure,
     7→  operationSuccess,
     8→} from '@/shared/lib/operationResult';
     9→import {
    10→  deleteSegmentGenerationGroup,
    11→  syncSegmentDeletionCaches,
    12→} from '../services/segmentDeletionService';
    13→
    14→interface SegmentDeleteOperationResult {
    15→  deleted: boolean;
    16→}
    17→
    18→export function useDeleteSegmentHandler(
    19→  queryClient: ReturnType<typeof useQueryClient>,
    20→  setDeletingSegmentId: Dispatch<SetStateAction<string | null>>,
    21→  projectId?: string,
    22→) {
    23→  return useCallback(async (generationId: string) => {
    24→    if (!projectId) {
    25→      return operationFailure(new Error('Project scope is required for segment deletion'), {
    26→        policy: 'fail_closed',
    27→        recoverable: false,
    28→        errorCode: 'shot_editor_segment_delete_missing_project_scope',
    29→        message: 'Project scope is required for segment deletion',
    30→      });
    31→    }
    32→
    33→    setDeletingSegmentId(generationId);
    34→    try {
    35→      const deletion = await deleteSegmentGenerationGroup({
    36→        generationId,
    37→        projectId,
    38→      });
    39→
    40→      if (!deletion.deleted) {
    41→        return operationSuccess(
    42→          { deleted: false } satisfies SegmentDeleteOperationResult,
    43→          { policy: 'best_effort' },
    44→        );
    45→      }
    46→
    47→      await syncSegmentDeletionCaches({
    48→        queryClient,
    49→        projectId,
    50→        parentGenerationId: deletion.parentGenerationId,
    51→        idsToDelete: deletion.idsToDelete,
    52→      });
    53→
    54→      return operationSuccess(
    55→        { deleted: true } satisfies SegmentDeleteOperationResult,
    56→        { policy: 'best_effort' },
    57→      );
    58→    } catch (error) {
    59→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, {
    60→        context: 'SegmentDelete',
    61→        toastTitle: 'Failed to delete segment',

    63→      return operationFailure(error, {

    65→        recoverable: true,
    66→        errorCode: 'shot_editor_segment_delete_failed',
    67→        message: 'Failed to delete segment',
    68→      });
    69→    } finally {
    70→      setDeletingSegmentId(null);
    71→    }
    72→  }, [projectId, queryClient, setDeletingSegmentId]);
    73→}
    74→

1→/**
     2→ * DataFreshnessManager - Single source of truth for data freshness and polling decisions
     3→ *
     4→ * This class centralizes all decisions about:
     5→ * - Whether data is fresh (based on realtime events)
     6→ * - What polling intervals React Query should use
     7→ * - Realtime connection health status
     8→ */
     9→
    10→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
    11→import { registerDebugGlobal } from '@/shared/runtime/debugRegistry';
    12→
    13→type QueryKeyLike = readonly unknown[];
    14→type RealtimeStatus = 'connected' | 'disconnected' | 'error';
    15→type PollingInterval = number | false; // false = no polling
    16→type FreshnessSubscriber = () => void;
    17→
    18→function serializeQueryKey(queryKey: QueryKeyLike): string {
    19→  return JSON.stringify(queryKey);
    20→}
    21→
    22→function markQueryKeysFresh(
    23→  lastEventTimes: Map<string, number>,
    24→  queryKeys: readonly QueryKeyLike[],
    25→  now: number,
    26→): void {
    27→  queryKeys.forEach((queryKey) => {
    28→    lastEventTimes.set(serializeQueryKey(queryKey), now);
    29→  });
    30→}
    31→
    32→function getLastEventTime(
    33→  lastEventTimes: Map<string, number>,
    34→  queryKey: QueryKeyLike,
    35→): number | undefined {
    36→  return lastEventTimes.get(serializeQueryKey(queryKey));
    37→}
    38→
    39→function isQueryFresh(
    40→  lastEventTimes: Map<string, number>,
    41→  queryKey: QueryKeyLike,
    42→  freshnessThreshold: number,
    43→  now: number,
    44→): boolean {
    45→  const lastEvent = getLastEventTime(lastEventTimes, queryKey);
    46→  if (!lastEvent) {
    47→    return false;
    48→  }
    49→  return now - lastEvent < freshnessThreshold;
    50→}
    51→
    52→function buildQueryAgeDiagnostics(
    53→  lastEventTimes: Map<string, number>,
    54→  now: number,
    55→  parseQueryKey: (rawKey: string) => unknown,
    56→): Array<{ query: unknown; ageMs: number; ageSec: number }> {
    57→  return Array.from(lastEventTimes.entries()).map(([key, time]) => ({
    58→    query: parseQueryKey(key),
    59→    ageMs: now - time,
    60→    ageSec: Math.round((now - time) / 1000),
    61→  }));
    62→}
    63→
    64→interface DataFreshnessState {
    65→  realtimeStatus: RealtimeStatus;
    66→  lastEventTimes: Map<string, number>;
    67→  lastStatusChange: number;
    68→  /** Track consecutive fetch failures per query for circuit breaker */
    69→  fetchFailures: Map<string, { count: number; lastFailure: number }>;
    70→}
    71→
    72→class DataFreshnessManager {
    73→  private state: DataFreshnessState = {
    74→    realtimeStatus: 'disconnected',
    75→    lastEventTimes: new Map(),
    76→    lastStatusChange: Date.now(),
    77→    fetchFailures: new Map()
    78→  };
    79→
    80→  private subscribers = new Set<FreshnessSubscriber>();
    81→
    82→  // Circuit breaker settings
    83→  private readonly CIRCUIT_BREAKER_THRESHOLD = 3; // failures before backing off
    84→  private readonly CIRCUIT_BREAKER_RESET_MS = 60_000; // 1 minute to reset failure count
    85→
    86→  // Toast throttling - prevent spamming error toasts
    87→  private lastErrorToastTime = 0;
    88→  private readonly ERROR_TOAST_THROTTLE_MS = 30_000; // Only show error toast every 30 seconds
    89→
    90→  private parseQueryKey(rawKey: string): unknown {
    91→    try {
    92→      return JSON.parse(rawKey);
    93→    } catch {
    94→      return rawKey;
    95→    }
    96→  }
    97→
    98→  /**
    99→   * Report realtime connection status change
   100→   */
   101→  onRealtimeStatusChange(status: RealtimeStatus, _reason?: string) {
   102→    const previousStatus = this.state.realtimeStatus;
   103→    const now = Date.now();
   104→
   105→    // Ignore duplicate status changes to keep lastStatusChange stable.
   106→    // This allows the "recently connected" grace period in getPollingInterval to actually expire.
   107→    if (previousStatus === status) {
   108→      return; // Don't update state or notify subscribers for duplicates
   109→    }
   110→
   111→    // Actual status transition - update state
   112→    this.state.realtimeStatus = status;
   113→    this.state.lastStatusChange = now;
   114→
   115→    // Notify all subscribers that polling intervals may have changed
   116→    this.notifySubscribers();
   117→  }
   118→
   119→  /**
   120→   * Report that realtime events were received for specific queries
   121→   */
   122→  onRealtimeEvent(_eventType: string, affectedQueries: readonly QueryKeyLike[]) {
   123→    const now = Date.now();
   124→    markQueryKeysFresh(this.state.lastEventTimes, affectedQueries, now);
   125→
   126→    // Notify subscribers that data freshness has changed
   127→    this.notifySubscribers();
   128→  }
   129→
   130→  /**
   131→   * Get the appropriate polling interval for a query
   132→   * Returns false to disable polling when realtime is working well
   133→   */
   134→  getPollingInterval(queryKey: QueryKeyLike): PollingInterval {
   135→    const [REDACTED](queryKey);
   136→    const lastEvent = getLastEventTime(this.state.lastEventTimes, queryKey);
   137→    const now = Date.now();
   138→    const timeSinceStatusChange = now - this.state.lastStatusChange;
   139→
   140→    // If realtime is connected, trust it after it's been stable
   141→    if (this.state.realtimeStatus === 'connected') {
   142→      // If realtime just connected (< 30 seconds), give it time to prove it's stable
   143→      if (timeSinceStatusChange < 30000) {
   144→        return 30000; // 30 seconds - wait for realtime to prove it's stable
   145→      }
   146→
   147→      // If realtime has been stable for >30 seconds, trust it.
   148→      // "No events" just means "nothing changed" — not "realtime is broken".
   149→
   150→      if (lastEvent) {
   151→        const eventAge = now - lastEvent;
   152→
   153→        if (eventAge < 60000) { // Events within 1 minute
   154→          return false; // Disable polling — realtime is working
   155→        } else if (eventAge < 3 * 60 * 1000) { // Events within 3 minutes
   156→          return 60000; // 60 seconds - light backup polling
   157→        }
   158→      }
   159→
   160→      // Realtime stable for >30s but no events — this is normal when idle.
   161→      // Use very light polling as a safety net only.
   162→      if (timeSinceStatusChange > 5 * 60 * 1000) {
   163→        // Realtime been stable for >5 minutes - fully trust it
   164→        return false; // Disable polling — realtime is stable, idle is OK
   165→      } else {
   166→        // Realtime stable for 30s-5min - use safety net polling
   167→        return 60000; // 60 seconds - safety net while realtime proves long-term stability
   168→      }
   169→    }
   170→
   171→    // If realtime is disconnected or errored, use GRADUATED backoff polling
   172→    // to prevent thundering herd and connection overload
   173→    const disconnectedDuration = now - this.state.lastStatusChange;
   174→
   175→    // Check circuit breaker - if this query has had many failures, back off more
   176→    const failureInfo = this.state.fetchFailures.get(key);
   177→    const hasRecentFailures = failureInfo &&
   178→      (now - failureInfo.lastFailure) < this.CIRCUIT_BREAKER_RESET_MS &&
   179→      failureInfo.count >= this.CIRCUIT_BREAKER_THRESHOLD;
   180→
   181→    let pollingInterval: number;
   182→
   183→    if (hasRecentFailures) {
   184→      // Circuit breaker triggered - use much longer interval
   185→      pollingInterval = 60_000; // 60 seconds
   186→    } else if (disconnectedDuration < 30_000) {
   187→      // First 30 seconds: 15s polling (give realtime time to reconnect)
   188→      pollingInterval = 15_000;
   189→    } else if (disconnectedDuration < 2 * 60_000) {
   190→      // 30s - 2 minutes: 30s polling
   191→      pollingInterval = 30_000;
   192→    } else if (disconnectedDuration < 5 * 60_000) {
   193→      // 2-5 minutes: 45s polling
   194→      pollingInterval = 45_000;
   195→    } else {
   196→      // >5 minutes: 60s polling (realtime probably has issues)
   197→      pollingInterval = 60_000;
   198→    }
   199→
   200→    return pollingInterval;
   201→  }
   202→
   203→  /**
   204→   * Report a fetch failure for circuit breaker tracking
   205→   */
   206→  onFetchFailure(queryKey: QueryKeyLike, error: Error) {
   207→    const [REDACTED](queryKey);
   208→    const now = Date.now();
   209→    const existing = this.state.fetchFailures.get(key);
   210→
   211→    // Reset count if last failure was too long ago
   212→    const shouldReset = existing && (now - existing.lastFailure) > this.CIRCUIT_BREAKER_RESET_MS;
   213→
   214→    const newCount = shouldReset ? 1 : (existing?.count || 0) + 1;
   215→    this.state.fetchFailures.set(key, { count: newCount, lastFailure: now });
   216→
   217→    const isCircuitBreakerTriggered = newCount >= this.CIRCUIT_BREAKER_THRESHOLD;
   218→
   219→    const errorType = this.classifyError(error);
   220→
   221→    // Notify subscribers so polling intervals can adjust
   222→    if (isCircuitBreakerTriggered) {
   223→      this.notifySubscribers();
   224→
   225→      // Show user-facing error toast (throttled to prevent spam)
   226→      if (now - this.lastErrorToastTime > this.ERROR_TOAST_THROTTLE_MS) {
   227→        this.lastErrorToastTime = now;
   228→
   229→        this.reportCircuitBreakerError({
   230→          queryKey: key,
   231→          failureCount: newCount,
   232→          errorType,
   233→          error,
   234→        });
   235→      }
   236→    }
   237→  }
   238→
   239→  private reportCircuitBreakerError(input: {
   240→    queryKey: string;
   241→    failureCount: number;
   242→    errorType: string;
   243→    error: Error;
   244→  }) {
   245→    const userMessage = this.getUserFriendlyErrorMessage(input.errorType, input.failureCount);
   246→    normalizeAndPresentError(new Error('Data may be outdated. Will retry automatically.'), {
   247→      context: 'DataFreshnessManager.onFetchFailure',
   248→      toastTitle: userMessage,
   249→      showToast: true,
   250→      logData: {
   251→        [REDACTED](input.queryKey),
   252→        failureCount: input.failureCount,
   253→        errorType: input.errorType,
   254→        errorMessage: input.error.message,
   255→      },
   256→    });
   257→  }
   258→
   259→  /**
   260→   * Get a user-friendly error message based on error type
   261→   */
   262→  private getUserFriendlyErrorMessage(errorType: string, failureCount: number): string {
   263→    switch (errorType) {
   264→      case 'CONNECTION_CLOSED':
   265→      case 'NETWORK_ERROR':
   266→        return 'Connection issue detected';
   267→      case 'TIMEOUT':
   268→        return 'Server is slow to respond';
   269→      case 'RATE_LIMITED':
   270→        return 'Too many requests - slowing down';
   271→      case 'SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE':
   272→        return 'Service temporarily unavailable';
   273→      case 'AUTH_ERROR':
   274→        return 'Authentication issue - try refreshing';
   275→      default:
   276→        return `Connection issues (${failureCount} failures)`;
   277→    }
   278→  }
   279→
   280→  /**
   281→   * Report a successful fetch (resets circuit breaker)
   282→   */
   283→  onFetchSuccess(queryKey: QueryKeyLike) {
   284→    const [REDACTED](queryKey);
   285→    const existing = this.state.fetchFailures.get(key);
   286→
   287→    if (existing && existing.count > 0) {
   288→      // Reset failure count on success
   289→      this.state.fetchFailures.delete(key);
   290→    }
   291→  }
   292→
   293→  /**
   294→   * Classify error type for better logging and handling
   295→   */
   296→  private classifyError(error: Error): string {
   297→    const message = error.message?.toLowerCase() || '';
   298→
   299→    if (message.includes('connection_closed') || message.includes('err_connection_closed')) {
   300→      return 'CONNECTION_CLOSED';
   301→    }
   302→    if (message.includes('failed to fetch') || message.includes('network')) {
   303→      return 'NETWORK_ERROR';
   304→    }
   305→    if (message.includes('timeout') || message.includes('timed out')) {
   306→      return 'TIMEOUT';
   307→    }
   308→    if (message.includes('abort')) {
   309→      return 'ABORTED';
   310→    }
   311→    if (message.includes('401') || message.includes('unauthorized')) {
   312→      return 'AUTH_ERROR';
   313→    }
   314→    if (message.includes('429') || message.includes('rate limit')) {
   315→      return 'RATE_LIMITED';
   316→    }
   317→    if (message.includes('503') || message.includes('service unavailable')) {
   318→      return 'SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE';
   319→    }
   320→    return 'UNKNOWN';
   321→  }
   322→
   323→  /**
   324→   * Check if data for a query is considered fresh
   325→   */
   326→  isDataFresh(queryKey: QueryKeyLike, freshnessThreshold: number = 30000): boolean {
   327→    return isQueryFresh(this.state.lastEventTimes, queryKey, freshnessThreshold, Date.now());
   328→  }
   329→
   330→  /**
   331→   * Get current freshness state for debugging
   332→   */
   333→  getDiagnostics() {
   334→    const now = Date.now();
   335→    return {
   336→      realtimeStatus: this.state.realtimeStatus,
   337→      timeSinceStatusChange: now - this.state.lastStatusChange,
   338→      trackedQueries: this.state.lastEventTimes.size,
   339→      queryAges: buildQueryAgeDiagnostics(this.state.lastEventTimes, now, this.parseQueryKey),
   340→      subscriberCount: this.subscribers.size,
   341→      timestamp: now
   342→    };
   343→  }
   344→
   345→  /**
   346→   * Subscribe to freshness changes
   347→   * Returns unsubscribe function
   348→   */
   349→  subscribe(callback: () => void): () => void {
   350→    this.subscribers.add(callback);
   351→    return () => this.subscribers.delete(callback);
   352→  }
   353→
   354→  /**
   355→   * Clear all event history (useful for testing or project changes)
   356→   */
   357→  reset() {
   358→    this.state.lastEventTimes.clear();
   359→    this.state.fetchFailures.clear();
   360→    this.state.realtimeStatus = 'disconnected';
   361→    this.state.lastStatusChange = Date.now();
   362→    this.notifySubscribers();
   363→  }
   364→
   365→  /**
   366→   * Manually mark queries as fresh (useful for mutations)
   367→   */
   368→  markQueriesFresh(queryKeys: readonly QueryKeyLike[]) {
   369→    const now = Date.now();
   370→    markQueryKeysFresh(this.state.lastEventTimes, queryKeys, now);
   371→
   372→    this.notifySubscribers();
   373→  }
   374→
   375→  private notifySubscribers() {
   376→    this.subscribers.forEach((callback) => {
   377→      try {
   378→        callback();
   379→      } catch (error) {
   380→        normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'DataFreshnessManager', showToast: false });
   381→      }
   382→    });
   383→  }
   384→}
   385→
   386→// Singleton instance - single source of truth for the entire app
   387→export const dataFreshnessManager = new DataFreshnessManager();
   388→
   389→/** Dev-only helper for wiring debug globals during app bootstrap. */
   390→export function registerDataFreshnessManagerDebugGlobal(): void {
   391→  if (!import.meta.env.DEV || typeof window === 'undefined') {
   392→    return;
   393→  }
   394→
   395→  registerDebugGlobal(
   396→    '__DATA_FRESHNESS_MANAGER__',
   397→    dataFreshnessManager,
   398→    'DataFreshnessManager',
   399→  );
   400→}

   202→    return () => this.subscribers.delete(callback);
   203→  }
   204→
   205→  private emit(event: PreloadingEvent): void {
   206→    this.subscribers.forEach((callback) => {
   207→      try {
   208→        callback(event);
   209→      } catch (err) {
   210→        normalizeAndPresentError(err, { context: 'PreloadingService.subscriber', showToast: false });
   211→      }
   212→    });
   213→  }
   214→
   215→  // ===========================================================================
   216→  // DEBUGGING
   217→  // ===========================================================================
   218→
   219→  getDiagnostics(): {
   220→    state: PreloadingServiceState;
   221→    queue: { size: number; active: number };
   222→    tracker: ReturnType<typeof getLoadTrackerStats>;
   223→  } {
   224→    return {
   225→      state: { ...this.state },
   226→      queue: {
   227→        size: this.queue.size,
   228→        active: this.queue.activeCount,
   229→      },
   230→      tracker: getLoadTrackerStats(),
   231→    };
   232→  }
   233→}
   234→
   235→// =============================================================================
   236→// SINGLETON EXPORT
   237→// =============================================================================
   238→
   239→export const preloadingService = PreloadingService.getInstance();
   240→
   241→// Expose for debugging in browser console (dev only)
   242→if (import.meta.env.DEV && typeof window !== 'undefined') {
   243→  (window as unknown as { __PRELOADING_SERVICE__: PreloadingService }).__PRELOADING_SERVICE__ =
   244→    preloadingService;
   245→}

    11→export class AppError extends Error {

   171→export function isAppError(error: unknown): error is AppError {

   189→/**

   191→ */
   192→export function categorizeError(error: unknown, context?: Record<string, unknown>): AppError {
   193→  // Already an AppError
   194→  if (isAppError(error)) {
   195→    return error;
   196→  }
   197→
   198→  // Convert to Error if needed
   199→  const err = error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error));
   200→  const message = err.message.toLowerCase();
   201→
   202→  // Network errors
   203→  if (

   206→    message.includes('fetch') ||
   207→    message.includes('timeout') ||
   208→    message.includes('failed to fetch') ||

   212→  }
   213→
   214→  // Auth errors
   215→  if (
   216→    message.includes('unauthorized') ||
   217→    message.includes('forbidden') ||
   218→    message.includes('not authenticated') ||
   219→    message.includes('authentication required')
   220→  ) {
   221→    return AuthError.fromError(err, context);
   222→  }
   223→
   224→  // Validation errors
   225→  if (

   227→    message.includes('invalid') ||
   228→    message.includes('validation')
   229→  ) {
   230→    return new ValidationError(err.message, { context, cause: err });
   231→  }
   232→
   233→  // Default to generic AppError
   234→  return new AppError(err.message, { context, cause: err });

1→import type { AppError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/errors';
     2→import {
     3→  reportError,
     4→  type ErrorReportOptions,
     5→} from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/coreReporter';
     6→import { presentRuntimeError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeErrorPresenter';
     7→
     8→export interface RuntimeErrorOptions extends ErrorReportOptions {
     9→  toastTitle?: string;
    10→  showToast?: boolean;
    11→}
    12→
    13→/** Normalize unknown errors and route them through the shared presenter. */
    14→export function normalizeAndPresentError(error: unknown, options: RuntimeErrorOptions): AppError {
    15→  const { context, logData, onError, toastTitle, showToast } = options;
    16→  const appError = reportError(error, { context, logData, onError });
    17→
    18→  const shouldShowToast = showToast ?? appError.showToast;
    19→  if (shouldShowToast) {
    20→    presentRuntimeError(appError, toastTitle);
    21→  }
    22→
    23→  return appError;
    24→}
    25→
    26→/** Normalize, present, then throw for caller-level control-flow stops. */
    27→export function normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(error: unknown, options: RuntimeErrorOptions): never {
    28→  throw normalizeAndPresentError(error, options);
    29→}

    13→export function parseTaskParams(params: string | Record<string, unknown> | null | undefined): Record<string, unknown> {
    14→  if (!params) return {};
    15→  if (typeof params === 'string') {
    16→    try {
    17→      const parsed = JSON.parse(params);
    18→      return asRecord(parsed) ?? {};
    19→    } catch {
    20→      return {};
    21→    }
    22→  }
    23→  return asRecord(params) ?? {};
    24→}

    26→/**

    30→ * For orchestrated tasks: Returns all images from orchestrator

    36→export function deriveInputImages(parsedParams: Record<string, unknown>): string[] {
    37→  const params = parsedParams;
    38→  if (isTravelTaskParams(params)) {
    39→    const travelImages = deriveTravelInputImages(params);
    40→    if (travelImages.length > 0) {
    41→      return travelImages;

    46→  const orchestratorPayload = asRecord(params.full_orchestrator_payload);
    47→  const segmentParams = asRecord(params.individual_segment_params);
    48→
    49→  // Check if this is a segment task (individual segment of a larger generation)
    50→  const isSegmentTask = params?.segment_index !== undefined;
