   167→  imageUrl: string;
   168→  fileName: string;
   169→  fileType: string;
   170→  fileSize: number;
   171→  projectId: string;
   172→  prompt: string;
   173→  thumbnailUrl?: string;
   174→  /** Resolution in "WIDTHxHEIGHT" format (e.g., "1920x1080") */
   175→  resolution?: string;
   176→  /** Standard aspect ratio (e.g., "16:9") */
   177→  aspectRatio?: string;
   178→}): Promise<GenerationRow> {
   179→  const generationParams: Record<string, Json | undefined> = {
   180→    prompt: params.prompt,
   181→    source: 'external_upload',
   182→    original_filename: params.fileName,
   183→    file_type: params.fileType,
   184→    file_size: params.fileSize,
   185→  };
   186→
   187→  // Add dimension params if provided
   188→  if (params.resolution) {
   189→    generationParams.resolution = params.resolution;
   190→  }
   191→  if (params.aspectRatio) {
   192→    generationParams.aspect_ratio = params.aspectRatio;
   193→  }
   194→
   195→  const { data, error } = await createGenerationRecord({
   196→    imageUrl: params.imageUrl,
   197→    thumbnailUrl: params.thumbnailUrl || params.imageUrl,
   198→    fileType: params.fileType || 'image',
   199→    projectId: params.projectId,
   200→    generationParams,
   201→  });
   202→
   203→  if (error || !data) {
   204→    normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(error ?? new Error('Failed to create generation'), {
   205→      context: 'useCreateGeneration.createGeneration',
   206→      showToast: false,
   207→      logData: { projectId: params.projectId },
   208→    });
   209→  }
   210→
   211→  // Create the original variant for this generation
   212→  const { error: variantError } = await createGenerationPrimaryVariant({
   213→    generationId: data.id,
   214→    imageUrl: params.imageUrl,
   215→    thumbnailUrl: params.thumbnailUrl || params.imageUrl,
   216→    generationParams,
   217→    variantType: VARIANT_TYPE.ORIGINAL,
   218→  });
   219→
   220→  if (variantError) {
   221→    normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(variantError, {
   222→      context: 'useCreateGeneration.createVariant',
   223→      showToast: false,
   224→    });
   225→  }
   226→
   227→  return data;
   228→}
   229→
   230→/**
   231→ * Star/unstar a generation using direct Supabase call.
   232→ * @internal Used by useToggleGenerationStar hook.
   233→ */
   234→async function toggleGenerationStar(params: ScopedGenerationInput & { starred: boolean }): Promise<void> {
   235→  const projectId = ensureProjectScope(
   236→    params.projectId,
   237→    'useGenerationMutations.toggleGenerationStar.projectScope',
   238→  );
   239→  await verifyGenerationScope(
   240→    params.id,
   241→    projectId,
   242→    'useGenerationMutations.toggleGenerationStar.scopeValidation',
   243→  );
   244→
   245→  const { data, error } = await updateGenerationStarByScope({
   246→    id: params.id,
   247→    projectId,
   248→    starred: params.starred,
   249→  });
   250→
   251→  if (error) {
   252→    normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(error, {
   253→      context: 'useGenerationMutations.toggleGenerationStar',
   254→      showToast: false,
   255→      logData: { generationId: params.id, projectId, starred: params.starred },
   256→    });
   257→  }
   258→
   259→  if (!data || data.length === 0) {
   260→    normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(
   261→      new Error('No rows updated while toggling generation star (possible RLS policy issue)'),
   262→      {
   263→        context: 'useGenerationMutations.toggleGenerationStar.noRows',
   264→        showToast: false,
   265→        logData: { generationId: params.id, projectId, starred: params.starred },
   266→      },
   267→    );
   268→  }
   269→}
   270→
   271→// ===== Mutation Hooks =====
   272→
   273→/**
   274→ * Shared delete mutation factory for generations and variants.
   275→ * @internal
   276→ */
   277→function useDeleteFromTable(table: 'generations' | 'generation_variants', entityLabel: string) {
   278→  return useMutation({
   279→    mutationFn: async (input: ScopedGenerationInput | ScopedVariantInput) => {
   280→      const projectId = ensureProjectScope(
   281→        input.projectId,
   282→        `useGenerationMutations.useDeleteFromTable.${table}.projectScope`,
   283→      );
   284→
   285→      if (table === 'generations') {
   286→        await verifyGenerationScope(
   287→          input.id,
   288→          projectId,
   289→          `useGenerationMutations.useDeleteFromTable.${table}.scopeValidation`,
   290→        );
   291→
   292→        const { data, error } = await deleteGenerationByScope({
   293→          id: input.id,
   294→          projectId,
   295→        });
   296→
   297→        if (error) {
   298→          normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(error, {
   299→            context: `useGenerationMutations.useDeleteFromTable.${table}`,
   300→            showToast: false,
   301→            logData: { id: input.id, projectId, entityLabel },
   302→          });
   303→        }
   304→
   305→        if (!data || data.length === 0) {
   306→          normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(new Error('No rows deleted while enforcing generation scope'), {
   307→            context: `useGenerationMutations.useDeleteFromTable.${table}.noRows`,
   308→            showToast: false,
   309→            logData: { id: input.id, projectId, entityLabel },
   310→          });
   311→        }
   312→
   313→        return;
   314→      }
   315→
   316→      const variantScope = await verifyVariantScope(
   317→        input.id,
   318→        projectId,
   319→        `useGenerationMutations.useDeleteFromTable.${table}.scopeValidation`,
   320→      );
   321→      const { data, error } = await deleteGenerationVariantByScope({
   322→        id: input.id,
   323→        generationId: variantScope.generationId,
   324→      });
   325→
   326→      if (error) {
   327→        normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(error, {
   328→          context: `useGenerationMutations.useDeleteFromTable.${table}`,
   329→          showToast: false,
   330→          logData: { id: input.id, projectId, entityLabel, generationId: variantScope.generationId },
   331→        });
   332→      }
   333→
   334→      if (!data || data.length === 0) {
   335→        normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(new Error('No rows deleted while enforcing variant scope'), {
   336→          context: `useGenerationMutations.useDeleteFromTable.${table}.noRows`,
   337→          showToast: false,
   338→          logData: { id: input.id, projectId, entityLabel, generationId: variantScope.generationId },
   339→        });
   340→      }
   341→    },
   342→    onError: (error: Error) => {
   343→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, {
   344→        context: `useDelete${entityLabel.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + entityLabel.slice(1)}`,
   345→        toastTitle: `Failed to delete ${entityLabel}`,
   346→      });
   347→    },
   348→  });
   349→}
   350→
   351→export function useDeleteGeneration() {
   352→  return useDeleteFromTable('generations', 'generation');
   353→}
   354→
   355→/**
   356→ * Delete a variant from generation_variants table.
   357→ * Use this for edit tools (edit-images, edit-video, character-animate) that create variants.
   358→ */
   359→export function useDeleteVariant() {
   360→  return useDeleteFromTable('generation_variants', 'variant');
   361→}
   362→
   363→export function useUpdateGenerationLocation() {
   364→  return useMutation({
   365→    mutationFn: ({ id, location, thumbUrl, projectId }: { id: string; location: string; thumbUrl?: string; projectId: string }) => {
   366→      return updateGenerationLocation({ id, location, thumbUrl, projectId });
   367→    },
   368→    onError: (error: Error) => {
   369→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'useUpdateGenerationLocation', toastTitle: 'Failed to update generation' });
   370→    },
   371→  });
   372→}
   373→
   374→export function useCreateGeneration() {
   375→  return useMutation({
   376→    mutationFn: createGeneration,
   377→    onError: (error: Error) => {
   378→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'useCreateGeneration', toastTitle: 'Failed to create generation' });
   379→    },
   380→  });
   381→}
   382→
   383→export function useToggleGenerationStar() {
   384→  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
   385→
   386→  return useMutation({
   387→    mutationFn: ({ id, starred, projectId }: { id: string; starred: boolean; projectId: string; shotId?: string }) => {
   388→      return toggleGenerationStar({ id, starred, projectId });
   389→    },
   390→    onMutate: async ({ id, starred, shotId }) => {
   391→      return applyOptimisticGenerationStarUpdate(queryClient, {
   392→        generationId: id,
   393→        starred,
   394→        shotId,
   395→      });
   396→    },
   397→    onError: (error: Error, _variables, context) => {
   398→      rollbackOptimisticGenerationStarUpdate(queryClient, context);
   399→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'useToggleGenerationStar', toastTitle: 'Failed to toggle star' });
   400→    },
   401→    onSuccess: (_data, variables) => {
   402→      // Emit custom event so Timeline knows to refetch star data
   403→      if (variables.shotId) {
   404→        dispatchAppEvent('generation-star-updated', {
   405→          generationId: variables.id, shotId: variables.shotId!, starred: variables.starred,
   406→        });
   407→      }
   408→    },
   409→  });
   410→}
   411→

    44→function extractLoadedImageIds(data: unknown): Array<{ id: string }> {
    45→  if (!data || typeof data !== 'object') {
    46→    return [];
    47→  }
    48→
    49→  const maybeItems = (data as { items?: unknown }).items;
    50→  if (!Array.isArray(maybeItems)) {
    51→    return [];
    52→  }
    53→
    54→  return maybeItems
    55→    .map((item) => {
    56→      if (!item || typeof item !== 'object') {

    58→      }
    59→      const id = (item as { id?: unknown }).id;

   398→export function useInlineEditState(
   399→  media: GenerationRow,
   400→  onNavigateToGeneration?: (generationId: string) => Promise<void>,
   401→): InlineEditStateResult {
   402→  const env = useInlineEditEnvironment(media);
   403→  const persistence = useInlineEditPersistence(env.actualGenerationId, env.selectedProjectId);
   404→  const activeVariant = persistence.variants.activeVariant;
   405→  const effectiveImageUrl = activeVariant?.location || env.effectiveImageUrl;
   406→  useEffect(() => {
   407→    env.setUpscaleActiveVariant(activeVariant?.location, activeVariant?.id);
   408→  }, [env, activeVariant?.location, activeVariant?.id]);
   409→  const { data: availableLoras } = usePublicLoras();
   410→  const { inpainting, magic } = useInlineEditInpaintingAndMagic(media, env, persistence);
   411→  const reposition = useInlineEditReposition(media, env, inpainting, persistence);
   412→  const img2img = useInlineEditImg2Img(media, env, persistence, availableLoras);
   413→  useInlineEditSettingsSync(env.actualGenerationId, persistence.editSettings, inpainting);
   414→  const { sourceGenerationData } = useSourceGeneration({
   415→    media,
   416→    onOpenExternalGeneration: onNavigateToGeneration
   417→      ? async (id) => onNavigateToGeneration(id)
   418→      : undefined,
   419→  });
   420→  const starToggle = useStarToggle({ media });
   421→  const handleDownload = async () => {
   422→    await downloadMedia(effectiveImageUrl, media.id, env.isVideo, media.contentType);
   423→  };
   424→  const {
   425→    inpaintingState,
   426→    transformState,
   427→    generationState,
   428→    imageEditValue,
   429→  } = buildInlineEditStateModels({
   430→    env,
   431→    persistence,
   432→    inpainting,
   433→    magic,
   434→    reposition,
   435→    img2img,
   436→    starToggle,
   437→    handleDownload,
   438→  });
   439→  return {
   440→    media,
   441→    canvasEnvironment: {
   442→      isMobile: env.isMobile,
   443→      selectedProjectId: env.selectedProjectId,
   444→      isCloudMode: env.isCloudMode,
   445→      isVideo: env.isVideo,
   446→      imageContainerRef: env.imageContainerRef,
   447→      effectiveImageUrl,
   448→      imageDimensions: env.imageDimensions,
   449→      setImageDimensions: env.setImageDimensions,
   450→      isUpscaling: env.isUpscaling,
   451→      handleUpscale: env.handleUpscale,
   452→    },
   453→    inpaintingState,
   454→    transformState,
   455→    generationState,
   456→    variants: {
   457→      variants: persistence.variants.variants,
   458→      activeVariant: persistence.variants.activeVariant,
   459→      isLoading: persistence.variants.isLoading,
   460→      setActiveVariantId: persistence.variants.setActiveVariantId,
   461→      setPrimaryVariant: persistence.variants.setPrimaryVariant,
   462→      deleteVariant: persistence.variants.deleteVariant,
   463→    },
   464→    sourceGenerationData,
   465→    availableLoras,
   466→    imageEditValue,
   467→  } satisfies InlineEditStateResult;
   468→}

    69→export async function uploadAndProcessReference(
    70→  input: UploadAndProcessReferenceInput,
    71→): Promise<OperationResult<UploadAndProcessReferenceResult>> {
    72→  try {
    73→    const dataURL = await fileToDataURL(input.file);
    74→    const originalUploadedUrl = await uploadImageToStorage(input.file);
    75→
    76→    let processedDataURL = dataURL;
    77→    if (input.selectedProjectId) {
    78→      const { aspectRatio } = await resolveProjectResolution(input.selectedProjectId);
    79→      const processed = await processStyleReferenceForAspectRatioString(dataURL, aspectRatio);
    80→      if (!processed) {
    81→        return operationFailure(new Error('Failed to process image for aspect ratio'), {
    82→          policy: 'fail_closed',
    83→          errorCode: 'reference_aspect_processing_failed',
    84→          message: 'Failed to process image for aspect ratio',
    85→          recoverable: false,
    86→          cause: { selectedProjectId: input.selectedProjectId },
    87→        });
    88→      }
    89→      processedDataURL = processed;
    90→    }
    91→
    92→    const processedFile = dataURLtoFile(
    93→      processedDataURL,
    94→      `style-reference-processed-${Date.now()}.png`,
    95→    );
    96→    if (!processedFile) {
    97→      return operationFailure(new Error('Failed to convert processed image to file'), {
    98→        policy: 'fail_closed',
    99→        errorCode: 'reference_file_conversion_failed',
   100→        message: 'Failed to convert processed image to file',
   101→        recoverable: false,
   102→      });
   103→    }
   104→
   105→    const processedUploadedUrl = await uploadImageToStorage(processedFile);
   106→    return operationSuccess({ originalUploadedUrl, processedUploadedUrl }, { policy: 'best_effort' });
   107→  } catch (error) {
   108→    return operationFailure(error, {
   109→      policy: 'degrade',
   110→      errorCode: 'reference_upload_failed',
   111→      message: 'Failed to upload and process reference image',
   112→      recoverable: true,
   113→      cause: error,
   114→    });

   118→export async function resolveReferenceThumbnailUrl(
   119→  input: ResolveReferenceThumbnailInput,

   121→  try {
   122→    const thumbnailResult = await generateClientThumbnail(input.file, 300, 0.8);
   123→    const { data: { session } } = await supabase().auth.getSession();
   124→    if (!session?.user?.id) {
   125→      return operationFailure(new Error('User not authenticated'), {
   126→        policy: 'fail_closed',

   133→    const thumbnailFilename = generateThumbnailFilename();

   135→    const { error: thumbnailUploadError } = await supabase().storage
   136→      .from(MEDIA_BUCKET)
   137→      .upload(thumbnailPath, thumbnailResult.thumbnailBlob, {
   138→        contentType: 'image/jpeg',
   139→        upsert: true,
   140→      });

   142→    if (thumbnailUploadError) {

   154→
   155→    const { data: thumbnailUrlData } = supabase().storage
   156→      .from(MEDIA_BUCKET)

     9→
    10→export type { SupabaseClientAccessResult };
    11→
    12→export interface SupabaseClientRegistry {
    13→  getClientResult: () => SupabaseClientAccessResult;
    14→}
    15→
    16→/** Runtime bootstrap entrypoint for app startup. */
    17→export function initializeSupabase() {
    18→  return initializeSupabaseClientRuntime();
    19→}
    20→
    21→export function initializeSupabaseResult(): SupabaseClientAccessResult {
    22→  try {
    23→    const client = initializeSupabase();
    24→    return { ok: true, client };
    25→  } catch (error) {
    26→    return { ok: false, error: normalizeSupabaseError(error) };
    27→  }
    28→}
    29→
    30→/** Runtime accessor that never throws; callers can branch on initialization state. */
    31→export function getSupabaseClientResult(): SupabaseClientAccessResult {
    32→  const result = getSupabaseRuntimeClientResult();
    33→  return result.ok ? result : { ok: false, error: normalizeSupabaseError(result.error) };
    34→}
    35→
    36→export const supabaseClientRegistry: SupabaseClientRegistry = {
    37→  getClientResult: getSupabaseClientResult,
    38→};
    39→
    40→/** Runtime accessor for initialized app runtime. Throws if bootstrap has not run. */
    41→export function getSupabaseClient() {
    42→  const result = supabaseClientRegistry.getClientResult();
    43→  if (!result.ok) {
    44→    throw result.error;
    45→  }
    46→  return result.client;
    47→}

   272→
   273→/**
   274→ * Shared delete mutation factory for generations and variants.
   275→ * @internal
   276→ */
   277→function useDeleteFromTable(table: 'generations' | 'generation_variants', entityLabel: string) {
   278→  return useMutation({
   279→    mutationFn: async (input: ScopedGenerationInput | ScopedVariantInput) => {
   280→      const projectId = ensureProjectScope(
   281→        input.projectId,
   282→        `useGenerationMutations.useDeleteFromTable.${table}.projectScope`,
   283→      );
   284→
   285→      if (table === 'generations') {
   286→        await verifyGenerationScope(
   287→          input.id,
   288→          projectId,
   289→          `useGenerationMutations.useDeleteFromTable.${table}.scopeValidation`,
   290→        );
   291→
   292→        const { data, error } = await deleteGenerationByScope({
   293→          id: input.id,
   294→          projectId,
   295→        });
   296→
   297→        if (error) {
   298→          normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(error, {
   299→            context: `useGenerationMutations.useDeleteFromTable.${table}`,
   300→            showToast: false,
   301→            logData: { id: input.id, projectId, entityLabel },
   302→          });
   303→        }
   304→
   305→        if (!data || data.length === 0) {
   306→          normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(new Error('No rows deleted while enforcing generation scope'), {
   307→            context: `useGenerationMutations.useDeleteFromTable.${table}.noRows`,
   308→            showToast: false,
   309→            logData: { id: input.id, projectId, entityLabel },
   310→          });
   311→        }
   312→
   313→        return;
   314→      }
   315→
   316→      const variantScope = await verifyVariantScope(
   317→        input.id,
   318→        projectId,
   319→        `useGenerationMutations.useDeleteFromTable.${table}.scopeValidation`,
   320→      );
   321→      const { data, error } = await deleteGenerationVariantByScope({
   322→        id: input.id,
   323→        generationId: variantScope.generationId,
   324→      });
   325→
   326→      if (error) {
   327→        normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(error, {
   328→          context: `useGenerationMutations.useDeleteFromTable.${table}`,
   329→          showToast: false,
   330→          logData: { id: input.id, projectId, entityLabel, generationId: variantScope.generationId },
   331→        });
   332→      }
   333→
   334→      if (!data || data.length === 0) {
   335→        normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(new Error('No rows deleted while enforcing variant scope'), {
   336→          context: `useGenerationMutations.useDeleteFromTable.${table}.noRows`,
   337→          showToast: false,
   338→          logData: { id: input.id, projectId, entityLabel, generationId: variantScope.generationId },
   339→        });
   340→      }
   341→    },
   342→    onError: (error: Error) => {
   343→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, {
   344→        context: `useDelete${entityLabel.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + entityLabel.slice(1)}`,
   345→        toastTitle: `Failed to delete ${entityLabel}`,
   346→      });
   347→    },
   348→  });
   349→}
   350→
   351→export function useDeleteGeneration() {
   352→  return useDeleteFromTable('generations', 'generation');
   353→}
   354→
   355→/**
   356→ * Delete a variant from generation_variants table.
   357→ * Use this for edit tools (edit-images, edit-video, character-animate) that create variants.
   358→ */
   359→export function useDeleteVariant() {
   360→  return useDeleteFromTable('generation_variants', 'variant');
   361→}
   362→
   363→export function useUpdateGenerationLocation() {
   364→  return useMutation({

   366→      return updateGenerationLocation({ id, location, thumbUrl, projectId });
   367→    },
   368→    onError: (error: Error) => {
   369→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'useUpdateGenerationLocation', toastTitle: 'Failed to update generation' });
   370→    },
   371→  });
   372→}
   373→
   374→export function useCreateGeneration() {

   379→    },

   381→}
   382→
   383→export function useToggleGenerationStar() {
   384→  const queryClient = useQueryClient();

   386→  return useMutation({

1→const FRAME_QUANTIZATION_STEP = 4;
     2→const FRAME_QUANTIZATION_OFFSET = 1;
     3→
     4→export function quantizeTotalFrames(total: number, minTotal: number = 17): number {
     5→  const quantized =
     6→    Math.round((total - FRAME_QUANTIZATION_OFFSET) / FRAME_QUANTIZATION_STEP) *
     7→      FRAME_QUANTIZATION_STEP +
     8→    FRAME_QUANTIZATION_OFFSET;
     9→  return Math.max(minTotal, quantized);
    10→}
    11→
    12→export function getQuantizedGap(
    13→  desiredGap: number,
    14→  context: number,
    15→  minTotal: number = 17
    16→): number {
    17→  const total = context * 2 + desiredGap;
    18→  const quantizedTotal = quantizeTotalFrames(total, minTotal);
    19→  const gap = quantizedTotal - context * 2;
    20→
    21→  if (gap >= 1) {
    22→    return gap;
    23→  }
    24→
    25→  const minimumTotalWithPositiveGap = context * 2 + 1;
    26→  const validTotal = quantizeTotalFrames(minimumTotalWithPositiveGap, minTotal);
    27→  return validTotal - context * 2;
    28→}
    29→

1→import { debugConfig } from './debugConfig';
     2→
     3→const CHANNEL_FLAGS = {
     4→  cache: 'tasksPaneDebug',
     5→  render: 'renderLogging',
     6→} as const;
     7→
     8→type DebugChannel = keyof typeof CHANNEL_FLAGS;
     9→type DebugFlag = Parameters<typeof debugConfig.isEnabled>[0];
    10→
    11→const overrides: Partial<Record<DebugChannel, boolean>> = {};
    12→
    13→const isDev = Boolean(import.meta.env.DEV);
    14→
    15→function channelFlag(channel: DebugChannel): DebugFlag {
    16→  return CHANNEL_FLAGS[channel];
    17→}
    18→
    19→function isChannelEnabled(channel: DebugChannel): boolean {
    20→  if (!isDev) {
    21→    return false;
    22→  }
    23→
    24→  const override = overrides[channel];
    25→  if (override !== undefined) {
    26→    return override;
    27→  }
    28→
    29→  return debugConfig.isEnabled(channelFlag(channel));
    30→}
    31→
    32→function shouldLog(channel: DebugChannel, force: boolean): boolean {
    33→  return force ? isDev : isChannelEnabled(channel);
    34→}
    35→
    36→function withTag(channel: DebugChannel, message: string): string {
    37→  return `[${channel}] ${message}`;
    38→}
    39→
    40→export function enableDebugChannel(channel: DebugChannel): void {
    41→  overrides[channel] = true;
    42→}
    43→
    44→export function disableDebugChannel(channel: DebugChannel): void {
    45→  overrides[channel] = false;
    46→}
    47→
    48→export function resetDebugChannel(channel: DebugChannel): void {
    49→  delete overrides[channel];
    50→}
    51→
    52→export function debugChannelEnabled(channel: DebugChannel): boolean {
    53→  return isChannelEnabled(channel);
    54→}
    55→
    56→export function debugLog(
    57→  channel: DebugChannel,
    58→  message: string,
    59→  data?: unknown,
    60→  force: boolean = false,
    61→): void {
    62→  if (!shouldLog(channel, force)) {
    63→    return;
    64→  }
    65→
    66→  if (data === undefined) {
    67→    console.log(withTag(channel, message));
    68→    return;
    69→  }
    70→
    71→  console.log(withTag(channel, message), data);
    72→}
    73→
    74→export function debugWarn(

    76→  message: string,

    13→function cacheOAuthIntentFlag(): OAuthIntentCacheResult {

     4→interface ComposedSignalResult {
     5→  signal: AbortSignal;
     6→  cleanup: () => void;
     7→}
     8→
     9→function getRequestUrl(input: URL | RequestInfo): string {
    10→  if (typeof input === 'string') {
    11→    return input;
    12→  }
    13→  if (input instanceof URL) {
    14→    return input.toString();
    15→  }
    16→  if (input instanceof Request) {

    21→
    22→export function composeAbortSignals(timeoutSignal: AbortSignal, callerSignal?: AbortSignal): ComposedSignalResult {
    23→  if (!callerSignal) {
    24→    return {
    25→      signal: timeoutSignal,
    26→      cleanup: () => {},
    27→    };
    28→  }
    29→
    30→  const composedController = new AbortController();
    31→  const abort = () => {
    32→    if (!composedController.signal.aborted) {
    33→      composedController.abort();
    34→    }
    35→  };
    36→
    37→  if (timeoutSignal.aborted || callerSignal.aborted) {
    38→    abort();
    39→    return {
    40→      signal: composedController.signal,
    41→      cleanup: () => {},
    42→    };
    43→  }
    44→
    45→  const onAbort = () => abort();
    46→  timeoutSignal.addEventListener('abort', onAbort, { once: true });
    47→  callerSignal.addEventListener('abort', onAbort, { once: true });
    48→
    49→  return {
    50→    signal: composedController.signal,
    51→    cleanup: () => {
    52→      timeoutSignal.removeEventListener('abort', onAbort);
    53→      callerSignal.removeEventListener('abort', onAbort);
    54→    },
    55→  };
    56→}
    57→
    58→function toAbortError(reason: unknown): Error {
    59→  if (reason instanceof Error) {
    60→    return reason;
    61→  }
    62→
    63→  const message = typeof reason === 'string'
    64→    ? reason
    65→    : 'The operation was aborted.';
    66→
    67→  if (typeof DOMException !== 'undefined') {
    68→    return new DOMException(message, 'AbortError');
    69→  }
    70→
    71→  return new Error(message);
    72→}
    73→
    74→export function fetchWithTimeout(input: URL | RequestInfo, init: RequestInit = {}): Promise<Response> {
    75→  const url = getRequestUrl(input);
    76→  const isEdgeFunction = url.includes('/functions/v1/');
    77→  const isStorageUpload = url.includes('/storage/v1/object/');
    78→
    79→  if (!isEdgeFunction && !isStorageUpload) {
    80→    return fetch(input, init);
    81→  }
    82→
    83→  const callerSignal = init.signal instanceof AbortSignal ? init.signal : undefined;
    84→  if (callerSignal?.aborted) {
    85→    return Promise.reject(toAbortError(callerSignal.reason));
    86→  }
    87→
    88→  const controller = new AbortController();
    89→  const timeoutMs = isEdgeFunction ? EDGE_FUNCTION_TIMEOUT_MS : STORAGE_UPLOAD_TIMEOUT_MS;
    90→  const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), timeoutMs);
    91→  const { signal, cleanup } = composeAbortSignals(
    92→    controller.signal,
    93→    callerSignal,
    94→  );
    95→
    96→  return fetch(input, { ...init, signal }).finally(() => {
    97→    clearTimeout(timeoutId);
    98→    cleanup();
    99→  });
   100→}

   398→export function useInlineEditState(
   399→  media: GenerationRow,
   400→  onNavigateToGeneration?: (generationId: string) => Promise<void>,
   401→): InlineEditStateResult {
   402→  const env = useInlineEditEnvironment(media);
   403→  const persistence = useInlineEditPersistence(env.actualGenerationId, env.selectedProjectId);
   404→  const activeVariant = persistence.variants.activeVariant;
   405→  const effectiveImageUrl = activeVariant?.location || env.effectiveImageUrl;
   406→  useEffect(() => {
   407→    env.setUpscaleActiveVariant(activeVariant?.location, activeVariant?.id);
   408→  }, [env, activeVariant?.location, activeVariant?.id]);
   409→  const { data: availableLoras } = usePublicLoras();
   410→  const { inpainting, magic } = useInlineEditInpaintingAndMagic(media, env, persistence);
   411→  const reposition = useInlineEditReposition(media, env, inpainting, persistence);
   412→  const img2img = useInlineEditImg2Img(media, env, persistence, availableLoras);
   413→  useInlineEditSettingsSync(env.actualGenerationId, persistence.editSettings, inpainting);
   414→  const { sourceGenerationData } = useSourceGeneration({
   415→    media,
   416→    onOpenExternalGeneration: onNavigateToGeneration
   417→      ? async (id) => onNavigateToGeneration(id)
   418→      : undefined,
   419→  });
   420→  const starToggle = useStarToggle({ media });
   421→  const handleDownload = async () => {
   422→    await downloadMedia(effectiveImageUrl, media.id, env.isVideo, media.contentType);
   423→  };
   424→  const {
   425→    inpaintingState,
   426→    transformState,
   427→    generationState,
   428→    imageEditValue,
   429→  } = buildInlineEditStateModels({
   430→    env,
   431→    persistence,
   432→    inpainting,
   433→    magic,
   434→    reposition,
   435→    img2img,
   436→    starToggle,
   437→    handleDownload,
   438→  });
   439→  return {
   440→    media,
   441→    canvasEnvironment: {
   442→      isMobile: env.isMobile,
   443→      selectedProjectId: env.selectedProjectId,
   444→      isCloudMode: env.isCloudMode,
   445→      isVideo: env.isVideo,
   446→      imageContainerRef: env.imageContainerRef,
   447→      effectiveImageUrl,
   448→      imageDimensions: env.imageDimensions,
   449→      setImageDimensions: env.setImageDimensions,
   450→      isUpscaling: env.isUpscaling,
   451→      handleUpscale: env.handleUpscale,
   452→    },
   453→    inpaintingState,
   454→    transformState,
   455→    generationState,
   456→    variants: {
   457→      variants: persistence.variants.variants,
   458→      activeVariant: persistence.variants.activeVariant,
   459→      isLoading: persistence.variants.isLoading,
   460→      setActiveVariantId: persistence.variants.setActiveVariantId,
   461→      setPrimaryVariant: persistence.variants.setPrimaryVariant,
   462→      deleteVariant: persistence.variants.deleteVariant,
   463→    },
   464→    sourceGenerationData,
   465→    availableLoras,
   466→    imageEditValue,
   467→  } satisfies InlineEditStateResult;
   468→}

    37→function useLightboxLayoutModel(props: LightboxLayoutProps) {
    38→  const core = useLightboxCoreSafe();
    39→  const mediaState = useLightboxMediaSafe();
    40→  const variantsState = useLightboxVariantsSafe();
    41→  const navigation = useLightboxNavigationSafe();

    43→  const videoEdit = useVideoEditSafe();
    44→
    45→  const isSidePanelLayout = props.showPanel && props.shouldShowSidePanel;
    46→  const isStackedLayout = props.showPanel && !props.shouldShowSidePanel;
    47→  const floatingToolVariant: 'mobile' | 'tablet' = core.isMobile ? 'mobile' : 'tablet';
    48→  const mediaDisplayVariant: 'desktop-side-panel' | 'mobile-stacked' | 'regular-centered' = props.showPanel
    49→    ? (isSidePanelLayout ? 'desktop-side-panel' : 'mobile-stacked')
    50→    : 'regular-centered';
    51→  const mediaDisplayContainerClassName = isSidePanelLayout
    52→    ? 'max-w-full max-h-full'
    53→    : 'w-full h-full';
    54→  const mediaDisplayDebugContext = props.showPanel
    55→    ? (isSidePanelLayout ? 'Desktop' : 'Mobile Stacked')
    56→    : 'Regular Centered';
    57→  const topCenterClassName = isStackedLayout
    58→    ? 'absolute top-4 md:top-16 left-1/2 transform -translate-x-1/2 z-[60] flex flex-col items-center gap-2'
    59→    : 'absolute top-4 left-1/2 transform -translate-x-1/2 z-[60] flex flex-col items-center gap-2';
    60→
    61→  return {
    62→    props,
    63→    contexts: {
    64→      core,
    65→      mediaState,
    66→      variantsState,
    67→      navigation,
    68→      imageEdit,
    69→      videoEdit,
    70→    },
    71→    layout: {
    72→      isSidePanelLayout,
    73→      isStackedLayout,
    74→      floatingToolVariant,
    75→      mediaDisplayVariant,
    76→      mediaDisplayContainerClassName,
    77→      mediaDisplayDebugContext,
    78→      topCenterClassName,
    79→    },
    80→  };
    81→}

    83→type LightboxLayoutModel = ReturnType<typeof useLightboxLayoutModel>;

    85→function MediaContent({ model }: { model: LightboxLayoutModel }) {
    86→  const { mediaState, variantsState, videoEdit } = model.contexts;

    88→  if (mediaState.isVideo && videoEdit.isVideoEditModeActive && videoEdit.videoEditing) {
    89→    return (

    91→        videoRef={videoEdit.videoEditing.videoRef}

    94→        videoDuration={videoEdit.videoDuration}
    95→        onLoadedMetadata={videoEdit.setVideoDuration}
    96→        selections={videoEdit.videoEditing.selections}
    97→        activeSelectionId={videoEdit.videoEditing.activeSelectionId}
    98→        onSelectionChange={videoEdit.videoEditing.handleUpdateSelection}
    99→        onSelectionClick={videoEdit.videoEditing.setActiveSelectionId}
   100→        onRemoveSelection={videoEdit.videoEditing.handleRemoveSelection}
   101→        onAddSelection={videoEdit.videoEditing.handleAddSelection}
   102→      />

   106→  if (mediaState.isVideo && videoEdit.isVideoTrimModeActive) {

   134→      debugContext={model.layout.mediaDisplayDebugContext}

   362→        style={isDesktopPanel ? { width: '40%' } : { height: '50%' }}

   370→function CenteredLayoutView({ model }: { model: LightboxLayoutModel }) {

   378→    >
   379→      <div

   381→        className={cn(

   396→      >

   398→        {showAnnotationControls && (
   399→          <AnnotationFloatingControls

   404→            onToggleFreeForm={model.contexts.imageEdit.handleToggleFreeForm}

   408→            freeFormInactiveClassName="bg-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-600 text-white"

   418→
   419→        <NavigationArrows
   420→          showNavigation={model.contexts.navigation.showNavigation}

   423→          onNext={model.contexts.navigation.handleSlotNavNext}
   424→          hasPrevious={model.contexts.navigation.hasPrevious}
   425→          hasNext={model.contexts.navigation.hasNext}
   426→          variant="mobile"
   427→        />
   428→      </div>
   429→
   430→    </div>
   431→  );
   432→}
   433→
   434→export const LightboxLayout: React.FC<LightboxLayoutProps> = (props) => {

1→/**
     2→ * useReplaceInShot Hook
     3→ *
     4→ * Handles swapping timeline position from a parent generation to the current image.
     5→ * Used when user wants to replace a parent image in the timeline with a derived image.
     6→ */
     7→
     8→import { useCallback } from 'react';
     9→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
    10→import { getSupabaseClient as supabase } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
    11→
    12→interface UseReplaceInShotProps {
    13→  /** Callback to close the lightbox after successful replacement */
    14→  onClose: () => void;
    15→}
    16→
    17→interface UseReplaceInShotReturn {
    18→  /**
    19→   * Replace parent's timeline position with current image
    20→   * @param parentGenerationId - ID of the parent generation to remove from timeline
    21→   * @param currentMediaId - ID of the current media to place in timeline
    22→   * @param parentTimelineFrame - Timeline frame position to use
    23→   * @param shotId - Shot ID for the replacement
    24→   */
    25→  handleReplaceInShot: (
    26→    parentGenerationId: string,
    27→    currentMediaId: string,
    28→    parentTimelineFrame: number,
    29→    shotId: string
    30→  ) => Promise<void>;
    31→}
    32→
    33→export function useReplaceInShot({
    34→  onClose,
    35→}: UseReplaceInShotProps): UseReplaceInShotReturn {
    36→  const handleReplaceInShot = useCallback(async (
    37→    parentGenerationId: string,
    38→    currentMediaId: string,
    39→    parentTimelineFrame: number,
    40→    shotIdParam: string
    41→  ) => {
    42→
    43→    try {
    44→      // 1. Remove timeline_frame from parent's shot_generation record
    45→      const { error: removeError } = await supabase().from('shot_generations')
    46→        .update({ timeline_frame: null })
    47→        .eq('generation_id', parentGenerationId)
    48→        .eq('shot_id', shotIdParam);
    49→
    50→      if (removeError) throw removeError;
    51→
    52→      // 2. Update or create shot_generation for current image with the timeline_frame
    53→      // First check if current image already has a shot_generation for this shot
    54→      const { data: existingAssoc } = await supabase().from('shot_generations')
    55→        .select('id')
    56→        .eq('generation_id', currentMediaId)
    57→        .eq('shot_id', shotIdParam)
    58→        .single();
    59→
    60→      if (existingAssoc) {
    61→        // Update existing
    62→        const { error: updateError } = await supabase().from('shot_generations')
    63→          .update({
    64→            timeline_frame: parentTimelineFrame,
    65→            metadata: { user_positioned: true, drag_source: 'replace_parent' }
    66→          })
    67→          .eq('id', existingAssoc.id);
    68→
    69→        if (updateError) throw updateError;
    70→      } else {
    71→        // Create new
    72→        const { error: createError } = await supabase().from('shot_generations')
    73→          .insert({
    74→            shot_id: shotIdParam,
    75→            generation_id: currentMediaId,
    76→            timeline_frame: parentTimelineFrame,
    77→            metadata: { user_positioned: true, drag_source: 'replace_parent' }
    78→          });
    79→
    80→        if (createError) throw createError;
    81→      }
    82→
    83→      // Close lightbox to force refresh when reopened
    84→      onClose();
    85→    } catch (error) {
    86→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'useReplaceInShot', showToast: false });
    87→      throw error;
    88→    }
    89→  }, [onClose]);
    90→
    91→  return { handleReplaceInShot };
    92→}
    93→

    29→function resolveTaskScopeProjectId(projectId: string | null): string | null {

    31→    return projectId;
    32→  }
    33→  const selectedProjectId = getProjectSelectionFallbackId();
    34→  if (selectedProjectId && selectedProjectId.trim().length > 0) {
    35→    return selectedProjectId;
    36→  }
    37→  return null;
    38→}
    39→
    40→/**
    41→ * Preload task mappings for a batch of generations in the background.
    42→ */
    43→export async function preloadGenerationTaskMappings(
    44→  queryClient: QueryClient,
    45→  generationIds: string[],
    46→  projectId: string | null,
    47→  options: PreloadGenerationTaskMappingsOptions = {},
    48→) {
    49→  const supabase = getSupabaseClient();
    50→  const effectiveProjectId = resolveTaskScopeProjectId(projectId);
    51→  const {
    52→    batchSize = 5,
    53→    delayBetweenBatches = 200,
    54→    preloadFullTaskData = false,
    55→  } = options;
    56→
    57→  for (let i = 0; i < generationIds.length; i += batchSize) {
    58→    const batch = generationIds.slice(i, i + batchSize);
    59→
    60→    const mappings = await getPrimaryTaskMappingsForGenerations(batch, { projectId: effectiveProjectId ?? undefined });
    61→    let reportedBatchQueryFailure = false;
    62→
    63→    const prefetchTasks: Array<Promise<unknown>> = [];
    64→
    65→    batch.forEach((generationId) => {
    66→      const mapping = mappings.get(generationId);
    67→      const cacheEntry = toGenerationTaskMappingCacheEntry(mapping);
    68→      queryClient.setQueryData<GenerationTaskMappingCacheEntry>(
    69→        taskQueryKeys.generationMapping(generationId),
    70→        cacheEntry,
    71→      );
    72→
    73→      if (!reportedBatchQueryFailure && cacheEntry.status === 'query_failed' && cacheEntry.queryError) {
    74→        reportedBatchQueryFailure = true;
    75→        normalizeAndPresentError(new Error(cacheEntry.queryError), {
    76→          context: 'GenerationTaskCache',
    77→          showToast: false,
    78→        });
    79→      }
    80→
    81→      if (preloadFullTaskData && effectiveProjectId && cacheEntry.taskId && cacheEntry.status === 'ok') {
    82→        prefetchTasks.push(queryClient.prefetchQuery({
    83→          [REDACTED](cacheEntry.taskId, effectiveProjectId),
    84→          queryFn: async () => {
    85→            const { data, error } = await supabase
    86→              .from('tasks')
    87→              .select('*')
    88→              .eq('id', cacheEntry.taskId)
    89→              .eq('project_id', effectiveProjectId)
    90→              .single();
    91→
    92→            if (error) throw error;
    93→            if (!isTaskDbRow(data)) {
    94→              throw new Error('Task row has unexpected shape');
    95→            }
    96→            return mapTaskDbRowToTask(data);
    97→          },
    98→          staleTime: 2 * 60 * 1000,
    99→        }));
   100→      }
   101→    });
   102→
   103→    if (prefetchTasks.length > 0) {
   104→      await Promise.all(prefetchTasks);
   105→    }
   106→
   107→    if (i + batchSize < generationIds.length) {
   108→      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, delayBetweenBatches));
   109→    }
   110→  }
   111→}
   112→
   113→export function mergeGenerationsWithTaskData(
   114→  generations: GenerationRow[],
   115→  queryClient: QueryClient,
   116→  projectId: string | null,
   117→): GenerationWithTaskData[] {
   118→  const effectiveProjectId = resolveTaskScopeProjectId(projectId);
   119→
   120→  return generations.map((generation) => {
   121→    const generationId = generation.generation_id ?? generation.id;
   122→    const cachedMapping = queryClient.getQueryData<GenerationTaskMappingCacheEntry>(
   123→      taskQueryKeys.generationMapping(generationId),
   124→    );
   125→    const taskId = cachedMapping?.taskId || null;
   126→    const taskData = (taskId && effectiveProjectId)
   127→      ? queryClient.getQueryData<Task>(taskQueryKeys.single(taskId, effectiveProjectId))
   128→      : null;
   129→    const taskMappingStatus = cachedMapping?.status ?? (taskId ? 'ok' : 'not_loaded');
   130→
   131→    return {
   132→      ...generation,
   133→      taskId,
   134→      taskData,
   135→      taskMappingStatus,
   136→      ...(cachedMapping?.queryError ? { taskMappingError: cachedMapping.queryError } : {}),
   137→    };
   138→  });
   139→}

    10→export type { SupabaseClientAccessResult };

    13→  getClientResult: () => SupabaseClientAccessResult;

    16→/** Runtime bootstrap entrypoint for app startup. */
    17→export function initializeSupabase() {

    19→}
    20→
    21→export function initializeSupabaseResult(): SupabaseClientAccessResult {
    22→  try {
    23→    const client = initializeSupabase();
    24→    return { ok: true, client };
    25→  } catch (error) {
    26→    return { ok: false, error: normalizeSupabaseError(error) };
    27→  }
    28→}
    29→
    30→/** Runtime accessor that never throws; callers can branch on initialization state. */
    31→export function getSupabaseClientResult(): SupabaseClientAccessResult {
    32→  const result = getSupabaseRuntimeClientResult();
    33→  return result.ok ? result : { ok: false, error: normalizeSupabaseError(result.error) };
    34→}
    35→
    36→export const supabaseClientRegistry: SupabaseClientRegistry = {
    37→  getClientResult: getSupabaseClientResult,
    38→};
    39→
    40→/** Runtime accessor for initialized app runtime. Throws if bootstrap has not run. */
    41→export function getSupabaseClient() {
    42→  const result = supabaseClientRegistry.getClientResult();
    43→  if (!result.ok) {
    44→    throw result.error;
    45→  }
    46→  return result.client;
    47→}

1→/**
     2→ * Utility for extracting poster images (first frame) from video files
     3→ */
     4→
     5→/**
     6→ * Extract the first frame of a video as a Blob
     7→ * @param videoFile The video file to extract from
     8→ * @returns Promise that resolves to a Blob of the poster image (JPEG)
     9→ */
    10→export function extractVideoPosterFrame(videoFile: File): Promise<Blob> {
    11→  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    12→    const video = document.createElement('video');
    13→    const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    14→    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    15→
    16→    if (!ctx) {
    17→      reject(new Error('Failed to get canvas context'));
    18→      return;
    19→    }
    20→
    21→    video.preload = 'metadata';
    22→    video.muted = true;
    23→    video.playsInline = true;
    24→
    25→    // When metadata is loaded, we can get dimensions
    26→    video.addEventListener('loadedmetadata', () => {
    27→      canvas.width = video.videoWidth;
    28→      canvas.height = video.videoHeight;
    29→      
    30→      // Seek to a small time to avoid black frames at the start
    31→      video.currentTime = 0.1;
    32→    });
    33→
    34→    // When we've seeked to the right time, capture the frame
    35→    video.addEventListener('seeked', () => {
    36→      try {
    37→        // Draw the video frame to canvas
    38→        ctx.drawImage(video, 0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    39→        
    40→        // Convert canvas to blob
    41→        canvas.toBlob(
    42→          (blob) => {
    43→            if (blob) {
    44→              resolve(blob);
    45→            } else {
    46→              reject(new Error('Failed to create blob from canvas'));
    47→            }
    48→            
    49→            // Cleanup
    50→            video.src = '';
    51→            URL.revokeObjectURL(video.src);
    52→          },
    53→          'image/jpeg',
    54→          0.85 // Quality
    55→        );
    56→      } catch (error) {
    57→        reject(error);
    58→      }
    59→    });
    60→
    61→    video.addEventListener('error', () => {
    62→      reject(new Error('Failed to load video'));
    63→    });
    64→
    65→    // Load the video
    66→    video.src = URL.createObjectURL(videoFile);
    67→  });
    68→}
    69→

    23→/**

    31→export const useShotCreation = ({

    39→  // We need to use media.generation_id (actual generations table ID) for creating new shot associations
    40→  const actualGenerationId = useMemo(() => {

    56→    onClose: undefined,

    58→

1→/**
     2→ * useVariantPromotion - Handles promoting variants to standalone generations
     3→ *
     4→ * Manages variant promotion (creating standalone generation from a variant)
     5→ * and adding variants as new generations to shots with timeline positioning.
     6→ */
     7→
     8→import { useState, useCallback } from 'react';
     9→import { toast } from '@/shared/components/ui/runtime/sonner';
    10→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
    11→import { getSupabaseClient as supabase } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
    12→import { usePromoteVariantToGeneration } from '@/shared/hooks/usePromoteVariantToGeneration';
    13→import { useAddImageToShot } from '@/shared/hooks/shots';
    14→
    15→interface UseVariantPromotionProps {
    16→  selectedProjectId: string | null;
    17→}
    18→
    19→interface UseVariantPromotionReturn {
    20→  promoteSuccess: boolean;
    21→  isPromoting: boolean;
    22→  handlePromoteToGeneration: (variantId: string) => Promise<void>;
    23→  handleAddVariantAsNewGenerationToShot: (
    24→    shotId: string,
    25→    variantId: string,
    26→    currentTimelineFrame?: number
    27→  ) => Promise<boolean>;
    28→}
    29→
    30→export function useVariantPromotion({
    31→  selectedProjectId,
    32→}: UseVariantPromotionProps): UseVariantPromotionReturn {
    33→  const promoteVariantMutation = usePromoteVariantToGeneration();
    34→  const addImageToShotMutation = useAddImageToShot();
    35→  const [promoteSuccess, setPromoteSuccess] = useState(false);
    36→
    37→  // Handler for "Make new image" button in VariantSelector
    38→  const handlePromoteToGeneration = useCallback(async (variantId: string) => {
    39→    if (!selectedProjectId) {
    40→      toast.error('No project selected');
    41→      return;
    42→    }
    43→
    44→    setPromoteSuccess(false);
    45→
    46→    try {
    47→      await promoteVariantMutation.mutateAsync({
    48→        variantId,
    49→        projectId: selectedProjectId,
    50→      });
    51→
    52→      setPromoteSuccess(true);
    53→      setTimeout(() => setPromoteSuccess(false), 2000);
    54→    } catch (error) {
    55→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'useVariantPromotion', showToast: false });
    56→    }
    57→  }, [promoteVariantMutation, selectedProjectId]);
    58→
    59→  // Handler for "Add as new image to shot" button in ShotSelectorControls
    60→  // Positions new image between current and next item in the TARGET shot
    61→  const handleAddVariantAsNewGenerationToShot = useCallback(async (
    62→    shotId: string,
    63→    variantId: string,
    64→    currentTimelineFrame?: number
    65→  ): Promise<boolean> => {
    66→    if (!selectedProjectId) {
    67→      toast.error('No project selected');
    68→      return false;
    69→    }
    70→
    71→    try {
    72→      // 1. Create the generation from the variant
    73→      const newGen = await promoteVariantMutation.mutateAsync({
    74→        variantId,
    75→        projectId: selectedProjectId,
    76→      });
    77→
    78→      // 2. Calculate target timeline frame by querying the TARGET shot's items
    79→      let targetTimelineFrame: number | undefined;
    80→      if (currentTimelineFrame !== undefined) {
    81→        // Query all items in the target shot to find next item and calculate average spacing
    82→        const { data: allShotItems } = await supabase().from('shot_generations')
    83→          .select('timeline_frame')
    84→          .eq('shot_id', shotId)
    85→          .not('timeline_frame', 'is', null)
    86→          .order('timeline_frame', { ascending: true });
    87→
    88→        const frames = (allShotItems || [])
    89→          .map(item => item.timeline_frame as number)
    90→          .filter(f => f !== null && f !== undefined);
    91→
    92→        // Find the next item after current position
    93→        const nextTimelineFrame = frames.find(f => f > currentTimelineFrame);
    94→
    95→        if (nextTimelineFrame !== undefined && nextTimelineFrame > currentTimelineFrame) {
    96→          // Place in the middle between current and next
    97→          targetTimelineFrame = Math.floor((currentTimelineFrame + nextTimelineFrame) / 2);
    98→          // If middle would be same as current (consecutive frames), use current + 1
    99→          if (targetTimelineFrame === currentTimelineFrame) {
   100→            targetTimelineFrame = currentTimelineFrame + 1;
   101→          }
   102→        } else {
   103→          // No next item in shot - calculate average spacing and use that
   104→          if (frames.length >= 2) {
   105→            // Calculate average gap between consecutive frames
   106→            let totalGap = 0;
   107→            for (let i = 1; i < frames.length; i++) {
   108→              totalGap += frames[i] - frames[i - 1];
   109→            }
   110→            const averageGap = Math.round(totalGap / (frames.length - 1));
   111→            targetTimelineFrame = currentTimelineFrame + Math.max(1, averageGap);
   112→          } else {
   113→            // Only one item in shot, use current + 1
   114→            targetTimelineFrame = currentTimelineFrame + 1;
   115→          }
   116→        }
   117→      }
   118→
   119→      // 3. Add to shot
   120→      await addImageToShotMutation.mutateAsync({
   121→        shot_id: shotId,
   122→        generation_id: newGen.id,
   123→        project_id: selectedProjectId,
   124→        imageUrl: newGen.location,
   125→        thumbUrl: newGen.thumbnail_url || undefined,
   126→        timelineFrame: targetTimelineFrame,
   127→      });
   128→      return true;
   129→    } catch (error) {
   130→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'useVariantPromotion', showToast: false });
   131→      return false;
   132→    }
   133→  }, [promoteVariantMutation, addImageToShotMutation, selectedProjectId]);
   134→
   135→  return {
   136→    promoteSuccess,
   137→    isPromoting: promoteVariantMutation.isPending,
   138→    handlePromoteToGeneration,
   139→    handleAddVariantAsNewGenerationToShot,
   140→  };
   141→}
   142→

   398→export function useInlineEditState(
   399→  media: GenerationRow,
   400→  onNavigateToGeneration?: (generationId: string) => Promise<void>,
   401→): InlineEditStateResult {
   402→  const env = useInlineEditEnvironment(media);
   403→  const persistence = useInlineEditPersistence(env.actualGenerationId, env.selectedProjectId);
   404→  const activeVariant = persistence.variants.activeVariant;
   405→  const effectiveImageUrl = activeVariant?.location || env.effectiveImageUrl;
   406→  useEffect(() => {
   407→    env.setUpscaleActiveVariant(activeVariant?.location, activeVariant?.id);
   408→  }, [env, activeVariant?.location, activeVariant?.id]);
   409→  const { data: availableLoras } = usePublicLoras();
   410→  const { inpainting, magic } = useInlineEditInpaintingAndMagic(media, env, persistence);
   411→  const reposition = useInlineEditReposition(media, env, inpainting, persistence);
   412→  const img2img = useInlineEditImg2Img(media, env, persistence, availableLoras);
   413→  useInlineEditSettingsSync(env.actualGenerationId, persistence.editSettings, inpainting);
   414→  const { sourceGenerationData } = useSourceGeneration({
   415→    media,
   416→    onOpenExternalGeneration: onNavigateToGeneration
   417→      ? async (id) => onNavigateToGeneration(id)
   418→      : undefined,
   419→  });
   420→  const starToggle = useStarToggle({ media });
   421→  const handleDownload = async () => {
   422→    await downloadMedia(effectiveImageUrl, media.id, env.isVideo, media.contentType);
   423→  };
   424→  const {
   425→    inpaintingState,
   426→    transformState,
   427→    generationState,
   428→    imageEditValue,
   429→  } = buildInlineEditStateModels({
   430→    env,
   431→    persistence,
   432→    inpainting,
   433→    magic,
   434→    reposition,
   435→    img2img,
   436→    starToggle,
   437→    handleDownload,
   438→  });
   439→  return {
   440→    media,
   441→    canvasEnvironment: {
   442→      isMobile: env.isMobile,
   443→      selectedProjectId: env.selectedProjectId,
   444→      isCloudMode: env.isCloudMode,
   445→      isVideo: env.isVideo,
   446→      imageContainerRef: env.imageContainerRef,
   447→      effectiveImageUrl,
   448→      imageDimensions: env.imageDimensions,
   449→      setImageDimensions: env.setImageDimensions,
   450→      isUpscaling: env.isUpscaling,
   451→      handleUpscale: env.handleUpscale,
   452→    },
   453→    inpaintingState,
   454→    transformState,
   455→    generationState,
   456→    variants: {
   457→      variants: persistence.variants.variants,
   458→      activeVariant: persistence.variants.activeVariant,
   459→      isLoading: persistence.variants.isLoading,
   460→      setActiveVariantId: persistence.variants.setActiveVariantId,
   461→      setPrimaryVariant: persistence.variants.setPrimaryVariant,
   462→      deleteVariant: persistence.variants.deleteVariant,
   463→    },
   464→    sourceGenerationData,
   465→    availableLoras,
   466→    imageEditValue,
   467→  } satisfies InlineEditStateResult;

1→/** @publicContract Supabase browser runtime entrypoint. */

     3→import {
     4→  type SupabaseClientAccessResult,
     5→  getSupabaseRuntimeClientResult,
     6→  initializeSupabaseClientRuntime,
     7→  normalizeSupabaseError,
     8→} from '@/integrations/supabase/runtime/supabaseRuntime';
     9→
    10→export type { SupabaseClientAccessResult };
    11→
    12→export interface SupabaseClientRegistry {
    13→  getClientResult: () => SupabaseClientAccessResult;
    14→}
    15→
    16→/** Runtime bootstrap entrypoint for app startup. */
    17→export function initializeSupabase() {
    18→  return initializeSupabaseClientRuntime();
    19→}
    20→
    21→export function initializeSupabaseResult(): SupabaseClientAccessResult {
    22→  try {
    23→    const client = initializeSupabase();
    24→    return { ok: true, client };
    25→  } catch (error) {
    26→    return { ok: false, error: normalizeSupabaseError(error) };
    27→  }
    28→}
    29→
    30→/** Runtime accessor that never throws; callers can branch on initialization state. */
    31→export function getSupabaseClientResult(): SupabaseClientAccessResult {
    32→  const result = getSupabaseRuntimeClientResult();
    33→  return result.ok ? result : { ok: false, error: normalizeSupabaseError(result.error) };
    34→}
    35→
    36→export const supabaseClientRegistry: SupabaseClientRegistry = {
    37→  getClientResult: getSupabaseClientResult,
    38→};
    39→
    40→/** Runtime accessor for initialized app runtime. Throws if bootstrap has not run. */
    41→export function getSupabaseClient() {
    42→  const result = supabaseClientRegistry.getClientResult();
    43→  if (!result.ok) {
    44→    throw result.error;
    45→  }
    46→  return result.client;
    47→}

     7→ * - effectiveImageDimensions: Guaranteed dimensions with fallbacks
     8→ */
     9→
    10→import { useMemo } from 'react';
    11→import { ASPECT_RATIO_TO_RESOLUTION } from '@/shared/lib/media/aspectRatios';
    12→
    13→interface UseEffectiveMediaProps {
    14→  isVideo: boolean;
    15→  activeVariant: {
    16→    id?: string | null;
    17→    location?: string | null;
    18→    thumbnail_url?: string | null;
    19→    is_primary?: boolean | null;
    20→  } | null;
    21→  effectiveImageUrl: string | undefined;
    22→  imageDimensions: { width: number; height: number } | null;
    23→  projectAspectRatio: string | undefined;
    24→}
    25→
    26→interface UseEffectiveMediaReturn {
    27→  effectiveVideoUrl: string | undefined;
    28→  effectiveMediaUrl: string | undefined;
    29→  effectiveImageDimensions: { width: number; height: number };
    30→}
    31→
    32→export function useEffectiveMedia({
    33→  isVideo,
    34→  activeVariant,
    35→  effectiveImageUrl,
    36→  imageDimensions,
    37→  projectAspectRatio,
    38→}: UseEffectiveMediaProps): UseEffectiveMediaReturn {
    39→  // Get the effective video URL (active variant or current media)
    40→  const effectiveVideoUrl = useMemo(() => {
    41→    if (isVideo && activeVariant) {
    42→      return activeVariant.location ?? undefined;
    43→    }
    44→    return effectiveImageUrl;
    45→  }, [isVideo, activeVariant, effectiveImageUrl]);
    46→
    47→  // For images, use the active variant's location when a variant is explicitly selected
    48→  const effectiveMediaUrl = useMemo(() => {
    49→
    50→    // If an active variant is set (any variant, including primary), use its location
    51→    if (activeVariant && activeVariant.location) {
    52→      return activeVariant.location;
    53→    }
    54→    // Otherwise use the standard effective image URL
    55→    return effectiveImageUrl;
    56→  }, [activeVariant, effectiveImageUrl]);
    57→
    58→  // Compute effective dimensions that are GUARANTEED to have a value
    59→  // This is computed synchronously during render, so there's no flicker
    60→  // Priority: extracted/loaded dimensions > project aspect ratio > 16:9 default
    61→  const effectiveImageDimensions = useMemo(() => {
    62→    // Use actual dimensions if we have them
    63→    if (imageDimensions) {
    64→      return imageDimensions;
    65→    }
    66→
    67→    // Fallback to project aspect ratio
    68→    if (projectAspectRatio) {
    69→      const resolution = ASPECT_RATIO_TO_RESOLUTION[projectAspectRatio];
    70→      if (resolution && resolution.includes('x')) {
    71→        const [w, h] = resolution.split('x').map(Number);
    72→        if (!isNaN(w) && !isNaN(h) && w > 0 && h > 0) {
    73→          return { width: w, height: h };
    74→        }
    75→      }
    76→    }
    77→
    78→    // Absolute last resort: 16:9 default
    79→    return { width: 1920, height: 1080 };
    80→  }, [imageDimensions, projectAspectRatio]);
    81→
    82→  return {
    83→    effectiveVideoUrl,
    84→    effectiveMediaUrl,
    85→    effectiveImageDimensions,
    86→  };
    87→}
    88→

   293→export function buildIndividualTravelSegmentParams(
   294→  params: IndividualTravelSegmentParams,
   295→  finalResolution: string,
   296→): Record<string, unknown> {
   297→  const state = buildSegmentState(params);
   298→  const orchestratorDetails = buildOrchestratorDetails(params, state, finalResolution);
   299→  const sourceSnapshot = buildTaskPayloadSnapshot(params.originalParams);
   300→  const legacyContractTaskId = extractOrchestratorTaskIdParam(params.originalParams);
   301→  const legacyRunId = extractRunIdParam(params.originalParams);
   302→  const orchestratorTaskId = resolveSnapshotOrchestratorTaskId(sourceSnapshot)
   303→    ?? legacyContractTaskId
   304→    ?? resolveStringCandidate(
   305→      asString(state.orchDetails.orchestrator_task_id),
   306→      asString(state.orig.orchestrator_task_id_ref),
   307→    );
   308→  const runId = resolveSnapshotRunId(sourceSnapshot)
   309→    ?? legacyRunId
   310→    ?? asString(state.orchDetails.run_id);
   311→
   312→  const hasPairShotGenerationId = Boolean(
   313→    params.pair_shot_generation_id
   314→    || params.start_image_variant_id
   315→    || params.end_image_variant_id,
   316→  );
   317→  const segmentRegenerationMode = hasPairShotGenerationId
   318→    ? 'segment_regen_from_pair'
   319→    : 'segment_regen_from_order';
   320→  const generationRouting = params.child_generation_id
   321→    ? 'variant_child'
   322→    : 'child_generation';
   323→
   324→  const familyContract = buildIndividualSegmentFamilyContract({
   325→    segmentRegenerationMode,
   326→    generationRouting,
   327→    segmentIndex: params.segment_index,
   328→    hasEndImage: Boolean(params.end_image_url),
   329→    hasPairShotGenerationId,
   330→  });
   331→
   332→  const composedPayload = composeTaskFamilyPayload({
   333→    taskFamily: 'individual_travel_segment',
   334→    orchestratorDetails,
   335→    orchestrationInput: {
   336→      taskFamily: 'individual_travel_segment',
   337→      orchestratorTaskId,
   338→      runId,
   339→      parentGenerationId: params.parent_generation_id,
   340→      childGenerationId: params.child_generation_id,
   341→      childOrder: params.segment_index,
   342→      shotId: params.shot_id,
   343→      generationRouting,
   344→      siblingLookup: runId ? 'run_id' : 'orchestrator_task_id',
   345→      segmentRegenerationMode,
   346→    },
   347→    taskViewInput: {
   348→      inputImages: state.inputImages,
   349→      prompt: state.basePrompt,
   350→      enhancedPrompt: state.enhancedPrompt,
   351→      negativePrompt: state.negativePrompt,
   352→      modelName: state.modelName,
   353→      resolution: finalResolution,
   354→    },
   355→    familyContract,
   356→  });

   358→  const taskParams = {

   360→    ...composedPayload,
   361→  };
   362→  taskParams.individual_segment_params = buildIndividualSegmentParamsPayload(params, state);
   363→  return taskParams;

    32→
    33→export function useJoinClips({
    34→  media,
    35→  isVideo,
    36→  selectedProjectId,
    37→}: UseJoinClipsProps): UseJoinClipsReturn {
    38→  const navigate = useNavigate();
    39→
    40→  const [isAddingToJoin, setIsAddingToJoin] = useState(false);
    41→  const [addToJoinSuccess, setAddToJoinSuccess] = useState(false);
    42→
    43→  const handleAddToJoin = useCallback(() => {
    44→
    45→    if (!media || !isVideo) {
    46→      return;
    47→    }
    48→
    49→    setIsAddingToJoin(true);
    50→    try {
    51→      // Get the video URL from the media object
    52→      // For videos, 'location' is the primary storage field
    53→      // 'url' is not a declared field on GenerationRow but may exist at runtime from raw DB data
    54→      const mediaRecord = media as unknown as Record<string, unknown>;
    55→      const videoUrl = media.location || (mediaRecord.url as string | undefined) || media.imageUrl;
    56→      const thumbnailUrl = media.thumbUrl || media.thumbnail_url;
    57→
    58→      if (!videoUrl) {
    59→        console.error('[JoinClipsDebug] No video URL found on media object!', media);
    60→        setIsAddingToJoin(false);
    61→        return;
    62→      }
    63→
    64→      const userId = readUserIdFromStorage();
    65→      const [REDACTED](selectedProjectId, userId);
    66→
    67→      // Get existing pending clips or start fresh
    68→      const existingData = localStorage.getItem(queueKey);
    69→      const parsedPending = existingData ? JSON.parse(existingData) : [];
    70→      const pendingClips: PendingJoinClipEntry[] = Array.isArray(parsedPending) ? parsedPending : [];
    71→
    72→      // Add new clip (avoid duplicates by generationId)
    73→      if (!pendingClips.some(clip => clip.generationId === media.id)) {
    74→        const newClip: PendingJoinClipEntry = {
    75→          videoUrl,
    76→          thumbnailUrl: thumbnailUrl ?? undefined,
    77→          generationId: media.id,
    78→          timestamp: Date.now(),
    79→          ...(selectedProjectId ? { projectId: selectedProjectId } : {}),
    80→          ...(userId ? { userId } : {}),
    81→        };
    82→        enqueueJoinClipsIntent(newClip, { projectId: selectedProjectId, userId });
    83→        pendingClips.push(newClip);
    84→        localStorage.setItem(queueKey, JSON.stringify(pendingClips));
    85→      }

    87→      setAddToJoinSuccess(true);
    88→      setTimeout(() => setAddToJoinSuccess(false), 2000);

    91→    } finally {

    93→    }
    94→  }, [media, isVideo, selectedProjectId]);

    98→  }, [navigate]);

    12→export interface SourceVariantData {
    13→  id: string;
    14→  location: string;
    15→  thumbnail_url: string | null;
    16→  variant_type: string | null;
    17→  is_primary: boolean;
    18→}
    19→
    20→/** Enriched generation data with shot associations */
    21→interface SourceGenerationWithAssociations extends GenerationRow {
    22→  all_shot_associations: Array<{ shot_id: string; timeline_frame: number | null }>;
    23→}
    24→
    25→interface UseSourceGenerationReturn {
    26→  sourceGenerationData: SourceGenerationWithAssociations | null;
    27→  sourcePrimaryVariant: SourceVariantData | null;
    28→}
    29→
    30→/**
    31→ * Hook to fetch and manage source generation (based_on) data
    32→ * Fetches the generation that this media was derived from, plus its primary variant
    33→ */
    34→export const useSourceGeneration = ({
    35→  media
    36→}: UseSourceGenerationParams): UseSourceGenerationReturn => {
    37→  const [sourceGenerationData, setSourceGenerationData] = useState<SourceGenerationWithAssociations | null>(null);
    38→  const [sourcePrimaryVariant, setSourcePrimaryVariant] = useState<SourceVariantData | null>(null);
    39→  const metadataBasedOnId = (media.metadata as Record<string, unknown> | null)?.based_on as string | undefined;
    40→
    41→  useEffect(() => {
    42→    const basedOnId = media.based_on;
    43→    const basedOnFromMetadata = metadataBasedOnId;
    44→
    45→    // Check both direct field and metadata
    46→    const effectiveBasedOnId = basedOnId || basedOnFromMetadata;
    47→    
    48→    if (!effectiveBasedOnId) {
    49→      setSourceGenerationData(null);
    50→      setSourcePrimaryVariant(null);
    51→      return;
    52→    }
    53→    
    54→    const fetchSourceGeneration = async () => {
    55→      try {
    56→        // Fetch source generation with shot associations and primary variant
    57→        // Use left join (no !inner) so we get the generation even if it's not in any shot
    58→        const { data, error } = await supabase().from('generations')
    59→          .select(`
    60→            *,
    61→            generation_variants!generation_variants_generation_id_fkey(
    62→              id,
    63→              location,
    64→              thumbnail_url,
    65→              variant_type,
    66→              is_primary
    67→            )
    68→          `)
    69→          .eq('id', effectiveBasedOnId)
    70→          .maybeSingle();
    71→
    72→        if (error) throw error;
    73→
    74→        if (data) {
    75→          // Extract shot associations from joined data
    76→          const joinedData = data as unknown as Record<string, unknown>;
    77→          const shotAssociations = expandShotData(
    78→            joinedData.shot_data as Record<string, unknown> | null | undefined,
    79→          );
    80→          const variants = (joinedData.generation_variants || []) as SourceVariantData[];
    81→          
    82→          // Find primary variant
    83→          const primaryVariant = variants.find((v) => v.is_primary) || null;
    84→          
    85→          // Add shot associations to the data for easy access
    86→          const enrichedData: SourceGenerationWithAssociations = {
    87→            ...data as unknown as GenerationRow,
    88→            all_shot_associations: shotAssociations,
    89→          };
    90→
    91→          setSourceGenerationData(enrichedData);
    92→          setSourcePrimaryVariant(primaryVariant);
    93→        } else {
    94→          setSourceGenerationData(null);
    95→          setSourcePrimaryVariant(null);
    96→        }
    97→      } catch (error) {
    98→        normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'useSourceGeneration', showToast: false });
    99→        // Don't show toast - this is a non-critical feature
   100→        setSourceGenerationData(null);
   101→        setSourcePrimaryVariant(null);
   102→      }
   103→    };
   104→    
   105→    void fetchSourceGeneration();
   106→  }, [media.based_on, metadataBasedOnId]);
   107→
   108→  return {
   109→    sourceGenerationData,
   110→    sourcePrimaryVariant
   111→  };
   112→};
   113→

    19→export function updateAllShotsCaches(

    22→  updater: (old: Shot[] | undefined) => Shot[],
    23→  onlyExisting: boolean = false
