    36→ */
    37→function normalizePositions(
    38→  allFinalPositions: Array<{ id: string; frame: number }>
    39→): Map<string, { newFrame: number; reason: string }> {
    40→  const normalizedUpdates = new Map<string, { newFrame: number; reason: string }>();
    41→
    42→  if (allFinalPositions.length === 0) return normalizedUpdates;
    43→
    44→  // Sort by frame position
    45→  const sorted = [...allFinalPositions].sort((a, b) => a.frame - b.frame);
    46→
    47→  let currentFrame = 0;
    48→
    49→  for (let i = 0; i < sorted.length; i++) {
    50→    const item = sorted[i];
    51→
    52→    if (i === 0) {
    53→      if (item.frame !== 0) {
    54→        normalizedUpdates.set(item.id, { newFrame: 0, reason: 'Normalized to start at 0' });
    55→      }
    56→      currentFrame = 0;
    57→    } else {
    58→      const prevItem = sorted[i - 1];
    59→      const originalGap = item.frame - prevItem.frame;
    60→      const normalizedGap = Math.min(originalGap, MAX_FRAME_GAP);
    61→      const normalizedFrame = currentFrame + normalizedGap;
    62→
    63→      if (normalizedFrame !== item.frame) {
    64→        normalizedUpdates.set(item.id, {
    65→          newFrame: normalizedFrame,
    66→          reason: originalGap > MAX_FRAME_GAP
    67→            ? `Gap compressed from ${originalGap} to ${normalizedGap}`
    68→            : 'Shifted to maintain sequence'
    69→        });
    70→      }
    71→      currentFrame = normalizedFrame;
    72→    }
    73→  }
    74→
    75→  return normalizedUpdates;
    76→}
    77→
    78→// ============================================================================
    79→// Frame distribution for drag-and-drop
    80→// ============================================================================
    81→
    82→/**
    83→ * Find a ShotGeneration by canonical shot_generations.id.
    84→ */
    85→export function findGeneration(
    86→  shotGenerations: ShotGeneration[],
    87→  key?: string | null
    88→): ShotGeneration | undefined {
    89→  if (!key) return undefined;
    90→  return shotGenerations.find(sg => sg.id === key);
    91→}
    92→
    93→interface DistributionContext {
    94→  draggedShotGens: ShotGeneration[];
    95→  draggedItemIds: string[];
    96→  newStartIndex: number;
    97→  allItems: Array<{ id: string; timeline_frame: number | null }>;
    98→  shotGenerations: ShotGeneration[];
    99→}
   100→
   101→/**
   102→ * Calculate frame positions for dragged items based on their new position in the list.
   103→ * Returns accumulated updates (not yet deduplicated or normalized).
   104→ */
   105→export function calculateDistributedFrames(ctx: DistributionContext): FrameUpdate[] {
   106→  const { draggedShotGens, draggedItemIds, newStartIndex, allItems, shotGenerations } = ctx;
   107→  const accumulateUpdates: FrameUpdate[] = [];
   108→
   109→  const pushUpdate = (id: string, frame: number, reason: string) => {
   110→    const normalizedFrame = Math.max(0, Math.floor(frame));
   111→    accumulateUpdates.push({ id, newFrame: normalizedFrame, reason });
   112→  };
   113→
   114→  const newEndIndex = newStartIndex + draggedItemIds.length - 1;
   115→  const predecessor = newStartIndex > 0 ? allItems[newStartIndex - 1] : null;
   116→  const successor = newEndIndex < allItems.length - 1 ? allItems[newEndIndex + 1] : null;
   117→
   118→  if (newStartIndex === 0 && successor) {
   119→    // Special case: dropping at position 0
   120→    calculateDropAtPositionZero(
   121→      draggedShotGens, draggedItemIds, newEndIndex, allItems, shotGenerations, successor, pushUpdate
   122→    );
   123→  } else if (predecessor && successor && predecessor.timeline_frame != null && successor.timeline_frame != null) {
   124→    // Between two items - distribute evenly in the gap
   125→    const gap = successor.timeline_frame - predecessor.timeline_frame;
   126→    const numItems = draggedItemIds.length;
   127→    const interval = gap / (numItems + 1);
   128→
   129→    draggedShotGens.forEach((sg, i) => {
   130→      const newFrame = predecessor.timeline_frame! + (interval * (i + 1));
   131→      pushUpdate(sg.id, newFrame, `Distributed in gap (${i + 1}/${numItems})`);
   132→    });
   133→  } else if (predecessor && predecessor.timeline_frame != null) {
   134→    // At end - extend timeline using average spacing of existing items
   135→    const existingFrames = allItems
   136→      .filter(item => item.timeline_frame != null)
   137→      .map(item => item.timeline_frame!);
   138→    const spacing = calculateAverageSpacing(existingFrames, DEFAULT_FRAME_SPACING);
   139→
   140→    draggedShotGens.forEach((sg, i) => {
   141→      const newFrame = predecessor.timeline_frame! + (spacing * (i + 1));
   142→      pushUpdate(sg.id, newFrame, `Extend at end (${i + 1}/${draggedItemIds.length})`);
   143→    });
   144→  } else if (successor && successor.timeline_frame != null) {
   145→    // At start - distribute between 0 and successor
   146→    const gap = successor.timeline_frame;
   147→    const numItems = draggedItemIds.length;
   148→    const interval = gap / (numItems + 1);
   149→
   150→    draggedShotGens.forEach((sg, i) => {
   151→      const newFrame = interval * (i + 1);
   152→      pushUpdate(sg.id, newFrame, `Distributed from start (${i + 1}/${numItems})`);
   153→    });
   154→  } else {
   155→    // First items in timeline - start at 0 and space by default
   156→
   157→    draggedShotGens.forEach((sg, i) => {
   158→      const newFrame = DEFAULT_FRAME_SPACING * i;
   159→      pushUpdate(sg.id, newFrame, `Initial placement (${i + 1}/${draggedItemIds.length})`);
   160→    });
   161→  }
   162→
   163→  return accumulateUpdates;
   164→}
   165→
   166→/**
   167→ * Handle the special case of dropping items at position 0.
   168→ */
   169→function calculateDropAtPositionZero(
   170→  draggedShotGens: ShotGeneration[],
   171→  draggedItemIds: string[],
   172→  newEndIndex: number,
   173→  allItems: Array<{ id: string; timeline_frame: number | null }>,
   174→  shotGenerations: ShotGeneration[],
   175→  successor: { id: string; timeline_frame: number | null },
   176→  pushUpdate: (id: string, frame: number, reason: string) => void
   177→) {
   178→  const displacedFirstItem = successor;
   179→  const oldSecondItem = newEndIndex + 2 < allItems.length ? allItems[newEndIndex + 2] : null;
   180→
   181→  // First dragged item goes to frame 0
   182→  pushUpdate(draggedShotGens[0].id, 0, 'First item at position 0');
   183→
   184→  // Calculate new position for displaced first item
   185→  let displacedNewFrame: number;
   186→  if (oldSecondItem?.timeline_frame != null) {
   187→    displacedNewFrame = Math.floor((0 + oldSecondItem.timeline_frame) / 2);
   188→  } else if (displacedFirstItem.timeline_frame != null) {
   189→    displacedNewFrame = Math.max(DEFAULT_FRAME_SPACING, displacedFirstItem.timeline_frame);
   190→  } else {
   191→    displacedNewFrame = DEFAULT_FRAME_SPACING;
   192→  }
   193→
   194→  // Update displaced item
   195→  const displacedShotGen = findGeneration(shotGenerations, displacedFirstItem.id);
   196→  if (displacedShotGen?.id) {
   197→    pushUpdate(displacedShotGen.id, displacedNewFrame, 'Displaced first item shifted');
   198→  }
   199→
   200→  // Distribute remaining dragged items between 0 and displaced item's new position
   201→  if (draggedItemIds.length > 1) {
   202→    const numRemaining = draggedItemIds.length - 1;
   203→    const gap = displacedNewFrame;
   204→    const interval = gap / (numRemaining + 1);
   205→
   206→    for (let i = 1; i < draggedItemIds.length; i++) {
   207→      const newFrame = interval * i;
   208→      pushUpdate(draggedShotGens[i].id, newFrame, `Distributed after first (${i}/${draggedItemIds.length})`);
   209→    }
   210→  }
   211→}
   212→
   213→// ============================================================================
   214→// Update deduplication
   215→// ============================================================================
   216→
   217→/**
   218→ * Deduplicate frame updates (last write wins per id).
   219→ */
   220→export function deduplicateUpdates(
   221→  updates: FrameUpdate[]
   222→): Map<string, { newFrame: number; reason: string }> {
   223→  const uniqueUpdates = new Map<string, { newFrame: number; reason: string }>();
   224→  updates.forEach(entry => {
   225→    const existing = uniqueUpdates.get(entry.id);
   226→    if (!existing || existing.newFrame !== entry.newFrame) {
   227→      uniqueUpdates.set(entry.id, { newFrame: entry.newFrame, reason: entry.reason });
   228→    }
   229→  });
   230→  return uniqueUpdates;
   231→}
   232→
   233→/**
   234→ * Build the complete picture of final positions (updated + unchanged) for all positioned items,
   235→ * then normalize and merge back into the updates map.
   236→ */
   237→export function buildAndNormalizeFinalPositions(
   238→  uniqueUpdates: Map<string, { newFrame: number; reason: string }>,
   239→  shotGenerations: ShotGeneration[]
   240→): Map<string, { newFrame: number; reason: string }> {
   241→  const allFinalPositions: Array<{ id: string; frame: number }> = [];
   242→
   243→  for (const sg of shotGenerations) {
   244→    if (sg.timeline_frame == null || sg.timeline_frame < 0) continue;
   245→    const update = uniqueUpdates.get(sg.id);
   246→    const finalFrame = update ? update.newFrame : sg.timeline_frame;
   247→    allFinalPositions.push({ id: sg.id, frame: finalFrame });
   248→  }
   249→
   250→  allFinalPositions.sort((a, b) => a.frame - b.frame);
   251→
   252→  if (allFinalPositions.length === 0) return uniqueUpdates;
   253→
   254→  const normalizedUpdates = normalizePositions(allFinalPositions);
   255→
   256→  // Merge normalized updates into uniqueUpdates
   257→  for (const [id, payload] of normalizedUpdates) {
   258→    const existing = uniqueUpdates.get(id);
   259→    if (existing) {
   260→      uniqueUpdates.set(id, { newFrame: payload.newFrame, reason: `${existing.reason} → ${payload.reason}` });
   261→    } else {
   262→      uniqueUpdates.set(id, payload);
   263→    }
   264→  }
   265→
   266→  return uniqueUpdates;
   267→}
   268→

1→import { useCallback } from 'react';
     2→import { getSupabaseClientResult } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
     3→import {
     4→  operationFailure,
     5→  operationSuccess,
     6→  type OperationResult,
     7→} from '@/shared/lib/operationResult';
     8→import { getStorageItem, removeStorageItems } from './storage';
     9→import { runAuthSupabaseOperation } from './runAuthSupabaseOperation';
    10→
    11→const REFERRAL_KEYS = [
    12→  'referralCode',
    13→  'referralSessionId',
    14→  'referralFingerprint',
    15→  'referralTimestamp',
    16→] as const;
    17→
    18→export function useAuthReferralFinalize() {
    19→  return useCallback(async (): Promise<OperationResult<{ finalized: boolean }>> => {
    20→    const supabaseResult = getSupabaseClientResult();
    21→    if (!supabaseResult.ok) {
    22→      return operationFailure(supabaseResult.error, {
    23→        policy: 'degrade',
    24→        recoverable: true,
    25→        errorCode: 'supabase_runtime_uninitialized',
    26→        message: 'Supabase runtime is not initialized while finalizing referrals.',
    27→      });
    28→    }
    29→    const supabase = supabaseResult.client;
    30→    const referralSessionId = getStorageItem(
    31→      'referralSessionId',
    32→      'useAuthReferralFinalize.read.referralSessionId',
    33→    );
    34→    const referralFingerprint = getStorageItem(
    35→      'referralFingerprint',
    36→      'useAuthReferralFinalize.read.referralFingerprint',
    37→    );
    38→    const referralCode = getStorageItem(
    39→      'referralCode',
    40→      'useAuthReferralFinalize.read.referralCode',
    41→    );
    42→
    43→    if (!referralCode || !referralSessionId || !referralFingerprint) {
    44→      return operationSuccess({ finalized: false });
    45→    }
    46→
    47→    return runAuthSupabaseOperation({
    48→      context: 'useAuthReferralFinalize.finalize',
    49→      errorCode: 'referral_finalize_failed',
    50→      showToast: false,
    51→      run: async () => {
    52→        const { error } = await supabase.rpc('create_referral_from_session', {
    53→          p_session_id: referralSessionId,
    54→          p_fingerprint: referralFingerprint,
    55→        });
    56→        if (error) {
    57→          throw error;
    58→        }
    59→        removeStorageItems(REFERRAL_KEYS, 'useAuthReferralFinalize.cleanup');
    60→        return { finalized: true };
    61→      },
    62→    });
    63→  }, []);
    64→}
    65→

     2→
     3→import {
     4→  type SupabaseClientAccessResult,

     8→} from '@/integrations/supabase/runtime/supabaseRuntime';
     9→
    10→export type { SupabaseClientAccessResult };
    11→
    12→export interface SupabaseClientRegistry {
    13→  getClientResult: () => SupabaseClientAccessResult;

    15→
    16→/** Runtime bootstrap entrypoint for app startup. */
    17→export function initializeSupabase() {
    18→  return initializeSupabaseClientRuntime();
    19→}
    20→
    21→export function initializeSupabaseResult(): SupabaseClientAccessResult {
    22→  try {
    23→    const client = initializeSupabase();
    24→    return { ok: true, client };
    25→  } catch (error) {
    26→    return { ok: false, error: normalizeSupabaseError(error) };

    29→
    30→/** Runtime accessor that never throws; callers can branch on initialization state. */
    31→export function getSupabaseClientResult(): SupabaseClientAccessResult {
    32→  const result = getSupabaseRuntimeClientResult();
    33→  return result.ok ? result : { ok: false, error: normalizeSupabaseError(result.error) };

    41→export function getSupabaseClient() {
    42→  const result = supabaseClientRegistry.getClientResult();
    43→  if (!result.ok) {
    44→    throw result.error;
    45→  }

1→import { useCallback } from 'react';
     2→import { getSupabaseClientResult } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
     3→import { runAuthSupabaseOperation } from './auth/runAuthSupabaseOperation';
     4→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
     5→import {
     6→  operationFailure,
     7→  operationSuccess,
     8→  type OperationResult,
     9→} from '@/shared/lib/operationResult';
    10→
    11→type OAuthIntentCacheResult = OperationResult<{ cached: boolean }>;
    12→
    13→function cacheOAuthIntentFlag(): OAuthIntentCacheResult {
    14→  try {
    15→    localStorage.setItem('oauthInProgress', 'true');
    16→    return operationSuccess({ cached: true }, { policy: 'best_effort' });
    17→  } catch (error) {
    18→    return operationFailure(error, {
    19→      policy: 'degrade',
    20→      recoverable: true,
    21→      errorCode: 'oauth_intent_cache_failed',
    22→      message: 'Unable to cache OAuth intent in local storage.',
    23→      cause: error,
    24→    });
    25→  }
    26→}
    27→
    28→export function useDiscordSignIn() {
    29→  return useCallback(async () => {
    30→    const supabaseResult = getSupabaseClientResult();
    31→    if (!supabaseResult.ok) {
    32→      return operationFailure(supabaseResult.error, {
    33→        policy: 'degrade',
    34→        recoverable: true,
    35→        errorCode: 'supabase_runtime_uninitialized',
    36→        message: 'Supabase runtime is not initialized yet.',
    37→      });
    38→    }
    39→    const supabase = supabaseResult.client;
    40→    const intentCacheResult = cacheOAuthIntentFlag();
    41→    if (!intentCacheResult.ok) {
    42→      normalizeAndPresentError(intentCacheResult.error, {
    43→        context: 'useDiscordSignIn.cacheOauthIntent',
    44→        showToast: false,
    45→        logData: {
    46→          errorCode: intentCacheResult.errorCode,
    47→          policy: intentCacheResult.policy,
    48→          recoverable: intentCacheResult.recoverable,
    49→        },
    50→      });
    51→    }
    52→
    53→    const oauthStartResult = await runAuthSupabaseOperation({
    54→      context: 'useDiscordSignIn.startOAuth',
    55→      errorCode: 'discord_oauth_start_failed',
    56→      showToast: true,
    57→      toastTitle: 'Failed to start Discord sign-in. Please try again.',
    58→      run: async () => {
    59→        const { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithOAuth({
    60→          provider: 'discord',
    61→          options: {
    62→            redirectTo: window.location.origin,
    63→          },
    64→        });
    65→
    66→        if (error) {
    67→          throw error;
    68→        }
    69→
    70→        return { started: true as const };
    71→      },
    72→    });
    73→
    74→    if (!oauthStartResult.ok) {
    75→      return oauthStartResult;
    76→    }
    77→
    78→    return operationSuccess(
    79→      {
    80→        ...oauthStartResult.value,
    81→        oauthIntentCached: intentCacheResult.ok,
    82→      },
    83→      {
    84→        policy: intentCacheResult.ok ? oauthStartResult.policy : 'degrade',
    85→      },
    86→    );
    87→  }, []);
    88→}
    89→

   121→  const smartPollingConfig = useSmartPollingConfig(taskQueryKeys.paginated(safeCacheProjectKey));
   122→

   125→    queryFn: createPaginatedTasksQueryFn({

   127→      allProjectIds,
   128→      effectiveProjectId,
   129→      status,
   130→      taskType,
   131→      visibleTaskTypes,
   132→      limit,
   133→      offset,
   134→      page,
   135→    }, safeCacheProjectKey),
   136→    enabled: allProjects ? !!allProjectIds?.length : !!effectiveProjectId,
   137→    placeholderData: keepPreviousData,
   138→    ...QUERY_PRESETS.realtimeBacked,
   139→    ...smartPollingConfig,
   140→    refetchIntervalInBackground: true,
   141→    retry: STANDARD_RETRY,
   142→    retryDelay: STANDARD_RETRY_DELAY,
   143→  });
   144→
   145→  useProcessingRefetchGuard(status, query);

    37→interface AbortSignalCapable<T> {
    38→  abortSignal?: (signal: AbortSignal) => T;

    40→
    41→function isAbortSignal(value: unknown): value is AbortSignal {
    42→  return !!value
    43→    && typeof value === 'object'
    44→    && 'aborted' in value

    48→function maybeAttachAbortSignal<T>(query: T, signal?: AbortSignal): T {
    49→  if (!signal) return query;
    50→
    51→  const candidate = query as T & AbortSignalCapable<T>;
    52→  if (typeof candidate.abortSignal === 'function') {
    53→    return candidate.abortSignal(signal);
    54→  }
    55→
    56→  return query;
    57→}

    59→function throwIfAborted(signal?: AbortSignal): void {
    60→  if (signal?.aborted) {

    63→      cause: signal.reason,

    65→  }

   216→/**

   220→ */
   221→function isSettingsWrapper(data: unknown): data is SettingsFetchResult {
   222→  if (!data || typeof data !== 'object') return false;
   223→  return 'settings' in data && 'hasShotSettings' in data;
   224→}
   225→
   226→/**

   228→ * Cache stores data as { settings: T, hasShotSettings: boolean }
   229→ */
   230→export function extractSettingsFromCache<T>(cacheData: unknown): T | undefined {
   231→  if (!cacheData) return undefined;
   232→  return isSettingsWrapper(cacheData) ? (cacheData.settings as T) : (cacheData as T);

   235→/**

   237→ * Use this in setQueryData callbacks for optimistic updates

   240→ * @param updater - Either an object of updates, or a function that receives prevSettings and returns updates

   242→export function updateSettingsCache<T extends Record<string, unknown>>(
   243→  prev: unknown,

   246→  const wrapper = isSettingsWrapper(prev);
   247→  const prevSettings = (wrapper ? ((prev as SettingsFetchResult).settings ?? {}) : (prev ?? {})) as T;
   248→  const updates = typeof updater === 'function' ? updater(prevSettings) : updater;
   249→  return {
   250→    settings: { ...prevSettings, ...updates } as T,
   251→    hasShotSettings: wrapper ? ((prev as SettingsFetchResult).hasShotSettings ?? false) : false
   252→  };
   253→}
   254→
   255→// ============================================================================
   256→// Query retry helper
   257→// ============================================================================
   258→
   259→/** Determines whether a failed settings query should be retried. */
   260→function shouldRetrySettingsQuery(failureCount: number, error: Error): boolean {
   261→  const classified = classifyToolSettingsError(error);
   262→  if (
   263→    classified.code === 'auth_required'
   264→    || classified.code === 'cancelled'
   265→    || classified.code === 'network'
   266→  ) {
   267→    return false;
   268→  }
   269→  return failureCount < 3;
   270→}
   271→
   272→// ============================================================================
   273→// Mutation success/error helpers
   274→// ============================================================================
   275→
   276→/** Merge mutation result into query cache and refetch related caches. */
   277→function handleMutationSuccess(
   278→  fullMergedSettings: Record<string, unknown> | null,
   279→  toolId: string,
   280→  projectId: string | undefined,
   281→  shotId: string | undefined,
   282→  queryClient: ReturnType<typeof useQueryClient>,
   283→) {
   284→  if (fullMergedSettings === null) return;
   285→
   286→  queryClient.setQueryData(
   287→    queryKeys.settings.tool(toolId, projectId, shotId),
   288→    (oldData: unknown) => {
   289→      const oldWrapper = isSettingsWrapper(oldData);
   290→      const oldSettings = oldWrapper
   291→        ? (((oldData as SettingsFetchResult).settings ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>)
   292→        : ((oldData ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>);
   293→      const mergedSettings = deepMerge({}, oldSettings, fullMergedSettings);
   294→
   295→      return {
   296→        settings: mergedSettings,
   297→        hasShotSettings: oldWrapper ? ((oldData as SettingsFetchResult).hasShotSettings ?? false) : false
   298→      };
   299→    }
   300→  );
   301→
   302→  if (shotId) {
   303→    queryClient.refetchQueries({ [REDACTED](shotId) });
   304→  }
   305→}
   306→
   307→/** Log/toast mutation errors and invalidate cache for non-network failures. */
   308→function handleMutationError(
   309→  error: Error,
   310→  toolId: string,
   311→  projectId: string | undefined,
   312→  shotId: string | undefined,
   313→  queryClient: ReturnType<typeof useQueryClient>,
   314→) {
   315→  const classified = classifyToolSettingsError(error);
   316→
   317→  if (classified.code === 'cancelled') {
   318→    return;
   319→  }
   320→
   321→  if (classified.code === 'network') return;
   322→
   323→  normalizeAndPresentError(classified, { context: 'useToolSettings.update', toastTitle: `Failed to save ${toolId} settings` });
   324→
   325→  queryClient.invalidateQueries({
   326→    [REDACTED](toolId, projectId, shotId)
   327→  });
   328→}
   329→
   330→// Type overloads
   331→export function useToolSettings<T>(toolId: string, context?: { projectId?: string; shotId?: string; enabled?: boolean }): {
   332→  settings: T | undefined;
   333→  isLoading: boolean;
   334→  error: Error | null;
   335→  update: (scope: SettingsScope, settings: Partial<T>) => Promise<void>;
   336→  isUpdating: boolean;
   337→  /** Whether the shot had settings stored in DB (vs just defaults/project settings) */
   338→  hasShotSettings: boolean;
   339→};
   340→
   341→/**
   342→ * Low-level hook for reading and writing tool settings across all scopes.
   343→ *
   344→ * Performs cascade resolution (defaults -> user -> project -> shot) and returns
   345→ * a merged settings object. Writes go through the global settings write queue.
   346→ *
   347→ * Most features should use `useAutoSaveSettings` instead, which adds auto-save,
   348→ * dirty tracking, and entity-change handling on top of this hook.
   349→ *
   350→ * Use this directly only when you need manual save control or complex write patterns.
   351→ *
   352→ * @see docs/structure_detail/settings_system.md for the full settings hook decision tree
   353→ */
   354→export function useToolSettings<T>(
   355→  toolId: string,
   356→  context?: { projectId?: string; shotId?: string; enabled?: boolean }
   357→) {
   358→  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
   359→
   360→  // Determine parameter shapes
   361→  const projectIdFromRuntime = getProjectSelectionFallbackId() ?? undefined;
   362→  const projectId: string | undefined = context?.projectId ?? projectIdFromRuntime ?? undefined;
   363→  const shotId: string | undefined = context?.shotId;
   364→  const fetchEnabled: boolean = context?.enabled ?? true;
   365→
   366→  // Refs to access current values in stable callbacks without recreating them
   367→  const projectIdRef = useRef(projectId);
   368→  projectIdRef.current = projectId;
   369→  const shotIdRef = useRef(shotId);
   370→  shotIdRef.current = shotId;
   371→
   372→  // Fetch merged settings using Supabase with mobile optimizations
   373→  const { data: queryResult, isLoading, error } = useQuery({
   374→    [REDACTED](toolId, projectId, shotId),
   375→    queryFn: async ({ signal }): Promise<SettingsFetchResult> => {
   376→      return fetchToolSettingsSupabaseOrThrow(toolId, { projectId, shotId }, signal);
   377→    },
   378→    enabled: !!toolId && fetchEnabled,
   379→    ...QUERY_PRESETS.static,
   380→    staleTime: 10 * 60 * 1000,
   381→    retry: shouldRetrySettingsQuery,
   382→    retryDelay: STANDARD_RETRY_DELAY,
   383→    networkMode: 'online',
   384→  });
   385→
   386→  // Extract settings and hasShotSettings from the query result
   387→  const wrapper = isSettingsWrapper(queryResult);
   388→  const settings = wrapper ? (queryResult as SettingsFetchResult).settings : queryResult;
   389→  const hasShotSettings = wrapper ? ((queryResult as SettingsFetchResult).hasShotSettings ?? false) : false;
   390→
   391→  // Log errors for debugging (except expected cancellations)
   392→  if (error && classifyToolSettingsError(error).code !== 'cancelled') {
   393→    normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'useToolSettings', showToast: false });
   394→  }
   395→
   396→  // Update settings mutation
   397→  const updateMutation = useMutation({
   398→    mutationFn: async ({ scope, settings: newSettings, entityId }: {
   399→      scope: SettingsScope;
   400→      settings: Partial<T>;
   401→      entityId?: string;
   402→    }) => {
   403→      let idForScope: string | undefined = entityId;
   404→
   405→      if (!idForScope) {
   406→        if (scope === 'user') {
   407→          const { data: { user } } = await resolveAndCacheUserId();
   408→          idForScope = user?.id;
   409→          if (!idForScope) {
   410→            throw new ToolSettingsError(
   411→              'auth_required',
   412→              'Authentication required for user settings update',
   413→            );
   414→          }
   415→        } else if (scope === 'project') {
   416→          idForScope = projectId;
   417→        } else if (scope === 'shot') {
   418→          idForScope = shotId;
   419→        }
   420→      }
   421→
   422→      if (!idForScope) {
   423→        throw new ToolSettingsError(
   424→          'invalid_scope_identifier',
   425→          `Missing identifier for ${scope} tool settings update`,
   426→        );
   427→      }
   428→
   429→      const fullMergedSettings = await updateToolSettingsSupabase({
   430→          scope,
   431→          id: idForScope,
   432→          toolId,
   433→          patch: newSettings,
   434→      });
   435→
   436→      return fullMergedSettings;
   437→    },
   438→    onSuccess: (fullMergedSettings) => {
   439→      handleMutationSuccess(fullMergedSettings, toolId, projectId, shotId, queryClient);
   440→    },
   441→    onError: (error: Error) => {
   442→      handleMutationError(error, toolId, projectId, shotId, queryClient);
   443→    },
   444→  });
   445→
   446→  // Get stable reference to mutateAsync - useMutation returns a new object each render
   447→  // but mutateAsync itself is stable
   448→  const mutateAsyncRef = useRef(updateMutation.mutateAsync);
   449→  mutateAsyncRef.current = updateMutation.mutateAsync;
   450→
   451→  // CRITICAL: Wrap in useCallback with stable deps to prevent cascading re-renders.
   452→  // Use refs to access current projectId/shotId without recreating this function.
   453→  // The entityId is snapshotted at call time via refs for correctness.
   454→  const update = useCallback(async (scope: SettingsScope, settings: Partial<T>): Promise<void> => {
   455→    // Snapshot the target entity id NOW to prevent cross-project/shot overwrites
   456→    // Use refs to get current values without causing callback recreation
   457→    const entityId = scope === 'project' ? projectIdRef.current : (scope === 'shot' ? shotIdRef.current : undefined);
   458→
   459→    // NOTE: No debounce here - callers (like useShotSettings) are responsible for debouncing.
   460→    // Using mutateAsync so callers can await the actual DB write completion.
   461→    // Use ref to access stable mutateAsync without recreating this callback.
   462→    await mutateAsyncRef.current({ scope, settings, entityId });
   463→  }, []); // Empty deps - all values accessed via refs for stability
   464→
   465→  return useMemo(() => ({
   466→    settings: settings as T | undefined,
   467→    isLoading,
   468→    error: error as Error | null,
   469→    update,
   470→    isUpdating: updateMutation.isPending,
   471→    hasShotSettings,
   472→  }), [settings, isLoading, error, update, updateMutation.isPending, hasShotSettings]);
   473→}
   474→

     9→function isRetryableNetworkError(err: unknown): boolean {
    10→  const message = (err as Error)?.message?.toLowerCase() || '';
    11→  const status = (err instanceof Object && 'status' in err) ? (err as { status: unknown }).status : undefined;

    13→  const isNetworkError = message.includes('load failed') ||

    19→    message.includes('forbidden') ||
    20→    message.includes('not found') ||
    21→    message.includes('quota') ||
    22→    status === 401 ||
    23→    status === 403 ||
    24→    status === 404;
    25→
    26→  return isNetworkError && !isServerError;
    27→}

     3→type SettingsScopeIdentifier = 'user' | 'project' | 'shot';
     4→type SettingsScopeTableName = 'users' | 'projects' | 'shots';
     5→
     6→export function resolveSettingsScopeTable(scope: SettingsScopeIdentifier): SettingsScopeTableName {
     7→  switch (scope) {
     8→    case 'user':
     9→      return 'users';
    10→    case 'project':
    11→      return 'projects';
    12→    case 'shot':
    13→      return 'shots';
    14→  }
    15→
    16→  throw new Error(`Invalid settings scope: ${String(scope)}`);

    18→
    19→export function selectSettingsForScope(scope: SettingsScopeIdentifier, id: string) {
    20→  const tableName = resolveSettingsScopeTable(scope);
    21→  return getSupabaseClient()
    22→    .from(tableName)
    23→    .select('settings')
    24→    .eq('id', id)
    25→    .single();

1→import { useEffect, useRef, useCallback, RefObject } from 'react';
     2→
     3→type EventType = 'click' | 'mousedown' | 'touchstart';
     4→
     5→interface UseClickOutsideOptions {
     6→  /** Event type(s) to listen for (default: ['mousedown']) */
     7→  events?: EventType[];
     8→  /** Whether the hook is enabled (default: true) */
     9→  enabled?: boolean;
    10→  /** Delay before attaching listeners (ms) - prevents catching the click that opened the element */
    11→  delay?: number;
    12→  /** Use capture phase for event listeners */
    13→  capture?: boolean;
    14→}
    15→
    16→/**
    17→ * Hook that calls a callback when user clicks/touches outside the referenced element.
    18→ *
    19→ * @param callback - Function to call when click outside is detected
    20→ * @param options - Configuration options
    21→ * @returns ref - Attach this to the element you want to detect clicks outside of
    22→ *
    23→ * @example
    24→ * // Basic usage - click outside to close
    25→ * const ref = useClickOutside(() => setIsOpen(false));
    26→ * return <div ref={ref}>...</div>;
    27→ *
    28→ * @example
    29→ * // With options - touch support for iPad
    30→ * const ref = useClickOutside(
    31→ *   () => setSelectedEndpoint(null),
    32→ *   { events: ['touchstart'], enabled: isTablet && selectedEndpoint !== null }
    33→ * );
    34→ *
    35→ * @example
    36→ * // With existing ref
    37→ * const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
    38→ * useClickOutside(() => setIsActive(false), { enabled: isActive }, containerRef);
    39→ */
    40→export function useClickOutside<T extends HTMLElement = HTMLDivElement>(
    41→  callback: () => void,
    42→  options: UseClickOutsideOptions = {},
    43→  existingRef?: RefObject<T>
    44→): RefObject<T> {
    45→  const {
    46→    events = ['mousedown'],
    47→    enabled = true,
    48→    delay = 0,
    49→    capture = false,
    50→  } = options;
    51→
    52→  const internalRef = useRef<T>(null);
    53→  const ref = existingRef || internalRef;
    54→  const callbackRef = useRef(callback);
    55→
    56→  // Keep callback ref up to date
    57→  useEffect(() => {
    58→    callbackRef.current = callback;
    59→  }, [callback]);
    60→
    61→  const handleEvent = useCallback((event: Event) => {
    62→    if (ref.current && !ref.current.contains(event.target as Node)) {
    63→      callbackRef.current();
    64→    }
    65→  }, [ref]);
    66→
    67→  useEffect(() => {
    68→    if (!enabled) return;
    69→
    70→    const subscribe = () => {
    71→      events.forEach((eventType) => {
    72→        document.addEventListener(eventType, handleEvent, { capture });
    73→      });
    74→    };
    75→
    76→    const unsubscribe = () => {
    77→      events.forEach((eventType) => {
    78→        document.removeEventListener(eventType, handleEvent, { capture });
    79→      });
    80→    };
    81→
    82→    // Delay subscription to avoid catching the event that triggered this state
    83→    const timeoutId = delay > 0 ? setTimeout(subscribe, delay) : null;
    84→    if (!timeoutId) subscribe();
    85→
    86→    return () => {
    87→      if (timeoutId) clearTimeout(timeoutId);
    88→      unsubscribe();
    89→    };
    90→  }, [enabled, events, handleEvent, delay, capture]);
    91→
    92→  return ref;
    93→}
    94→

    46→}
    47→
    48→export function resetDebugChannel(channel: DebugChannel): void {
    49→  delete overrides[channel];
    50→}
    51→
    52→export function debugChannelEnabled(channel: DebugChannel): boolean {
    53→  return isChannelEnabled(channel);
    54→}
    55→
    56→export function debugLog(
    57→  channel: DebugChannel,
    58→  message: string,
    59→  data?: unknown,
    60→  force: boolean = false,
    61→): void {
    62→  if (!shouldLog(channel, force)) {
    63→    return;
    64→  }
    65→
    66→  if (data === undefined) {
    67→    console.log(withTag(channel, message));

1→import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
     2→import { useToolSettings } from '@/shared/hooks/useToolSettings';
     3→import { SETTINGS_IDS } from '@/shared/lib/settingsIds';
     4→
     5→// Import canonical types from single source of truth
     6→import {
     7→  type LastUsedEditSettings,
     8→  type VideoEditSubMode,
     9→  type PanelMode,
    10→  DEFAULT_LAST_USED,
    11→  SYNCED_SETTING_KEYS
    12→} from '../model/editSettingsTypes';
    13→
    14→// Re-export types for backwards compatibility
    15→export type { LastUsedEditSettings, VideoEditSubMode, PanelMode };
    16→
    17→// localStorage keys for instant access (no loading delay)
    18→const STORAGE_KEY_PROJECT = (projectId: string) => `lightbox-edit-last-used-${projectId}`;
    19→const STORAGE_KEY_GLOBAL = 'lightbox-edit-last-used-global';
    20→
    21→interface UseLastUsedEditSettingsReturn {
    22→  lastUsed: LastUsedEditSettings;
    23→  updateLastUsed: (settings: Partial<LastUsedEditSettings>) => void;
    24→  isLoading: boolean;
    25→}
    26→
    27→interface UseLastUsedEditSettingsProps {
    28→  projectId: string | null;
    29→  enabled?: boolean;
    30→}
    31→
    32→/**
    33→ * Compares two LastUsedEditSettings objects to detect changes.
    34→ * Uses SYNCED_SETTING_KEYS for synced fields, plus user-preference fields.
    35→ */
    36→function hasSettingsChanged(prev: LastUsedEditSettings, next: LastUsedEditSettings): boolean {
    37→  // Check synced settings (using the canonical list)
    38→  for (const key of SYNCED_SETTING_KEYS) {
    39→    if (key === 'advancedSettings') {
    40→      // Deep compare for objects
    41→      if (JSON.stringify(prev.advancedSettings) !== JSON.stringify(next.advancedSettings)) {
    42→        return true;
    43→      }
    44→    } else {
    45→      // Shallow compare for primitives
    46→      if (prev[key as keyof LastUsedEditSettings] !== next[key as keyof LastUsedEditSettings]) {
    47→        return true;
    48→      }
    49→    }
    50→  }
    51→
    52→  // Check user-preference settings
    53→  if (prev.editMode !== next.editMode) return true;
    54→  if (prev.videoEditSubMode !== next.videoEditSubMode) return true;
    55→  if (prev.panelMode !== next.panelMode) return true;
    56→
    57→  return false;
    58→}
    59→
    60→/**
    61→ * Hook for managing "last used" edit settings
    62→ *
    63→ * Storage strategy (following shotSettingsInheritance pattern):
    64→ * 1. localStorage (project-specific) - instant access
    65→ * 2. localStorage (global) - fallback for new projects
    66→ * 3. useToolSettings (user → project) - cross-device sync
    67→ *
    68→ * On update: saves to all locations
    69→ * On load: localStorage first (instant), then syncs from DB
    70→ */
    71→export function useLastUsedEditSettings({
    72→  projectId,
    73→  enabled = true,
    74→}: UseLastUsedEditSettingsProps): UseLastUsedEditSettingsReturn {
    75→
    76→  // Database storage via useToolSettings (cascades: user → project)
    77→  const {
    78→    settings: dbSettings,
    79→    isLoading: isDbLoading,
    80→    update: updateDbSettings,
    81→  } = useToolSettings<LastUsedEditSettings>(SETTINGS_IDS.LIGHTBOX_EDIT, {
    82→    projectId: projectId || undefined,
    83→    enabled: enabled && !!projectId,
    84→  });
    85→
    86→  // Track if we've synced from DB yet
    87→  const hasSyncedFromDbRef = useRef(false);
    88→  const lastProjectIdRef = useRef<string | null>(null);
    89→
    90→  // Get instant localStorage value (for zero-delay loading)
    91→  const getLocalStorageValue = useCallback((): LastUsedEditSettings => {
    92→    if (!projectId) return DEFAULT_LAST_USED;
    93→
    94→    try {
    95→      // Try project-specific first
    96→      const projectStored = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY_PROJECT(projectId));
    97→      if (projectStored) {
    98→        const parsed = JSON.parse(projectStored);
    99→        const merged = { ...DEFAULT_LAST_USED, ...parsed };
   100→        return merged;
   101→      }
   102→
   103→      // Fall back to global (for new projects)
   104→      const globalStored = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY_GLOBAL);
   105→      if (globalStored) {
   106→        const parsed = JSON.parse(globalStored);
   107→        const merged = { ...DEFAULT_LAST_USED, ...parsed };
   108→        return merged;
   109→      }
   110→    } catch {
   111→      // Failed to read localStorage
   112→    }
   113→
   114→    return DEFAULT_LAST_USED;
   115→  }, [projectId]);
   116→
   117→  // Use ref for current value to avoid re-render on every access
   118→  // Lazy initialization to prevent getLocalStorageValue from running every render
   119→  const currentValueRef = useRef<LastUsedEditSettings | null>(null);
   120→  if (currentValueRef.current === null) {
   121→    currentValueRef.current = getLocalStorageValue();
   122→  }
   123→
   124→  // Reset on project change
   125→  useEffect(() => {
   126→    if (projectId !== lastProjectIdRef.current) {
   127→      lastProjectIdRef.current = projectId;
   128→      hasSyncedFromDbRef.current = false;
   129→      currentValueRef.current = getLocalStorageValue();
   130→    }
   131→  }, [projectId, getLocalStorageValue]);
   132→
   133→  // Sync from DB when loaded (DB is source of truth for cross-device)
   134→  useEffect(() => {
   135→    if (!isDbLoading && dbSettings && !hasSyncedFromDbRef.current && projectId) {
   136→      hasSyncedFromDbRef.current = true;
   137→
   138→      // Merge DB settings (may have newer values from other device)
   139→      const merged = { ...currentValueRef.current, ...dbSettings };
   140→      currentValueRef.current = merged;
   141→
   142→      // Update localStorage with DB values
   143→      try {
   144→        localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY_PROJECT(projectId), JSON.stringify(merged));
   145→        localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY_GLOBAL, JSON.stringify(merged));
   146→      } catch { /* intentionally ignored */ }
   147→    }
   148→  }, [isDbLoading, dbSettings, projectId]);
   149→
   150→  // Update all storage locations
   151→  const updateLastUsed = useCallback((updates: Partial<LastUsedEditSettings>) => {
   152→    const prev = currentValueRef.current!;
   153→    const merged = { ...prev, ...updates };
   154→
   155→    // Check if anything actually changed
   156→    if (!hasSettingsChanged(prev, merged)) {
   157→      return;
   158→    }
   159→
   160→    currentValueRef.current = merged;
   161→
   162→    // Only log panelMode changes for PanelRestore debugging
   163→
   164→    // 1. Update localStorage (instant for next time)
   165→    try {
   166→      if (projectId) {
   167→        localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY_PROJECT(projectId), JSON.stringify(merged));
   168→      }
   169→      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY_GLOBAL, JSON.stringify(merged));
   170→    } catch { /* intentionally ignored */ }
   171→
   172→    // 2. Update database (cross-device sync)
   173→    // Save at user level only - "last used" is a personal preference, not project-specific
   174→    void updateDbSettings('user', merged).catch(() => {
   175→      // Swallow to avoid spam - useToolSettings handles errors
   176→    });
   177→  }, [projectId, updateDbSettings]);
   178→
   179→  return {
   180→    lastUsed: currentValueRef.current!,
   181→    updateLastUsed,
   182→    isLoading: isDbLoading && !hasSyncedFromDbRef.current,
   183→  };
   184→}

1→import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
     2→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
     3→import { GenerationRow } from '@/domains/generation/types';
     4→import { getSupabaseClient as supabase } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
     5→import { expandShotData } from '@/shared/lib/shotData';
     6→
     7→interface UseSourceGenerationParams {
     8→  media: GenerationRow;
     9→  onOpenExternalGeneration?: (generationId: string, derivedContext?: string[]) => Promise<void>;
    10→}
    11→
    12→export interface SourceVariantData {
    13→  id: string;
    14→  location: string;
    15→  thumbnail_url: string | null;
    16→  variant_type: string | null;
    17→  is_primary: boolean;
    18→}
    19→
    20→/** Enriched generation data with shot associations */
    21→interface SourceGenerationWithAssociations extends GenerationRow {
    22→  all_shot_associations: Array<{ shot_id: string; timeline_frame: number | null }>;
    23→}
    24→
    25→interface UseSourceGenerationReturn {
    26→  sourceGenerationData: SourceGenerationWithAssociations | null;
    27→  sourcePrimaryVariant: SourceVariantData | null;
    28→}
    29→
    30→/**
    31→ * Hook to fetch and manage source generation (based_on) data
    32→ * Fetches the generation that this media was derived from, plus its primary variant
    33→ */
    34→export const useSourceGeneration = ({
    35→  media
    36→}: UseSourceGenerationParams): UseSourceGenerationReturn => {
    37→  const [sourceGenerationData, setSourceGenerationData] = useState<SourceGenerationWithAssociations | null>(null);
    38→  const [sourcePrimaryVariant, setSourcePrimaryVariant] = useState<SourceVariantData | null>(null);
    39→  const metadataBasedOnId = (media.metadata as Record<string, unknown> | null)?.based_on as string | undefined;
    40→
    41→  useEffect(() => {
    42→    const basedOnId = media.based_on;
    43→    const basedOnFromMetadata = metadataBasedOnId;
    44→
    45→    // Check both direct field and metadata
    46→    const effectiveBasedOnId = basedOnId || basedOnFromMetadata;
    47→    
    48→    if (!effectiveBasedOnId) {
    49→      setSourceGenerationData(null);
    50→      setSourcePrimaryVariant(null);
    51→      return;
    52→    }
    53→    
    54→    const fetchSourceGeneration = async () => {
    55→      try {
    56→        // Fetch source generation with shot associations and primary variant
    57→        // Use left join (no !inner) so we get the generation even if it's not in any shot
    58→        const { data, error } = await supabase().from('generations')
    59→          .select(`
    60→            *,
    61→            generation_variants!generation_variants_generation_id_fkey(
    62→              id,
    63→              location,
    64→              thumbnail_url,
    65→              variant_type,
    66→              is_primary
    67→            )
    68→          `)
    69→          .eq('id', effectiveBasedOnId)
    70→          .maybeSingle();
    71→
    72→        if (error) throw error;
    73→
    74→        if (data) {
    75→          // Extract shot associations from joined data
    76→          const joinedData = data as unknown as Record<string, unknown>;
    77→          const shotAssociations = expandShotData(
    78→            joinedData.shot_data as Record<string, unknown> | null | undefined,
    79→          );
    80→          const variants = (joinedData.generation_variants || []) as SourceVariantData[];
    81→          
    82→          // Find primary variant
    83→          const primaryVariant = variants.find((v) => v.is_primary) || null;
    84→          
    85→          // Add shot associations to the data for easy access
    86→          const enrichedData: SourceGenerationWithAssociations = {
    87→            ...data as unknown as GenerationRow,
    88→            all_shot_associations: shotAssociations,
    89→          };
    90→
    91→          setSourceGenerationData(enrichedData);
    92→          setSourcePrimaryVariant(primaryVariant);
    93→        } else {
    94→          setSourceGenerationData(null);
    95→          setSourcePrimaryVariant(null);
    96→        }
    97→      } catch (error) {
    98→        normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'useSourceGeneration', showToast: false });
    99→        // Don't show toast - this is a non-critical feature
   100→        setSourceGenerationData(null);
   101→        setSourcePrimaryVariant(null);
   102→      }
   103→    };
   104→    
   105→    void fetchSourceGeneration();
   106→  }, [media.based_on, metadataBasedOnId]);
   107→
   108→  return {
   109→    sourceGenerationData,
   110→    sourcePrimaryVariant
   111→  };
   112→};
   113→

     2→
     3→interface UseLayoutModeParams {
     4→  isMobile: boolean;
     5→  showTaskDetails: boolean;

     7→  isVideo: boolean;

     9→  isMagicEditMode: boolean;

    11→
    12→interface UseLayoutModeReturn {
    13→  isTabletOrLarger: boolean;
    14→  isTouchLikeDevice: boolean;
    15→  shouldShowSidePanel: boolean;
    16→  isUnifiedEditMode: boolean;
    17→  isPortraitMode: boolean;

    19→
    20→/**
    21→ * Hook to detect layout mode and device capabilities
    22→ * Determines which layout variant to use (desktop/mobile/tablet)
    23→ */
    24→export const useLayoutMode = ({
    25→  showTaskDetails,
    26→  isSpecialEditMode,
    27→  isVideo,
    28→  isInpaintMode,
    29→  isMagicEditMode
    30→}: UseLayoutModeParams): UseLayoutModeReturn => {
    31→  // Use shared device detection hook for all device/orientation detection
    32→  const { isTabletOrLarger, isPortraitMode: isPortrait, isTouchDevice: isTouchLikeDevice } = useDeviceInfo();
    33→
    34→  // Unified special mode check - both inpaint and magic edit use the same layout
    35→  const isUnifiedEditMode = isInpaintMode || isMagicEditMode;
    36→
    37→  // Show sidebar on tablet/larger for: task details (even if loading), special edit modes, OR videos (always on iPad)
    38→  // Note: We show sidebar immediately for showTaskDetails to prevent layout jump while task loads
    39→  // Exception: On portrait tablets (like vertical iPad), use mobile layout for better UX
    40→  const shouldShowSidePanel = !isPortrait && ((showTaskDetails && isTabletOrLarger) || (isSpecialEditMode && isTabletOrLarger) || (isVideo && isTabletOrLarger));
    41→
    42→  return {
    43→    isTabletOrLarger,
    44→    isTouchLikeDevice,
    45→    shouldShowSidePanel,
    46→    isUnifiedEditMode,
    47→    isPortraitMode: isPortrait
    48→  };
    49→};

   185→
   186→    // Prefer override from gallery source
   187→    if (typeof associatedWithoutPositionInSelectedShot === 'boolean') {
   188→      // Check for composite key (mediaId:shotId) first, then fallback to simple mediaId
   189→      const compositeKey = `${media.id}:${selectedShotId}`;
   190→      const hasComposite = optimisticUnpositionedIds?.has(compositeKey);
   191→      const hasSimple = optimisticUnpositionedIds?.has(media.id);
   192→      return associatedWithoutPositionInSelectedShot || !!hasComposite || !!hasSimple;
   193→    }
   194→    
   195→    // Check optimistic state first - try composite key (mediaId:shotId), then fallback to simple mediaId
   196→    const compositeKey = `${media.id}:${selectedShotId}`;
   197→    if (optimisticUnpositionedIds?.has(compositeKey)) return true;
   198→    if (optimisticUnpositionedIds?.has(media.id)) return true;
   199→    
   200→    // Check if this media is associated with the selected shot without position
   201→    // First check single shot association
   202→    const mediaExtAssoc = media as GenerationRow & MediaWithShotFields;
   203→    if (mediaExtAssoc.shot_id === selectedShotId) {
   204→      return mediaExtAssoc.position === null || mediaExtAssoc.position === undefined;
   205→    }
   206→
   207→    // Check multiple shot associations
   208→    const assocShotAssociations = mediaExtAssoc.all_shot_associations;
   209→    if (assocShotAssociations && Array.isArray(assocShotAssociations)) {
   210→      const matchingAssociation = assocShotAssociations.find(
   211→        (assoc: ShotAssociation) => assoc.shot_id === selectedShotId
   212→      );
   213→      return !!(matchingAssociation &&
   214→             (matchingAssociation.position === null || matchingAssociation.position === undefined));
   215→    }
   216→    
   217→    return false;
   218→  }, [selectedShotId, media, optimisticUnpositionedIds, associatedWithoutPositionInSelectedShot]);
   219→
   220→  const handleAddToShotWithoutPosition = () => executeAddToShot(
   221→    onAddToShotWithoutPosition, isAlreadyAssociatedWithoutPosition, onShowSecondaryTick, onOptimisticUnpositioned
   222→  );
   223→
   224→  return {
   225→    isAlreadyPositionedInSelectedShot,
   226→    isAlreadyAssociatedWithoutPosition,
   227→    handleAddToShot,
   228→    handleAddToShotWithoutPosition,
   229→  };
   230→};

    11→  activateClickShield: () => void;
    12→}
    13→
    14→/**
    15→ * Hook for managing lightbox navigation
    16→ * Handles keyboard controls (arrow keys, escape) and safe closing with click shield
    17→ */
    18→export const useLightboxNavigation = ({
    19→  onNext,
    20→  onPrevious,
    21→  onClose,
    22→}: UseLightboxNavigationProps): UseLightboxNavigationReturn => {
    23→  
    24→  // Short-lived global click shield to absorb iOS synthetic clicks after touchend
    25→  const activateClickShield = useCallback(() => {
    26→    try {
    27→      const shield = document.createElement('div');
    28→      shield.setAttribute('data-mobile-click-shield', 'true');
    29→      shield.style.position = 'fixed';
    30→      shield.style.top = '0';
    31→      shield.style.left = '0';
    32→      shield.style.right = '0';
    33→      shield.style.bottom = '0';
    34→      shield.style.background = 'transparent';
    35→      shield.style.pointerEvents = 'all';
    36→      shield.style.zIndex = '2147483647';
    37→      shield.style.touchAction = 'none';
    38→
    39→      const block = (ev: Event) => {
    40→        try { ev.preventDefault(); } catch { /* intentionally ignored */ }
    41→        try { ev.stopPropagation(); } catch { /* intentionally ignored */ }
    42→        try { ev.stopImmediatePropagation?.(); } catch { /* intentionally ignored */ }
    43→      };
    44→
    45→      shield.addEventListener('click', block, true);
    46→      shield.addEventListener('pointerdown', block, true);
    47→      shield.addEventListener('pointerup', block, true);
    48→      shield.addEventListener('touchstart', block, { capture: true, passive: false } as AddEventListenerOptions);
    49→      shield.addEventListener('touchend', block, { capture: true, passive: false } as AddEventListenerOptions);
    50→
    51→      document.body.appendChild(shield);
    52→
    53→      window.setTimeout(() => {
    54→        try { shield.remove(); } catch { /* intentionally ignored */ }
    55→      }, 350);
    56→    } catch { /* intentionally ignored */ }
    57→  }, []);
    58→
    59→  const safeClose = useCallback(() => {
    60→    activateClickShield();
    61→    onClose();
    62→  }, [activateClickShield, onClose]);
    63→
    64→  /**
    65→   * Global key handler (capture phase)
    66→   * --------------------------------------------------
    67→   * Registered on the capture phase so it fires before any intermediate
    68→   * stopPropagation calls (Base-UI dialog internals swallow keydown
    69→   * during bubble phase in edit mode).
    70→   *
    71→   * Callbacks are stored in refs so the listener is registered once
    72→   * and never re-attached (avoids effect thrashing when parent re-renders).
    73→   */
    74→  const onNextRef = useRef(onNext);
    75→  const onPreviousRef = useRef(onPrevious);
    76→  const onCloseRef = useRef(onClose);
    77→  onNextRef.current = onNext;
    78→  onPreviousRef.current = onPrevious;
    79→  onCloseRef.current = onClose;
    80→
    81→  useEffect(() => {
    82→    /**
    83→     * CAPTURE-phase handler so arrow navigation works even when something
    84→     * in the DOM tree (e.g. Base-UI internals) calls stopPropagation on
    85→     * the keydown event during the bubble phase.
    86→     */
    87→    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
    88→      // Check if another dialog/modal is open on top
    89→      const dialogOverlays = document.querySelectorAll('[data-dialog-backdrop]');
    90→      const hasHigherZIndexDialog = Array.from(dialogOverlays).some((overlay) => {
    91→        const zIndex = parseInt(window.getComputedStyle(overlay as Element).zIndex || '0', 10);
    92→        return zIndex > 100000;
    93→      });
    94→      if (hasHigherZIndexDialog) return;
    95→
    96→      // Don't intercept arrow keys when user is in a text field
    97→      const active = document.activeElement;
    98→      const isTextInput = active instanceof HTMLInputElement
    99→        || active instanceof HTMLTextAreaElement
   100→        || (active as HTMLElement)?.isContentEditable;
   101→
   102→      if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' && onPreviousRef.current && !isTextInput) {
   103→        e.preventDefault();
   104→        onPreviousRef.current();
   105→      } else if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' && onNextRef.current && !isTextInput) {
   106→        e.preventDefault();
   107→        onNextRef.current();
   108→      } else if (e.key === 'Escape') {
   109→        e.preventDefault();
   110→        onCloseRef.current();
   111→      }
   112→    };
   113→
   114→    document.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown, true); // capture phase
   115→    return () => document.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown, true);
   116→  }, []); // stable — callbacks read from refs
   117→
   118→  return {
   119→    safeClose,
   120→    activateClickShield,
   121→  };
   122→};

   124→

1→/**
     2→ * Best-effort clipboard write that never throws.
     3→ * Returns true when the write succeeds.
     4→ */
     5→export async function writeClipboardTextSafe(
     6→  text: string,
     7→  options: { allowExecCommandFallback?: boolean } = {},
     8→): Promise<boolean> {
     9→  if (!text) {
    10→    return false;
    11→  }
    12→
    13→  if (typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && navigator.clipboard?.writeText) {
    14→    try {
    15→      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
    16→      return true;
    17→    } catch {
    18→      // fall through to optional fallback
    19→    }
    20→  }
    21→
    22→  if (!options.allowExecCommandFallback || typeof document === 'undefined') {
    23→    return false;
    24→  }
    25→
    26→  let textarea: HTMLTextAreaElement | null = null;
    27→  try {
    28→    textarea = document.createElement('textarea');
    29→    textarea.value = text;
    30→    textarea.style.position = 'fixed';
    31→    textarea.style.left = '-9999px';
    32→    document.body.appendChild(textarea);
    33→    textarea.select();
    34→    return document.execCommand('copy') === true;
    35→  } catch {
    36→    return false;
    37→  } finally {
    38→    if (textarea?.parentNode) {
    39→      textarea.parentNode.removeChild(textarea);
    40→    }
    41→  }
    42→}
    43→

1→/**
     2→ * Shot-generation link operations: add, remove, reorder images within shots.
     3→ * These operate on the shot_generations junction table.
     4→ *
     5→ * Helpers live in ./shotMutationHelpers.ts
     6→ * useDuplicateAsNewGeneration lives in ./useDuplicateAsNewGeneration.ts
     7→ */
     8→
     9→import { useMutation, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
    10→import { getSupabaseClient as supabase } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
    11→import { GenerationRow } from '@/domains/generation/types';
    12→import { toast } from '@/shared/components/ui/runtime/sonner';
    13→import { enqueueGenerationsInvalidation } from '@/shared/hooks/invalidation';
    14→import { queryKeys } from '@/shared/lib/queryKeys';
    15→import {
    16→  cancelShotsQueries,
    17→  findShotsCache,
    18→  updateAllShotsCaches,
    19→  rollbackShotsCaches,
    20→  rollbackShotGenerationsCache,
    21→  cancelShotGenerationsQuery
    22→} from './cacheUtils';
    23→import {
    24→  optimisticallyRemoveFromUnifiedGenerations,
    25→} from './shotMutationHelpers';
    26→import {
    27→  applyOptimisticCaches,
    28→  replaceOptimisticItemInCache,
    29→  replaceOptimisticItemInShotsCache,
    30→  runAddImageMutation,
    31→  toAddImageErrorMessage,
    32→  withVariableMetadata,
    33→  type AddImageToShotVariables,
    34→} from './addImageToShotHelpers';
    35→import { persistTimelineFrameBatch } from '@/shared/lib/timelineFrameBatchPersist';
    36→
    37→// Re-export useDuplicateAsNewGeneration for backwards compatibility
    38→export { useDuplicateAsNewGeneration } from './useDuplicateAsNewGeneration';
    39→
    40→// ============================================================================
    41→// ADD IMAGE TO SHOT (unified hook)
    42→// ============================================================================
    43→
    44→interface AddImageToShotContext {
    45→  previousShots: ReturnType<typeof findShotsCache> | undefined;
    46→  previousFastGens: GenerationRow[] | undefined;
    47→  project_id: string | undefined;
    48→  shot_id: string | undefined;
    49→  tempId?: string;
    50→}
    51→
    52→/**
    53→ * Add a generation to a shot.
    54→ *
    55→ * This is the unified hook that handles both positioned and unpositioned additions:
    56→ * - timelineFrame: undefined → auto-calculate position
    57→ * - timelineFrame: null → add without position (appears in unpositioned section)
    58→ * - timelineFrame: number → use explicit position
    59→ */
    60→export const useAddImageToShot = () => {
    61→  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
    62→
    63→  return useMutation<Record<string, unknown>, Error, AddImageToShotVariables, AddImageToShotContext>({
    64→    mutationFn: async (variables: AddImageToShotVariables) => {
    65→      const data = await runAddImageMutation(variables);
    66→      return withVariableMetadata(data, variables);
    67→    },
    68→
    69→    onMutate: async (variables): Promise<AddImageToShotContext> => {
    70→      const {
    71→        shot_id,
    72→        project_id,
    73→        imageUrl,
    74→        thumbUrl,
    75→        skipOptimistic,
    76→      } = variables;
    77→
    78→      if (!project_id) {
    79→        return { previousShots: undefined, previousFastGens: undefined, project_id: undefined, shot_id: undefined };
    80→      }
    81→
    82→      await cancelShotsQueries(queryClient, project_id);
    83→      await cancelShotGenerationsQuery(queryClient, shot_id);
    84→
    85→      const previousShots = findShotsCache(queryClient, project_id);
    86→      const previousFastGens = queryClient.getQueryData<GenerationRow[]>(
    87→        queryKeys.generations.byShot(shot_id)
    88→      );
    89→
    90→      let tempId: string | undefined;
    91→
    92→      // Only perform optimistic update if we have image URL and not skipped
    93→      if ((imageUrl || thumbUrl) && !skipOptimistic) {
    94→        tempId = `temp-${Date.now()}-${Math.random()}`;
    95→        applyOptimisticCaches(queryClient, variables, previousFastGens, tempId);
    96→      }
    97→
    98→      // Optimistically remove from unified-generations (for "items without shots" filter)
    99→      optimisticallyRemoveFromUnifiedGenerations(
   100→        queryClient,
   101→        project_id,
   102→        variables.generation_id
   103→      );
   104→
   105→      return { previousShots, previousFastGens, project_id, shot_id, tempId };
   106→    },
   107→
   108→    onError: (error: Error, _variables, context) => {
   109→      // Check for duplicate key constraint
   110→      const isDuplicateError =
   111→        error.message?.includes('unique_shot_generation_pair') ||
   112→        error.message?.includes('duplicate key value');
   113→
   114→      if (isDuplicateError) {
   115→        toast.error('Database error: unexpected constraint. Please try again.');
   116→        return;
   117→      }
   118→
   119→      // Rollback caches
   120→      if (context?.previousShots && context.project_id) {
   121→        rollbackShotsCaches(queryClient, context.project_id, context.previousShots);
   122→      }
   123→      if (context?.previousFastGens && context.shot_id) {
   124→        rollbackShotGenerationsCache(queryClient, context.shot_id, context.previousFastGens);
   125→      }
   126→      if (context?.project_id) {
   127→        queryClient.invalidateQueries({
   128→          [REDACTED](context.project_id),
   129→        });
   130→      }
   131→
   132→      toast.error(`Failed to add image to shot: ${toAddImageErrorMessage(error)}`);
   133→    },
   134→
   135→    onSuccess: (data, variables, context) => {
   136→      const { project_id, shot_id } = variables;
   137→
   138→      // Replace temp ID with real ID in cache
   139→      if (context?.tempId) {
   140→        replaceOptimisticItemInCache(queryClient, shot_id, context.tempId, data);
   141→        replaceOptimisticItemInShotsCache(queryClient, project_id, shot_id, context.tempId, data);
   142→      }
   143→
   144→      // Invalidate related queries
   145→      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED](project_id) });
   146→      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED](shot_id) });
   147→      queryClient.invalidateQueries({
   148→        [REDACTED](project_id),
   149→      });
   150→      // Invalidate byShot to ensure timeline refetches with complete data.
   151→      // Critical when the target shot's cache wasn't populated at mutation time
   152→      // (e.g., adding to a different shot than the one currently viewed),
   153→      // since no optimistic item would have been created in that case.
   154→      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED](shot_id) });
   155→      // Invalidate segment position map so videos reposition to match new timeline order
   156→      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED](shot_id) });
   157→      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED](shot_id, project_id) });
   158→    },
   159→  });
   160→};
   161→
   162→/**
   163→ * Add image to shot WITHOUT position.
   164→ * Backwards-compatible wrapper around useAddImageToShot.
   165→ *
   166→ * Note: This intentionally skips optimistic item creation in the shots cache
   167→ * (matching original behavior). The item will appear after realtime confirms.
   168→ * Only the unified-generations cache is updated optimistically (for instant
   169→ * removal from "items without shots" filter).
   170→ */
   171→export const useAddImageToShotWithoutPosition = () => {
   172→  const addMutation = useAddImageToShot();
   173→
   174→  return {
   175→    ...addMutation,
   176→    mutateAsync: (vars: Omit<AddImageToShotVariables, 'timelineFrame' | 'skipOptimistic'>) =>
   177→      addMutation.mutateAsync({ ...vars, timelineFrame: null, skipOptimistic: true }),
   178→    mutate: (vars: Omit<AddImageToShotVariables, 'timelineFrame' | 'skipOptimistic'>) =>
   179→      addMutation.mutate({ ...vars, timelineFrame: null, skipOptimistic: true }),
   180→  };
   181→};
   182→
   183→// ============================================================================
   184→// REMOVE IMAGE FROM SHOT
   185→// ============================================================================
   186→
   187→/**
   188→ * Remove image from shot's timeline (sets timeline_frame = NULL).
   189→ * This does NOT delete the shot_generations record - just removes the position.
   190→ */
   191→export const useRemoveImageFromShot = () => {
   192→  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
   193→  const log = import.meta.env.DEV ? (...args: Parameters<typeof console.log>) => console.log(...args) : () => {};
   194→
   195→  return useMutation({
   196→    mutationFn: async ({
   197→      shotId,
   198→      shotGenerationId,
   199→      projectId,
   200→      shiftItems,
   201→    }: {
   202→      shotId: string;
   203→      shotGenerationId: string;
   204→      projectId: string;
   205→      /** When deleting the first item, shift remaining items back */
   206→      shiftItems?: Array<{ id: string; newFrame: number }>;
   207→    }) => {
   208→      if (!shotId || !shotGenerationId || !projectId) {
   209→        throw new Error(`Missing required parameters`);
   210→      }
   211→
   212→      const { error } = await supabase().from('shot_generations')
   213→        .update({ timeline_frame: null })
   214→        .eq('id', shotGenerationId);
   215→
   216→      if (error) {
   217→        throw error;
   218→      }
   219→
   220→      // Persist frame shifts (optimistic update already applied in onMutate)
   221→      if (shiftItems && shiftItems.length > 0) {
   222→        await persistTimelineFrameBatch({
   223→          shotId,
   224→          updates: shiftItems.map((item) => ({
   225→            shotGenerationId: item.id,
   226→            timelineFrame: item.newFrame,
   227→            metadata: { user_positioned: true, drag_source: 'remove-shift' },
   228→          })),
   229→          operationLabel: 'remove-image-shift',
   230→          timeoutOperationName: 'remove-image-shift-rpc',
   231→          logPrefix: '[ShotGenerationMutations]',
   232→          log,
   233→        });
   234→      }
   235→
   236→      return { shotId, shotGenerationId, projectId };
   237→    },
   238→
   239→    onMutate: async (variables) => {
   240→      const { shotId, shotGenerationId, projectId, shiftItems } = variables;
   241→
   242→      await cancelShotsQueries(queryClient, projectId);
   243→      await cancelShotGenerationsQuery(queryClient, shotId);
   244→
   245→      const previousShots = findShotsCache(queryClient, projectId);
   246→      const previousFastGens = queryClient.getQueryData<GenerationRow[]>(
   247→        queryKeys.generations.byShot(shotId)
   248→      );
   249→
   250→      // Build a shift lookup for items that need frame updates
   251→      const shiftMap = new Map(shiftItems?.map(s => [s.id, s.newFrame]) ?? []);
   252→
   253→      // Optimistically: set timeline_frame = null on deleted item + shift remaining
   254→      if (previousFastGens) {
   255→        queryClient.setQueryData(
   256→          queryKeys.generations.byShot(shotId),
   257→          previousFastGens.map(g => {
   258→            if (g.id === shotGenerationId) return { ...g, timeline_frame: null };
   259→            const shifted = shiftMap.get(g.id);
   260→            if (shifted !== undefined) return { ...g, timeline_frame: shifted };
   261→            return g;
   262→          })
   263→        );
   264→      }
   265→
   266→      if (previousShots) {
   267→        updateAllShotsCaches(queryClient, projectId, (shots = []) =>
   268→          shots.map(shot => {
   269→            if (shot.id === shotId) {
   270→              return {
   271→                ...shot,
   272→                images: (shot.images ?? []).map(img => {
   273→                  if (img.id === shotGenerationId) return { ...img, timeline_frame: null };
   274→                  const shifted = shiftMap.get(img.id);
   275→                  if (shifted !== undefined) return { ...img, timeline_frame: shifted };
   276→                  return img;
   277→                }),
   278→              };
   279→            }
   280→            return shot;
   281→          })
   282→        );
   283→      }
   284→
   285→      return { previousShots, previousFastGens, projectId, shotId };
   286→    },
   287→
   288→    onError: (err: Error, _variables, context) => {
   289→      if (context?.previousShots && context.projectId) {
   290→        rollbackShotsCaches(queryClient, context.projectId, context.previousShots);
   291→      }
   292→      if (context?.previousFastGens && context.shotId) {
   293→        rollbackShotGenerationsCache(queryClient, context.shotId, context.previousFastGens);
   294→      }
   295→
   296→      toast.error(`Failed to remove image from timeline: ${err.message}`);
   297→    },
   298→
   299→    onSuccess: (data) => {
   300→      // Invalidate segment queries
   301→      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED](data.shotId) });
   302→      queryClient.invalidateQueries({
   303→        [REDACTED](data.shotId, data.projectId),
   304→      });
   305→    },
   306→  });
   307→};
   308→
   309→// ============================================================================
   310→// UPDATE SHOT IMAGE ORDER
   311→// ============================================================================
   312→
   313→export const useUpdateShotImageOrder = () => {
   314→  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
   315→
   316→  return useMutation({
   317→    mutationFn: async ({
   318→      updates,
   319→      projectId,
   320→      shotId,
   321→    }: {
   322→      updates: { shot_id: string; generation_id: string; timeline_frame: number }[];
   323→      projectId: string;
   324→      shotId: string;
   325→    }) => {
   326→      const promises = updates.map(update =>
   327→        supabase().from('shot_generations')
   328→          .update({ timeline_frame: update.timeline_frame })
   329→          .eq('shot_id', update.shot_id)
   330→          .eq('generation_id', update.generation_id)
   331→      );
   332→
   333→      const results = await Promise.all(promises);
   334→
   335→      const errors = results.filter(r => r.error);
   336→      if (errors.length > 0) {
   337→        throw new Error(`Reorder failed: ${errors.map(e => e.error?.message).join(', ')}`);
   338→      }
   339→
   340→      return { projectId, shotId, updates };
   341→    },
   342→
   343→    onMutate: async (variables) => {
   344→      const { updates, shotId } = variables;
   345→
   346→      await cancelShotGenerationsQuery(queryClient, shotId);
   347→
   348→      const previousFastGens = queryClient.getQueryData<GenerationRow[]>(
   349→        queryKeys.generations.byShot(shotId)
   350→      );
   351→
   352→      if (previousFastGens) {
   353→        const updatedGens = previousFastGens.map(gen => {
   354→          const update = updates.find(u => u.generation_id === gen.generation_id);
   355→          if (update) {
   356→            return { ...gen, timeline_frame: update.timeline_frame };
   357→          }
   358→          return gen;
   359→        });
   360→
   361→        updatedGens.sort((a, b) => (a.timeline_frame || 0) - (b.timeline_frame || 0));
   362→        queryClient.setQueryData(queryKeys.generations.byShot(shotId), updatedGens);
   363→      }
   364→
   365→      return { previousFastGens, shotId };
   366→    },
   367→
   368→    onError: (_err: Error, _variables, context) => {
   369→      if (context?.previousFastGens && context.shotId) {
   370→        rollbackShotGenerationsCache(queryClient, context.shotId, context.previousFastGens);
   371→      }
   372→
   373→      toast.error('Failed to reorder images');
   374→    },
   375→
   376→    onSuccess: (data) => {
   377→      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED](data.shotId) });
   378→      queryClient.invalidateQueries({
   379→        predicate: query => query.queryKey[0] === 'source-slot-generations',
   380→      });
   381→      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED](data.shotId) });
   382→      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED](data.shotId, data.projectId) });
   383→    },
   384→  });
   385→};
   386→
   387→// ============================================================================
   388→// POSITION EXISTING GENERATION IN SHOT
   389→// ============================================================================
   390→
   391→/**
   392→ * Position an existing generation that has NULL timeline_frame.
   393→ */
   394→export const usePositionExistingGenerationInShot = () => {
   395→  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
   396→
   397→  return useMutation({
   398→    mutationFn: async ({
   399→      shot_id,
   400→      generation_id,
   401→      project_id,
   402→    }: {
   403→      shot_id: string;
   404→      generation_id: string;
   405→      project_id: string;
   406→    }) => {
   407→      const { data, error } = await supabase().rpc('add_generation_to_shot', {
   408→        p_shot_id: shot_id,
   409→        p_generation_id: generation_id,
   410→        p_with_position: true,
   411→      });
   412→
   413→      if (error) {
   414→        throw error;
   415→      }
   416→
   417→      return { shot_id, generation_id, project_id, data };
   418→    },
   419→
   420→    onSuccess: (data) => {
   421→      enqueueGenerationsInvalidation(queryClient, data.shot_id, {
   422→        reason: 'add-image-to-shot',
   423→        scope: 'all',
   424→        includeShots: true,
   425→        projectId: data.project_id,
   426→        includeProjectUnified: true,
   427→      });
   428→    },
   429→
   430→    onError: (error: Error) => {
   431→      toast.error(`Failed to position image: ${error.message}`);
   432→    },
   433→  });
   434→};

    18→export function useDeleteSegmentHandler(
    19→  queryClient: ReturnType<typeof useQueryClient>,
    20→  setDeletingSegmentId: Dispatch<SetStateAction<string | null>>,
    21→  projectId?: string,
    22→) {

    28→        errorCode: 'shot_editor_segment_delete_missing_project_scope',

    41→        return operationSuccess(
    42→          { deleted: false } satisfies SegmentDeleteOperationResult,
    43→          { policy: 'best_effort' },
    44→        );
    45→      }

    47→      await syncSegmentDeletionCaches({
    48→        queryClient,

    51→        idsToDelete: deletion.idsToDelete,

    56→        { policy: 'best_effort' },

    69→    } finally {
