    79→  switch (scopeStatus) {
    80→    case 'scope_mismatch':
    81→      return 'Variant exists but does not belong to the active project scope';
    82→    case 'missing_project_scope':
    83→      return 'Variant does not have project scope metadata';
    84→    case 'missing_variant':
    85→      return 'Variant not found';
    86→    case 'missing_generation':
    87→      return 'Variant generation was not found';
    88→    case 'query_failed':
    89→      return `Variant scope lookup failed${queryError ? `: ${queryError}` : ''}`;
    90→    default:
    91→      return `Variant scope validation failed (${scopeStatus})`;
    92→  }
    93→}
    94→
    95→function toLineageScopeError(
    96→  error: unknown,
    97→  fallback: {
    98→    variantId: string;
    99→    projectId: string;
   100→    status: LineageScopeFailureStatus;
   101→    queryError?: string;
   102→  },
   103→): LineageScopeError {
   104→  if (isLineageScopeError(error)) {
   105→    return error;
   106→  }
   107→
   108→  const message = error instanceof Error
   109→    ? error.message
   110→    : buildScopeValidationErrorMessage(fallback.status, fallback.queryError);
   111→
   112→  return new LineageScopeError({
   113→    ...fallback,
   114→    message,
   115→  });
   116→}
   117→
   118→async function fetchVariantById(variantId: string, projectId: string): Promise<VariantRecord> {
   119→  const scope = await resolveVariantProjectScope(variantId, projectId);
   120→  if (scope.status !== 'ok' || !scope.generationId) {
   121→    throw new LineageScopeError({
   122→      status: scope.status as LineageScopeFailureStatus,
   123→      variantId,
   124→      projectId,
   125→      queryError: scope.queryError,
   126→      message: buildScopeValidationErrorMessage(scope.status, scope.queryError),
   127→    });
   128→  }
   129→
   130→  const { data, error } = await getSupabaseClient().from('generation_variants')
   131→    .select('id, generation_id, params, location, thumbnail_url, created_at, variant_type')
   132→    .eq('id', variantId)
   133→    .eq('generation_id', scope.generationId)
   134→    .single();
   135→
   136→  if (error) {
   137→    throw toLineageScopeError(error, {
   138→      status: 'query_failed',
   139→      variantId,
   140→      projectId,
   141→      queryError: error.message,
   142→    });
   143→  }
   144→
   145→  if (!data) {
   146→    throw new LineageScopeError({
   147→      status: 'missing_variant',
   148→      variantId,
   149→      projectId,
   150→      message: buildScopeValidationErrorMessage('missing_variant'),
   151→    });
   152→  }
   153→  return data as VariantRecord;
   154→}
   155→
   156→/**
   157→ * Recursively fetch the lineage chain for a variant.
   158→ * Follows `params.source_variant_id` across generation boundaries.
   159→ */
   160→async function fetchLineageChain(variantId: string, projectId: string): Promise<LineageItem[]> {
   161→  const chain: LineageItem[] = [];
   162→  const visited = new Set<string>();
   163→  let currentId: string | null = variantId;
   164→
   165→  while (currentId && !visited.has(currentId)) {
   166→    visited.add(currentId);
   167→    const variant = await fetchVariantById(currentId, projectId);
   168→
   169→    chain.unshift({
   170→      id: variant.id,
   171→      imageUrl: variant.location,
   172→      thumbnailUrl: variant.thumbnail_url,
   173→      createdAt: variant.created_at,
   174→      type: 'variant',
   175→      variantType: variant.variant_type,
   176→    });
   177→    currentId = readSourceVariantId(variant.params);
   178→  }
   179→
   180→  return chain;
   181→}
   182→
   183→/**
   184→ * Hook to fetch the full lineage chain for a variant.
   185→ *
   186→ * @param variantId - The variant ID to fetch lineage for
   187→ * @param projectId - Project scope required for lineage traversal
   188→ * @returns Object with chain (oldest to newest), loading state, and whether there's lineage
   189→ */
   190→export function useLineageChain(variantId: string | null, projectId: string | null): LineageChainResult {
   191→  const { data: chain = [], isLoading, error } = useQuery<LineageItem[], LineageScopeError>({
   192→    queryKey: [...generationQueryKeys.lineageChain(variantId!), projectId ?? '__no-project__'],
   193→    queryFn: async () => {
   194→      try {
   195→        return await fetchLineageChain(variantId!, projectId!);
   196→      } catch (caughtError) {
   197→        const normalizedError = toLineageScopeError(caughtError, {
   198→          status: 'query_failed',
   199→          variantId: variantId!,
   200→          projectId: projectId!,
   201→        });
   202→        normalizeAndPresentError(normalizedError, {
   203→          context: 'useLineageChain',
   204→          showToast: false,
   205→          logData: {
   206→            variantId: normalizedError.variantId,
   207→            projectId: normalizedError.projectId,
   208→            status: normalizedError.status,
   209→            queryError: normalizedError.queryError,
   210→          },
   211→        });
   212→        throw normalizedError;
   213→      }
   214→    },
   215→    enabled: !!variantId && !!projectId,
   216→    staleTime: 5 * 60 * 1000, // 5 minutes - lineage doesn't change
   217→    gcTime: 10 * 60 * 1000, // 10 minutes
   218→  });
   219→
   220→  return {
   221→    chain,
   222→    isLoading,
   223→    // Has lineage if chain has more than 1 item (the current variant + at least one ancestor)
   224→    hasLineage: chain.length > 1,
   225→    error: error ?? null,
   226→  };
   227→}
   228→
   229→/**
   230→ * Count the lineage chain length for a variant.
   231→ * Returns the number of ancestors (0 if no lineage, 1+ if has ancestors).
   232→ * This fetches directly without caching - use sparingly for initial checks.
   233→ *
   234→ * Reuses fetchLineageChain to avoid duplicating the traversal logic.
   235→ */
   236→export async function getLineageDepth(variantId: string, projectId: string): Promise<number> {
   237→  const chain = await fetchLineageChain(variantId, projectId);
   238→  // chain includes the variant itself; ancestors = chain length - 1
   239→  return Math.max(0, chain.length - 1);
   240→}
   241→
   242→// NOTE: Default export removed - use named export { useLineageChain } instead
   243→

1→const FRAME_QUANTIZATION_STEP = 4;
     2→const FRAME_QUANTIZATION_OFFSET = 1;
     3→
     4→export function quantizeTotalFrames(total: number, minTotal: number = 17): number {
     5→  const quantized =
     6→    Math.round((total - FRAME_QUANTIZATION_OFFSET) / FRAME_QUANTIZATION_STEP) *
     7→      FRAME_QUANTIZATION_STEP +
     8→    FRAME_QUANTIZATION_OFFSET;
     9→  return Math.max(minTotal, quantized);
    10→}
    11→
    12→export function getQuantizedGap(
    13→  desiredGap: number,
    14→  context: number,
    15→  minTotal: number = 17
    16→): number {
    17→  const total = context * 2 + desiredGap;
    18→  const quantizedTotal = quantizeTotalFrames(total, minTotal);
    19→  const gap = quantizedTotal - context * 2;
    20→
    21→  if (gap >= 1) {
    22→    return gap;
    23→  }
    24→
    25→  const minimumTotalWithPositiveGap = context * 2 + 1;
    26→  const validTotal = quantizeTotalFrames(minimumTotalWithPositiveGap, minTotal);
    27→  return validTotal - context * 2;
    28→}
    29→

1→export const fileToDataURL = (file: File): Promise<string> =>
     2→  new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
     3→    const reader = new FileReader();
     4→    reader.onload = () => resolve(reader.result as string);
     5→    reader.onerror = (error) => reject(error);
     6→    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
     7→  });
     8→
     9→export const dataURLtoFile = (
    10→  dataUrl: string,
    11→  filename: string,
    12→  fileType?: string
    13→): File | null => {
    14→  try {
    15→    const [metadata, payload] = dataUrl.split(',');
    16→    if (!metadata || !payload) {
    17→      throw new Error('Invalid Data URL format');
    18→    }
    19→
    20→    const mimeMatch = metadata.match(/:(.*?);/);
    21→    const mimeType =
    22→      fileType ||
    23→      (mimeMatch && mimeMatch[1]) ||
    24→      'application/octet-stream';
    25→    const decodedPayload = atob(payload);
    26→    const bytes = new Uint8Array(decodedPayload.length);
    27→
    28→    for (let i = 0; i < decodedPayload.length; i += 1) {
    29→      bytes[i] = decodedPayload.charCodeAt(i);
    30→    }
    31→
    32→    return new File([bytes], filename, { type: mimeType });
    33→  } catch {
    34→    return null;
    35→  }
    36→};
    37→

1→import { getSupabaseClient } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
     2→import { QueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
     3→import type { GenerationRow } from '@/domains/generation/types';
     4→import { Task } from '@/types/tasks';
     5→import { taskQueryKeys } from '@/shared/lib/queryKeys/tasks';
     6→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
     7→import { getProjectSelectionFallbackId } from '@/shared/contexts/projectSelectionStore';
     8→import { isTaskDbRow, mapTaskDbRowToTask } from '@/shared/lib/taskRowMapper';
     9→import {
    10→  getPrimaryTaskMappingsForGenerations,
    11→  toGenerationTaskMappingCacheEntry,
    12→  type GenerationTaskMappingCacheEntry,
    13→  type GenerationTaskMappingStatus,
    14→} from '@/shared/lib/generationTaskRepository';
    15→
    16→interface PreloadGenerationTaskMappingsOptions {
    17→  batchSize?: number;
    18→  delayBetweenBatches?: number;
    19→  preloadFullTaskData?: boolean;
    20→}
    21→
    22→interface GenerationWithTaskData extends GenerationRow {
    23→  taskId?: string | null;
    24→  taskData?: Task | null;
    25→  taskMappingStatus?: GenerationTaskMappingStatus;
    26→  taskMappingError?: string;
    27→}
    28→
    29→function resolveTaskScopeProjectId(projectId: string | null): string | null {
    30→  if (projectId && projectId.trim().length > 0) {
    31→    return projectId;
    32→  }
    33→  const selectedProjectId = getProjectSelectionFallbackId();
    34→  if (selectedProjectId && selectedProjectId.trim().length > 0) {
    35→    return selectedProjectId;
    36→  }
    37→  return null;
    38→}
    39→
    40→/**
    41→ * Preload task mappings for a batch of generations in the background.
    42→ */
    43→export async function preloadGenerationTaskMappings(
    44→  queryClient: QueryClient,
    45→  generationIds: string[],
    46→  projectId: string | null,
    47→  options: PreloadGenerationTaskMappingsOptions = {},
    48→) {
    49→  const supabase = getSupabaseClient();
    50→  const effectiveProjectId = resolveTaskScopeProjectId(projectId);
    51→  const {
    52→    batchSize = 5,
    53→    delayBetweenBatches = 200,
    54→    preloadFullTaskData = false,
    55→  } = options;
    56→
    57→  for (let i = 0; i < generationIds.length; i += batchSize) {
    58→    const batch = generationIds.slice(i, i + batchSize);
    59→
    60→    const mappings = await getPrimaryTaskMappingsForGenerations(batch, { projectId: effectiveProjectId ?? undefined });
    61→    let reportedBatchQueryFailure = false;
    62→
    63→    const prefetchTasks: Array<Promise<unknown>> = [];
    64→
    65→    batch.forEach((generationId) => {
    66→      const mapping = mappings.get(generationId);
    67→      const cacheEntry = toGenerationTaskMappingCacheEntry(mapping);
    68→      queryClient.setQueryData<GenerationTaskMappingCacheEntry>(
    69→        taskQueryKeys.generationMapping(generationId),
    70→        cacheEntry,
    71→      );
    72→
    73→      if (!reportedBatchQueryFailure && cacheEntry.status === 'query_failed' && cacheEntry.queryError) {
    74→        reportedBatchQueryFailure = true;
    75→        normalizeAndPresentError(new Error(cacheEntry.queryError), {
    76→          context: 'GenerationTaskCache',
    77→          showToast: false,
    78→        });
    79→      }
    80→
    81→      if (preloadFullTaskData && effectiveProjectId && cacheEntry.taskId && cacheEntry.status === 'ok') {
    82→        prefetchTasks.push(queryClient.prefetchQuery({
    83→          [REDACTED](cacheEntry.taskId, effectiveProjectId),
    84→          queryFn: async () => {
    85→            const { data, error } = await supabase
    86→              .from('tasks')
    87→              .select('*')
    88→              .eq('id', cacheEntry.taskId)
    89→              .eq('project_id', effectiveProjectId)
    90→              .single();
    91→
    92→            if (error) throw error;
    93→            if (!isTaskDbRow(data)) {
    94→              throw new Error('Task row has unexpected shape');
    95→            }
    96→            return mapTaskDbRowToTask(data);
    97→          },
    98→          staleTime: 2 * 60 * 1000,
    99→        }));
   100→      }
   101→    });
   102→
   103→    if (prefetchTasks.length > 0) {
   104→      await Promise.all(prefetchTasks);
   105→    }
   106→
   107→    if (i + batchSize < generationIds.length) {
   108→      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, delayBetweenBatches));
   109→    }
   110→  }
   111→}
   112→
   113→export function mergeGenerationsWithTaskData(
   114→  generations: GenerationRow[],
   115→  queryClient: QueryClient,
   116→  projectId: string | null,
   117→): GenerationWithTaskData[] {
   118→  const effectiveProjectId = resolveTaskScopeProjectId(projectId);
   119→
   120→  return generations.map((generation) => {
   121→    const generationId = generation.generation_id ?? generation.id;
   122→    const cachedMapping = queryClient.getQueryData<GenerationTaskMappingCacheEntry>(
   123→      taskQueryKeys.generationMapping(generationId),
   124→    );
   125→    const taskId = cachedMapping?.taskId || null;
   126→    const taskData = (taskId && effectiveProjectId)
   127→      ? queryClient.getQueryData<Task>(taskQueryKeys.single(taskId, effectiveProjectId))
   128→      : null;
   129→    const taskMappingStatus = cachedMapping?.status ?? (taskId ? 'ok' : 'not_loaded');
   130→
   131→    return {
   132→      ...generation,
   133→      taskId,
   134→      taskData,
   135→      taskMappingStatus,
   136→      ...(cachedMapping?.queryError ? { taskMappingError: cachedMapping.queryError } : {}),
   137→    };
   138→  });
   139→}
   140→

    73→      if (!reportedBatchQueryFailure && cacheEntry.status === 'query_failed' && cacheEntry.queryError) {
    74→        reportedBatchQueryFailure = true;
    75→        normalizeAndPresentError(new Error(cacheEntry.queryError), {
    76→          context: 'GenerationTaskCache',
    77→          showToast: false,
    78→        });
    79→      }
    80→
    81→      if (preloadFullTaskData && effectiveProjectId && cacheEntry.taskId && cacheEntry.status === 'ok') {
    82→        prefetchTasks.push(queryClient.prefetchQuery({
    83→          [REDACTED](cacheEntry.taskId, effectiveProjectId),
    84→          queryFn: async () => {
    85→            const { data, error } = await supabase
    86→              .from('tasks')
    87→              .select('*')
    88→              .eq('id', cacheEntry.taskId)
    89→              .eq('project_id', effectiveProjectId)
    90→              .single();
    91→
    92→            if (error) throw error;
    93→            if (!isTaskDbRow(data)) {
    94→              throw new Error('Task row has unexpected shape');
    95→            }
    96→            return mapTaskDbRowToTask(data);
    97→          },
    98→          staleTime: 2 * 60 * 1000,
    99→        }));
   100→      }
   101→    });
   102→
   103→    if (prefetchTasks.length > 0) {
   104→      await Promise.all(prefetchTasks);
   105→    }
   106→
   107→    if (i + batchSize < generationIds.length) {
   108→      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, delayBetweenBatches));
   109→    }
   110→  }
   111→}
   112→
   113→export function mergeGenerationsWithTaskData(
   114→  generations: GenerationRow[],
   115→  queryClient: QueryClient,
   116→  projectId: string | null,
   117→): GenerationWithTaskData[] {
   118→  const effectiveProjectId = resolveTaskScopeProjectId(projectId);
   119→
   120→  return generations.map((generation) => {
   121→    const generationId = generation.generation_id ?? generation.id;
   122→    const cachedMapping = queryClient.getQueryData<GenerationTaskMappingCacheEntry>(
   123→      taskQueryKeys.generationMapping(generationId),
   124→    );
   125→    const taskId = cachedMapping?.taskId || null;
   126→    const taskData = (taskId && effectiveProjectId)
   127→      ? queryClient.getQueryData<Task>(taskQueryKeys.single(taskId, effectiveProjectId))
   128→      : null;
   129→    const taskMappingStatus = cachedMapping?.status ?? (taskId ? 'ok' : 'not_loaded');
   130→
   131→    return {
   132→      ...generation,
   133→      taskId,
   134→      taskData,
   135→      taskMappingStatus,
   136→      ...(cachedMapping?.queryError ? { taskMappingError: cachedMapping.queryError } : {}),
   137→    };
   138→  });
   139→}

1→/**
     2→ * useReplaceInShot Hook
     3→ *
     4→ * Handles swapping timeline position from a parent generation to the current image.
     5→ * Used when user wants to replace a parent image in the timeline with a derived image.
     6→ */
     7→
     8→import { useCallback } from 'react';
     9→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
    10→import { getSupabaseClient as supabase } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
    11→
    12→interface UseReplaceInShotProps {
    13→  /** Callback to close the lightbox after successful replacement */
    14→  onClose: () => void;
    15→}
    16→
    17→interface UseReplaceInShotReturn {
    18→  /**
    19→   * Replace parent's timeline position with current image
    20→   * @param parentGenerationId - ID of the parent generation to remove from timeline
    21→   * @param currentMediaId - ID of the current media to place in timeline
    22→   * @param parentTimelineFrame - Timeline frame position to use
    23→   * @param shotId - Shot ID for the replacement
    24→   */
    25→  handleReplaceInShot: (
    26→    parentGenerationId: string,
    27→    currentMediaId: string,
    28→    parentTimelineFrame: number,
    29→    shotId: string
    30→  ) => Promise<void>;
    31→}
    32→
    33→export function useReplaceInShot({
    34→  onClose,
    35→}: UseReplaceInShotProps): UseReplaceInShotReturn {
    36→  const handleReplaceInShot = useCallback(async (
    37→    parentGenerationId: string,
    38→    currentMediaId: string,
    39→    parentTimelineFrame: number,
    40→    shotIdParam: string
    41→  ) => {
    42→
    43→    try {
    44→      // 1. Remove timeline_frame from parent's shot_generation record
    45→      const { error: removeError } = await supabase().from('shot_generations')
    46→        .update({ timeline_frame: null })
    47→        .eq('generation_id', parentGenerationId)
    48→        .eq('shot_id', shotIdParam);
    49→
    50→      if (removeError) throw removeError;
    51→
    52→      // 2. Update or create shot_generation for current image with the timeline_frame
    53→      // First check if current image already has a shot_generation for this shot
    54→      const { data: existingAssoc } = await supabase().from('shot_generations')
    55→        .select('id')
    56→        .eq('generation_id', currentMediaId)
    57→        .eq('shot_id', shotIdParam)
    58→        .single();
    59→
    60→      if (existingAssoc) {
    61→        // Update existing
    62→        const { error: updateError } = await supabase().from('shot_generations')
    63→          .update({
    64→            timeline_frame: parentTimelineFrame,
    65→            metadata: { user_positioned: true, drag_source: 'replace_parent' }
    66→          })
    67→          .eq('id', existingAssoc.id);
    68→
    69→        if (updateError) throw updateError;
    70→      } else {
    71→        // Create new
    72→        const { error: createError } = await supabase().from('shot_generations')
    73→          .insert({
    74→            shot_id: shotIdParam,
    75→            generation_id: currentMediaId,
    76→            timeline_frame: parentTimelineFrame,
    77→            metadata: { user_positioned: true, drag_source: 'replace_parent' }
    78→          });
    79→
    80→        if (createError) throw createError;
    81→      }
    82→
    83→      // Close lightbox to force refresh when reopened
    84→      onClose();
    85→    } catch (error) {
    86→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'useReplaceInShot', showToast: false });
    87→      throw error;
    88→    }
    89→  }, [onClose]);
    90→
    91→  return { handleReplaceInShot };
    92→}
    93→

    11→function isNoRowsPostgrestError(error: unknown): boolean {
    12→  if (!error || typeof error !== 'object') {

    14→  }
    15→  const candidate = error as { code?: unknown; message?: unknown };
    16→  if (candidate.code === POSTGREST_NO_ROWS_CODE) {
    17→    return true;
    18→  }
    19→  return typeof candidate.message === 'string' && /0 rows/i.test(candidate.message);

   199→      variantId,
   200→      generationId: null,
   201→      projectId: data.project_id ?? null,
   202→      status: 'missing_generation',
   203→    };
   204→  }
   205→
   206→  if (expectedProjectId && data.project_id && data.project_id !== expectedProjectId) {
   207→    return {
   208→      variantId,
   209→      generationId: data.generation_id,
   210→      projectId: data.project_id,
   211→      status: 'scope_mismatch',
   212→    };
   213→  }
   214→
   215→  const generationScope = await resolveGenerationProjectScope(
   216→    data.generation_id,
   217→    expectedProjectId,
   218→    supabaseRegistry,
   219→  );
   220→
   221→  if (generationScope.status !== 'ok') {
   222→    return {
   223→      variantId,
   224→      generationId: data.generation_id,
   225→      projectId: generationScope.projectId,
   226→      status: generationScope.status,
   227→      queryError: generationScope.queryError,
   228→    };
   229→  }
   230→
   231→  return {
   232→    variantId,
   233→    generationId: data.generation_id,
   234→    projectId: generationScope.projectId,
   235→    status: 'ok',
   236→  };
   237→}
   238→
   239→export async function getPrimaryTaskIdForGeneration(
   240→  generationId: string,
   241→  options?: GenerationTaskRepositoryOptions,
   242→): Promise<GenerationTaskMapping> {
   243→  const mappings = await getPrimaryTaskMappingsForGenerations([generationId], options);
   244→  return mappings.get(generationId) ?? {
   245→    generationId,
   246→    taskId: null,
   247→    status: 'missing_generation',
   248→  };
   249→}
   250→
   251→export async function getPrimaryTaskMappingsForGenerations(
   252→  generationIds: string[],
   253→  options?: GenerationTaskRepositoryOptions,
   254→): Promise<Map<string, GenerationTaskMapping>> {
   255→  if (generationIds.length === 0) {
   256→    return new Map();
   257→  }
   258→
   259→  const requestedIds = Array.from(new Set(generationIds));
   260→  const supabaseResult = (options?.supabaseRegistry ?? supabaseClientRegistry).getClientResult();
   261→  if (!supabaseResult.ok) {
   262→    const failures = new Map<string, GenerationTaskMapping>();
   263→    requestedIds.forEach((generationId) => {
   264→      failures.set(generationId, {
   265→        generationId,
   266→        taskId: null,
   267→        status: 'query_failed',
   268→        queryError: supabaseResult.error.message,
   269→      });
   270→    });
   271→    return failures;
   272→  }
   273→
   274→  const supabase = supabaseResult.client;
   275→  const query = supabase
   276→    .from('generations')
   277→    .select('id, tasks, project_id')
   278→    .in('id', requestedIds);
   279→
   280→  const { data, error } = await query;
   281→
   282→  if (error) {
   283→    const failures = new Map<string, GenerationTaskMapping>();
   284→    requestedIds.forEach((generationId) => {
   285→      failures.set(generationId, {
   286→        generationId,
   287→        taskId: null,
   288→        status: 'query_failed',
   289→        queryError: error.message,
   290→      });
   291→    });
   292→    return failures;
   293→  }
   294→
   295→  const rowsById = new Map((data || []).map((row) => [row.id, row]));
   296→
   297→  const mappings = new Map<string, GenerationTaskMapping>();
   298→  for (const generationId of requestedIds) {
   299→    const row = rowsById.get(generationId);
   300→
   301→    if (!row) {
   302→      mappings.set(generationId, {
   303→        generationId,
   304→        taskId: null,
   305→        status: 'missing_generation',
   306→      });
   307→      continue;
   308→    }
   309→
   310→    if (options?.projectId && row.project_id !== options.projectId) {
   311→      mappings.set(generationId, {
   312→        generationId,
   313→        taskId: null,
   314→        status: 'scope_mismatch',
   315→      });
   316→      continue;
   317→    }
   318→
   319→    const parsed = parseGenerationTaskId(row.tasks);
   320→    mappings.set(generationId, {
   321→      generationId,
   322→      taskId: parsed.taskId,
   323→      status: parsed.status,
   324→    });
   325→  }
   326→
   327→  return mappings;
   328→}
   329→
   330→export function toGenerationTaskMappingCacheEntry(
   331→  mapping: GenerationTaskMapping | undefined,
   332→): GenerationTaskMappingCacheEntry {
   333→  return {
   334→    taskId: mapping?.taskId ?? null,
   335→    status: mapping?.status ?? 'not_loaded',
   336→    ...(mapping?.queryError ? { queryError: mapping.queryError } : {}),
   337→  };
   338→}
   339→

    33→  return result.ok ? result : { ok: false, error: normalizeSupabaseError(result.error) };

    35→
    36→export const supabaseClientRegistry: SupabaseClientRegistry = {
    37→  getClientResult: getSupabaseClientResult,
    38→};
    39→
    40→/** Runtime accessor for initialized app runtime. Throws if bootstrap has not run. */
    41→export function getSupabaseClient() {
    42→  const result = supabaseClientRegistry.getClientResult();
    43→  if (!result.ok) {
    44→    throw result.error;
    45→  }
    46→  return result.client;
    47→}
    48→

1→/**
     2→ * useVariantPromotion - Handles promoting variants to standalone generations
     3→ *
     4→ * Manages variant promotion (creating standalone generation from a variant)
     5→ * and adding variants as new generations to shots with timeline positioning.
     6→ */
     7→
     8→import { useState, useCallback } from 'react';
     9→import { toast } from '@/shared/components/ui/runtime/sonner';
    10→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
    11→import { getSupabaseClient as supabase } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
    12→import { usePromoteVariantToGeneration } from '@/shared/hooks/usePromoteVariantToGeneration';
    13→import { useAddImageToShot } from '@/shared/hooks/shots';
    14→
    15→interface UseVariantPromotionProps {
    16→  selectedProjectId: string | null;
    17→}
    18→
    19→interface UseVariantPromotionReturn {
    20→  promoteSuccess: boolean;
    21→  isPromoting: boolean;
    22→  handlePromoteToGeneration: (variantId: string) => Promise<void>;
    23→  handleAddVariantAsNewGenerationToShot: (
    24→    shotId: string,
    25→    variantId: string,
    26→    currentTimelineFrame?: number
    27→  ) => Promise<boolean>;
    28→}
    29→
    30→export function useVariantPromotion({
    31→  selectedProjectId,
    32→}: UseVariantPromotionProps): UseVariantPromotionReturn {
    33→  const promoteVariantMutation = usePromoteVariantToGeneration();
    34→  const addImageToShotMutation = useAddImageToShot();
    35→  const [promoteSuccess, setPromoteSuccess] = useState(false);
    36→
    37→  // Handler for "Make new image" button in VariantSelector
    38→  const handlePromoteToGeneration = useCallback(async (variantId: string) => {
    39→    if (!selectedProjectId) {
    40→      toast.error('No project selected');
    41→      return;
    42→    }
    43→
    44→    setPromoteSuccess(false);
    45→
    46→    try {
    47→      await promoteVariantMutation.mutateAsync({
    48→        variantId,
    49→        projectId: selectedProjectId,
    50→      });
    51→
    52→      setPromoteSuccess(true);
    53→      setTimeout(() => setPromoteSuccess(false), 2000);
    54→    } catch (error) {
    55→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'useVariantPromotion', showToast: false });
    56→    }
    57→  }, [promoteVariantMutation, selectedProjectId]);
    58→
    59→  // Handler for "Add as new image to shot" button in ShotSelectorControls
    60→  // Positions new image between current and next item in the TARGET shot
    61→  const handleAddVariantAsNewGenerationToShot = useCallback(async (
    62→    shotId: string,
    63→    variantId: string,
    64→    currentTimelineFrame?: number
    65→  ): Promise<boolean> => {
    66→    if (!selectedProjectId) {
    67→      toast.error('No project selected');
    68→      return false;
    69→    }
    70→
    71→    try {
    72→      // 1. Create the generation from the variant
    73→      const newGen = await promoteVariantMutation.mutateAsync({
    74→        variantId,
    75→        projectId: selectedProjectId,
    76→      });
    77→
    78→      // 2. Calculate target timeline frame by querying the TARGET shot's items
    79→      let targetTimelineFrame: number | undefined;
    80→      if (currentTimelineFrame !== undefined) {
    81→        // Query all items in the target shot to find next item and calculate average spacing
    82→        const { data: allShotItems } = await supabase().from('shot_generations')
    83→          .select('timeline_frame')
    84→          .eq('shot_id', shotId)
    85→          .not('timeline_frame', 'is', null)
    86→          .order('timeline_frame', { ascending: true });
    87→
    88→        const frames = (allShotItems || [])
    89→          .map(item => item.timeline_frame as number)
    90→          .filter(f => f !== null && f !== undefined);
    91→
    92→        // Find the next item after current position
    93→        const nextTimelineFrame = frames.find(f => f > currentTimelineFrame);
    94→
    95→        if (nextTimelineFrame !== undefined && nextTimelineFrame > currentTimelineFrame) {
    96→          // Place in the middle between current and next
    97→          targetTimelineFrame = Math.floor((currentTimelineFrame + nextTimelineFrame) / 2);
    98→          // If middle would be same as current (consecutive frames), use current + 1
    99→          if (targetTimelineFrame === currentTimelineFrame) {
   100→            targetTimelineFrame = currentTimelineFrame + 1;
   101→          }
   102→        } else {
   103→          // No next item in shot - calculate average spacing and use that
   104→          if (frames.length >= 2) {
   105→            // Calculate average gap between consecutive frames
   106→            let totalGap = 0;
   107→            for (let i = 1; i < frames.length; i++) {
   108→              totalGap += frames[i] - frames[i - 1];
   109→            }
   110→            const averageGap = Math.round(totalGap / (frames.length - 1));
   111→            targetTimelineFrame = currentTimelineFrame + Math.max(1, averageGap);
   112→          } else {
   113→            // Only one item in shot, use current + 1
   114→            targetTimelineFrame = currentTimelineFrame + 1;
   115→          }
   116→        }
   117→      }
   118→
   119→      // 3. Add to shot
   120→      await addImageToShotMutation.mutateAsync({
   121→        shot_id: shotId,
   122→        generation_id: newGen.id,
   123→        project_id: selectedProjectId,
   124→        imageUrl: newGen.location,
   125→        thumbUrl: newGen.thumbnail_url || undefined,
   126→        timelineFrame: targetTimelineFrame,
   127→      });
   128→      return true;
   129→    } catch (error) {
   130→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'useVariantPromotion', showToast: false });
   131→      return false;
   132→    }
   133→  }, [promoteVariantMutation, addImageToShotMutation, selectedProjectId]);
   134→
   135→  return {
   136→    promoteSuccess,
   137→    isPromoting: promoteVariantMutation.isPending,
   138→    handlePromoteToGeneration,
   139→    handleAddVariantAsNewGenerationToShot,
   140→  };
   141→}
   142→

    46→  // Singleton

    48→
    49→  static getInstance(): PreloadingService {

    52→    }
    53→    return PreloadingService.instance;
    54→  }
    55→
    56→  private constructor() {
    57→    this.config = getPreloadConfig();
    58→    this.queue = new PreloadQueue(this.config.maxConcurrent);
    59→
    60→    // Subscribe to connection status changes from DataFreshnessManager
    61→    this.subscribeToConnectionStatus();
    62→
    63→  }
    64→
    65→  /**
    66→   * Subscribe to DataFreshnessManager to track connection status.
    67→   */
    68→  private subscribeToConnectionStatus(): void {
    69→    // Get initial status
    70→    const initialDiagnostics = dataFreshnessManager.getDiagnostics();
    71→    this.state.isConnected = initialDiagnostics.realtimeStatus === 'connected';
    72→
    73→    // Subscribe to changes
    74→    dataFreshnessManager.subscribe(() => {
    75→      const diagnostics = dataFreshnessManager.getDiagnostics();
    76→      const isConnected = diagnostics.realtimeStatus === 'connected';
    77→
    78→      if (isConnected !== this.state.isConnected) {
    79→        this.onConnectionStatusChange(isConnected);
    80→      }
    81→    });
    82→  }
    83→
    84→  // ===========================================================================
    85→  // LIFECYCLE EVENTS
    86→  // ===========================================================================
    87→
    88→  /**
    89→   * Called when the selected project changes.
    90→   * Clears all preloading state for the old project.
    91→   */
    92→  onProjectChange(projectId: string | null): void {
    93→    if (projectId === this.state.currentProjectId) {
    94→      return;
    95→    }
    96→
    97→    const previousProject = this.state.currentProjectId;
    98→
    99→    // Clear queue
   100→    this.queue.clear();
   101→
   102→    // Clear load tracker (single source of truth for what's loaded)
   103→    const clearedCount = clearAllLoadedImages('project switch');
   104→
   105→    this.state.currentProjectId = projectId;
   106→
   107→    this.emit({
   108→      type: 'project-changed',
   109→      data: { from: previousProject, to: projectId, clearedCount },
   110→    });
   111→  }
   112→
   113→  /**
   114→   * Called when generations are deleted (via realtime or mutation).
   115→   * Removes them from the load tracker.
   116→   */
   117→  onGenerationsDeleted(generationIds: string[]): void {
   118→    if (generationIds.length === 0) return;
   119→
   120→    // Remove from load tracker (the source of truth)
   121→    const clearedCount = clearLoadedImages(
   122→      generationIds.map((id) => ({ id }))
   123→    );
   124→
   125→    this.emit({
   126→      type: 'generations-deleted',
   127→      data: { ids: generationIds, clearedCount },
   128→    });

   130→
   131→  /**
   132→   * Called when connection status changes (from DataFreshnessManager).
   133→   * Could be used to adjust preloading strategy.
   134→   */
   135→  onConnectionStatusChange(isConnected: boolean): void {
   136→    if (isConnected === this.state.isConnected) return;
   137→
   138→    this.state.isConnected = isConnected;
   139→
   140→    // If disconnected, pause aggressive preloading
   141→    if (!isConnected) {
   142→      this.queue.clear();
   143→    }
   144→
   145→    this.emit({
   146→      type: 'connection-changed',
   147→      data: { isConnected },
   148→    });
   149→  }
   150→
   151→  /**
   152→   * Pause all preloading (e.g., when lightbox is open).
   153→   */
   154→  pause(): void {
   155→    if (this.state.isPaused) return;
   156→    this.state.isPaused = true;
   157→    this.queue.clear();
   158→  }
   159→
   160→  /**
   161→   * Resume preloading.
   162→   */
   163→  resume(): void {
   164→    if (!this.state.isPaused) return;
   165→    this.state.isPaused = false;
   166→  }
   167→
   168→  // ===========================================================================
   169→  // PRELOADING API
   170→  // ===========================================================================
   171→
   172→  /**
   173→   * Preload a batch of images.
   174→   * Uses the shared queue to avoid overwhelming the network.
   175→   */
   176→  async preloadImages(
   177→    images: PreloadableImage[],
   178→    priority: number = PRIORITY.normal
   179→  ): Promise<void> {
   180→    if (this.state.isPaused || !this.state.isConnected) {
   181→      return;
   182→    }
   183→
   184→    await preloadImages(images, this.queue, this.config, priority);
   185→
   186→    this.emit({ type: 'queue-updated' });
   187→  }
   188→
   189→  /**
   190→   * Get the current config.
   191→   */
   192→  getConfig(): PreloadConfig {
   193→    return this.config;
   194→  }
   195→
   196→  // ===========================================================================
   197→  // SUBSCRIPTION
   198→  // ===========================================================================
   199→
   200→  subscribe(callback: PreloadingSubscriber): () => void {
   201→    this.subscribers.add(callback);
   202→    return () => this.subscribers.delete(callback);
   203→  }
   204→
   205→  private emit(event: PreloadingEvent): void {
   206→    this.subscribers.forEach((callback) => {
   207→      try {
   208→        callback(event);
   209→      } catch (err) {
   210→        normalizeAndPresentError(err, { context: 'PreloadingService.subscriber', showToast: false });
   211→      }
   212→    });
   213→  }
   214→
   215→  // ===========================================================================
   216→  // DEBUGGING
   217→  // ===========================================================================
   218→
   219→  getDiagnostics(): {

   221→    queue: { size: number; active: number };
   222→    tracker: ReturnType<typeof getLoadTrackerStats>;
   223→  } {

   226→      queue: {
   227→        size: this.queue.size,
   228→        active: this.queue.activeCount,
   229→      },
   230→      tracker: getLoadTrackerStats(),
   231→    };
   232→  }
   233→}
   234→
   235→// =============================================================================
   236→// SINGLETON EXPORT
   237→// =============================================================================
   238→
   239→export const preloadingService = PreloadingService.getInstance();

   242→if (import.meta.env.DEV && typeof window !== 'undefined') {

    36→export interface DerivedCountsResult {

    48→
    49→function createEmptyDerivedCountsResult(): DerivedCountsResult {

    51→    derivedCounts: {},

    56→
    57→/**
    58→ * Calculate derivedCount for generations (how many variants/derivatives exist)
    59→ * Also tracks whether any variants are unviewed (for NEW badge display)
    60→ *
    61→ * Queries both:
    62→ * - generations table (based_on relationships)
    63→ * - generation_variants table (edit variants)
    64→ *
    65→ * @param generationIds - Array of generation IDs to count variants for
    66→ * @returns Object with derivedCounts and hasUnviewedVariants maps
    67→ */
    68→async function calculateDerivedCounts(
    69→  generationIds: string[]
    70→): Promise<DerivedCountsResult> {
    71→  const persistedGenerationIds = filterUuidStrings(generationIds);
    72→  if (persistedGenerationIds.length === 0) {
    73→    return createEmptyDerivedCountsResult();
    74→  }
    75→
    76→  const { derivedCounts, hasUnviewedVariants, unviewedVariantCounts } = createEmptyDerivedCountsResult();
    77→
    78→  // Only count from generation_variants table (actual variants)
    79→  // Note: We intentionally don't count based_on generations here - those are
    80→  // separate images in the gallery, not variants of this image
    81→  const { data: variantCountsData, error: variantCountsError } = await supabase().from('generation_variants')
    82→    .select('generation_id, viewed_at')
    83→    .in('generation_id', persistedGenerationIds);
    84→
    85→  if (variantCountsError) {
    86→    throw new ServerError('Failed to load variant badge counts', {
    87→      context: { generationIdsCount: generationIds.length },
    88→      cause: variantCountsError,
    89→    });
    90→  }
    91→
    92→  if (variantCountsData) {
    93→    for (const item of variantCountsData as Array<{ generation_id: string; viewed_at: string | null }>) {
    94→      const genId = item.generation_id;
    95→      derivedCounts[genId] = (derivedCounts[genId] || 0) + 1;
    96→      if (item.viewed_at === null) {
    97→        hasUnviewedVariants[genId] = true;
    98→        unviewedVariantCounts[genId] = (unviewedVariantCounts[genId] || 0) + 1;
    99→      }
   100→    }
   101→  }
   102→
   103→  return { derivedCounts, hasUnviewedVariants, unviewedVariantCounts };
   104→}

   222→function extractThumbnailUrl(item: RawGeneration, mainUrl: string): string {

   253→/**

   262→export function transformGeneration(

   276→  let contentType: string | undefined;

   279→    contentType = 'video/mp4';
   280→  } else if (storedContentType === 'image') {
   281→    // Default to png for images, can be overridden by URL extension  
   282→    contentType = 'image/png';
   283→  }
   284→  
   285→  // Compute stable URL identities for caching/comparison

   288→  const thumbUrlIdentity = stripQueryParameters(thumbnailUrl);
   289→
   290→  // Base transformation - fields common to all generations
   291→  const baseItem: GeneratedImageWithMetadata = {
   292→    id: item.id,
   293→    url: mainUrl,
   294→    thumbUrl: thumbnailUrl,
   295→    urlIdentity,
   296→    thumbUrlIdentity,
   297→    prompt,
   298→    metadata: {
   299→      ...(item.params || {}),
   300→      taskId, // Include task ID in metadata for MediaGalleryItem
   301→      taskIdStatus: taskIdParse.status, // Surface parse health to avoid silent shape drift
   302→      based_on: item.based_on, // Include based_on for lineage tracking
   303→      ...(options.metadata || {}), // Merge any additional metadata
   304→    },
   305→    createdAt: item.created_at,
   306→    updatedAt: item.updated_at,
   307→    isVideo,
   308→    contentType, // For proper download file extensions
   309→    starred: item.starred || false,
   310→    based_on: item.based_on, // Top level for easy access
   311→    position: null, // Will be set if shot context provided
   312→    timeline_frame: null, // Will be set if shot context provided
   313→    name: item.name || (item.params?.name as string | undefined) || undefined,
   314→    derivedCount: item.derivedCount || 0, // Number of generations/variants based on this one
   315→    hasUnviewedVariants: item.hasUnviewedVariants || false, // For NEW badge display
   316→    unviewedVariantCount: item.unviewedVariantCount || 0, // Count for tooltip
   317→    // Parent/child relationship fields

   320→    child_order: item.child_order ?? undefined,
   321→  };

   323→  // Normalize JSONB shot_data into a flat association list.

   327→  if (options.shotImageEntryId || options.timeline_frame !== undefined) {
   328→    return {
   329→      ...baseItem,
   330→      shotImageEntryId: options.shotImageEntryId,
   331→      timeline_frame: options.timeline_frame ?? null,
   332→      position: normalizePosition(options.timeline_frame),
   333→    };
   334→  }
   335→
   336→  // Otherwise, process shot associations from query data
   337→  if (shotGenerations.length > 0) {
   338→    // Single shot optimization
   339→    if (shotGenerations.length === 1) {
   340→      const singleShot = shotGenerations[0];
   341→      return {
   342→        ...baseItem,
   343→        shot_id: singleShot.shot_id,
   344→        position: normalizePosition(singleShot.timeline_frame),
   345→        timeline_frame: singleShot.timeline_frame,
   346→      };
   347→    }
   348→    
   349→    // Multiple shots: include all associations
   350→    const allAssociations = shotGenerations.map(shotGen => ({
   351→      shot_id: shotGen.shot_id,
   352→      timeline_frame: shotGen.timeline_frame,
   353→      position: normalizePosition(shotGen.timeline_frame),
   354→    }));
   355→    
   356→    // When filtering by specific shot, use that shot as primary
   357→    let primaryShot = shotGenerations[0];
   358→    if (options.shotId) {
   359→      const matchingShot = shotGenerations.find(shotGen => shotGen.shot_id === options.shotId);
   360→      if (matchingShot) {
   361→        primaryShot = matchingShot;
   362→      }
   363→    }
   364→
   365→    return {
   366→      ...baseItem,
   367→      shot_id: primaryShot.shot_id,
   368→      position: normalizePosition(primaryShot.timeline_frame),
   369→      timeline_frame: primaryShot.timeline_frame,
   370→      all_shot_associations: allAssociations,
   371→    };
   372→  }

   374→  return baseItem;
   375→}

   405→    thumbUrl: genData.location,
   406→    location: genData.location,
   407→    type: genData.type ?? undefined,
   408→    createdAt: genData.created_at,
   409→    timeline_frame: shotGen.timeline_frame ?? undefined,
   410→    metadata: (shotGen.metadata as GenerationMetadata | undefined) ?? undefined,
   411→    starred: genData.starred ?? false,
   412→    based_on: genData.based_on ?? undefined,
   413→    derivedCount: genData.derivedCount ?? 0,
   414→  };
   415→}
   416→
   417→/**
   418→ * Detect if a URL points to a video based on file extension.
   419→ * Used for variants which lack a `type` column.
   420→ */
   421→function isVideoUrl(url: string | null | undefined): boolean {
   422→  if (!url) return false;
   423→  const videoExtensions = ['.mp4', '.webm', '.mov', '.avi', '.mkv'];
   424→  return videoExtensions.some(ext => url.toLowerCase().includes(ext));
   425→}
   426→
   427→/**
   428→ * Transform a raw variant record from generation_variants table to UI format.
   429→ *
   430→ * Mirrors `transformGeneration` but for variants, which have a different
   431→ * schema (no `type` column, different metadata shape).
   432→ *
   433→ * @param variant - Raw variant from database query
   434→ * @param options - Optional overrides (e.g. toolType fallback)
   435→ * @returns Transformed variant ready for UI display
   436→ */
   437→export function transformVariant(
   438→  variant: RawVariant,
   439→  options?: { toolType?: string }
   440→): GeneratedImageWithMetadata {
   441→  const isVideo = isVideoUrl(variant.location);
   442→  const variantParams = (variant.params ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
   443→  const storedContentType = variantParams.content_type as string | undefined;
   444→
   445→  let contentType: string | undefined;
   446→  if (storedContentType === 'video' || isVideo) {
   447→    contentType = 'video/mp4';
   448→  } else {
   449→    contentType = 'image/png';
   450→  }
   451→
   452→  return {
   453→    id: variant.id,
   454→    url: variant.location,
   455→    thumbUrl: variant.thumbnail_url || variant.location,
   456→    isVideo,
   457→    contentType,
   458→    createdAt: variant.created_at,
   459→    starred: false, // Variants don't have starred flag
   460→    metadata: {
   461→      prompt: variantParams.prompt as string | undefined,
   462→      variant_type: variant.variant_type,
   463→      name: variant.name,
   464→      generation_id: variant.generation_id,
   465→      tool_type: (variantParams.tool_type as string) || options?.toolType,
   466→      created_from: variantParams.created_from as string | undefined,
   467→      source_task_id: variantParams.source_task_id as string | undefined,
   468→      content_type: storedContentType,
   469→    },
   470→    shot_id: undefined,
   471→    position: undefined,
   472→    all_shot_associations: undefined,
   473→  };
   474→}
   475→

     3→import { QuickCreateSuccess, ShotOption } from '../types';
     4→import { useQuickShotCreate } from '@/shared/hooks/useQuickShotCreate';

     6→
     7→interface UseShotCreationProps {
     8→  media: GenerationRow;
     9→  selectedProjectId: string | null;
    10→  allShots: ShotOption[];
    11→  onNavigateToShot?: (shot: Shot, options?: { isNewlyCreated?: boolean }) => void;
    12→  onClose: () => void;

    14→}
    15→
    16→interface UseShotCreationReturn {

    18→  quickCreateSuccess: QuickCreateSuccess;
    19→  handleQuickCreateAndAdd: () => Promise<void>;
    20→  handleQuickCreateSuccess: () => void;

    22→
    23→/**
    24→ * Hook for managing quick shot creation with image in MediaLightbox
    25→ * 
    26→ * This is a thin wrapper around useQuickShotCreate that:
    27→ * 1. Handles the generation_id vs id distinction (when viewing from ShotImagesEditor,
    28→ *    media.id is the shot_generations.id, not the actual generations.id)
    29→ * 2. Uses custom navigation via onNavigateToShot callback instead of internal navigation
    30→ */
    31→export const useShotCreation = ({
    32→  media,
    33→  allShots,
    34→  onNavigateToShot,
    35→  onClose,
    36→  onShotChange,
    37→}: UseShotCreationProps): UseShotCreationReturn => {
    38→  // CRITICAL: When viewing from ShotImagesEditor, media.id is the shot_generations.id (join table ID)
    39→  // We need to use media.generation_id (actual generations table ID) for creating new shot associations
    40→  const actualGenerationId = useMemo(() => {
    41→    const genId = getGenerationId(media);
    42→    return genId;
    43→  }, [media]);
    44→
    45→  // Use the consolidated hook
    46→  const {
    47→    isCreatingShot,
    48→    quickCreateSuccess,
    49→    handleQuickCreateAndAdd,
    50→    clearQuickCreateSuccess,
    51→  } = useQuickShotCreate({
    52→    generationId: actualGenerationId ?? media.id,
    53→    shots: allShots,
    54→    onShotChange,
    55→    // Don't use the hook's built-in navigation - we have custom navigation via onNavigateToShot
    56→    onClose: undefined,
    57→  });
    58→
    59→  // Custom navigation handler that uses onNavigateToShot callback
    60→  const handleQuickCreateSuccess = useCallback(() => {
    61→
    62→    if (quickCreateSuccess.shotId && onNavigateToShot) {
    63→      // Try to find the shot in the list first
    64→      const shotOption = allShots?.find(s => s.id === quickCreateSuccess.shotId);
    65→
    66→      // Close the lightbox first
    67→      onClose();
    68→
    69→      if (shotOption) {
    70→        // Build a minimal Shot object compatible with navigation
    71→        const minimalShot: Shot = {
    72→          id: shotOption.id,
    73→          name: shotOption.name,
    74→          images: [],
    75→          position: 0,
    76→        };
    77→        onNavigateToShot(minimalShot, { isNewlyCreated: true });
    78→      } else {
    79→        // Fallback when shot not in list yet
    80→        const minimalShot: Shot = {
    81→          id: quickCreateSuccess.shotId,
    82→          name: quickCreateSuccess.shotName || 'Shot',
    83→          images: [],
    84→          position: 0,
    85→        };
    86→        onNavigateToShot(minimalShot, { isNewlyCreated: true });
    87→      }
    88→    }
    89→
    90→    // Always clear the success state (prevents the header from sticking on "Visit Shot")
    91→    clearQuickCreateSuccess();
    92→  }, [quickCreateSuccess, onNavigateToShot, onClose, allShots, clearQuickCreateSuccess]);
    93→
    94→  return {
    95→    isCreatingShot,
    96→    quickCreateSuccess,
    97→    handleQuickCreateAndAdd,
    98→    handleQuickCreateSuccess,
    99→  };
   100→};

1→/**
     2→ * NetworkStatusManager - Centralized network status management
     3→ *
     4→ * Provides a single source of truth for online/offline status and connection type.
     5→ * Integrates with reconnect and polling flows for network-aware behavior.
     6→ */
     7→
     8→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
     9→import type { NavigatorWithDeviceInfo } from '@/types/browser-extensions';
    10→
    11→interface NetworkStatus {
    12→  isOnline: boolean;
    13→  effectiveType?: '2g' | '3g' | '4g' | 'slow-2g';
    14→  lastTransitionAt: number;
    15→  previousOnlineStatus: boolean;
    16→}
    17→
    18→type NetworkEventType = 'online' | 'offline' | 'connection-change';
    19→
    20→interface NetworkStatusSubscriber {
    21→  (status: NetworkStatus, eventType: NetworkEventType, event?: Event): void;
    22→}
    23→
    24→export class NetworkStatusManager {
    25→  private status: NetworkStatus;
    26→  private subscribers: Set<NetworkStatusSubscriber> = new Set();
    27→  private initialized = false;
    28→
    29→  constructor() {
    30→    const nav = navigator as NavigatorWithDeviceInfo;
    31→    this.status = {
    32→      isOnline: navigator.onLine,
    33→      effectiveType: nav.connection?.effectiveType,
    34→      lastTransitionAt: Date.now(),
    35→      previousOnlineStatus: navigator.onLine,
    36→    };
    37→  }
    38→
    39→  initialize(): void {
    40→    if (this.initialized) return;
    41→
    42→    const handleOnline = (event: Event) => this.handleNetworkChange('online', event);
    43→    const handleOffline = (event: Event) => this.handleNetworkChange('offline', event);
    44→    const handleConnectionChange = (event: Event) => this.handleNetworkChange('connection-change', event);
    45→
    46→    window.addEventListener('online', handleOnline);
    47→    window.addEventListener('offline', handleOffline);
    48→
    49→    const nav = navigator as NavigatorWithDeviceInfo;
    50→    if (nav.connection) {
    51→      nav.connection.addEventListener('change', handleConnectionChange);
    52→    }
    53→
    54→    this.initialized = true;
    55→  }
    56→
    57→  getStatus(): NetworkStatus {
    58→    return { ...this.status };
    59→  }
    60→
    61→  subscribe(callback: NetworkStatusSubscriber): () => void {
    62→    this.subscribers.add(callback);
    63→    return () => this.subscribers.delete(callback);
    64→  }
    65→
    66→  isSlowConnection(): boolean {
    67→    return this.status.effectiveType === '2g' || this.status.effectiveType === 'slow-2g';
    68→  }
    69→
    70→  getRecommendedIntervals(): { fast: number; normal: number; slow: number } {
    71→    if (!this.status.isOnline) {
    72→      return { fast: 60000, normal: 120000, slow: 300000 };
    73→    }
    74→
    75→    if (this.isSlowConnection()) {
    76→      return { fast: 30000, normal: 60000, slow: 180000 };
    77→    }
    78→
    79→    return { fast: 10000, normal: 30000, slow: 60000 };
    80→  }
    81→
    82→  private handleNetworkChange(eventType: NetworkEventType, event?: Event): void {
    83→    const now = Date.now();
    84→    const newIsOnline = navigator.onLine;
    85→    const nav = navigator as NavigatorWithDeviceInfo;
    86→    const newEffectiveType = nav.connection?.effectiveType;
    87→
    88→    const onlineStatusChanged = newIsOnline !== this.status.isOnline;
    89→    const connectionChanged = newEffectiveType !== this.status.effectiveType;
    90→
    91→    if (!onlineStatusChanged && !connectionChanged) {
    92→      return;
    93→    }
    94→
    95→    const previousStatus = { ...this.status };
    96→    this.status = {
    97→      isOnline: newIsOnline,
    98→      effectiveType: newEffectiveType,
    99→      lastTransitionAt: now,
   100→      previousOnlineStatus: previousStatus.isOnline,
   101→    };
   102→
   103→    this.subscribers.forEach((callback) => {
   104→      try {
   105→        callback(this.status, eventType, event);
   106→      } catch (error) {
   107→        normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'NetworkStatusManager', showToast: false });
   108→      }
   109→    });
   110→  }
   111→}
   112→
   113→let networkStatusManager: NetworkStatusManager;
   114→
   115→export function getNetworkStatusManager(): NetworkStatusManager {
   116→  if (!networkStatusManager) {
   117→    networkStatusManager = new NetworkStatusManager();
   118→    networkStatusManager.initialize();
   119→
   120→    if (import.meta.env.DEV && typeof window !== 'undefined') {
   121→      void import('@/shared/services/network/networkStatusDebug').then(({ installNetworkStatusDebugHelpers }) => {
   122→        installNetworkStatusDebugHelpers(networkStatusManager);
   123→      });
   124→    }
   125→  }
   126→
   127→  return networkStatusManager;
   128→}
   129→

     2→ * ImageEditContext — Composed provider for all image edit state.
     3→ *
     4→ * Splits state into three sub-contexts by concern:
     5→ *   - ImageEditCanvasContext: mode, brush, annotation, canvas, reposition, display
     6→ *   - ImageEditFormContext: prompts, strengths, LoRA, model, advanced settings
     7→ *   - ImageEditStatusContext: generation loading/success flags
     8→ *
     9→ * The split reduces re-renders: canvas components don't re-render when the user
    10→ * types in a prompt field, and form components don't re-render on brush strokes.
    11→ *
    12→ * ImageEditState still exists as a composed type. Components should use the
    13→ * specific sub-context hooks (useImageEditCanvasSafe, useImageEditFormSafe,
    14→ * useImageEditStatusSafe) for optimal performance.

   239→export async function getPrimaryTaskIdForGeneration(
   240→  generationId: string,
   241→  options?: GenerationTaskRepositoryOptions,
   242→): Promise<GenerationTaskMapping> {
   243→  const mappings = await getPrimaryTaskMappingsForGenerations([generationId], options);

   251→export async function getPrimaryTaskMappingsForGenerations(
   252→  generationIds: string[],
   253→  options?: GenerationTaskRepositoryOptions,
   254→): Promise<Map<string, GenerationTaskMapping>> {
   255→  if (generationIds.length === 0) {
   256→    return new Map();
   257→  }
   258→
   259→  const requestedIds = Array.from(new Set(generationIds));
   260→  const supabaseResult = (options?.supabaseRegistry ?? supabaseClientRegistry).getClientResult();
   261→  if (!supabaseResult.ok) {
   262→    const failures = new Map<string, GenerationTaskMapping>();
   263→    requestedIds.forEach((generationId) => {
   264→      failures.set(generationId, {
   265→        generationId,
   266→        taskId: null,
   267→        status: 'query_failed',
   268→        queryError: supabaseResult.error.message,
   269→      });
   270→    });
   271→    return failures;
   272→  }
   273→
   274→  const supabase = supabaseResult.client;
   275→  const query = supabase
   276→    .from('generations')
   277→    .select('id, tasks, project_id')
   278→    .in('id', requestedIds);
   279→
   280→  const { data, error } = await query;
   281→
   282→  if (error) {
   283→    const failures = new Map<string, GenerationTaskMapping>();
   284→    requestedIds.forEach((generationId) => {
   285→      failures.set(generationId, {
   286→        generationId,
   287→        taskId: null,
   288→        status: 'query_failed',
   289→        queryError: error.message,
   290→      });
   291→    });
   292→    return failures;
   293→  }
   294→
   295→  const rowsById = new Map((data || []).map((row) => [row.id, row]));
   296→
   297→  const mappings = new Map<string, GenerationTaskMapping>();
   298→  for (const generationId of requestedIds) {
   299→    const row = rowsById.get(generationId);
   300→
   301→    if (!row) {
   302→      mappings.set(generationId, {
   303→        generationId,
   304→        taskId: null,
   305→        status: 'missing_generation',
   306→      });
   307→      continue;
   308→    }
   309→
   310→    if (options?.projectId && row.project_id !== options.projectId) {
   311→      mappings.set(generationId, {
   312→        generationId,
   313→        taskId: null,
   314→        status: 'scope_mismatch',
   315→      });
   316→      continue;
   317→    }
   318→
   319→    const parsed = parseGenerationTaskId(row.tasks);
   320→    mappings.set(generationId, {
   321→      generationId,
   322→      taskId: parsed.taskId,
   323→      status: parsed.status,
   324→    });
   325→  }
   326→
   327→  return mappings;
   328→}

   337→  };

1→import { formatDistanceToNow } from 'date-fns';
     2→import { abbreviateRelativeTime, formatRelativeDuration } from '@/shared/lib/timeFormatting';
     3→import { useLiveRelativeTimestamp } from './useLiveRelativeTimestamp';
     4→
     5→type RelativeTimestampPreset = 'default' | 'task' | 'processing' | 'completed';
     6→
     7→interface UseUpdatingTimestampOptions {
     8→  date?: string | Date | null;
     9→  abbreviate?: (str: string) => string;
    10→  disabled?: boolean;
    11→  preset?: RelativeTimestampPreset;
    12→}
    13→
    14→const relativeTimestampFormatters: Record<
    15→  RelativeTimestampPreset,
    16→  (date: Date, abbreviate: (str: string) => string) => string
    17→> = {
    18→  default: (date, abbreviate) => abbreviate(formatDistanceToNow(date, { addSuffix: true })),
    19→  task: (date) => {
    20→    const abbreviated = abbreviateRelativeTime(formatDistanceToNow(date, { addSuffix: true }));
    21→    return abbreviated || '<1 min ago';
    22→  },
    23→  processing: (date) => `Processing for ${formatRelativeDuration(date, { includeDays: false })}`,
    24→  completed: (date) => `Completed ${formatRelativeDuration(date)} ago`,
    25→};
    26→
    27→export function useRelativeTimestamp({
    28→  date,
    29→  abbreviate = abbreviateRelativeTime,
    30→  disabled = false,
    31→  preset = 'default',
    32→}: UseUpdatingTimestampOptions = {}): string | null {
    33→  const formatter = relativeTimestampFormatters[preset];
    34→
    35→  return useLiveRelativeTimestamp({
    36→    dateInput: date,
    37→    disabled,
    38→    formatter: (parsedDate) => formatter(parsedDate, abbreviate),
    39→  });
    40→}
    41→
    42→export function useUpdatingTimestamp(options: UseUpdatingTimestampOptions = {}): string | null {
    43→  return useRelativeTimestamp(options);
    44→}

    47→  return useRelativeTimestamp({
    48→    date,
    49→    preset: 'task',

   398→export function useInlineEditState(
   399→  media: GenerationRow,
   400→  onNavigateToGeneration?: (generationId: string) => Promise<void>,
   401→): InlineEditStateResult {
   402→  const env = useInlineEditEnvironment(media);
   403→  const persistence = useInlineEditPersistence(env.actualGenerationId, env.selectedProjectId);
   404→  const activeVariant = persistence.variants.activeVariant;
   405→  const effectiveImageUrl = activeVariant?.location || env.effectiveImageUrl;
   406→  useEffect(() => {
   407→    env.setUpscaleActiveVariant(activeVariant?.location, activeVariant?.id);
   408→  }, [env, activeVariant?.location, activeVariant?.id]);
   409→  const { data: availableLoras } = usePublicLoras();
   410→  const { inpainting, magic } = useInlineEditInpaintingAndMagic(media, env, persistence);
   411→  const reposition = useInlineEditReposition(media, env, inpainting, persistence);
   412→  const img2img = useInlineEditImg2Img(media, env, persistence, availableLoras);
   413→  useInlineEditSettingsSync(env.actualGenerationId, persistence.editSettings, inpainting);
   414→  const { sourceGenerationData } = useSourceGeneration({
   415→    media,
   416→    onOpenExternalGeneration: onNavigateToGeneration
   417→      ? async (id) => onNavigateToGeneration(id)
   418→      : undefined,
   419→  });
   420→  const starToggle = useStarToggle({ media });
   421→  const handleDownload = async () => {
   422→    await downloadMedia(effectiveImageUrl, media.id, env.isVideo, media.contentType);
   423→  };
   424→  const {
   425→    inpaintingState,
   426→    transformState,
   427→    generationState,
   428→    imageEditValue,
   429→  } = buildInlineEditStateModels({
   430→    env,
   431→    persistence,
   432→    inpainting,
   433→    magic,
   434→    reposition,
   435→    img2img,
   436→    starToggle,
   437→    handleDownload,
   438→  });
   439→  return {
   440→    media,
   441→    canvasEnvironment: {
   442→      isMobile: env.isMobile,
   443→      selectedProjectId: env.selectedProjectId,
   444→      isCloudMode: env.isCloudMode,
   445→      isVideo: env.isVideo,
   446→      imageContainerRef: env.imageContainerRef,
   447→      effectiveImageUrl,
   448→      imageDimensions: env.imageDimensions,
   449→      setImageDimensions: env.setImageDimensions,
   450→      isUpscaling: env.isUpscaling,
   451→      handleUpscale: env.handleUpscale,
   452→    },
   453→    inpaintingState,
   454→    transformState,
   455→    generationState,
   456→    variants: {
   457→      variants: persistence.variants.variants,
   458→      activeVariant: persistence.variants.activeVariant,
   459→      isLoading: persistence.variants.isLoading,
   460→      setActiveVariantId: persistence.variants.setActiveVariantId,
   461→      setPrimaryVariant: persistence.variants.setPrimaryVariant,
   462→      deleteVariant: persistence.variants.deleteVariant,
   463→    },
   464→    sourceGenerationData,
   465→    availableLoras,
   466→    imageEditValue,
   467→  } satisfies InlineEditStateResult;
   468→}

1→/**
     2→ * Global Settings Write Queue
     3→ *
     4→ * Prevents network exhaustion by serializing and coalescing settings writes.
     5→ *
     6→ * Features:
     7→ * - Global concurrency limit (default: 1 in-flight write)
     8→ * - Per-target debouncing (coalesces rapid updates)
     9→ * - Merge-on-write (latest patch wins per field)
    10→ * - Optional AbortSignal passthrough for caller cancellation
    11→ * - Best-effort flush on page unload
    12→ *
    13→ * @see settings_system.md for the full settings architecture
    14→ */
    15→
    16→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
    17→
    18→export interface QueuedWrite {
    19→  scope: 'user' | 'project' | 'shot';
    20→  entityId: string;
    21→  toolId: string;
    22→  patch: Record<string, unknown>;
    23→  signal?: AbortSignal;
    24→}
    25→
    26→interface PendingWrite {
    27→  write: QueuedWrite;
    28→  resolvers: Array<{ resolve: (value: unknown) => void; reject: (error: unknown) => void }>;
    29→  timerId: NodeJS.Timeout | null;
    30→  enqueuedAt: number;

    41→
    42→// The actual write function - injected to avoid circular imports
    43→let writeFunction: ((write: QueuedWrite) => Promise<unknown>) | null = null;
    44→
    45→function createAbortError(): Error {
    46→  if (typeof DOMException !== 'undefined') {
    47→    return new DOMException('Request was cancelled', 'AbortError');
    48→  }
    49→  const error = new Error('Request was cancelled');
    50→  error.name = 'AbortError';
    51→  return error;
    52→}
    53→
    54→function throwIfAborted(signal?: AbortSignal): void {
    55→  if (signal?.aborted) {
    56→    throw createAbortError();
    57→  }
    58→}

    60→/**

    73→    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
    74→      if (document.visibilityState === 'hidden') {
    75→        flushAll();
    76→      }
    77→    });
    78→  }
    79→}
    80→
    81→/**
    82→ * Create a unique key for deduplication
    83→ */
    84→function targetKey(write: QueuedWrite): string {
    85→  return `${write.scope}:${write.entityId}:${write.toolId}`;
    86→}
    87→
    88→/**
    89→ * Shallow merge (one level deep)
    90→ */
    91→function shallowMergePatch(existing: Record<string, unknown>, incoming: Record<string, unknown>): Record<string, unknown> {
    92→  return { ...existing, ...incoming };
    93→}
    94→
    95→/**
    96→ * Process the next item in the flush queue
    97→ */
    98→async function processQueue() {
    99→  if (inFlightCount >= MAX_CONCURRENT || flushQueue.length === 0) {
   100→    return;
   101→  }
   102→
   103→  const next = flushQueue.shift();
   104→  if (!next) return;
   105→
   106→  const { targetKey: key, pending } = next;
   107→  
   108→  // Remove from pending map (we're about to process it)
   109→  pendingByTarget.delete(key);
   110→  
   111→  inFlightCount++;
   112→  
   113→  try {
   114→    if (!writeFunction) {
   115→      throw new Error('[SettingsWriteQueue] Write function not initialized');
   116→    }
   117→
   118→    throwIfAborted(pending.write.signal);
   119→    const result = await writeFunction(pending.write);
   120→    
   121→    // Resolve all waiters
   122→    for (const { resolve } of pending.resolvers) {
   123→      resolve(result);
   124→    }
   125→  } catch (error) {
   126→    normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'SettingsWriteQueue', showToast: false });
   127→
   128→    // Reject all waiters
   129→    for (const { reject } of pending.resolvers) {
   130→      reject(error);
   131→    }
   132→  } finally {
   133→    inFlightCount--;
   134→    
   135→    // Process next item
   136→    processQueue();
   137→  }
   138→}
   139→
   140→/**
   141→ * Schedule a pending write for flush
   142→ */
   143→function scheduleFlush(key: string, pending: PendingWrite) {
   144→  // Clear existing timer
   145→  if (pending.timerId) {
   146→    clearTimeout(pending.timerId);
   147→    pending.timerId = null;
   148→  }
   149→  
   150→  // Add to flush queue and process
   151→  flushQueue.push({ targetKey: key, pending });
   152→  processQueue();
   153→}
   154→
   155→/**
   156→ * Enqueue a settings write.
   157→ * 
   158→ * Returns a promise that resolves when the write completes.
   159→ * Multiple writes to the same target within the debounce window are merged.
   160→ * 
   161→ * @param write - The write to enqueue
   162→ * @param mode - 'debounced' (default) waits for debounce window; 'immediate' flushes now
   163→ */
   164→export function enqueueSettingsWrite(
   165→  write: QueuedWrite,
   166→  mode: 'debounced' | 'immediate' = 'debounced'
   167→): Promise<unknown> {
   168→  const key = targetKey(write);
   169→
   170→  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
   171→    if (write.signal?.aborted) {
   172→      reject(createAbortError());
   173→      return;
   174→    }
   175→
   176→    const existing = pendingByTarget.get(key);
   177→
   178→    if (existing) {
   179→      // Merge with existing pending write
   180→      existing.write.patch = shallowMergePatch(existing.write.patch, write.patch);
   181→      if (write.signal) {
   182→        existing.write.signal = write.signal;
   183→      }
   184→      existing.resolvers.push({ resolve, reject });
   185→
   186→      if (mode === 'immediate') {
   187→        // Cancel debounce timer and flush now
   188→        scheduleFlush(key, existing);
   189→      }
   190→      // else: existing timer will handle it
   191→      
   192→    } else {
   193→      // Create new pending write
   194→      const pending: PendingWrite = {
   195→        write: { ...write, patch: { ...write.patch } },
   196→        resolvers: [{ resolve, reject }],
   197→        timerId: null,
   198→        enqueuedAt: Date.now(),
   199→      };
   200→
   201→      pendingByTarget.set(key, pending);
   202→
   203→      if (mode === 'immediate') {
   204→        scheduleFlush(key, pending);
   205→      } else {
   206→        // Set debounce timer
   207→        pending.timerId = setTimeout(() => {
   208→          scheduleFlush(key, pending);
   209→        }, DEBOUNCE_MS);
   210→      }
   211→    }
   212→  });
   213→}
   214→
   215→
   216→/**
   217→ * Flush all pending writes immediately.
   218→ * Best-effort: returns without waiting.
   219→ */
   220→function flushAll(): void {
   221→  for (const [key, pending] of pendingByTarget.entries()) {
   222→    if (pending.timerId) {
   223→      clearTimeout(pending.timerId);
   224→      pending.timerId = null;
   225→    }
   226→    flushQueue.push({ targetKey: key, pending });
   227→  }
   228→  pendingByTarget.clear();
   229→  processQueue();
   230→}
   231→
   232→

   192→export function categorizeError(error: unknown, context?: Record<string, unknown>): AppError {

   197→

     2→import type { Database } from '@/integrations/supabase/databasePublicTypes';
     3→import { createSupabaseClient } from '@/integrations/supabase/bootstrap/createSupabaseClient';
     4→import { initializeSupabaseRuntime } from '@/integrations/supabase/bootstrap/initializeSupabaseRuntime';
     5→
     6→type SupabaseClientInstance = SupabaseClient<Database>;
     7→const SUPABASE_RUNTIME_NOT_INITIALIZED_MESSAGE =
     8→  'Supabase runtime is not initialized. Call initializeSupabaseClientRuntime() during app bootstrap.';
     9→
    10→let runtimeClient: SupabaseClientInstance | null = null;
    11→let runtimeError: Error | null = null;
    12→
    13→export type SupabaseClientAccessResult =
    14→  | { ok: true; client: SupabaseClientInstance }
    15→  | { ok: false; error: Error };
    16→
    17→export function normalizeSupabaseError(error: unknown): Error {
    18→  return error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error));
    19→}
    20→
    21→export function initializeSupabaseClientRuntime(): SupabaseClientInstance {
    22→  if (runtimeClient) {
    23→    return runtimeClient;
    24→  }
    25→
    26→  try {
    27→    const client = createSupabaseClient();
    28→    initializeSupabaseRuntime(client);
    29→    runtimeClient = client;
    30→    runtimeError = null;
    31→    return client;
    32→  } catch (error) {
    33→    const normalized = normalizeSupabaseError(error);
    34→    runtimeClient = null;
    35→    runtimeError = normalized;
    36→    throw normalized;
    37→  }
    38→}
    39→
    40→export function getSupabaseRuntimeClientResult(): SupabaseClientAccessResult {
    41→  if (runtimeClient) {
    42→    return { ok: true, client: runtimeClient };
    43→  }
    44→
    45→  if (runtimeError) {
    46→    return { ok: false, error: runtimeError };
    47→  }
    48→
    49→  return {
    50→    ok: false,
    51→    error: new Error(SUPABASE_RUNTIME_NOT_INITIALIZED_MESSAGE),
