    83→function hasLegacyField(
    84→  value: unknown,
    85→  field: string,
    86→): boolean {
    87→  return Boolean(
    88→    value
    89→    && typeof value === 'object'
    90→    && !Array.isArray(value)
    91→    && field in (value as Record<string, unknown>)
    92→    && (value as Record<string, unknown>)[field] !== undefined,
    93→  );
    94→}
    95→
    96→interface TravelStructureLegacyUsage {
    97→  topLevelFields: LegacyTopLevelField[];
    98→  structureVideoFields: LegacyStructureVideoField[];
    99→}
   100→
   101→export function collectTravelStructureLegacyUsage(
   102→  value: unknown,
   103→): TravelStructureLegacyUsage {
   104→  const record = value && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value)
   105→    ? (value as Record<string, unknown>)
   106→    : {};
   107→
   108→  const topLevelFields = LEGACY_TRAVEL_TOP_LEVEL_FIELDS.filter(
   109→    (field) => record[field] !== undefined,
   110→  );
   111→
   112→  const structureVideos = Array.isArray(record.structure_videos)
   113→    ? record.structure_videos
   114→    : [];
   115→  const structureVideoFields = LEGACY_TRAVEL_STRUCTURE_VIDEO_FIELDS.filter((field) =>
   116→    structureVideos.some((entry) => hasLegacyField(entry, field)),
   117→  );
   118→
   119→  return { topLevelFields, structureVideoFields };
   120→}
   121→
   122→export function enforceTravelStructureLegacyPolicy(
   123→  usage: TravelStructureLegacyUsage,
   124→  options?: {
   125→    context?: string;
   126→    enforcement?: 'warn' | 'throw' | 'auto';
   127→  },
   128→): boolean {
   129→  const usedFields = [...usage.topLevelFields, ...usage.structureVideoFields];
   130→  if (usedFields.length === 0) {
   131→    return false;
   132→  }
   133→
   134→  const details = usedFields.join(', ');
   135→  return signalPastRemovalTargetUsage({
   136→    alias: 'travel_between_images.legacy_structure_fields',
   137→    policy: legacyStructurePolicy,
   138→    remediation: `Migrate to structure_guidance + canonical structure_videos. Legacy fields seen: ${details}.` +
   139→      (options?.context ? ` Context: ${options.context}.` : ''),
   140→    enforcement: options?.enforcement ?? 'auto',
   141→  });
   142→}
   143→
   144→/**
   145→ * Canonical migration adapter for legacy structure-video settings.
   146→ * Preserves explicit structure_type values and only falls back to defaults
   147→ * when legacy payloads omit type information.
   148→ */
   149→export function migrateLegacyStructureVideos(
   150→  value: unknown,
   151→  options: LegacyStructureVideoMigrationOptions,
   152→): MigratedLegacyStructureVideo[] {
   153→  const settings = asRecord(value);
   154→  if (!settings) {
   155→    return [];
   156→  }
   157→
   158→  const topLevelStructureType = parseStructureType(
   159→    settings.structure_video_type ?? settings.structureType,
   160→  );
   161→  const topLevelTreatment = parseTreatment(
   162→    settings.structure_video_treatment ?? settings.treatment,
   163→  );
   164→  const topLevelMotionStrength = parseNumber(
   165→    settings.structure_video_motion_strength ?? settings.motionStrength,
   166→  );
   167→  const topLevelUni3cEndPercent = parseNumber(settings.uni3c_end_percent);
   168→
   169→  const rawStructureVideos = Array.isArray(settings.structure_videos)
   170→    ? settings.structure_videos
   171→    : null;
   172→  if (rawStructureVideos) {
   173→    return rawStructureVideos
   174→      .map((entry) => {
   175→        const record = asRecord(entry);
   176→        if (!record) {
   177→          return null;
   178→        }
   179→
   180→        const path = parseString(record.path);
   181→        if (!path) {
   182→          return null;
   183→        }
   184→
   185→        const metadata = asRecord(record.metadata);
   186→        const resourceId = parseString(record.resource_id);
   187→        return {
   188→          path,
   189→          start_frame: parseNumber(record.start_frame) ?? 0,
   190→          end_frame: parseNumber(record.end_frame) ?? options.defaultEndFrame,
   191→          treatment: parseTreatment(record.treatment) ?? topLevelTreatment ?? options.defaultVideoTreatment,
   192→          motion_strength: parseNumber(record.motion_strength) ?? topLevelMotionStrength ?? options.defaultMotionStrength,
   193→          structure_type: parseStructureType(record.structure_type) ?? topLevelStructureType ?? options.defaultStructureType,
   194→          uni3c_end_percent: parseNumber(record.uni3c_end_percent) ?? topLevelUni3cEndPercent ?? options.defaultUni3cEndPercent,
   195→          metadata: metadata as VideoMetadata | null ?? null,
   196→          resource_id: resourceId ?? null,
   197→        } satisfies MigratedLegacyStructureVideo;
   198→      })
   199→      .filter((entry): entry is MigratedLegacyStructureVideo => entry !== null);
   200→  }
   201→
   202→  const singlePath = parseString(settings.structure_video_path ?? settings.path);
   203→  if (!singlePath) {
   204→    return [];
   205→  }
   206→
   207→  const metadata = asRecord(settings.metadata);
   208→  const resourceId = parseString(settings.resource_id ?? settings.resourceId);
   209→  return [{
   210→    path: singlePath,
   211→    start_frame: 0,
   212→    end_frame: options.defaultEndFrame,
   213→    treatment: topLevelTreatment ?? options.defaultVideoTreatment,
   214→    motion_strength: topLevelMotionStrength ?? options.defaultMotionStrength,
   215→    structure_type: topLevelStructureType ?? options.defaultStructureType,
   216→    uni3c_end_percent: topLevelUni3cEndPercent ?? options.defaultUni3cEndPercent,
   217→    metadata: metadata as VideoMetadata | null ?? null,
   218→    resource_id: resourceId ?? null,
   219→  }];
   220→}

1→/**

    10→/**
    11→ * Parse task params, handling both string and object formats
    12→ */
    13→export function parseTaskParams(params: string | Record<string, unknown> | null | undefined): Record<string, unknown> {
    14→  if (!params) return {};
    15→  if (typeof params === 'string') {
    16→    try {
    17→      const parsed = JSON.parse(params);
    18→      return asRecord(parsed) ?? {};
    19→    } catch {
    20→      return {};
    21→    }
    22→  }
    23→  return asRecord(params) ?? {};
    24→}

    26→/**
    27→ * Derive input images from task params
    28→ *
    29→ * For segment tasks (has segment_index): Only returns segment-specific images
    30→ * For orchestrated tasks: Returns all images from orchestrator
    31→ * For other tasks: Checks various image field locations
    32→ *
    33→ * @param parsedParams - Already-parsed task params object
    34→ * @returns Array of image URLs
    35→ */
    36→export function deriveInputImages(parsedParams: Record<string, unknown>): string[] {
    37→  const params = parsedParams;
    38→  if (isTravelTaskParams(params)) {
    39→    const travelImages = deriveTravelInputImages(params);
    40→    if (travelImages.length > 0) {
    41→      return travelImages;
    42→    }
    43→  }
    44→
    45→  const orchestratorDetails = asRecord(params.orchestrator_details);
    46→  const orchestratorPayload = asRecord(params.full_orchestrator_payload);
    47→  const segmentParams = asRecord(params.individual_segment_params);
    48→
    49→  // Check if this is a segment task (individual segment of a larger generation)
    50→  const isSegmentTask = params?.segment_index !== undefined;
    51→
    52→  // For segment tasks, ONLY use segment-specific images (not the full orchestrator list)
    53→  if (isSegmentTask) {
    54→    // Priority: individual_segment_params > top-level input_image_paths_resolved
    55→    if (Array.isArray(segmentParams?.input_image_paths_resolved) && segmentParams.input_image_paths_resolved.length > 0) {
    56→      return segmentParams.input_image_paths_resolved.filter((x): x is string => typeof x === 'string');
    57→    }
    58→    // Fallback to start/end image URLs
    59→    if (segmentParams?.start_image_url || segmentParams?.end_image_url) {
    60→      const urls: string[] = [];
    61→      if (typeof segmentParams?.start_image_url === 'string') urls.push(segmentParams.start_image_url);
    62→      if (typeof segmentParams?.end_image_url === 'string') urls.push(segmentParams.end_image_url);
    63→      return urls;
    64→    }
    65→    // Fallback to top-level (which should be segment-specific for segment tasks)
    66→    if (Array.isArray(params?.input_image_paths_resolved)) {
    67→      return params.input_image_paths_resolved.filter((x): x is string => typeof x === 'string');
    68→    }
    69→    return [];
    70→  }
    71→
    72→  // For non-segment tasks, collect from all locations
    73→  const urls: string[] = [];
    74→
    75→  // Image edit task paths
    76→  if (typeof params?.image_url === 'string') urls.push(params.image_url);
    77→  if (typeof params?.image === 'string') urls.push(params.image);
    78→  if (typeof params?.input_image === 'string') urls.push(params.input_image);
    79→  if (typeof params?.init_image === 'string') urls.push(params.init_image);
    80→  if (typeof params?.control_image === 'string') urls.push(params.control_image);
    81→  if (Array.isArray(params?.images)) urls.push(...params.images.filter((x): x is string => typeof x === 'string'));
    82→  if (Array.isArray(params?.input_images)) urls.push(...params.input_images.filter((x): x is string => typeof x === 'string'));
    83→  if (typeof params?.mask_url === 'string') urls.push(params.mask_url);
    84→
    85→  // Travel/video task paths - orchestrator details contain all images for full timeline
    86→  if (Array.isArray(orchestratorDetails?.input_image_paths_resolved)) {
    87→    urls.push(...orchestratorDetails.input_image_paths_resolved.filter((x): x is string => typeof x === 'string'));
    88→  } else if (Array.isArray(orchestratorPayload?.input_image_paths_resolved)) {
    89→    urls.push(...orchestratorPayload.input_image_paths_resolved.filter((x): x is string => typeof x === 'string'));
    90→  } else if (Array.isArray(params?.input_image_paths_resolved)) {
    91→    urls.push(...params.input_image_paths_resolved.filter((x): x is string => typeof x === 'string'));
    92→  }
    93→
    94→  return Array.from(new Set(urls.filter(Boolean)));
    95→}
    96→
    97→/**
    98→ * Extract prompt from task params
    99→ *
   100→ * For segment tasks: Checks individual_segment_params first
   101→ * For orchestrated tasks: Checks orchestrator details
   102→ * For other tasks: Falls back to top-level prompt
   103→ *
   104→ * Prefers enhanced_prompts_expanded over base_prompts_expanded when available,
   105→ * as enhanced prompts contain the AI-improved version of the user's prompt.
   106→ *
   107→ * @param parsedParams - Already-parsed task params object
   108→ * @returns The prompt string or null
   109→ */
   110→export function derivePrompt(parsedParams: Record<string, unknown>): string | null {
   111→  const params = parsedParams;
   112→  if (isTravelTaskParams(params)) {
   113→    return deriveTravelPrompt(params);

   127→    const enhancedFromOrchestratorPayload = asStringArray(orchestratorPayload?.enhanced_prompts_expanded);

   131→      segmentIndex === null ? undefined : enhancedFromOrchestratorDetails?.[segmentIndex],
   132→      segmentIndex === null ? undefined : enhancedFromOrchestratorPayload?.[segmentIndex],
   133→    );
   134→    if (enhancedPrompt) return enhancedPrompt;
   135→
   136→    // Fall back to base prompt
   137→    return (
   138→      pickFirstString(
   139→        segmentParams?.base_prompt,
   140→        params.base_prompt,
   141→        params.prompt,
   142→        orchestratorDetails?.base_prompt,
   143→      ) ?? null
   144→    );
   145→  }
   146→
   147→  // For full timeline/orchestrated tasks
   148→  // The global base_prompt is what the user typed in the prompt field.
   149→  // Per-pair overrides (base_prompts_expanded) are segment-specific and shouldn't
   150→  // be shown as the task-level prompt — they're misleading when the user explicitly
   151→  // cleared the global prompt.
   152→  const enhancedFromOrchestratorDetails = asStringArray(orchestratorDetails?.enhanced_prompts_expanded);
   153→  const enhancedFromOrchestratorPayload = asStringArray(orchestratorPayload?.enhanced_prompts_expanded);
   154→  return (

   157→      orchestratorPayload?.base_prompt,

   161→      // which are per-pair overrides, not task-level prompts.
   162→      enhancedFromOrchestratorDetails?.[0],
   163→      enhancedFromOrchestratorPayload?.[0],
   164→    ) ?? null
   165→  );
   166→}

   207→/**

   210→export function extractLoras(parsedParams: Record<string, unknown>): LoraInfo[] {

   264→];
   265→
   266→const TRAVEL_PROMPT_SOURCE_ORDER: TravelPayloadSource[] = [
   267→  'taskViewContract',
   268→  'familyContract',
   269→  'individualSegmentParams',
   270→  'orchestratorDetails',
   271→  'fullOrchestratorPayload',
   272→  'rawParams',
   273→];
   274→
   275→function dedupeTruthyStrings(values: Array<string | undefined>): string[] {
   276→  return Array.from(new Set(values.filter((value): value is string => typeof value === 'string' && value.length > 0)));
   277→}
   278→
   279→function isTravelTaskParams(params: Record<string, unknown>): boolean {
   280→  const familyContract = asRecord(params.task_family_contract);
   281→  return (
   282→    params.task_family === 'travel_between_images'
   283→    || familyContract?.task_family === 'travel_between_images'
   284→    || params.orchestrator_details !== undefined
   285→    || params.full_orchestrator_payload !== undefined
   286→    || params.individual_segment_params !== undefined
   287→    || Array.isArray(params.image_urls)
   288→    || Array.isArray(params.input_image_paths_resolved)
   289→  );
   290→}
   291→
   292→function deriveTravelInputImages(params: Record<string, unknown>): string[] {
   293→  const snapshot = buildTaskPayloadSnapshot(params);
   294→  const reader = createTravelPayloadReader(snapshot);
   295→  const isSegmentTask = params.segment_index !== undefined;
   296→
   297→  if (isSegmentTask) {
   298→    const segmentInputImages = reader.pickStringArray('input_image_paths_resolved', TRAVEL_SEGMENT_IMAGE_SOURCE_ORDER);
   299→    if (segmentInputImages && segmentInputImages.length > 0) {
   300→      return dedupeTruthyStrings(segmentInputImages);
   301→    }
   302→
   303→    const startImage = reader.pickString('start_image_url', TRAVEL_SEGMENT_IMAGE_SOURCE_ORDER);
   304→    const endImage = reader.pickString('end_image_url', TRAVEL_SEGMENT_IMAGE_SOURCE_ORDER);
   305→    return dedupeTruthyStrings([startImage, endImage]);
   306→  }
   307→
   308→  const timelineSources = [
   309→    reader.pickStringArray('input_images', TRAVEL_TIMELINE_IMAGE_SOURCE_ORDER),
   310→    reader.pickStringArray('input_image_paths_resolved', TRAVEL_TIMELINE_IMAGE_SOURCE_ORDER),
   311→    reader.pickStringArray('image_urls', TRAVEL_TIMELINE_IMAGE_SOURCE_ORDER),
   312→  ];
   313→  for (const candidate of timelineSources) {
   314→    if (candidate && candidate.length > 0) {
   315→      return dedupeTruthyStrings(candidate);
   316→    }
   317→  }
   318→
   319→  return [];
   320→}
   321→
   322→function deriveTravelPrompt(params: Record<string, unknown>): string | null {
   323→  const snapshot = buildTaskPayloadSnapshot(params);
   324→  const reader = createTravelPayloadReader(snapshot);
   325→  const segmentIndex = toIntegerOrNull(params.segment_index);
   326→  const isSegmentTask = params.segment_index !== undefined;
   327→
   328→  if (isSegmentTask) {
   329→    const enhancedPromptsExpanded = reader.pickStringArray('enhanced_prompts_expanded', [
   330→      'orchestratorDetails',
   331→      'fullOrchestratorPayload',
   332→      'rawParams',
   333→    ]);
   334→    const enhancedPrompt = pickFirstString(
   335→      reader.pickString('enhanced_prompt', TRAVEL_PROMPT_SOURCE_ORDER),
   336→      segmentIndex === null ? undefined : enhancedPromptsExpanded?.[segmentIndex],
   337→    );
   338→    if (enhancedPrompt) {
   339→      return enhancedPrompt;
   340→    }
   341→
   342→    return (
   343→      pickFirstString(
   344→        reader.pickString('prompt', TRAVEL_PROMPT_SOURCE_ORDER),
   345→        reader.pickString('base_prompt', TRAVEL_PROMPT_SOURCE_ORDER),
   346→      ) ?? null
   347→    );
   348→  }
   349→
   350→  return (
   351→    pickFirstString(
   352→      reader.pickString('prompt', TRAVEL_PROMPT_SOURCE_ORDER),
   353→      reader.pickString('base_prompt', TRAVEL_PROMPT_SOURCE_ORDER),
   354→      reader.pickString('enhanced_prompt', TRAVEL_PROMPT_SOURCE_ORDER),
   355→    ) ?? null
   356→  );
   357→}
   358→
   359→function asRecord(value: unknown): Record<string, unknown> | null {
   360→  if (!value || typeof value !== 'object' || Array.isArray(value)) return null;
   361→  return value as Record<string, unknown>;
   362→}
   363→
   364→function asString(value: unknown): string | null {
   365→  return typeof value === 'string' ? value : null;
   366→}
   367→
   368→function asStringArray(value: unknown): string[] | null {
   369→  if (!Array.isArray(value)) return null;
   370→  return value.filter((item): item is string => typeof item === 'string');
   371→}
   372→
   373→function toIntegerOrNull(value: unknown): number | null {
   374→  const numeric = toFiniteNumber(value);
   375→  if (numeric === null || !Number.isInteger(numeric)) return null;
   376→  return numeric;
   377→}
   378→
   379→function toFiniteNumber(value: unknown): number | null {
   380→  const numeric = typeof value === 'number' ? value : Number(value);
   381→  return Number.isFinite(numeric) ? numeric : null;
   382→}
   383→
   384→function pickFirstString(...values: unknown[]): string | null {
   385→  for (const value of values) {
   386→    const text = asString(value);
   387→    if (text) return text;
   388→  }
   389→  return null;
   390→}

    89→async function waitForVariantDelay(

   104→    existingDelay.settleCallbacks.forEach((settle) => settle(false));

1→/**

     3→ *
     4→ * Unified video editing panel for both desktop and mobile layouts.
     5→ * Handles Trim, Replace Portion, and Regenerate sub-modes with variant display.
     6→ *
     7→ * Supports props-first pattern: optional state props (coreState, videoEditState,
     8→ * variantsState) override context values when provided. This allows the component
     9→ * to work both within VideoLightbox (using context) and standalone (using props).

1→/**
     2→ * Shared Generation Data Transformers
     3→ * 
     4→ * SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for transforming generation data from database to UI format.
     5→ * 
     6→ * This eliminates the need to manually update transformation logic in multiple places
     7→ * when adding new fields. Instead, update once here and all consumers automatically
     8→ * get the new field.
     9→ * 
    10→ * Architecture Benefits:
    11→ * - DRY: No duplicated transformation logic across hooks/components
    12→ * - Type Safety: Centralized TypeScript types ensure consistency
    13→ * - Maintainability: Add new fields in one place instead of 5+
    14→ * - Testability: Can unit test transformations in isolation
    15→ * 
    16→ * NOTE: upscaled_url has been removed - upscaled versions are now stored as
    17→ * generation_variants with variant_type='upscaled' and become the primary variant,
    18→ * so `location` already contains the best available URL.
    19→ */
    20→
    21→import type { GeneratedImageWithMetadata } from '@/shared/components/MediaGallery/types';
    22→import type { GenerationRow } from '@/domains/generation/types';
    23→import type { GenerationMetadata } from '@/domains/generation/types';
    24→import { getSupabaseClient as supabase } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
    25→import { stripQueryParameters } from '@/shared/lib/media/mediaUrl';
    26→import { TOOL_IDS, isToolId } from '@/shared/lib/toolIds';
    27→import { ServerError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/errors';
    28→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
    29→import { expandShotData } from '@/shared/lib/shotData';
    30→import { parseGenerationTaskId } from '@/shared/lib/generationTaskIdParser';
    31→import { filterUuidStrings } from '@/shared/lib/uuid';
    32→
    33→/**
    34→ * Result type for calculateDerivedCounts
    35→ */
    36→export interface DerivedCountsResult {
    37→  /** Count of variants/derivatives per generation */
    38→  derivedCounts: Record<string, number>;
    39→  /** Whether each generation has any unviewed variants (viewed_at IS NULL) */
    40→  hasUnviewedVariants: Record<string, boolean>;
    41→  /** Count of unviewed variants per generation */
    42→  unviewedVariantCounts: Record<string, number>;
    43→  /** True when counts were intentionally returned empty due to a read-path failure. */
    44→  degraded?: boolean;
    45→  /** Machine-readable reason for degraded fallback behavior. */
    46→  errorCode?: 'query_failed';
    47→}
    48→
    49→function createEmptyDerivedCountsResult(): DerivedCountsResult {
    50→  return {
    51→    derivedCounts: {},
    52→    hasUnviewedVariants: {},
    53→    unviewedVariantCounts: {},
    54→  };
    55→}
    56→
    57→/**
    58→ * Calculate derivedCount for generations (how many variants/derivatives exist)
    59→ * Also tracks whether any variants are unviewed (for NEW badge display)
    60→ *
    61→ * Queries both:
    62→ * - generations table (based_on relationships)
    63→ * - generation_variants table (edit variants)
    64→ *
    65→ * @param generationIds - Array of generation IDs to count variants for
    66→ * @returns Object with derivedCounts and hasUnviewedVariants maps
    67→ */
    68→async function calculateDerivedCounts(
    69→  generationIds: string[]
    70→): Promise<DerivedCountsResult> {
    71→  const persistedGenerationIds = filterUuidStrings(generationIds);
    72→  if (persistedGenerationIds.length === 0) {
    73→    return createEmptyDerivedCountsResult();
    74→  }
    75→
    76→  const { derivedCounts, hasUnviewedVariants, unviewedVariantCounts } = createEmptyDerivedCountsResult();
    77→
    78→  // Only count from generation_variants table (actual variants)
    79→  // Note: We intentionally don't count based_on generations here - those are
    80→  // separate images in the gallery, not variants of this image
    81→  const { data: variantCountsData, error: variantCountsError } = await supabase().from('generation_variants')
    82→    .select('generation_id, viewed_at')
    83→    .in('generation_id', persistedGenerationIds);
    84→
    85→  if (variantCountsError) {
    86→    throw new ServerError('Failed to load variant badge counts', {
    87→      context: { generationIdsCount: generationIds.length },
    88→      cause: variantCountsError,
    89→    });
    90→  }
    91→
    92→  if (variantCountsData) {
    93→    for (const item of variantCountsData as Array<{ generation_id: string; viewed_at: string | null }>) {
    94→      const genId = item.generation_id;
    95→      derivedCounts[genId] = (derivedCounts[genId] || 0) + 1;
    96→      if (item.viewed_at === null) {
    97→        hasUnviewedVariants[genId] = true;
    98→        unviewedVariantCounts[genId] = (unviewedVariantCounts[genId] || 0) + 1;
    99→      }
   100→    }
   101→  }
   102→
   103→  return { derivedCounts, hasUnviewedVariants, unviewedVariantCounts };
   104→}
   105→
   106→/**
   107→ * Fail-open variant of calculateDerivedCounts for non-critical UI surfaces.
   108→ * Keeps badge rendering resilient when counts query intermittently fails.
   109→ */
   110→export async function calculateDerivedCountsSafe(
   111→  generationIds: string[]
   112→): Promise<DerivedCountsResult> {
   113→  try {
   114→    return await calculateDerivedCounts(generationIds);
   115→  } catch (error) {
   116→    normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'generationTransformers.calculateDerivedCountsSafe', showToast: false });
   117→    return {
   118→      ...createEmptyDerivedCountsResult(),
   119→      degraded: true,
   120→      errorCode: 'query_failed',
   121→    };
   122→  }
   123→}
   124→
   125→/**
   126→ * Raw variant record from generation_variants table (before transformation)
   127→ */
   128→export interface RawVariant {
   129→  id: string;
   130→  generation_id: string;
   131→  location: string;
   132→  thumbnail_url?: string | null;
   133→  params?: Record<string, unknown> | null;
   134→  variant_type?: string | null;
   135→  name?: string | null;
   136→  created_at: string;
   137→  /** Only present for derived-items queries */
   138→  is_primary?: boolean;
   139→  viewed_at?: string | null;
   140→}
   141→
   142→/**
   143→ * Raw generation record from database (before transformation)
   144→ */
   145→export interface RawGeneration {
   146→  id: string;
   147→  location: string;
   148→  thumbnail_url?: string | null;
   149→  type?: string | null;
   150→  created_at: string;
   151→  updated_at?: string | null;
   152→  params?: Record<string, unknown> | null;
   153→  starred?: boolean | null;
   154→  tasks?: string[] | string | null;
   155→  based_on?: string | null;
   156→  name?: string | null;
   157→  derivedCount?: number; // Number of generations/variants based on this one
   158→  hasUnviewedVariants?: boolean; // Whether any variants have viewed_at === null (for NEW badge)
   159→  unviewedVariantCount?: number; // Count of unviewed variants
   160→  // Parent/child relationship fields
   161→  is_child?: boolean | null;
   162→  parent_generation_id?: string | null;
   163→  child_order?: number | null;
   164→  // JSONB column mapping shot_id -> array of timeline_frames
   165→  // Each generation can appear multiple times in the same shot (different positions)
   166→  // Example: { "shot_id_123": [120, 420, null] } means 3 entries: at frame 120, 420, and one unpositioned
   167→  shot_data?: Record<string, (number | null)[]>;
   168→}
   169→
   170→/**
   171→ * Raw shot_generation record from database (before transformation)
   172→ */
   173→export interface RawShotGeneration {
   174→  id: string;
   175→  shot_id: string;
   176→  generation_id: string;
   177→  timeline_frame: number | null;
   178→  metadata?: Record<string, unknown> | null;
   179→  created_at?: string;
   180→  generation?: RawGeneration | RawGeneration[] | null;
   181→  generations?: RawGeneration | RawGeneration[] | null;
   182→}
   183→
   184→/**
   185→ * Options for transformation customization
   186→ */
   187→interface TransformOptions {
   188→  /** Shot image entry ID (from shot_generations table) */
   189→  shotImageEntryId?: string;
   190→  /** Timeline frame position */
   191→  timeline_frame?: number | null;
   192→  /** Additional metadata to merge */
   193→  metadata?: Record<string, unknown> | null;
   194→  /** Shot ID for filtering */
   195→  shotId?: string;
   196→  /** Whether to include verbose logging */
   197→  verbose?: boolean;
   198→}
   199→
   200→/**
   201→ * Extract prompt from various nested param structures
   202→ */
   203→function extractPrompt(params: Record<string, unknown> | null | undefined): string {
   204→  if (!params) return 'No prompt';
   205→
   206→  const originalParams = params.originalParams as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
   207→  const orchestratorDetails = originalParams?.orchestrator_details as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
   208→  const metadataBlock = params.metadata as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
   209→
   210→  return (
   211→    (orchestratorDetails?.prompt as string) ||
   212→    (params.prompt as string) ||
   213→    (metadataBlock?.prompt as string) ||
   214→    'No prompt'
   215→  );
   216→}
   217→
   218→/**
   219→ * Extract thumbnail URL with fallback logic
   220→ * Handles special case for travel-between-images videos where thumbnail might be in params
   221→ */
   222→function extractThumbnailUrl(item: RawGeneration, mainUrl: string): string {
   223→  // Start with database thumbnail_url field
   224→  let thumbnailUrl = item.thumbnail_url;
   225→  const toolType = item.params?.tool_type;
   226→  
   227→  // If no thumbnail in database, check params for travel-between-images videos
   228→  if (!thumbnailUrl && isToolId(toolType) && toolType === TOOL_IDS.TRAVEL_BETWEEN_IMAGES) {
   229→    const originalParams = item.params?.originalParams as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
   230→    const orchestratorDetails = originalParams?.orchestrator_details as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
   231→    const fullPayload = item.params?.full_orchestrator_payload as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
   232→    const originalFullPayload = originalParams?.full_orchestrator_payload as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
   233→
   234→    thumbnailUrl =
   235→      (item.params?.thumbnailUrl as string) ||
   236→      (orchestratorDetails?.thumbnail_url as string) ||
   237→      (fullPayload?.thumbnail_url as string) ||
   238→      (originalFullPayload?.thumbnail_url as string);
   239→  }
   240→  
   241→  // Final fallback to main URL
   242→  return thumbnailUrl || mainUrl;
   243→}
   244→
   245→/**
   246→ * Normalize timeline_frame to position (divide by 50)
   247→ */
   248→function normalizePosition(timelineFrame: number | null | undefined): number | null {
   249→  if (timelineFrame === null || timelineFrame === undefined) return null;
   250→  return Math.floor(timelineFrame / 50);
   251→}
   252→
   253→/**
   254→ * Transform a raw generation record from database to UI format
   255→ * 
   256→ * This is the MAIN transformation function used by most hooks/components
   257→ * 
   258→ * @param item - Raw generation from database query
   259→ * @param options - Optional customization (shot context, metadata, etc.)
   260→ * @returns Transformed generation ready for UI display
   261→ */
   262→export function transformGeneration(
   263→  item: RawGeneration,
   264→  options: TransformOptions = {}
   265→): GeneratedImageWithMetadata {
   266→  const mainUrl = item.location;
   267→  const thumbnailUrl = extractThumbnailUrl(item, mainUrl);
   268→  const taskIdParse = parseGenerationTaskId(item.tasks);
   269→  const taskId = taskIdParse.taskId;
   270→  const prompt = extractPrompt(item.params);
   271→  
   272→  // Extract content_type from params for proper download file extensions
   273→  // Stored as 'image' or 'video', convert to MIME type
   274→  const storedContentType = item.params?.content_type;
   275→  const isVideo = item.type?.includes('video') || storedContentType === 'video' || false;
   276→  let contentType: string | undefined;
   277→  if (storedContentType === 'video') {
   278→    // Default to mp4 for videos, can be overridden by URL extension
   279→    contentType = 'video/mp4';
   280→  } else if (storedContentType === 'image') {
   281→    // Default to png for images, can be overridden by URL extension  
   282→    contentType = 'image/png';
   283→  }
   284→  
   285→  // Compute stable URL identities for caching/comparison
   286→  // Supabase URLs have rotating tokens but the file path is stable
   287→  const urlIdentity = stripQueryParameters(mainUrl);
   288→  const thumbUrlIdentity = stripQueryParameters(thumbnailUrl);
   289→
   290→  // Base transformation - fields common to all generations
   291→  const baseItem: GeneratedImageWithMetadata = {
   292→    id: item.id,
   293→    url: mainUrl,
   294→    thumbUrl: thumbnailUrl,
   295→    urlIdentity,
   296→    thumbUrlIdentity,
   297→    prompt,
   298→    metadata: {
   299→      ...(item.params || {}),
   300→      taskId, // Include task ID in metadata for MediaGalleryItem
   301→      taskIdStatus: taskIdParse.status, // Surface parse health to avoid silent shape drift
   302→      based_on: item.based_on, // Include based_on for lineage tracking
   303→      ...(options.metadata || {}), // Merge any additional metadata
   304→    },
   305→    createdAt: item.created_at,
   306→    updatedAt: item.updated_at,
   307→    isVideo,
   308→    contentType, // For proper download file extensions
   309→    starred: item.starred || false,
   310→    based_on: item.based_on, // Top level for easy access
   311→    position: null, // Will be set if shot context provided
   312→    timeline_frame: null, // Will be set if shot context provided
   313→    name: item.name || (item.params?.name as string | undefined) || undefined,
   314→    derivedCount: item.derivedCount || 0, // Number of generations/variants based on this one
   315→    hasUnviewedVariants: item.hasUnviewedVariants || false, // For NEW badge display
   316→    unviewedVariantCount: item.unviewedVariantCount || 0, // Count for tooltip
   317→    // Parent/child relationship fields
   318→    is_child: item.is_child ?? undefined,
   319→    parent_generation_id: item.parent_generation_id ?? undefined,
   320→    child_order: item.child_order ?? undefined,
   321→  };
   322→
   323→  // Normalize JSONB shot_data into a flat association list.
   324→  const shotGenerations = expandShotData(item.shot_data as Record<string, unknown> | null | undefined);
   325→  
   326→  // If shot context is provided via options, use it
   327→  if (options.shotImageEntryId || options.timeline_frame !== undefined) {
   328→    return {
   329→      ...baseItem,
   330→      shotImageEntryId: options.shotImageEntryId,
   331→      timeline_frame: options.timeline_frame ?? null,
   332→      position: normalizePosition(options.timeline_frame),
   333→    };
   334→  }
   335→
   336→  // Otherwise, process shot associations from query data
   337→  if (shotGenerations.length > 0) {
   338→    // Single shot optimization
   339→    if (shotGenerations.length === 1) {
   340→      const singleShot = shotGenerations[0];
   341→      return {
   342→        ...baseItem,
   343→        shot_id: singleShot.shot_id,
   344→        position: normalizePosition(singleShot.timeline_frame),
   345→        timeline_frame: singleShot.timeline_frame,
   346→      };
   347→    }
   348→    
   349→    // Multiple shots: include all associations
   350→    const allAssociations = shotGenerations.map(shotGen => ({
   351→      shot_id: shotGen.shot_id,
   352→      timeline_frame: shotGen.timeline_frame,
   353→      position: normalizePosition(shotGen.timeline_frame),
   354→    }));
   355→    
   356→    // When filtering by specific shot, use that shot as primary
   357→    let primaryShot = shotGenerations[0];
   358→    if (options.shotId) {
   359→      const matchingShot = shotGenerations.find(shotGen => shotGen.shot_id === options.shotId);
   360→      if (matchingShot) {
   361→        primaryShot = matchingShot;
   362→      }
   363→    }
   364→
   365→    return {
   366→      ...baseItem,
   367→      shot_id: primaryShot.shot_id,
   368→      position: normalizePosition(primaryShot.timeline_frame),
   369→      timeline_frame: primaryShot.timeline_frame,
   370→      all_shot_associations: allAssociations,
   371→    };
   372→  }
   373→  
   374→  return baseItem;
   375→}
   376→
   377→/**
   378→ * Transform for Timeline component's specific needs
   379→ * Maps to GenerationRow format expected by Timeline
   380→ */
   381→export function transformForTimeline(
   382→  shotGen: RawShotGeneration
   383→): GenerationRow & { timeline_frame?: number } {
   384→  const gen = shotGen.generation || shotGen.generations;
   385→  const genData = Array.isArray(gen) ? gen[0] : gen;
   386→  
   387→  if (!genData) {
   388→    return {
   389→      // PRIMARY IDs: id = shot_generations.id (unique per entry), generation_id = actual generation
   390→      id: shotGen.id,
   391→      generation_id: shotGen.generation_id,
   392→      // Deprecated (backwards compat)
   393→      shotImageEntryId: shotGen.id,
   394→      timeline_frame: shotGen.timeline_frame ?? undefined,
   395→    };
   396→  }
   397→  
   398→  return {
   399→    // PRIMARY IDs: id = shot_generations.id (unique per entry), generation_id = actual generation
   400→    id: shotGen.id,
   401→    generation_id: shotGen.generation_id,
   402→    // Deprecated (backwards compat)
   403→    shotImageEntryId: shotGen.id,
   404→    imageUrl: genData.location,
   405→    thumbUrl: genData.location,
   406→    location: genData.location,
   407→    type: genData.type ?? undefined,
   408→    createdAt: genData.created_at,
   409→    timeline_frame: shotGen.timeline_frame ?? undefined,
   410→    metadata: (shotGen.metadata as GenerationMetadata | undefined) ?? undefined,
   411→    starred: genData.starred ?? false,
   412→    based_on: genData.based_on ?? undefined,
   413→    derivedCount: genData.derivedCount ?? 0,
   414→  };
   415→}
   416→
   417→/**
   418→ * Detect if a URL points to a video based on file extension.
   419→ * Used for variants which lack a `type` column.
   420→ */
   421→function isVideoUrl(url: string | null | undefined): boolean {
   422→  if (!url) return false;
   423→  const videoExtensions = ['.mp4', '.webm', '.mov', '.avi', '.mkv'];
   424→  return videoExtensions.some(ext => url.toLowerCase().includes(ext));
   425→}
   426→
   427→/**
   428→ * Transform a raw variant record from generation_variants table to UI format.
   429→ *
   430→ * Mirrors `transformGeneration` but for variants, which have a different
   431→ * schema (no `type` column, different metadata shape).
   432→ *
   433→ * @param variant - Raw variant from database query
   434→ * @param options - Optional overrides (e.g. toolType fallback)
   435→ * @returns Transformed variant ready for UI display
   436→ */
   437→export function transformVariant(
   438→  variant: RawVariant,
   439→  options?: { toolType?: string }
   440→): GeneratedImageWithMetadata {
   441→  const isVideo = isVideoUrl(variant.location);
   442→  const variantParams = (variant.params ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
   443→  const storedContentType = variantParams.content_type as string | undefined;
   444→
   445→  let contentType: string | undefined;
   446→  if (storedContentType === 'video' || isVideo) {
   447→    contentType = 'video/mp4';
   448→  } else {
   449→    contentType = 'image/png';
   450→  }
   451→
   452→  return {
   453→    id: variant.id,
   454→    url: variant.location,
   455→    thumbUrl: variant.thumbnail_url || variant.location,
   456→    isVideo,
   457→    contentType,
   458→    createdAt: variant.created_at,
   459→    starred: false, // Variants don't have starred flag
   460→    metadata: {
   461→      prompt: variantParams.prompt as string | undefined,
   462→      variant_type: variant.variant_type,
   463→      name: variant.name,
   464→      generation_id: variant.generation_id,
   465→      tool_type: (variantParams.tool_type as string) || options?.toolType,
   466→      created_from: variantParams.created_from as string | undefined,
   467→      source_task_id: variantParams.source_task_id as string | undefined,
   468→      content_type: storedContentType,
   469→    },
   470→    shot_id: undefined,
   471→    position: undefined,
   472→    all_shot_associations: undefined,
   473→  };
   474→}

     5→type TimelineWritePhase = 'queued' | 'start' | 'end';

     7→interface TimelineWriteEventMeta {

    29→/**
    30→ * Shared queue-phase logger for timeline write serialization.

    33→export function createTimelineWriteQueueLogger(options: TimelineWriteLoggerOptions): TimelineWriteEventHandler {
    34→  const log = options.log ?? console.log;
    35→  return (phase, meta) => {
    36→    const payload: Record<string, unknown> = {
    37→      shotId: shortTimelineId(meta.shotId),
    38→      requestId: meta.requestId,
    39→      operation: meta.operation,
    40→      waitMs: meta.waitMs,
    41→      queueDepth: meta.queueDepth,
    42→      blockedByOperation: meta.blockedByOperation ?? null,
    43→      blockedByDurationMs: meta.blockedByDurationMs ?? null,
    44→    };
    45→
    46→    if (phase !== 'start') {
    47→      payload.durationMs = meta.durationMs;
    48→    }
    49→
    50→    log(`${options.logPrefix} write queue ${phase}`, payload);
    51→  };
    52→}

    54→// --- Timeline write timeout ---
    55→
    56→const DEFAULT_TIMELINE_WRITE_TIMEOUT_MS = 15_000;
    57→const TIMELINE_WRITE_TIMEOUT_CODE = 'TIMELINE_WRITE_TIMEOUT';
    58→
    59→interface TimelineWriteTimeoutOptions {
    60→  timeoutMs?: number;
    61→  onTimeout?: (meta: { operation: string; timeoutMs: number; pendingMs: number }) => void;
    62→  upstreamSignal?: AbortSignal;

    64→
    65→class TimelineWriteTimeoutError extends Error {
    66→  readonly code = TIMELINE_WRITE_TIMEOUT_CODE;
    67→
    68→  constructor(operation: string, timeoutMs: number, cause?: unknown) {
    69→    super(`Timeline write "${operation}" timed out after ${timeoutMs}ms`);
    70→    this.name = 'TimelineWriteTimeoutError';
    71→    if (cause !== undefined) {
    72→      (this as { cause?: unknown }).cause = cause;
    73→    }

    82→      && error !== null

    86→  );

    89→export async function runTimelineWriteWithTimeout<T>(
    90→  operation: string,

    94→  const timeoutMs = options?.timeoutMs ?? DEFAULT_TIMELINE_WRITE_TIMEOUT_MS;

   113→  const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => {
   114→    timedOut = true;
   115→    options?.onTimeout?.({
   116→      operation,
   117→      timeoutMs,
   118→      pendingMs: Date.now() - startedAt,
   119→    });
   120→    controller.abort();
   121→  }, timeoutMs);
   122→
   123→  try {
   124→    return await task(controller.signal);
   125→  } catch (error) {
   126→    if (timedOut || (abortedByUpstream && controller.signal.aborted) || (controller.signal.aborted && isAbortError(error))) {
   127→      throw new TimelineWriteTimeoutError(operation, timeoutMs, error);
   128→    }
   129→    throw error;
   130→  } finally {
   131→    clearTimeout(timeoutId);
   132→    if (upstreamSignal) {
   133→      upstreamSignal.removeEventListener('abort', handleUpstreamAbort);
   134→    }
   135→  }
   136→}
   137→
   138→// --- Serialized timeline write queue ---
   139→
   140→const shotWriteTail = new Map<string, Promise<void>>();
   141→const shotWriteDepth = new Map<string, number>();
   142→const shotWriteActive = new Map<string, { requestId: number; operation: string; startedAt: number }>();
   143→let writeRequestCounter = 0;
   144→const DEFAULT_SERIALIZED_TIMELINE_TASK_TIMEOUT_MS = 30_000;
   145→
   146→interface TimelineSerializedWriteOptions {
   147→  timeoutMs?: number;
   148→  onTimeout?: (meta: {
   149→    shotId: string;
   150→    operation: string;
   151→    timeoutMs: number;
   152→    pendingMs: number;
   153→    requestId: number;
   154→  }) => void;
   155→}
   156→
   157→/**
   158→ * Returns true if any serialized timeline write is active or queued for the
   159→ * given shot. Both the timeline drag path and the batch editor path go through
   160→ * runSerializedTimelineWrite, so this covers all writes across both paths.
   161→ * Used by useTimelinePositions.syncFromDatabase to suppress stale syncs while
   162→ * the batch editor is writing (the batch editor does not set isLockedRef, so
   163→ * without this check a background refetch during the midpoint RPC would snap
   164→ * positions back to pre-edit values).
   165→ */
   166→export function isTimelineWriteActive(shotId: string): boolean {
   167→  return (shotWriteDepth.get(shotId) ?? 0) > 0;
   168→}
   169→
   170→/**
   171→ * Serialize timeline writes per shot to avoid overlapping updates from
   172→ * different UI flows (batch reorder, timeline drag, etc.).
   173→ */
   174→export async function runSerializedTimelineWrite<T>(
   175→  shotId: string,
   176→  operation: string,
   177→  task: (signal: AbortSignal) => Promise<T>,
   178→  onEvent?: TimelineWriteEventHandler,
   179→  options?: TimelineSerializedWriteOptions,
   180→): Promise<T> {
   181→  const requestId = ++writeRequestCounter;
   182→  const queuedAt = Date.now();
   183→  const previousTail = shotWriteTail.get(shotId) ?? Promise.resolve();
   184→  const nextDepth = (shotWriteDepth.get(shotId) ?? 0) + 1;
   185→  shotWriteDepth.set(shotId, nextDepth);
   186→  const blockedBy = shotWriteActive.get(shotId);
   187→  const blockedByDurationMs = blockedBy ? Math.max(0, queuedAt - blockedBy.startedAt) : null;
   188→
   189→  onEvent?.('queued', {
   190→    shotId,
   191→    operation,
   192→    waitMs: 0,
   193→    durationMs: 0,
   194→    queueDepth: Math.max(0, nextDepth - 1),
   195→    requestId,
   196→    blockedByOperation: blockedBy?.operation ?? null,
   197→    blockedByDurationMs,
   198→  });
   199→
   200→  let releaseTail!: () => void;
   201→  const currentTail = new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
   202→    releaseTail = resolve;
   203→  });
   204→
   205→  const chainedTail = previousTail.catch(() => undefined).then(() => currentTail);
   206→  shotWriteTail.set(shotId, chainedTail);
   207→
   208→  await previousTail.catch(() => undefined);
   209→
   210→  const startedAt = Date.now();
   211→  shotWriteActive.set(shotId, {
   212→    requestId,
   213→    operation,
   214→    startedAt,
   215→  });
   216→  onEvent?.('start', {
   217→    shotId,
   218→    operation,
   219→    waitMs: startedAt - queuedAt,
   220→    durationMs: 0,
   221→    queueDepth: Math.max(0, (shotWriteDepth.get(shotId) ?? 1) - 1),
   222→    requestId,
   223→    blockedByOperation: blockedBy?.operation ?? null,
   224→    blockedByDurationMs,
   225→  });
   226→
   227→  try {
   228→    const timeoutMs = options?.timeoutMs ?? DEFAULT_SERIALIZED_TIMELINE_TASK_TIMEOUT_MS;
   229→    return await runTimelineWriteWithTimeout(
   230→      operation,
   231→      task,
   232→      {
   233→        timeoutMs,
   234→        onTimeout: ({ pendingMs }) => {
   235→          options?.onTimeout?.({
   236→            shotId,
   237→            operation,
   238→            timeoutMs,
   239→            pendingMs,
   240→            requestId,
   241→          });
   242→        },
   243→      },
   244→    );
   245→  } finally {
   246→    releaseTail();
   247→
   248→    const remainingDepth = Math.max(0, (shotWriteDepth.get(shotId) ?? 1) - 1);
   249→    if (remainingDepth === 0) {
   250→      shotWriteDepth.delete(shotId);
   251→    } else {
   252→      shotWriteDepth.set(shotId, remainingDepth);
   253→    }
   254→
   255→    if (shotWriteTail.get(shotId) === chainedTail) {
   256→      shotWriteTail.delete(shotId);
   257→    }
   258→    if (shotWriteActive.get(shotId)?.requestId === requestId) {
   259→      shotWriteActive.delete(shotId);
   260→    }
   261→
   262→    onEvent?.('end', {
   263→      shotId,
   264→      operation,
   265→      waitMs: startedAt - queuedAt,
   266→      durationMs: Date.now() - startedAt,
   267→      queueDepth: Math.max(0, remainingDepth - 1),
   268→      requestId,
   269→      blockedByOperation: blockedBy?.operation ?? null,
   270→      blockedByDurationMs,
   271→    });
   272→  }
   273→}
   274→

   183→    if (hasRecentFailures) {
   184→      // Circuit breaker triggered - use much longer interval
   185→      pollingInterval = 60_000; // 60 seconds
   186→    } else if (disconnectedDuration < 30_000) {
   187→      // First 30 seconds: 15s polling (give realtime time to reconnect)
   188→      pollingInterval = 15_000;
   189→    } else if (disconnectedDuration < 2 * 60_000) {
   190→      // 30s - 2 minutes: 30s polling
   191→      pollingInterval = 30_000;
   192→    } else if (disconnectedDuration < 5 * 60_000) {
   193→      // 2-5 minutes: 45s polling
   194→      pollingInterval = 45_000;
   195→    } else {
   196→      // >5 minutes: 60s polling (realtime probably has issues)
   197→      pollingInterval = 60_000;
   198→    }
   199→
   200→    return pollingInterval;
   201→  }
   202→
   203→  /**
   204→   * Report a fetch failure for circuit breaker tracking
   205→   */
   206→  onFetchFailure(queryKey: QueryKeyLike, error: Error) {
   207→    const [REDACTED](queryKey);
   208→    const now = Date.now();
   209→    const existing = this.state.fetchFailures.get(key);
   210→
   211→    // Reset count if last failure was too long ago
   212→    const shouldReset = existing && (now - existing.lastFailure) > this.CIRCUIT_BREAKER_RESET_MS;
   213→
   214→    const newCount = shouldReset ? 1 : (existing?.count || 0) + 1;
   215→    this.state.fetchFailures.set(key, { count: newCount, lastFailure: now });
   216→
   217→    const isCircuitBreakerTriggered = newCount >= this.CIRCUIT_BREAKER_THRESHOLD;
   218→
   219→    const errorType = this.classifyError(error);
   220→
   221→    // Notify subscribers so polling intervals can adjust
   222→    if (isCircuitBreakerTriggered) {
   223→      this.notifySubscribers();
   224→
   225→      // Show user-facing error toast (throttled to prevent spam)
   226→      if (now - this.lastErrorToastTime > this.ERROR_TOAST_THROTTLE_MS) {
   227→        this.lastErrorToastTime = now;
   228→
   229→        this.reportCircuitBreakerError({
   230→          queryKey: key,
   231→          failureCount: newCount,
   232→          errorType,
   233→          error,
   234→        });
   235→      }
   236→    }
   237→  }
   238→
   239→  private reportCircuitBreakerError(input: {
   240→    queryKey: string;
   241→    failureCount: number;
   242→    errorType: string;
   243→    error: Error;
   244→  }) {
   245→    const userMessage = this.getUserFriendlyErrorMessage(input.errorType, input.failureCount);
   246→    normalizeAndPresentError(new Error('Data may be outdated. Will retry automatically.'), {
   247→      context: 'DataFreshnessManager.onFetchFailure',
   248→      toastTitle: userMessage,
   249→      showToast: true,
   250→      logData: {
   251→        [REDACTED](input.queryKey),
   252→        failureCount: input.failureCount,
   253→        errorType: input.errorType,
   254→        errorMessage: input.error.message,
   255→      },
   256→    });
   257→  }
   258→
   259→  /**
   260→   * Get a user-friendly error message based on error type
   261→   */
   262→  private getUserFriendlyErrorMessage(errorType: string, failureCount: number): string {
   263→    switch (errorType) {
   264→      case 'CONNECTION_CLOSED':
   265→      case 'NETWORK_ERROR':
   266→        return 'Connection issue detected';
   267→      case 'TIMEOUT':
   268→        return 'Server is slow to respond';
   269→      case 'RATE_LIMITED':
   270→        return 'Too many requests - slowing down';
   271→      case 'SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE':
   272→        return 'Service temporarily unavailable';
   273→      case 'AUTH_ERROR':
   274→        return 'Authentication issue - try refreshing';
   275→      default:
   276→        return `Connection issues (${failureCount} failures)`;
   277→    }
   278→  }
   279→
   280→  /**
   281→   * Report a successful fetch (resets circuit breaker)
   282→   */
   283→  onFetchSuccess(queryKey: QueryKeyLike) {
   284→    const [REDACTED](queryKey);
   285→    const existing = this.state.fetchFailures.get(key);
   286→
   287→    if (existing && existing.count > 0) {
   288→      // Reset failure count on success
   289→      this.state.fetchFailures.delete(key);
   290→    }
   291→  }
   292→
   293→  /**
   294→   * Classify error type for better logging and handling
   295→   */
   296→  private classifyError(error: Error): string {
   297→    const message = error.message?.toLowerCase() || '';
   298→
   299→    if (message.includes('connection_closed') || message.includes('err_connection_closed')) {
   300→      return 'CONNECTION_CLOSED';
   301→    }
   302→    if (message.includes('failed to fetch') || message.includes('network')) {
   303→      return 'NETWORK_ERROR';
   304→    }
   305→    if (message.includes('timeout') || message.includes('timed out')) {
   306→      return 'TIMEOUT';
   307→    }
   308→    if (message.includes('abort')) {
   309→      return 'ABORTED';
   310→    }
   311→    if (message.includes('401') || message.includes('unauthorized')) {
   312→      return 'AUTH_ERROR';
   313→    }
   314→    if (message.includes('429') || message.includes('rate limit')) {
   315→      return 'RATE_LIMITED';
   316→    }
   317→    if (message.includes('503') || message.includes('service unavailable')) {
   318→      return 'SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE';
   319→    }
   320→    return 'UNKNOWN';
   321→  }
   322→
   323→  /**
   324→   * Check if data for a query is considered fresh
   325→   */
   326→  isDataFresh(queryKey: QueryKeyLike, freshnessThreshold: number = 30000): boolean {
   327→    return isQueryFresh(this.state.lastEventTimes, queryKey, freshnessThreshold, Date.now());
   328→  }
   329→
   330→  /**
   331→   * Get current freshness state for debugging
   332→   */
   333→  getDiagnostics() {
   334→    const now = Date.now();
   335→    return {
   336→      realtimeStatus: this.state.realtimeStatus,
   337→      timeSinceStatusChange: now - this.state.lastStatusChange,
   338→      trackedQueries: this.state.lastEventTimes.size,
   339→      queryAges: buildQueryAgeDiagnostics(this.state.lastEventTimes, now, this.parseQueryKey),
   340→      subscriberCount: this.subscribers.size,
   341→      timestamp: now
   342→    };
   343→  }
   344→
   345→  /**
   346→   * Subscribe to freshness changes
   347→   * Returns unsubscribe function
   348→   */
   349→  subscribe(callback: () => void): () => void {
   350→    this.subscribers.add(callback);
   351→    return () => this.subscribers.delete(callback);
   352→  }
   353→
   354→  /**
   355→   * Clear all event history (useful for testing or project changes)
   356→   */
   357→  reset() {
   358→    this.state.lastEventTimes.clear();
   359→    this.state.fetchFailures.clear();
   360→    this.state.realtimeStatus = 'disconnected';
   361→    this.state.lastStatusChange = Date.now();
   362→    this.notifySubscribers();
   363→  }
   364→
   365→  /**
   366→   * Manually mark queries as fresh (useful for mutations)
   367→   */
   368→  markQueriesFresh(queryKeys: readonly QueryKeyLike[]) {
   369→    const now = Date.now();
   370→    markQueryKeysFresh(this.state.lastEventTimes, queryKeys, now);
   371→
   372→    this.notifySubscribers();
   373→  }
   374→
   375→  private notifySubscribers() {
   376→    this.subscribers.forEach((callback) => {
   377→      try {
   378→        callback();
   379→      } catch (error) {
   380→        normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'DataFreshnessManager', showToast: false });
   381→      }
   382→    });
   383→  }
   384→}
   385→
   386→// Singleton instance - single source of truth for the entire app
   387→export const dataFreshnessManager = new DataFreshnessManager();
   388→
   389→/** Dev-only helper for wiring debug globals during app bootstrap. */
   390→export function registerDataFreshnessManagerDebugGlobal(): void {
   391→  if (!import.meta.env.DEV || typeof window === 'undefined') {
   392→    return;
   393→  }
   394→
   395→  registerDebugGlobal(
   396→    '__DATA_FRESHNESS_MANAGER__',
   397→    dataFreshnessManager,
   398→    'DataFreshnessManager',
   399→  );
   400→}

     2→
     3→/** Runtime UUID v1-v5 validator for IDs persisted in Supabase UUID columns. */
     4→export function isUuid(value: unknown): value is string {
     5→  return typeof value === 'string' && UUID_REGEX.test(value);
     6→}
     7→
     8→/**
     9→ * Filters unknown string IDs down to valid UUIDs only.
    10→ * Uses Set() to avoid duplicate query parameters.
    11→ */
    12→export function filterUuidStrings(values: readonly string[]): string[] {
    13→  return Array.from(new Set(values.filter((value) => isUuid(value))));

   318→  private handleSubscribeFailure(reason: string, projectId: string, connectSequence: number): void {
   319→    if (!this.isCurrentConnectAttempt(connectSequence)) {
   320→      return;
   321→    }
   322→    const attempt = this.state.reconnectAttempt + 1;
   323→    const isExhausted = attempt > this.config.maxReconnectAttempts;
   324→    if (isExhausted) {

   326→        context: 'RealtimeConnection.handleSubscribeFailure',
   327→        showToast: false,
   328→        logData: { reason, attempt, maxReconnectAttempts: this.config.maxReconnectAttempts },
   329→      });

   331→        status: 'failed',
   332→        error: `Connection failed after ${this.config.maxReconnectAttempts} attempts: ${reason}`,
   333→        reconnectAttempt: attempt,
   334→        nextRetryAt: null,
   335→      });
   336→      dataFreshnessManager.onRealtimeStatusChange('error', 'Max reconnect attempts reached');
   337→    } else {
   338→      const delay = Math.min(
   339→        this.config.baseReconnectDelay * Math.pow(2, attempt - 1),
   340→        this.config.maxReconnectDelay
   341→      );
   342→      const nextRetryAt = Date.now() + delay;
   343→      console.warn(
   344→        `[RealtimeConnection] Subscribe failed: ${reason}. ` +
   345→        `Retrying in ${delay}ms (attempt ${attempt}/${this.config.maxReconnectAttempts})`
   346→      );
   347→      this.setState({
   348→        status: 'reconnecting',
   349→        error: reason,
   350→        reconnectAttempt: attempt,
   351→        nextRetryAt,
   352→      });
   353→      dataFreshnessManager.onRealtimeStatusChange('error', `Reconnecting: ${reason}`);
   354→      this.scheduleReconnect(projectId, delay, connectSequence);
   355→    }

   368→        }
   369→        this.channel = null;

   372→    }, delay);

     2→ * PreloadingService - Unified coordinator for all image preloading
     3→ *
     4→ * This is the single source of truth for:
     5→ * 1. Preload queue management (network concurrency)
     6→ * 2. Lifecycle coordination (project switch, deletions, connection changes)
     7→ *

    35→class PreloadingService {

    38→    isConnected: true,
    39→    isPaused: false,
    40→  };

    43→  private config: PreloadConfig;

    45→

    49→  static getInstance(): PreloadingService {
    50→    if (!PreloadingService.instance) {
    51→      PreloadingService.instance = new PreloadingService();
    52→    }
    53→    return PreloadingService.instance;
    54→  }
    55→
    56→  private constructor() {
    57→    this.config = getPreloadConfig();
    58→    this.queue = new PreloadQueue(this.config.maxConcurrent);
    59→
    60→    // Subscribe to connection status changes from DataFreshnessManager
    61→    this.subscribeToConnectionStatus();
    62→

    64→
    65→  /**
    66→   * Subscribe to DataFreshnessManager to track connection status.
    67→   */
    68→  private subscribeToConnectionStatus(): void {
    69→    // Get initial status
    70→    const initialDiagnostics = dataFreshnessManager.getDiagnostics();
    71→    this.state.isConnected = initialDiagnostics.realtimeStatus === 'connected';
    72→
    73→    // Subscribe to changes
    74→    dataFreshnessManager.subscribe(() => {
    75→      const diagnostics = dataFreshnessManager.getDiagnostics();
    76→      const isConnected = diagnostics.realtimeStatus === 'connected';
    77→
    78→      if (isConnected !== this.state.isConnected) {
    79→        this.onConnectionStatusChange(isConnected);
    80→      }
    81→    });
    82→  }

1→import { useMemo } from 'react';
     2→import { useGetTask } from '@/shared/hooks/tasks/useTasks';
     3→import { deriveInputImages } from '@/shared/lib/taskParamsUtils';
     4→import { Task } from '@/types/tasks';
     5→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
     6→
     7→interface UseGenerationDetailsOptions {
     8→  taskId?: string;
     9→  task?: Task;
    10→  inputImages?: string[];
    11→  projectId?: string | null;
    12→}
    13→
    14→interface UseGenerationDetailsResult {
    15→  task: Task | undefined;
    16→  inputImages: string[];
    17→  isLoading: boolean;
    18→  isError: boolean;
    19→}
    20→
    21→/**
    22→ * Hook for fetching and preparing task data for GenerationDetails
    23→ *
    24→ * Handles:
    25→ * - Fetching task data by ID if provided
    26→ * - Using directly provided task if available
    27→ * - Deriving input images from task params
    28→ */
    29→export function useGenerationDetails({
    30→  taskId,
    31→  task: taskProp,
    32→  inputImages: inputImagesProp,
    33→  projectId,
    34→}: UseGenerationDetailsOptions): UseGenerationDetailsResult {
    35→  // Fetch task data if taskId is provided and no task prop
    36→  const { data: fetchedTask, isLoading, isError } = useGetTask(taskId || '', projectId);
    37→
    38→  // Use provided task or fetched task
    39→  const task = taskProp || fetchedTask;
    40→
    41→  // Derive input images from task if not explicitly provided
    42→  const inputImages = useMemo(() => {
    43→    if (inputImagesProp && inputImagesProp.length > 0) {
    44→      return inputImagesProp;
    45→    }
    46→    if (!task?.params) return [];
    47→    // Parse params if needed
    48→    let params: Record<string, unknown>;
    49→    try {
    50→      params = typeof task.params === 'string' ? JSON.parse(task.params) : task.params;
    51→    } catch (error) {
    52→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, {
    53→        context: 'useGenerationDetails.parseTaskParams',
    54→        showToast: false,
    55→        logData: { taskId: task?.id, hasStringParams: typeof task?.params === 'string' },
    56→      });
    57→      return [];
    58→    }
    59→    return deriveInputImages(params);
    60→  }, [inputImagesProp, task]);
    61→
    62→  return {
    63→    task,
    64→    inputImages,
    65→    isLoading: taskId ? isLoading && !taskProp : false,
    66→    isError: taskId ? isError && !taskProp : false,
    67→  };
    68→}
    69→

1→import { getSupabaseClient } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
     2→
     3→type SettingsScopeIdentifier = 'user' | 'project' | 'shot';
     4→type SettingsScopeTableName = 'users' | 'projects' | 'shots';
     5→
     6→export function resolveSettingsScopeTable(scope: SettingsScopeIdentifier): SettingsScopeTableName {
     7→  switch (scope) {
     8→    case 'user':
     9→      return 'users';
    10→    case 'project':
    11→      return 'projects';
    12→    case 'shot':
    13→      return 'shots';
    14→  }
    15→
    16→  throw new Error(`Invalid settings scope: ${String(scope)}`);
    17→}
    18→
    19→export function selectSettingsForScope(scope: SettingsScopeIdentifier, id: string) {
    20→  const tableName = resolveSettingsScopeTable(scope);
    21→  return getSupabaseClient()
    22→    .from(tableName)
    23→    .select('settings')
    24→    .eq('id', id)
    25→    .single();
    26→}
    27→
    28→export function callUpdateToolSettingsAtomicRpc(
    29→  tableName: SettingsScopeTableName,
    30→  id: string,
    31→  toolId: string,
    32→  settings: Record<string, unknown>,
    33→) {
    34→  return getSupabaseClient().rpc('update_tool_settings_atomic', {
    35→    p_table_name: tableName,
    36→    p_id: id,
    37→    p_tool_id: toolId,
    38→    p_settings: settings,
    39→  });
    40→}
    41→

   109→
   110→export const VideoEditPanel: React.FC<VideoEditPanelProps> = ({
   111→  variant,
   112→  isCloudMode,
   113→  trim,
   114→  replace,
   115→  // Regenerate props (specialized)
   116→  regenerateFormProps,

   174→function inferMediaExtension(image: GeneratedImageWithMetadata, blob: Blob): string {
   175→  const contentType = blob.type || image.metadata?.content_type;
   176→  if (contentType) {
   177→    if (contentType.includes('jpeg') || contentType.includes('jpg')) return 'jpg';
   178→    if (contentType.includes('png')) return 'png';
   179→    if (contentType.includes('webp')) return 'webp';
   180→    if (contentType.includes('gif')) return 'gif';
   181→    if (image.isVideo) {
   182→      if (contentType.includes('webm')) return 'webm';
   183→      return 'mp4';
   184→    }
   185→  }
   186→  return image.isVideo ? 'mp4' : 'png';
   187→}

   189→function buildArchiveFileName(): string {
   190→  const now = new Date();
   191→  const dateStr = now.toISOString().split('T')[0].replace(/-/g, '');
   192→  return `starred-images-${dateStr}.zip`;
   193→}
   194→
   195→export async function downloadStarredMediaArchive(
   196→  options: DownloadStarredArchiveOptions,
   197→): Promise<{ count: number; archiveFilename: string }> {
   198→  const context = 'MediaGallery.downloadStarredMediaArchive';
   199→  const JSZipModule = await import('jszip');
   200→  const zip = new JSZipModule.default();
   201→
   202→  const sortedImages = [...options.images].sort((a, b) => {
   203→    const dateA = a.createdAt ? new Date(a.createdAt).getTime() : 0;
   204→    const dateB = b.createdAt ? new Date(b.createdAt).getTime() : 0;
   205→    if (dateA !== dateB) {
   206→      return dateA - dateB;
   207→    }
   208→    return a.id.localeCompare(b.id);
   209→  });
   210→
   211→  for (let i = 0; i < sortedImages.length; i += 1) {
   212→    const image = sortedImages[i];
   213→    const accessibleImageUrl = getDisplayUrl(image.url);
   214→    let response: Response;
   215→    try {
   216→      response = await fetch(accessibleImageUrl);
   217→    } catch (error) {
   218→      throw toDownloadServiceError({
   219→        error,
   220→        context,
   221→        url: accessibleImageUrl,
   222→        fallbackMessage: 'Network request failed',
   223→      });
   224→    }
   225→
   226→    if (!response.ok) {
   227→      throw new DownloadServiceError({
   228→        code: 'http_error',
   229→        context,
   230→        message: `Failed to fetch media: ${response.status} ${response.statusText}`,
   231→        status: response.status,
   232→        statusText: response.statusText,
   233→        url: accessibleImageUrl,
   234→      });
   235→    }
   236→
   237→    let blob: Blob;
   238→    try {
   239→      blob = await response.blob();
   240→    } catch (error) {
   241→      throw toDownloadServiceError({
   242→        error,
   243→        context,
   244→        url: accessibleImageUrl,
   245→        fallbackMessage: 'Failed to read download payload',
   246→      });
   247→    }
   248→
   249→    const extension = inferMediaExtension(image, blob);
   250→    const filename = `${String(i + 1).padStart(3, '0')}.${extension}`;
   251→    zip.file(filename, blob);
   252→    options.onProgress?.(i + 1, sortedImages.length);
   253→  }
   254→
   255→  const zipBlob = await zip.generateAsync({ type: 'blob' });
   256→  const archiveFilename = buildArchiveFileName();
   257→  downloadBlobAsFile(zipBlob, archiveFilename);
   258→  return { count: sortedImages.length, archiveFilename };

   231→type AbortableQuery<T> = {

   234→function maybeAttachAbortSignal<T>(query: T, signal?: AbortSignal): T {

   239→  if (typeof abortable.abortSignal === 'function') {
   240→    return abortable.abortSignal(signal);
   241→  }
   242→  return query;
   243→}
   244→async function raceWithAbort<T>(promise: Promise<T>, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<T> {

   253→        recoverable: true,

   261→      (value) => {
   262→        cleanup();
   263→        resolve(value);
   264→      },
   265→      (error) => {
   266→        cleanup();
   267→        reject(error);
   268→      },
   269→    );
   270→  });

   272→/** Fetch settings from all three scopes (user, project, shot) in parallel. */

   456→          metadata: contextInfo,
   457→        },

   108→  for (const { videoUrl, thumbnailUrl, generationId } of entries) {
   109→    if (!videoUrl) continue;
   110→
   111→    const durationSeconds = await readVideoDuration(videoUrl);
   112→
   113→    const clip: VideoClip = {
   114→      id: generateUUID(),
   115→      url: videoUrl,
   116→      posterUrl: thumbnailUrl,
   117→      durationSeconds,
   118→      loaded: false,
   119→      playing: false,
   120→      generationId,
   121→    };
   122→
   123→    actions.push({ type: 'deferred_insert', clip });
   124→  }
   125→
   126→  return actions;
   127→}
   128→
   129→export async function consumePendingJoinClips(
   130→  options: ConsumePendingJoinClipsOptions = {},
   131→): Promise<OperationResult<PendingClipAction[]>> {
   132→  const projectId = options.projectId ?? null;
   133→  const readVideoDuration = options.readVideoDuration ?? getVideoDurationFromUrl;
   134→
   135→  try {
   136→    const userId = readUserIdFromStorage();
   137→
   138→    const inMemoryPending = consumeJoinClipsIntents({ projectId, userId });
   139→    if (inMemoryPending.length > 0) {
   140→      const now = Date.now();
   141→      const scopedRecentClips = inMemoryPending.filter(
   142→        (clip) =>
   143→          now - clip.timestamp < PENDING_CLIPS_TTL_MS
   144→          && isPendingJoinClipInScope(clip, { projectId, userId }),
   145→      );
   146→      if (scopedRecentClips.length === 0) {
   147→        localStorage.removeItem(getPendingJoinClipsStorageKey(projectId, userId));
   148→        return operationSuccess([]);
   149→      }
   150→
   151→      const actions = await toPendingClipActions(scopedRecentClips, readVideoDuration);
   152→      localStorage.removeItem(getPendingJoinClipsStorageKey(projectId, userId));
   153→      return operationSuccess(actions);
   154→    }
   155→
   156→    const pendingKeys = getPendingJoinClipsCandidateKeys({ projectId, userId });
   157→    const pendingSource = pendingKeys
   158→      .map((key) => ({ key, raw: localStorage.getItem(key) }))
   159→      .find((item) => typeof item.raw === 'string' && item.raw.length > 0);
   160→
   161→    if (!pendingSource || !pendingSource.raw) {
   162→      return operationSuccess([]);
   163→    }
   164→
   165→    const parsedPendingClips = parsePendingJoinClips(pendingSource.raw);
   166→    if (!parsedPendingClips) {
   167→      normalizeAndPresentError(new Error('Invalid pending join clips payload'), {
   168→        context: 'JoinClipsPage.pendingClipsInvalid',
   169→        showToast: false,
   170→        logData: { [REDACTED] },
   171→      });
   172→      localStorage.removeItem(pendingSource.key);
   173→      return operationFailure(new Error('Invalid pending join clips payload'), {
   174→        policy: 'degrade',
   175→        errorCode: 'pending_join_clips_invalid_payload',
   176→        message: 'Invalid pending join clips payload',
   177→        recoverable: true,
   178→        cause: { [REDACTED] },
   179→      });
   180→    }
   181→
   182→    if (parsedPendingClips.invalidCount > 0) {
   183→      normalizeAndPresentError(new Error('Dropped invalid pending join clip entries'), {
   184→        context: 'JoinClipsPage.pendingClipsPartialRecovery',
   185→        showToast: false,
   186→        logData: {
   187→          [REDACTED],
   188→          totalEntries: parsedPendingClips.entries.length + parsedPendingClips.invalidCount,
   189→          invalidEntries: parsedPendingClips.invalidCount,
   190→        },
   191→      });
   192→    }
   193→
   194→    const now = Date.now();
   195→    const recentClips = parsedPendingClips.entries.filter(
   196→      clip => now - clip.timestamp < PENDING_CLIPS_TTL_MS,
   197→    );
   198→    const scopedRecentClips = recentClips.filter((clip) =>
   199→      isPendingJoinClipInScope(clip, { projectId, userId }),
   200→    );
   201→
   202→    if (scopedRecentClips.length === 0) {
   203→      localStorage.removeItem(pendingSource.key);
   204→      return operationSuccess([], {
   205→        ...(parsedPendingClips.invalidCount > 0 ? { policy: 'degrade' } : {}),
   206→      });
   207→    }
   208→
   209→    const actions = await toPendingClipActions(scopedRecentClips, readVideoDuration);
   210→
   211→    localStorage.removeItem(pendingSource.key);
   212→    return operationSuccess(actions, {
   213→      ...(parsedPendingClips.invalidCount > 0 ? { policy: 'degrade' } : {}),
   214→    });
   215→  } catch (error) {
   216→    normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'JoinClipsPage', showToast: false });
   217→    return operationFailure(error, {
   218→      policy: 'degrade',
   219→      errorCode: 'pending_join_clips_read_failed',
   220→      message: 'Failed to consume pending join clips',
   221→      recoverable: true,
   222→      cause: error,
   223→    });
   224→  }
   225→}
   226→
   227→/**
   228→ * Apply pending clip actions to an existing clips array.
   229→ * Resolves each deferred action by filling the first available empty slot,
   230→ * or appending when no empty slots remain.
   231→ */
   232→export function applyPendingClipActions(
   233→  prevClips: VideoClip[],
   234→  actions: PendingClipAction[],
   235→): VideoClip[] {
   236→  let clips = [...prevClips];
   237→  // Track which indices have been filled by previous actions in this batch
   238→  const filledIndices = new Set<number>();
   239→
   240→  for (const action of actions) {
   241→    const emptyIndex = clips.findIndex(
   242→      (clip, idx) => !clip.url && !filledIndices.has(idx),
   243→    );
   244→
   245→    if (emptyIndex !== -1) {
   246→      clips = clips.map((clip, idx) =>
   247→        idx === emptyIndex
   248→          ? {
   249→              ...clip,
   250→              url: action.clip.url,
   251→              posterUrl: action.clip.posterUrl,
   252→              durationSeconds: action.clip.durationSeconds,
   253→              loaded: false,
   254→              playing: false,
   255→              generationId: action.clip.generationId,
   256→            }
   257→          : clip,
   258→      );
   259→      filledIndices.add(emptyIndex);
   260→    } else {
   261→      clips = [...clips, action.clip];
   262→    }
   263→  }
   264→
   265→  return clips;
   266→}
   267→

     6→
     7→interface UseUpdatingTimestampOptions {
     8→  date?: string | Date | null;
     9→  abbreviate?: (str: string) => string;
    10→  disabled?: boolean;
    11→  preset?: RelativeTimestampPreset;
    12→}
    13→
    14→const relativeTimestampFormatters: Record<
    15→  RelativeTimestampPreset,
    16→  (date: Date, abbreviate: (str: string) => string) => string
    17→> = {
    18→  default: (date, abbreviate) => abbreviate(formatDistanceToNow(date, { addSuffix: true })),
    19→  task: (date) => {
    20→    const abbreviated = abbreviateRelativeTime(formatDistanceToNow(date, { addSuffix: true }));
    21→    return abbreviated || '<1 min ago';
    22→  },
    23→  processing: (date) => `Processing for ${formatRelativeDuration(date, { includeDays: false })}`,
    24→  completed: (date) => `Completed ${formatRelativeDuration(date)} ago`,
    25→};
    26→
    27→export function useRelativeTimestamp({
    28→  date,
    29→  abbreviate = abbreviateRelativeTime,
    30→  disabled = false,
    31→  preset = 'default',
    32→}: UseUpdatingTimestampOptions = {}): string | null {
    33→  const formatter = relativeTimestampFormatters[preset];
    34→
    35→  return useLiveRelativeTimestamp({
    36→    dateInput: date,
    37→    disabled,
    38→    formatter: (parsedDate) => formatter(parsedDate, abbreviate),
    39→  });
    40→}
    41→
    42→export function useUpdatingTimestamp(options: UseUpdatingTimestampOptions = {}): string | null {
    43→  return useRelativeTimestamp(options);
    44→}
    45→
    46→export function useTaskTimestamp(date?: string | Date | null) {
    47→  return useRelativeTimestamp({
    48→    date,
    49→    preset: 'task',
    50→  });
    51→}

1→/**
     2→ * Shared utilities for extracting data from task params
     3→ *
     4→ * This module provides a single source of truth for parsing task parameters,
     5→ * ensuring consistent behavior across TasksPane, MediaLightbox, and other components.

     7→import { buildTaskPayloadSnapshot } from './tasks/taskPayloadSnapshot';

    10→/**
    11→ * Parse task params, handling both string and object formats
    12→ */
    13→export function parseTaskParams(params: string | Record<string, unknown> | null | undefined): Record<string, unknown> {
    14→  if (!params) return {};
    15→  if (typeof params === 'string') {
    16→    try {
    17→      const parsed = JSON.parse(params);
    18→      return asRecord(parsed) ?? {};
    19→    } catch {
    20→      return {};
    21→    }
    22→  }
    23→  return asRecord(params) ?? {};
    24→}
    25→
    26→/**
    27→ * Derive input images from task params
    28→ *
    29→ * For segment tasks (has segment_index): Only returns segment-specific images
    30→ * For orchestrated tasks: Returns all images from orchestrator
    31→ * For other tasks: Checks various image field locations
    32→ *
    33→ * @param parsedParams - Already-parsed task params object
    34→ * @returns Array of image URLs
    35→ */
    36→export function deriveInputImages(parsedParams: Record<string, unknown>): string[] {
    37→  const params = parsedParams;
    38→  if (isTravelTaskParams(params)) {
    39→    const travelImages = deriveTravelInputImages(params);
    40→    if (travelImages.length > 0) {
    41→      return travelImages;
    42→    }
    43→  }
    44→
    45→  const orchestratorDetails = asRecord(params.orchestrator_details);
    46→  const orchestratorPayload = asRecord(params.full_orchestrator_payload);
    47→  const segmentParams = asRecord(params.individual_segment_params);
    48→
    49→  // Check if this is a segment task (individual segment of a larger generation)
    50→  const isSegmentTask = params?.segment_index !== undefined;
    51→
    52→  // For segment tasks, ONLY use segment-specific images (not the full orchestrator list)
    53→  if (isSegmentTask) {
    54→    // Priority: individual_segment_params > top-level input_image_paths_resolved
    55→    if (Array.isArray(segmentParams?.input_image_paths_resolved) && segmentParams.input_image_paths_resolved.length > 0) {
    56→      return segmentParams.input_image_paths_resolved.filter((x): x is string => typeof x === 'string');
    57→    }
    58→    // Fallback to start/end image URLs
    59→    if (segmentParams?.start_image_url || segmentParams?.end_image_url) {
    60→      const urls: string[] = [];
    61→      if (typeof segmentParams?.start_image_url === 'string') urls.push(segmentParams.start_image_url);
    62→      if (typeof segmentParams?.end_image_url === 'string') urls.push(segmentParams.end_image_url);
    63→      return urls;
    64→    }
    65→    // Fallback to top-level (which should be segment-specific for segment tasks)
    66→    if (Array.isArray(params?.input_image_paths_resolved)) {
    67→      return params.input_image_paths_resolved.filter((x): x is string => typeof x === 'string');
    68→    }
    69→    return [];
    70→  }
    71→
    72→  // For non-segment tasks, collect from all locations
    73→  const urls: string[] = [];
    74→
