    76→  if (typeof params?.image_url === 'string') urls.push(params.image_url);
    77→  if (typeof params?.image === 'string') urls.push(params.image);
    78→  if (typeof params?.input_image === 'string') urls.push(params.input_image);
    79→  if (typeof params?.init_image === 'string') urls.push(params.init_image);
    80→  if (typeof params?.control_image === 'string') urls.push(params.control_image);
    81→  if (Array.isArray(params?.images)) urls.push(...params.images.filter((x): x is string => typeof x === 'string'));
    82→  if (Array.isArray(params?.input_images)) urls.push(...params.input_images.filter((x): x is string => typeof x === 'string'));
    83→  if (typeof params?.mask_url === 'string') urls.push(params.mask_url);
    84→
    85→  // Travel/video task paths - orchestrator details contain all images for full timeline
    86→  if (Array.isArray(orchestratorDetails?.input_image_paths_resolved)) {
    87→    urls.push(...orchestratorDetails.input_image_paths_resolved.filter((x): x is string => typeof x === 'string'));
    88→  } else if (Array.isArray(orchestratorPayload?.input_image_paths_resolved)) {
    89→    urls.push(...orchestratorPayload.input_image_paths_resolved.filter((x): x is string => typeof x === 'string'));
    90→  } else if (Array.isArray(params?.input_image_paths_resolved)) {
    91→    urls.push(...params.input_image_paths_resolved.filter((x): x is string => typeof x === 'string'));
    92→  }
    93→
    94→  return Array.from(new Set(urls.filter(Boolean)));
    95→}
    96→
    97→/**
    98→ * Extract prompt from task params
    99→ *
   100→ * For segment tasks: Checks individual_segment_params first
   101→ * For orchestrated tasks: Checks orchestrator details
   102→ * For other tasks: Falls back to top-level prompt
   103→ *
   104→ * Prefers enhanced_prompts_expanded over base_prompts_expanded when available,
   105→ * as enhanced prompts contain the AI-improved version of the user's prompt.
   106→ *
   107→ * @param parsedParams - Already-parsed task params object
   108→ * @returns The prompt string or null
   109→ */
   110→export function derivePrompt(parsedParams: Record<string, unknown>): string | null {
   111→  const params = parsedParams;
   112→  if (isTravelTaskParams(params)) {
   113→    return deriveTravelPrompt(params);
   114→  }
   115→
   116→  const orchestratorDetails = asRecord(params.orchestrator_details);
   117→  const orchestratorPayload = asRecord(params.full_orchestrator_payload);
   118→  const segmentParams = asRecord(params.individual_segment_params);
   119→  const segmentIndex = toIntegerOrNull(params.segment_index);
   120→
   121→  const isSegmentTask = params.segment_index !== undefined;
   122→
   123→  // For segment tasks, try to get enhanced prompt first
   124→  if (isSegmentTask) {
   125→    // Check for enhanced prompt - can be singular field or in expanded array
   126→    const enhancedFromOrchestratorDetails = asStringArray(orchestratorDetails?.enhanced_prompts_expanded);
   127→    const enhancedFromOrchestratorPayload = asStringArray(orchestratorPayload?.enhanced_prompts_expanded);
   128→    const enhancedPrompt = pickFirstString(
   129→      segmentParams?.enhanced_prompt,
   130→      params.enhanced_prompt,
   131→      segmentIndex === null ? undefined : enhancedFromOrchestratorDetails?.[segmentIndex],
   132→      segmentIndex === null ? undefined : enhancedFromOrchestratorPayload?.[segmentIndex],
   133→    );
   134→    if (enhancedPrompt) return enhancedPrompt;
   135→
   136→    // Fall back to base prompt
   137→    return (
   138→      pickFirstString(
   139→        segmentParams?.base_prompt,
   140→        params.base_prompt,
   141→        params.prompt,
   142→        orchestratorDetails?.base_prompt,
   143→      ) ?? null
   144→    );
   145→  }
   146→
   147→  // For full timeline/orchestrated tasks
   148→  // The global base_prompt is what the user typed in the prompt field.
   149→  // Per-pair overrides (base_prompts_expanded) are segment-specific and shouldn't
   150→  // be shown as the task-level prompt — they're misleading when the user explicitly
   151→  // cleared the global prompt.
   152→  const enhancedFromOrchestratorDetails = asStringArray(orchestratorDetails?.enhanced_prompts_expanded);
   153→  const enhancedFromOrchestratorPayload = asStringArray(orchestratorPayload?.enhanced_prompts_expanded);
   154→  return (
   155→    pickFirstString(
   156→      orchestratorDetails?.base_prompt,
   157→      orchestratorPayload?.base_prompt,
   158→      params.base_prompt,
   159→      params.prompt,
   160→      // Fall back to enhanced prompts (AI-improved) but NOT base_prompts_expanded
   161→      // which are per-pair overrides, not task-level prompts.
   162→      enhancedFromOrchestratorDetails?.[0],
   163→      enhancedFromOrchestratorPayload?.[0],
   164→    ) ?? null
   165→  );
   166→}
   167→
   168→/**
   169→ * Check if a task type is an image edit task
   170→ */
   171→export function isImageEditTaskType(taskType: string | undefined): boolean {
   172→  const IMAGE_EDIT_TASK_TYPES = [
   173→    'z_image_turbo_i2i',
   174→    'image_inpaint',
   175→    'qwen_image_edit',
   176→    'magic_edit',
   177→    'kontext_image_edit',
   178→    'flux_image_edit',
   179→    'annotated_image_edit',
   180→  ];
   181→  return IMAGE_EDIT_TASK_TYPES.includes(taskType || '');
   182→}
   183→
   184→/**
   185→ * Check if a task type is a video enhancement task
   186→ */
   187→export function isVideoEnhanceTaskType(taskType: string | undefined): boolean {

   190→
   191→/**

   195→  return taskType === 'image-upscale';

   197→
   198→/**
   199→ * LoRA info extracted from task params
   200→ */
   201→interface LoraInfo {
   202→  url: string;
   203→  strength: number;
   204→  displayName: string;
   205→}
   206→
   207→/**
   208→ * Extract LoRAs from task params (checks multiple locations)
   209→ */
   210→export function extractLoras(parsedParams: Record<string, unknown>): LoraInfo[] {
   211→  const params = parsedParams;
   212→  const orchestratorDetails = asRecord(params.orchestrator_details);
   213→  const orchestratorPayload = asRecord(params.full_orchestrator_payload);
   214→
   215→  // Check for array format (image edit tasks use this)
   216→  const lorasArray = params.loras || orchestratorDetails?.loras || orchestratorPayload?.loras;
   217→  if (Array.isArray(lorasArray) && lorasArray.length > 0) {
   218→    return lorasArray
   219→      .map((lora): LoraInfo | null => {
   220→        const loraRecord = asRecord(lora);
   221→        if (!loraRecord) return null;
   222→        const url = asString(loraRecord.url) ?? '';
   223→        const parsedStrength = toFiniteNumber(loraRecord.strength) ?? toFiniteNumber(loraRecord.multiplier) ?? 1;
   224→        return {
   225→          url,
   226→          strength: parsedStrength,
   227→          displayName: extractLoraDisplayName(url),
   228→        };
   229→      })
   230→      .filter((lora): lora is LoraInfo => lora !== null);
   231→  }
   232→
   233→  // Check for object format (video tasks use additional_loras)
   234→  const additionalLoras = params.additional_loras || orchestratorDetails?.additional_loras || orchestratorPayload?.additional_loras;
   235→  if (additionalLoras && typeof additionalLoras === 'object' && Object.keys(additionalLoras as Record<string, unknown>).length > 0) {
   236→    return Object.entries(additionalLoras as Record<string, unknown>).map(([url, strength]) => ({
   237→      url,
   238→      strength: toFiniteNumber(strength) ?? 1,
   239→      displayName: extractLoraDisplayName(url),
   240→    }));
   241→  }
   242→
   243→  return [];
   244→}
   245→
   246→function extractLoraDisplayName(url: string): string {
   247→  const fileName = url.split('/').pop() || 'Unknown';
   248→  return fileName.replace(/\.(safetensors|ckpt|pt)$/i, '').replace(/_/g, ' ');
   249→}
   250→
   251→const TRAVEL_SEGMENT_IMAGE_SOURCE_ORDER: TravelPayloadSource[] = [
   252→  'individualSegmentParams',
   253→  'taskViewContract',
   254→  'familyContract',
   255→  'rawParams',
   256→];
   257→
   258→const TRAVEL_TIMELINE_IMAGE_SOURCE_ORDER: TravelPayloadSource[] = [
   259→  'taskViewContract',
   260→  'familyContract',
   261→  'orchestratorDetails',
   262→  'fullOrchestratorPayload',
   263→  'rawParams',
   264→];
   265→
   266→const TRAVEL_PROMPT_SOURCE_ORDER: TravelPayloadSource[] = [
   267→  'taskViewContract',
   268→  'familyContract',
   269→  'individualSegmentParams',
   270→  'orchestratorDetails',
   271→  'fullOrchestratorPayload',
   272→  'rawParams',
   273→];
   274→
   275→function dedupeTruthyStrings(values: Array<string | undefined>): string[] {
   276→  return Array.from(new Set(values.filter((value): value is string => typeof value === 'string' && value.length > 0)));
   277→}
   278→
   279→function isTravelTaskParams(params: Record<string, unknown>): boolean {
   280→  const familyContract = asRecord(params.task_family_contract);
   281→  return (
   282→    params.task_family === 'travel_between_images'
   283→    || familyContract?.task_family === 'travel_between_images'
   284→    || params.orchestrator_details !== undefined
   285→    || params.full_orchestrator_payload !== undefined
   286→    || params.individual_segment_params !== undefined
   287→    || Array.isArray(params.image_urls)
   288→    || Array.isArray(params.input_image_paths_resolved)
   289→  );
   290→}
   291→
   292→function deriveTravelInputImages(params: Record<string, unknown>): string[] {
   293→  const snapshot = buildTaskPayloadSnapshot(params);
   294→  const reader = createTravelPayloadReader(snapshot);
   295→  const isSegmentTask = params.segment_index !== undefined;
   296→
   297→  if (isSegmentTask) {
   298→    const segmentInputImages = reader.pickStringArray('input_image_paths_resolved', TRAVEL_SEGMENT_IMAGE_SOURCE_ORDER);
   299→    if (segmentInputImages && segmentInputImages.length > 0) {
   300→      return dedupeTruthyStrings(segmentInputImages);
   301→    }
   302→
   303→    const startImage = reader.pickString('start_image_url', TRAVEL_SEGMENT_IMAGE_SOURCE_ORDER);
   304→    const endImage = reader.pickString('end_image_url', TRAVEL_SEGMENT_IMAGE_SOURCE_ORDER);
   305→    return dedupeTruthyStrings([startImage, endImage]);
   306→  }
   307→
   308→  const timelineSources = [
   309→    reader.pickStringArray('input_images', TRAVEL_TIMELINE_IMAGE_SOURCE_ORDER),
   310→    reader.pickStringArray('input_image_paths_resolved', TRAVEL_TIMELINE_IMAGE_SOURCE_ORDER),
   311→    reader.pickStringArray('image_urls', TRAVEL_TIMELINE_IMAGE_SOURCE_ORDER),
   312→  ];
   313→  for (const candidate of timelineSources) {
   314→    if (candidate && candidate.length > 0) {
   315→      return dedupeTruthyStrings(candidate);
   316→    }
   317→  }
   318→
   319→  return [];
   320→}
   321→
   322→function deriveTravelPrompt(params: Record<string, unknown>): string | null {
   323→  const snapshot = buildTaskPayloadSnapshot(params);
   324→  const reader = createTravelPayloadReader(snapshot);
   325→  const segmentIndex = toIntegerOrNull(params.segment_index);
   326→  const isSegmentTask = params.segment_index !== undefined;
   327→
   328→  if (isSegmentTask) {
   329→    const enhancedPromptsExpanded = reader.pickStringArray('enhanced_prompts_expanded', [
   330→      'orchestratorDetails',
   331→      'fullOrchestratorPayload',
   332→      'rawParams',
   333→    ]);
   334→    const enhancedPrompt = pickFirstString(
   335→      reader.pickString('enhanced_prompt', TRAVEL_PROMPT_SOURCE_ORDER),
   336→      segmentIndex === null ? undefined : enhancedPromptsExpanded?.[segmentIndex],
   337→    );
   338→    if (enhancedPrompt) {
   339→      return enhancedPrompt;
   340→    }
   341→
   342→    return (
   343→      pickFirstString(
   344→        reader.pickString('prompt', TRAVEL_PROMPT_SOURCE_ORDER),
   345→        reader.pickString('base_prompt', TRAVEL_PROMPT_SOURCE_ORDER),
   346→      ) ?? null
   347→    );
   348→  }
   349→
   350→  return (
   351→    pickFirstString(
   352→      reader.pickString('prompt', TRAVEL_PROMPT_SOURCE_ORDER),
   353→      reader.pickString('base_prompt', TRAVEL_PROMPT_SOURCE_ORDER),
   354→      reader.pickString('enhanced_prompt', TRAVEL_PROMPT_SOURCE_ORDER),
   355→    ) ?? null
   356→  );
   357→}
   358→
   359→function asRecord(value: unknown): Record<string, unknown> | null {
   360→  if (!value || typeof value !== 'object' || Array.isArray(value)) return null;
   361→  return value as Record<string, unknown>;
   362→}
   363→
   364→function asString(value: unknown): string | null {
   365→  return typeof value === 'string' ? value : null;
   366→}
   367→
   368→function asStringArray(value: unknown): string[] | null {
   369→  if (!Array.isArray(value)) return null;
   370→  return value.filter((item): item is string => typeof item === 'string');
   371→}
   372→
   373→function toIntegerOrNull(value: unknown): number | null {
   374→  const numeric = toFiniteNumber(value);
   375→  if (numeric === null || !Number.isInteger(numeric)) return null;
   376→  return numeric;
   377→}
   378→
   379→function toFiniteNumber(value: unknown): number | null {
   380→  const numeric = typeof value === 'number' ? value : Number(value);
   381→  return Number.isFinite(numeric) ? numeric : null;
   382→}
   383→
   384→function pickFirstString(...values: unknown[]): string | null {
   385→  for (const value of values) {
   386→    const text = asString(value);
   387→    if (text) return text;
   388→  }
   389→  return null;
   390→}
   391→

1→import { normalizeAndReportError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeErrorReporting';
     2→import { getReconnectScheduler } from '@/integrations/supabase/support/reconnect/ReconnectScheduler';
     3→import type { SupabaseClient, Session } from '@supabase/supabase-js';
     4→
     5→type AuthCallback = (event: string, session: Session | null) => void;
     6→
     7→const AUTH_HEAL_DEBOUNCE_MS = 5000;
     8→
     9→export class AuthStateManager {
    10→  private listeners: Array<{id: string, callback: AuthCallback}> = [];
    11→  private isInitialized = false;
    12→  private __LAST_AUTH_HEAL_AT__ = 0;
    13→
    14→  constructor(private supabase: SupabaseClient) {}
    15→
    16→  subscribe(id: string, callback: AuthCallback) {
    17→    this.listeners.push({ id, callback });
    18→    return () => {
    19→      this.listeners = this.listeners.filter(listener => listener.id !== id);
    20→    };
    21→  }
    22→
    23→  private notifyListeners(event: string, session: Session | null) {
    24→    this.listeners.forEach(({ callback }) => {
    25→      try {
    26→        callback(event, session);
    27→      } catch (error) {
    28→        normalizeAndReportError(error, { context: 'AuthStateManager', showToast: false });
    29→      }
    30→    });
    31→  }
    32→
    33→  private handleCoreAuth(event: string, session: Session | null) {
    34→    try {
    35→      this.supabase?.realtime?.setAuth?.(session?.access_token ?? null);
    36→      
    37→      if (event === 'SIGNED_IN' && typeof window !== 'undefined') {
    38→        setTimeout(async () => {
    39→          try {
    40→            const now = Date.now();
    41→            if (now - this.__LAST_AUTH_HEAL_AT__ > AUTH_HEAL_DEBOUNCE_MS) {
    42→              this.__LAST_AUTH_HEAL_AT__ = now;
    43→              
    44→              // Use ReconnectScheduler instead of direct event dispatch
    45→              const scheduler = getReconnectScheduler();
    46→              scheduler.requestReconnect({
    47→                source: 'AuthManager',
    48→                reason: `SIGNED_IN event (${event})`,
    49→                priority: 'high'
    50→              });
    51→            }
    52→          } catch (healError) {
    53→            normalizeAndReportError(healError, { context: 'AuthStateManager', showToast: false });
    54→          }
    55→        }, 1000);
    56→      }
    57→    } catch (setAuthError) {
    58→      normalizeAndReportError(setAuthError, { context: 'AuthStateManager', showToast: false });
    59→    }
    60→  }
    61→
    62→  init() {
    63→    if (this.isInitialized) {
    64→      return;
    65→    }
    66→
    67→    try {
    68→      this.supabase.auth.onAuthStateChange((event, session) => {
    69→        this.handleCoreAuth(event, session);
    70→        this.notifyListeners(event, session);
    71→      });
    72→      this.isInitialized = true;
    73→    } catch (authError) {
    74→      normalizeAndReportError(authError, { context: 'AuthStateManager', showToast: false });
    75→    }
    76→  }
    77→}
    78→
    79→let authStateManager: AuthStateManager | null = null;
    80→
    81→export function initAuthStateManager(supabase: SupabaseClient): AuthStateManager {
    82→  if (!authStateManager) {
    83→    authStateManager = new AuthStateManager(supabase);
    84→    authStateManager.init();
    85→  }
    86→  return authStateManager;
    87→}
    88→
    89→export function getAuthStateManager(): AuthStateManager | null {
    90→  return authStateManager;
    91→}
    92→

    94→  authStateManager = null;
    95→}

1→/**
     2→ * Shared Generation Data Transformers
     3→ * 
     4→ * SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for transforming generation data from database to UI format.
     5→ * 
     6→ * This eliminates the need to manually update transformation logic in multiple places
     7→ * when adding new fields. Instead, update once here and all consumers automatically
     8→ * get the new field.
     9→ * 
    10→ * Architecture Benefits:
    11→ * - DRY: No duplicated transformation logic across hooks/components
    12→ * - Type Safety: Centralized TypeScript types ensure consistency
    13→ * - Maintainability: Add new fields in one place instead of 5+
    14→ * - Testability: Can unit test transformations in isolation
    15→ * 
    16→ * NOTE: upscaled_url has been removed - upscaled versions are now stored as
    17→ * generation_variants with variant_type='upscaled' and become the primary variant,
    18→ * so `location` already contains the best available URL.
    19→ */
    20→

    22→import type { GenerationRow } from '@/domains/generation/types';
    23→import type { GenerationMetadata } from '@/domains/generation/types';

    29→import { expandShotData } from '@/shared/lib/shotData';

    33→/**
    34→ * Result type for calculateDerivedCounts
    35→ */
    36→export interface DerivedCountsResult {
    37→  /** Count of variants/derivatives per generation */
    38→  derivedCounts: Record<string, number>;
    39→  /** Whether each generation has any unviewed variants (viewed_at IS NULL) */
    40→  hasUnviewedVariants: Record<string, boolean>;
    41→  /** Count of unviewed variants per generation */
    42→  unviewedVariantCounts: Record<string, number>;
    43→  /** True when counts were intentionally returned empty due to a read-path failure. */
    44→  degraded?: boolean;
    45→  /** Machine-readable reason for degraded fallback behavior. */
    46→  errorCode?: 'query_failed';
    47→}
    48→
    49→function createEmptyDerivedCountsResult(): DerivedCountsResult {
    50→  return {
    51→    derivedCounts: {},
    52→    hasUnviewedVariants: {},
    53→    unviewedVariantCounts: {},
    54→  };
    55→}
    56→
    57→/**
    58→ * Calculate derivedCount for generations (how many variants/derivatives exist)
    59→ * Also tracks whether any variants are unviewed (for NEW badge display)
    60→ *
    61→ * Queries both:
    62→ * - generations table (based_on relationships)
    63→ * - generation_variants table (edit variants)
    64→ *
    65→ * @param generationIds - Array of generation IDs to count variants for
    66→ * @returns Object with derivedCounts and hasUnviewedVariants maps
    67→ */
    68→async function calculateDerivedCounts(
    69→  generationIds: string[]
    70→): Promise<DerivedCountsResult> {
    71→  const persistedGenerationIds = filterUuidStrings(generationIds);
    72→  if (persistedGenerationIds.length === 0) {
    73→    return createEmptyDerivedCountsResult();
    74→  }
    75→
    76→  const { derivedCounts, hasUnviewedVariants, unviewedVariantCounts } = createEmptyDerivedCountsResult();
    77→
    78→  // Only count from generation_variants table (actual variants)
    79→  // Note: We intentionally don't count based_on generations here - those are
    80→  // separate images in the gallery, not variants of this image
    81→  const { data: variantCountsData, error: variantCountsError } = await supabase().from('generation_variants')
    82→    .select('generation_id, viewed_at')
    83→    .in('generation_id', persistedGenerationIds);
    84→
    85→  if (variantCountsError) {
    86→    throw new ServerError('Failed to load variant badge counts', {
    87→      context: { generationIdsCount: generationIds.length },
    88→      cause: variantCountsError,
    89→    });
    90→  }
    91→
    92→  if (variantCountsData) {
    93→    for (const item of variantCountsData as Array<{ generation_id: string; viewed_at: string | null }>) {
    94→      const genId = item.generation_id;
    95→      derivedCounts[genId] = (derivedCounts[genId] || 0) + 1;
    96→      if (item.viewed_at === null) {
    97→        hasUnviewedVariants[genId] = true;
    98→        unviewedVariantCounts[genId] = (unviewedVariantCounts[genId] || 0) + 1;
    99→      }
   100→    }
   101→  }
   102→
   103→  return { derivedCounts, hasUnviewedVariants, unviewedVariantCounts };
   104→}
   105→
   106→/**
   107→ * Fail-open variant of calculateDerivedCounts for non-critical UI surfaces.
   108→ * Keeps badge rendering resilient when counts query intermittently fails.

   110→export async function calculateDerivedCountsSafe(

   115→  } catch (error) {
   116→    normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'generationTransformers.calculateDerivedCountsSafe', showToast: false });

   156→  name?: string | null;
   157→  derivedCount?: number; // Number of generations/variants based on this one
   158→  hasUnviewedVariants?: boolean; // Whether any variants have viewed_at === null (for NEW badge)
   159→  unviewedVariantCount?: number; // Count of unviewed variants
   160→  // Parent/child relationship fields
   161→  is_child?: boolean | null;
   162→  parent_generation_id?: string | null;
   163→  child_order?: number | null;
   164→  // JSONB column mapping shot_id -> array of timeline_frames
   165→  // Each generation can appear multiple times in the same shot (different positions)
   166→  // Example: { "shot_id_123": [120, 420, null] } means 3 entries: at frame 120, 420, and one unpositioned
   167→  shot_data?: Record<string, (number | null)[]>;
   168→}
   169→
   170→/**
   171→ * Raw shot_generation record from database (before transformation)
   172→ */
   173→export interface RawShotGeneration {
   174→  id: string;
   175→  shot_id: string;
   176→  generation_id: string;
   177→  timeline_frame: number | null;
   178→  metadata?: Record<string, unknown> | null;
   179→  created_at?: string;
   180→  generation?: RawGeneration | RawGeneration[] | null;
   181→  generations?: RawGeneration | RawGeneration[] | null;
   182→}
   183→
   184→/**
   185→ * Options for transformation customization
   186→ */
   187→interface TransformOptions {
   188→  /** Shot image entry ID (from shot_generations table) */
   189→  shotImageEntryId?: string;
   190→  /** Timeline frame position */
   191→  timeline_frame?: number | null;
   192→  /** Additional metadata to merge */
   193→  metadata?: Record<string, unknown> | null;
   194→  /** Shot ID for filtering */
   195→  shotId?: string;
   196→  /** Whether to include verbose logging */
   197→  verbose?: boolean;
   198→}
   199→
   200→/**
   201→ * Extract prompt from various nested param structures
   202→ */
   203→function extractPrompt(params: Record<string, unknown> | null | undefined): string {
   204→  if (!params) return 'No prompt';
   205→
   206→  const originalParams = params.originalParams as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
   207→  const orchestratorDetails = originalParams?.orchestrator_details as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
   208→  const metadataBlock = params.metadata as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
   209→
   210→  return (
   211→    (orchestratorDetails?.prompt as string) ||
   212→    (params.prompt as string) ||
   213→    (metadataBlock?.prompt as string) ||
   214→    'No prompt'
   215→  );
   216→}
   217→
   218→/**
   219→ * Extract thumbnail URL with fallback logic
   220→ * Handles special case for travel-between-images videos where thumbnail might be in params
   221→ */
   222→function extractThumbnailUrl(item: RawGeneration, mainUrl: string): string {
   223→  // Start with database thumbnail_url field
   224→  let thumbnailUrl = item.thumbnail_url;
   225→  const toolType = item.params?.tool_type;
   226→  
   227→  // If no thumbnail in database, check params for travel-between-images videos
   228→  if (!thumbnailUrl && isToolId(toolType) && toolType === TOOL_IDS.TRAVEL_BETWEEN_IMAGES) {
   229→    const originalParams = item.params?.originalParams as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
   230→    const orchestratorDetails = originalParams?.orchestrator_details as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
   231→    const fullPayload = item.params?.full_orchestrator_payload as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
   232→    const originalFullPayload = originalParams?.full_orchestrator_payload as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
   233→
   234→    thumbnailUrl =
   235→      (item.params?.thumbnailUrl as string) ||
   236→      (orchestratorDetails?.thumbnail_url as string) ||
   237→      (fullPayload?.thumbnail_url as string) ||
   238→      (originalFullPayload?.thumbnail_url as string);
   239→  }
   240→  
   241→  // Final fallback to main URL
   242→  return thumbnailUrl || mainUrl;
   243→}
   244→
   245→/**
   246→ * Normalize timeline_frame to position (divide by 50)
   247→ */
   248→function normalizePosition(timelineFrame: number | null | undefined): number | null {
   249→  if (timelineFrame === null || timelineFrame === undefined) return null;
   250→  return Math.floor(timelineFrame / 50);
   251→}
   252→
   253→/**
   254→ * Transform a raw generation record from database to UI format
   255→ * 
   256→ * This is the MAIN transformation function used by most hooks/components
   257→ * 
   258→ * @param item - Raw generation from database query
   259→ * @param options - Optional customization (shot context, metadata, etc.)
   260→ * @returns Transformed generation ready for UI display
   261→ */
   262→export function transformGeneration(
   263→  item: RawGeneration,
   264→  options: TransformOptions = {}
   265→): GeneratedImageWithMetadata {
   266→  const mainUrl = item.location;
   267→  const thumbnailUrl = extractThumbnailUrl(item, mainUrl);
   268→  const taskIdParse = parseGenerationTaskId(item.tasks);
   269→  const taskId = taskIdParse.taskId;
   270→  const prompt = extractPrompt(item.params);
   271→  
   272→  // Extract content_type from params for proper download file extensions
   273→  // Stored as 'image' or 'video', convert to MIME type
   274→  const storedContentType = item.params?.content_type;
   275→  const isVideo = item.type?.includes('video') || storedContentType === 'video' || false;
   276→  let contentType: string | undefined;
   277→  if (storedContentType === 'video') {
   278→    // Default to mp4 for videos, can be overridden by URL extension
   279→    contentType = 'video/mp4';
   280→  } else if (storedContentType === 'image') {
   281→    // Default to png for images, can be overridden by URL extension  
   282→    contentType = 'image/png';
   283→  }
   284→  
   285→  // Compute stable URL identities for caching/comparison
   286→  // Supabase URLs have rotating tokens but the file path is stable
   287→  const urlIdentity = stripQueryParameters(mainUrl);
   288→  const thumbUrlIdentity = stripQueryParameters(thumbnailUrl);
   289→
   290→  // Base transformation - fields common to all generations
   291→  const baseItem: GeneratedImageWithMetadata = {
   292→    id: item.id,
   293→    url: mainUrl,
   294→    thumbUrl: thumbnailUrl,
   295→    urlIdentity,
   296→    thumbUrlIdentity,
   297→    prompt,
   298→    metadata: {
   299→      ...(item.params || {}),
   300→      taskId, // Include task ID in metadata for MediaGalleryItem
   301→      taskIdStatus: taskIdParse.status, // Surface parse health to avoid silent shape drift
   302→      based_on: item.based_on, // Include based_on for lineage tracking
   303→      ...(options.metadata || {}), // Merge any additional metadata
   304→    },
   305→    createdAt: item.created_at,
   306→    updatedAt: item.updated_at,
   307→    isVideo,
   308→    contentType, // For proper download file extensions
   309→    starred: item.starred || false,
   310→    based_on: item.based_on, // Top level for easy access
   311→    position: null, // Will be set if shot context provided
   312→    timeline_frame: null, // Will be set if shot context provided
   313→    name: item.name || (item.params?.name as string | undefined) || undefined,
   314→    derivedCount: item.derivedCount || 0, // Number of generations/variants based on this one
   315→    hasUnviewedVariants: item.hasUnviewedVariants || false, // For NEW badge display
   316→    unviewedVariantCount: item.unviewedVariantCount || 0, // Count for tooltip
   317→    // Parent/child relationship fields
   318→    is_child: item.is_child ?? undefined,
   319→    parent_generation_id: item.parent_generation_id ?? undefined,
   320→    child_order: item.child_order ?? undefined,
   321→  };
   322→
   323→  // Normalize JSONB shot_data into a flat association list.
   324→  const shotGenerations = expandShotData(item.shot_data as Record<string, unknown> | null | undefined);
   325→  
   326→  // If shot context is provided via options, use it
   327→  if (options.shotImageEntryId || options.timeline_frame !== undefined) {
   328→    return {
   329→      ...baseItem,
   330→      shotImageEntryId: options.shotImageEntryId,
   331→      timeline_frame: options.timeline_frame ?? null,
   332→      position: normalizePosition(options.timeline_frame),
   333→    };
   334→  }
   335→
   336→  // Otherwise, process shot associations from query data
   337→  if (shotGenerations.length > 0) {
   338→    // Single shot optimization
   339→    if (shotGenerations.length === 1) {
   340→      const singleShot = shotGenerations[0];
   341→      return {
   342→        ...baseItem,
   343→        shot_id: singleShot.shot_id,
   344→        position: normalizePosition(singleShot.timeline_frame),
   345→        timeline_frame: singleShot.timeline_frame,
   346→      };
   347→    }
   348→    
   349→    // Multiple shots: include all associations
   350→    const allAssociations = shotGenerations.map(shotGen => ({
   351→      shot_id: shotGen.shot_id,
   352→      timeline_frame: shotGen.timeline_frame,
   353→      position: normalizePosition(shotGen.timeline_frame),
   354→    }));
   355→    
   356→    // When filtering by specific shot, use that shot as primary
   357→    let primaryShot = shotGenerations[0];
   358→    if (options.shotId) {
   359→      const matchingShot = shotGenerations.find(shotGen => shotGen.shot_id === options.shotId);
   360→      if (matchingShot) {
   361→        primaryShot = matchingShot;
   362→      }
   363→    }
   364→
   365→    return {
   366→      ...baseItem,
   367→      shot_id: primaryShot.shot_id,
   368→      position: normalizePosition(primaryShot.timeline_frame),
   369→      timeline_frame: primaryShot.timeline_frame,
   370→      all_shot_associations: allAssociations,
   371→    };
   372→  }
   373→  
   374→  return baseItem;
   375→}
   376→
   377→/**
   378→ * Transform for Timeline component's specific needs
   379→ * Maps to GenerationRow format expected by Timeline
   380→ */
   381→export function transformForTimeline(
   382→  shotGen: RawShotGeneration
   383→): GenerationRow & { timeline_frame?: number } {
   384→  const gen = shotGen.generation || shotGen.generations;
   385→  const genData = Array.isArray(gen) ? gen[0] : gen;
   386→  
   387→  if (!genData) {
   388→    return {
   389→      // PRIMARY IDs: id = shot_generations.id (unique per entry), generation_id = actual generation
   390→      id: shotGen.id,
   391→      generation_id: shotGen.generation_id,
   392→      // Deprecated (backwards compat)
   393→      shotImageEntryId: shotGen.id,
   394→      timeline_frame: shotGen.timeline_frame ?? undefined,
   395→    };
   396→  }
   397→  
   398→  return {
   399→    // PRIMARY IDs: id = shot_generations.id (unique per entry), generation_id = actual generation
   400→    id: shotGen.id,
   401→    generation_id: shotGen.generation_id,
   402→    // Deprecated (backwards compat)
   403→    shotImageEntryId: shotGen.id,
   404→    imageUrl: genData.location,
   405→    thumbUrl: genData.location,
   406→    location: genData.location,
   407→    type: genData.type ?? undefined,
   408→    createdAt: genData.created_at,
   409→    timeline_frame: shotGen.timeline_frame ?? undefined,
   410→    metadata: (shotGen.metadata as GenerationMetadata | undefined) ?? undefined,
   411→    starred: genData.starred ?? false,
   412→    based_on: genData.based_on ?? undefined,
   413→    derivedCount: genData.derivedCount ?? 0,
   414→  };
   415→}
   416→
   417→/**
   418→ * Detect if a URL points to a video based on file extension.
   419→ * Used for variants which lack a `type` column.
   420→ */
   421→function isVideoUrl(url: string | null | undefined): boolean {
   422→  if (!url) return false;
   423→  const videoExtensions = ['.mp4', '.webm', '.mov', '.avi', '.mkv'];
   424→  return videoExtensions.some(ext => url.toLowerCase().includes(ext));
   425→}
   426→
   427→/**
   428→ * Transform a raw variant record from generation_variants table to UI format.
   429→ *
   430→ * Mirrors `transformGeneration` but for variants, which have a different
   431→ * schema (no `type` column, different metadata shape).
   432→ *
   433→ * @param variant - Raw variant from database query
   434→ * @param options - Optional overrides (e.g. toolType fallback)
   435→ * @returns Transformed variant ready for UI display
   436→ */
   437→export function transformVariant(
   438→  variant: RawVariant,
   439→  options?: { toolType?: string }
   440→): GeneratedImageWithMetadata {
   441→  const isVideo = isVideoUrl(variant.location);
   442→  const variantParams = (variant.params ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
   443→  const storedContentType = variantParams.content_type as string | undefined;
   444→
   445→  let contentType: string | undefined;
   446→  if (storedContentType === 'video' || isVideo) {
   447→    contentType = 'video/mp4';
   448→  } else {
   449→    contentType = 'image/png';
   450→  }
   451→
   452→  return {
   453→    id: variant.id,
   454→    url: variant.location,
   455→    thumbUrl: variant.thumbnail_url || variant.location,
   456→    isVideo,
   457→    contentType,
   458→    createdAt: variant.created_at,
   459→    starred: false, // Variants don't have starred flag
   460→    metadata: {
   461→      prompt: variantParams.prompt as string | undefined,
   462→      variant_type: variant.variant_type,
   463→      name: variant.name,
   464→      generation_id: variant.generation_id,
   465→      tool_type: (variantParams.tool_type as string) || options?.toolType,
   466→      created_from: variantParams.created_from as string | undefined,
   467→      source_task_id: variantParams.source_task_id as string | undefined,
   468→      content_type: storedContentType,
   469→    },
   470→    shot_id: undefined,
   471→    position: undefined,
   472→    all_shot_associations: undefined,
   473→  };
   474→}
   475→

1→/**
     2→ * Shared utilities for extracting data from task params
     3→ *
     4→ * This module provides a single source of truth for parsing task parameters,
     5→ * ensuring consistent behavior across TasksPane, MediaLightbox, and other components.

     7→import { buildTaskPayloadSnapshot } from './tasks/taskPayloadSnapshot';

     9→
    10→/**
    11→ * Parse task params, handling both string and object formats
    12→ */
    13→export function parseTaskParams(params: string | Record<string, unknown> | null | undefined): Record<string, unknown> {
    14→  if (!params) return {};
    15→  if (typeof params === 'string') {
    16→    try {
    17→      const parsed = JSON.parse(params);
    18→      return asRecord(parsed) ?? {};
    19→    } catch {
    20→      return {};
    21→    }
    22→  }
    23→  return asRecord(params) ?? {};
    24→}
    25→
    26→/**
    27→ * Derive input images from task params
    28→ *
    29→ * For segment tasks (has segment_index): Only returns segment-specific images
    30→ * For orchestrated tasks: Returns all images from orchestrator
    31→ * For other tasks: Checks various image field locations
    32→ *
    33→ * @param parsedParams - Already-parsed task params object
    34→ * @returns Array of image URLs
    35→ */
    36→export function deriveInputImages(parsedParams: Record<string, unknown>): string[] {
    37→  const params = parsedParams;
    38→  if (isTravelTaskParams(params)) {
    39→    const travelImages = deriveTravelInputImages(params);
    40→    if (travelImages.length > 0) {
    41→      return travelImages;
    42→    }
    43→  }
    44→
    45→  const orchestratorDetails = asRecord(params.orchestrator_details);
    46→  const orchestratorPayload = asRecord(params.full_orchestrator_payload);
    47→  const segmentParams = asRecord(params.individual_segment_params);
    48→
    49→  // Check if this is a segment task (individual segment of a larger generation)
    50→  const isSegmentTask = params?.segment_index !== undefined;
    51→
    52→  // For segment tasks, ONLY use segment-specific images (not the full orchestrator list)

    77→  if (typeof params?.image === 'string') urls.push(params.image);
    78→  if (typeof params?.input_image === 'string') urls.push(params.input_image);
    79→  if (typeof params?.init_image === 'string') urls.push(params.init_image);
    80→  if (typeof params?.control_image === 'string') urls.push(params.control_image);
    81→  if (Array.isArray(params?.images)) urls.push(...params.images.filter((x): x is string => typeof x === 'string'));
    82→  if (Array.isArray(params?.input_images)) urls.push(...params.input_images.filter((x): x is string => typeof x === 'string'));
    83→  if (typeof params?.mask_url === 'string') urls.push(params.mask_url);
    84→
    85→  // Travel/video task paths - orchestrator details contain all images for full timeline
    86→  if (Array.isArray(orchestratorDetails?.input_image_paths_resolved)) {
    87→    urls.push(...orchestratorDetails.input_image_paths_resolved.filter((x): x is string => typeof x === 'string'));
    88→  } else if (Array.isArray(orchestratorPayload?.input_image_paths_resolved)) {
    89→    urls.push(...orchestratorPayload.input_image_paths_resolved.filter((x): x is string => typeof x === 'string'));
    90→  } else if (Array.isArray(params?.input_image_paths_resolved)) {
    91→    urls.push(...params.input_image_paths_resolved.filter((x): x is string => typeof x === 'string'));
    92→  }

    94→  return Array.from(new Set(urls.filter(Boolean)));

    97→/**
    98→ * Extract prompt from task params
    99→ *
   100→ * For segment tasks: Checks individual_segment_params first
   101→ * For orchestrated tasks: Checks orchestrator details
   102→ * For other tasks: Falls back to top-level prompt

   105→ * as enhanced prompts contain the AI-improved version of the user's prompt.
   106→ *
   107→ * @param parsedParams - Already-parsed task params object
   108→ * @returns The prompt string or null
   109→ */
   110→export function derivePrompt(parsedParams: Record<string, unknown>): string | null {
   111→  const params = parsedParams;
   112→  if (isTravelTaskParams(params)) {
   113→    return deriveTravelPrompt(params);

   116→  const orchestratorDetails = asRecord(params.orchestrator_details);

   118→  const segmentParams = asRecord(params.individual_segment_params);
   119→  const segmentIndex = toIntegerOrNull(params.segment_index);

   127→    const enhancedFromOrchestratorPayload = asStringArray(orchestratorPayload?.enhanced_prompts_expanded);
   128→    const enhancedPrompt = pickFirstString(
   129→      segmentParams?.enhanced_prompt,
   130→      params.enhanced_prompt,
   131→      segmentIndex === null ? undefined : enhancedFromOrchestratorDetails?.[segmentIndex],
   132→      segmentIndex === null ? undefined : enhancedFromOrchestratorPayload?.[segmentIndex],
   133→    );
   134→    if (enhancedPrompt) return enhancedPrompt;
   135→
   136→    // Fall back to base prompt
   137→    return (
   138→      pickFirstString(
   139→        segmentParams?.base_prompt,
   140→        params.base_prompt,
   141→        params.prompt,
   142→        orchestratorDetails?.base_prompt,
   143→      ) ?? null
   144→    );
   145→  }
   146→
   147→  // For full timeline/orchestrated tasks
   148→  // The global base_prompt is what the user typed in the prompt field.
   149→  // Per-pair overrides (base_prompts_expanded) are segment-specific and shouldn't
   150→  // be shown as the task-level prompt — they're misleading when the user explicitly
   151→  // cleared the global prompt.
   152→  const enhancedFromOrchestratorDetails = asStringArray(orchestratorDetails?.enhanced_prompts_expanded);
   153→  const enhancedFromOrchestratorPayload = asStringArray(orchestratorPayload?.enhanced_prompts_expanded);
   154→  return (
   155→    pickFirstString(
   156→      orchestratorDetails?.base_prompt,
   157→      orchestratorPayload?.base_prompt,
   158→      params.base_prompt,
   159→      params.prompt,
   160→      // Fall back to enhanced prompts (AI-improved) but NOT base_prompts_expanded
   161→      // which are per-pair overrides, not task-level prompts.
   162→      enhancedFromOrchestratorDetails?.[0],
   163→      enhancedFromOrchestratorPayload?.[0],
   164→    ) ?? null
   165→  );
   166→}

   171→export function isImageEditTaskType(taskType: string | undefined): boolean {

   198→/**

   207→/**
   208→ * Extract LoRAs from task params (checks multiple locations)

   210→export function extractLoras(parsedParams: Record<string, unknown>): LoraInfo[] {
   211→  const params = parsedParams;
   212→  const orchestratorDetails = asRecord(params.orchestrator_details);
   213→  const orchestratorPayload = asRecord(params.full_orchestrator_payload);
   214→
   215→  // Check for array format (image edit tasks use this)
   216→  const lorasArray = params.loras || orchestratorDetails?.loras || orchestratorPayload?.loras;
   217→  if (Array.isArray(lorasArray) && lorasArray.length > 0) {

   220→        const loraRecord = asRecord(lora);

   222→        const url = asString(loraRecord.url) ?? '';
   223→        const parsedStrength = toFiniteNumber(loraRecord.strength) ?? toFiniteNumber(loraRecord.multiplier) ?? 1;
   224→        return {
   225→          url,
   226→          strength: parsedStrength,
   227→          displayName: extractLoraDisplayName(url),

   229→      })

   231→  }
   232→

   234→  const additionalLoras = params.additional_loras || orchestratorDetails?.additional_loras || orchestratorPayload?.additional_loras;
   235→  if (additionalLoras && typeof additionalLoras === 'object' && Object.keys(additionalLoras as Record<string, unknown>).length > 0) {
   236→    return Object.entries(additionalLoras as Record<string, unknown>).map(([url, strength]) => ({
   237→      url,
   238→      strength: toFiniteNumber(strength) ?? 1,
   239→      displayName: extractLoraDisplayName(url),
   240→    }));
   241→  }
   242→
   243→  return [];
   244→}
   245→
   246→function extractLoraDisplayName(url: string): string {

   248→  return fileName.replace(/\.(safetensors|ckpt|pt)$/i, '').replace(/_/g, ' ');
   249→}

   251→const TRAVEL_SEGMENT_IMAGE_SOURCE_ORDER: TravelPayloadSource[] = [

   275→function dedupeTruthyStrings(values: Array<string | undefined>): string[] {

   279→function isTravelTaskParams(params: Record<string, unknown>): boolean {

   292→function deriveTravelInputImages(params: Record<string, unknown>): string[] {

   311→    reader.pickStringArray('image_urls', TRAVEL_TIMELINE_IMAGE_SOURCE_ORDER),
   312→  ];
   313→  for (const candidate of timelineSources) {

   322→function deriveTravelPrompt(params: Record<string, unknown>): string | null {
   323→  const snapshot = buildTaskPayloadSnapshot(params);
   324→  const reader = createTravelPayloadReader(snapshot);

   330→      'orchestratorDetails',

   334→    const enhancedPrompt = pickFirstString(

   350→  return (

   353→      reader.pickString('base_prompt', TRAVEL_PROMPT_SOURCE_ORDER),
   354→      reader.pickString('enhanced_prompt', TRAVEL_PROMPT_SOURCE_ORDER),
   355→    ) ?? null
   356→  );
   357→}

   359→function asRecord(value: unknown): Record<string, unknown> | null {
   360→  if (!value || typeof value !== 'object' || Array.isArray(value)) return null;
   361→  return value as Record<string, unknown>;
   362→}
   363→
   364→function asString(value: unknown): string | null {
   365→  return typeof value === 'string' ? value : null;
   366→}
   367→
   368→function asStringArray(value: unknown): string[] | null {
   369→  if (!Array.isArray(value)) return null;
   370→  return value.filter((item): item is string => typeof item === 'string');
   371→}
   372→
   373→function toIntegerOrNull(value: unknown): number | null {
   374→  const numeric = toFiniteNumber(value);
   375→  if (numeric === null || !Number.isInteger(numeric)) return null;
   376→  return numeric;
   377→}
   378→
   379→function toFiniteNumber(value: unknown): number | null {
   380→  const numeric = typeof value === 'number' ? value : Number(value);
   381→  return Number.isFinite(numeric) ? numeric : null;
   382→}
   383→
   384→function pickFirstString(...values: unknown[]): string | null {
   385→  for (const value of values) {
   386→    const text = asString(value);
   387→    if (text) return text;
   388→  }
   389→  return null;
   390→}

1→/**
     2→ * Standardized error types for the application

     8→/**

    11→export class AppError extends Error {

    13→  public readonly showToast: boolean;

    35→/**

    39→export class NetworkError extends AppError {

    50→      context?: Record<string, unknown>;
    51→      cause?: Error;

    55→    this.name = 'NetworkError';
    56→    this.isOffline = options?.isOffline ?? !navigator.onLine;
    57→    this.isTimeout = options?.isTimeout ?? false;

    59→
    60→  static fromError(error: Error, context?: Record<string, unknown>): NetworkError {

    67→    } else if (isTimeout) {

    69→    }
    70→
    71→    return new NetworkError(message, { isOffline, isTimeout, context, cause: error });

   171→export function isAppError(error: unknown): error is AppError {

   192→export function categorizeError(error: unknown, context?: Record<string, unknown>): AppError {
   193→  // Already an AppError
   194→  if (isAppError(error)) {

   197→
   198→  // Convert to Error if needed
   199→  const err = error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error));
   200→  const message = err.message.toLowerCase();
   201→

   203→  if (

   205→    message.includes('network') ||
   206→    message.includes('fetch') ||
   207→    message.includes('timeout') ||
   208→    message.includes('failed to fetch') ||
   209→    !navigator.onLine

   212→  }
   213→
   214→  // Auth errors

   216→    message.includes('unauthorized') ||
   217→    message.includes('forbidden') ||
   218→    message.includes('not authenticated') ||
   219→    message.includes('authentication required')
   220→  ) {
   221→    return AuthError.fromError(err, context);
   222→  }
   223→
   224→  // Validation errors
   225→  if (

   227→    message.includes('invalid') ||
   228→    message.includes('validation')
   229→  ) {
   230→    return new ValidationError(err.message, { context, cause: err });
   231→  }
   232→
   233→  // Default to generic AppError
   234→  return new AppError(err.message, { context, cause: err });
   235→}

1→/**
     2→ * usePanelModeRestore Hook
     3→ *
     4→ * Handles automatic restoration of edit/info panel mode when media changes.
     5→ * If the user was last in edit mode, automatically re-enters edit mode.
     6→ */
     7→
     8→import { useRef, useEffect } from 'react';
     9→
    10→interface UsePanelModeRestoreProps {
    11→  /** Current media ID for tracking changes */
    12→  mediaId: string;
    13→  /** Persisted panel mode from last used settings */
    14→  persistedPanelMode: 'edit' | 'info' | null | undefined;
    15→  /** Whether currently in special edit mode (image) */
    16→  isSpecialEditMode: boolean;
    17→  /** Whether currently in video edit mode */
    18→  isInVideoEditMode: boolean;
    19→  /** Whether initial video trim mode was requested */
    20→  initialVideoTrimMode?: boolean;
    21→  /** Whether initial edit active was requested (explicit mode set, skip restore) */
    22→  initialEditActive?: boolean;
    23→}
    24→
    25→interface UseVideoPanelModeRestoreProps extends UsePanelModeRestoreProps {
    26→  isVideo: true;
    27→  /** Handler to enter video edit mode */
    28→  handleEnterVideoEditMode: () => void;
    29→}
    30→
    31→interface UseImagePanelModeRestoreProps extends UsePanelModeRestoreProps {
    32→  isVideo: false;
    33→  /** Handler to enter magic edit mode (image) */
    34→  handleEnterMagicEditMode: () => void;
    35→}
    36→
    37→interface UsePanelModeRestoreReturn {
    38→  /** Whether panel mode has been restored for current media */
    39→  hasRestoredPanelMode: boolean;
    40→}
    41→
    42→/**
    43→ * Automatically restores the last used panel mode (edit/info) when opening a media item.
    44→ * Prevents loops by tracking restoration per-media and respecting explicit modes.
    45→ */
    46→export function usePanelModeRestore({
    47→  mediaId,
    48→  persistedPanelMode,
    49→  isVideo,
    50→  isSpecialEditMode,
    51→  isInVideoEditMode,
    52→  initialVideoTrimMode,
    53→  initialEditActive,
    54→  ...modeHandlers
    55→}: UseVideoPanelModeRestoreProps | UseImagePanelModeRestoreProps): UsePanelModeRestoreReturn {
    56→  const hasRestoredPanelModeRef = useRef(false);
    57→  const enterEditMode = isVideo
    58→    ? modeHandlers.handleEnterVideoEditMode
    59→    : modeHandlers.handleEnterMagicEditMode;
    60→
    61→  // Main restoration effect
    62→  useEffect(() => {
    63→
    64→    // Only restore once per media (prevent loops)
    65→    if (hasRestoredPanelModeRef.current) {
    66→      return;
    67→    }
    68→
    69→    // Don't restore if initialVideoTrimMode or initialEditActive is set (explicit modes take precedence)
    70→    if (initialVideoTrimMode || initialEditActive) {
    71→      hasRestoredPanelModeRef.current = true;
    72→      return;
    73→    }
    74→
    75→    // Don't restore if already in edit mode
    76→    if (isSpecialEditMode || isInVideoEditMode) {
    77→      hasRestoredPanelModeRef.current = true;
    78→      return;
    79→    }
    80→
    81→    if (persistedPanelMode === 'edit') {
    82→      hasRestoredPanelModeRef.current = true;
    83→      setTimeout(() => enterEditMode(), 0);
    84→    } else {
    85→      hasRestoredPanelModeRef.current = true;
    86→    }
    87→  }, [
    88→    persistedPanelMode,
    89→    enterEditMode,
    90→    initialVideoTrimMode,
    91→    initialEditActive,
    92→    isSpecialEditMode,
    93→    isInVideoEditMode,
    94→  ]);
    95→
    96→  // Reset restore flag when media changes
    97→  useEffect(() => {
    98→    hasRestoredPanelModeRef.current = false;
    99→  }, [mediaId]);
   100→
   101→  return {
   102→    hasRestoredPanelMode: hasRestoredPanelModeRef.current,
   103→  };
   104→}
   105→

   290→        );

1→/**
     2→ * NetworkStatusManager - Centralized network status management
     3→ *
     4→ * Provides a single source of truth for online/offline status and connection type.
     5→ * Integrates with reconnect and polling flows for network-aware behavior.
     6→ */
     7→
     8→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
     9→import type { NavigatorWithDeviceInfo } from '@/types/browser-extensions';
    10→
    11→interface NetworkStatus {
    12→  isOnline: boolean;
    13→  effectiveType?: '2g' | '3g' | '4g' | 'slow-2g';
    14→  lastTransitionAt: number;
    15→  previousOnlineStatus: boolean;
    16→}
    17→
    18→type NetworkEventType = 'online' | 'offline' | 'connection-change';
    19→
    20→interface NetworkStatusSubscriber {
    21→  (status: NetworkStatus, eventType: NetworkEventType, event?: Event): void;
    22→}
    23→
    24→export class NetworkStatusManager {
    25→  private status: NetworkStatus;
    26→  private subscribers: Set<NetworkStatusSubscriber> = new Set();
    27→  private initialized = false;
    28→
    29→  constructor() {
    30→    const nav = navigator as NavigatorWithDeviceInfo;
    31→    this.status = {
    32→      isOnline: navigator.onLine,
    33→      effectiveType: nav.connection?.effectiveType,
    34→      lastTransitionAt: Date.now(),
    35→      previousOnlineStatus: navigator.onLine,
    36→    };
    37→  }
    38→
    39→  initialize(): void {
    40→    if (this.initialized) return;
    41→
    42→    const handleOnline = (event: Event) => this.handleNetworkChange('online', event);
    43→    const handleOffline = (event: Event) => this.handleNetworkChange('offline', event);
    44→    const handleConnectionChange = (event: Event) => this.handleNetworkChange('connection-change', event);
    45→
    46→    window.addEventListener('online', handleOnline);
    47→    window.addEventListener('offline', handleOffline);
    48→
    49→    const nav = navigator as NavigatorWithDeviceInfo;
    50→    if (nav.connection) {
    51→      nav.connection.addEventListener('change', handleConnectionChange);
    52→    }
    53→
    54→    this.initialized = true;
    55→  }
    56→
    57→  getStatus(): NetworkStatus {
    58→    return { ...this.status };
    59→  }
    60→
    61→  subscribe(callback: NetworkStatusSubscriber): () => void {
    62→    this.subscribers.add(callback);
    63→    return () => this.subscribers.delete(callback);
    64→  }
    65→
    66→  isSlowConnection(): boolean {
    67→    return this.status.effectiveType === '2g' || this.status.effectiveType === 'slow-2g';
    68→  }
    69→
    70→  getRecommendedIntervals(): { fast: number; normal: number; slow: number } {
    71→    if (!this.status.isOnline) {
    72→      return { fast: 60000, normal: 120000, slow: 300000 };
    73→    }
    74→
    75→    if (this.isSlowConnection()) {
    76→      return { fast: 30000, normal: 60000, slow: 180000 };
    77→    }
    78→
    79→    return { fast: 10000, normal: 30000, slow: 60000 };
    80→  }
    81→
    82→  private handleNetworkChange(eventType: NetworkEventType, event?: Event): void {
    83→    const now = Date.now();
    84→    const newIsOnline = navigator.onLine;
    85→    const nav = navigator as NavigatorWithDeviceInfo;
    86→    const newEffectiveType = nav.connection?.effectiveType;
    87→
    88→    const onlineStatusChanged = newIsOnline !== this.status.isOnline;
    89→    const connectionChanged = newEffectiveType !== this.status.effectiveType;
    90→
    91→    if (!onlineStatusChanged && !connectionChanged) {
    92→      return;
    93→    }
    94→
    95→    const previousStatus = { ...this.status };
    96→    this.status = {
    97→      isOnline: newIsOnline,
    98→      effectiveType: newEffectiveType,
    99→      lastTransitionAt: now,
   100→      previousOnlineStatus: previousStatus.isOnline,
   101→    };
   102→
   103→    this.subscribers.forEach((callback) => {
   104→      try {
   105→        callback(this.status, eventType, event);
   106→      } catch (error) {
   107→        normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'NetworkStatusManager', showToast: false });
   108→      }
   109→    });
   110→  }
   111→}
   112→
   113→let networkStatusManager: NetworkStatusManager;
   114→
   115→export function getNetworkStatusManager(): NetworkStatusManager {
   116→  if (!networkStatusManager) {
   117→    networkStatusManager = new NetworkStatusManager();
   118→    networkStatusManager.initialize();
   119→
   120→    if (import.meta.env.DEV && typeof window !== 'undefined') {
   121→      void import('@/shared/services/network/networkStatusDebug').then(({ installNetworkStatusDebugHelpers }) => {
   122→        installNetworkStatusDebugHelpers(networkStatusManager);
   123→      });
   124→    }
   125→  }
   126→
   127→  return networkStatusManager;
   128→}

1→import { useState, useCallback, useRef, useEffect } from 'react';
     2→
     3→interface UseOperationTrackingResult {
     4→  /** Whether a shot operation is currently in progress (suppresses query refetch) */
     5→  isShotOperationInProgress: boolean;
     6→  /** Whether a drag operation is in progress in the timeline */
     7→  isDraggingInTimeline: boolean;
     8→  /** Set the dragging state */
     9→  setIsDraggingInTimeline: (dragging: boolean) => void;
    10→  /** Signal that a shot operation has occurred (temporarily disables refetch) */
    11→  signalShotOperation: () => void;
    12→}
    13→
    14→/**
    15→ * Tracks mutation operations to prevent query race conditions.
    16→ *
    17→ * When a shot mutation completes, we briefly disable query refetch to:
    18→ * - Prevent "AbortError" from cancelled queries
    19→ * - Allow timeline position updates to complete without interference
    20→ * - Avoid UI flicker from rapid state changes
    21→ *
    22→ * Also tracks drag state to suppress realtime invalidations during drag.
    23→ */
    24→export function useOperationTracking(): UseOperationTrackingResult {
    25→  const [isShotOperationInProgress, setIsShotOperationInProgress] = useState(false);
    26→  const [isDraggingInTimeline, setIsDraggingInTimeline] = useState(false);
    27→  const operationTimeoutRef = useRef<NodeJS.Timeout | null>(null);
    28→
    29→  // Helper to signal that a shot operation has occurred
    30→  const signalShotOperation = useCallback(() => {
    31→
    32→    // Clear any existing timeout
    33→    if (operationTimeoutRef.current) {
    34→      clearTimeout(operationTimeoutRef.current);
    35→    }
    36→
    37→    // Set flag to disable query
    38→    setIsShotOperationInProgress(true);
    39→
    40→    // Clear flag after timeline has had time to complete position updates
    41→    // 100ms is enough for React's batch updates + timeline's immediate state updates
    42→    operationTimeoutRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
    43→      setIsShotOperationInProgress(false);
    44→      operationTimeoutRef.current = null;
    45→    }, 100);
    46→  }, []);
    47→
    48→  // Cleanup timeout on unmount
    49→  useEffect(() => {
    50→    return () => {
    51→      if (operationTimeoutRef.current) {
    52→        clearTimeout(operationTimeoutRef.current);
    53→      }
    54→    };
    55→  }, []);
    56→
    57→  return {
    58→    isShotOperationInProgress,
    59→    isDraggingInTimeline,
    60→    setIsDraggingInTimeline,
    61→    signalShotOperation,
    62→  };
    63→}
    64→

   176→  userLoras: PathLoraConfig[] = []
   177→): PhaseConfig {
   178→  return buildPhaseConfigWithLoras(userLoras);
   179→}
   180→
   181→/**
   182→ * Builds the ordered clip sequence from the provided parameters.
   183→ */
   184→function buildClipSequenceFromSource(source: JoinClipsClipSource): JoinClipDescriptor[] {
   185→  return source.clips.map((clip) => ({
   186→    url: clip.url,
   187→    ...(clip.name ? { name: clip.name } : {}),
   188→  }));
   189→}
   190→
   191→/**
   192→ * Validates join clips task parameters and returns the normalized clip sequence
   193→ * 
   194→ * @param params - Parameters to validate
   195→ * @throws TaskValidationError if validation fails
   196→ */
   197→function normalizeJoinClipsParams(params: CanonicalJoinClipsTaskInput): NormalizedJoinClipsParams {
   198→  validateRequiredFields(params, [
   199→    'project_id'
   200→  ]);
   201→
   202→  const clipSource = params.clip_source;
   203→  const clipSequence = buildClipSequenceFromSource(clipSource);
   204→
   205→  if (clipSequence.length < 2) {
   206→    throw new TaskValidationError("At least two clips are required to create a join", 'clips');
   207→  }
   208→
   209→  clipSequence.forEach((clip, index) => {
   210→    try {
   211→      validateNonEmptyString(clip.url, `clips[${index}]`, `Clip ${index + 1} URL`);
   212→    } catch {
   213→      throw new TaskValidationError(`Clip at position ${index} is missing a URL`, 'clips');
   214→    }
   215→  });
   216→
   217→  const joinsCount = clipSequence.length - 1;
   218→
   219→  if (params.per_join_settings && params.per_join_settings.length > joinsCount) {
   220→    throw new TaskValidationError(
   221→      "per_join_settings length cannot exceed the number of joins",
   222→      'per_join_settings'
   223→    );
   224→  }
   225→
   226→  const videoEdit = params.video_edit;
   227→  if (params.mode === 'video_edit' && !videoEdit) {
   228→    throw new TaskValidationError(
   229→      "video_edit config is required when mode is video_edit",
   230→      'mode',
   231→    );
   232→  }
   233→  if (videoEdit && !videoEdit.source_video_url) {
   234→    throw new TaskValidationError(
   235→      "video_edit.source_video_url is required when video_edit config is provided",
   236→      'video_edit',
   237→    );
   238→  }
   239→  if (params.mode !== 'video_edit' && videoEdit) {
   240→    throw new TaskValidationError(
   241→      "video_edit config can only be provided when mode is video_edit",
   242→      'mode',
   243→    );
   244→  }
   245→  if (params.mode === 'multi_clip' && clipSource.kind !== 'clips') {
   246→    throw new TaskValidationError(
   247→      "clip_source.kind must be clips when mode is multi_clip",
   248→      'mode',
   249→    );
   250→  }
   251→
   252→  const joinMode: JoinMode = params.mode === 'video_edit'
   253→    ? 'video_edit_join'
   254→    : 'multi_clip_join';
   255→
   256→  return {
   257→    clipSequence,
   258→    clipSourceKind: clipSource.kind,
   259→    joinMode,
   260→    videoEdit,
   261→  };
   262→}
   263→
   264→/**
   265→ * Builds the orchestrator payload for join clips
   266→ * 
   267→ * @param params - Raw join clips parameters
   268→ * @param clipSequence - Normalized list of clips in order
   269→ * @param runId - Generated run ID
   270→ * @param orchestratorTaskId - Generated orchestrator task ID
   271→ * @returns Processed orchestrator payload
   272→ */
   273→function buildJoinClipsPayload(
   274→  params: CanonicalJoinClipsTaskInput,
   275→  normalized: NormalizedJoinClipsParams,
   276→  runId: string,
   277→  orchestratorTaskId: string
   278→): Record<string, unknown> {
   279→  const clipSequence = normalized.clipSequence;
   280→  // Use provided phase config (advanced mode) or build from LoRAs (basic mode)
   281→  const phaseConfig = params.phase_config || buildJoinClipsPhaseConfig(params.loras || []);
   282→  
   283→  const orchestratorDetails: Record<string, unknown> = {
   284→    orchestrator_task_id: orchestratorTaskId,
   285→    clip_list: clipSequence.map(clip => ({
   286→      url: clip.url,
   287→      ...(clip.name ? { name: clip.name } : {}),
   288→    })),
   289→    run_id: runId,
   290→    shot_id: params.shot_id ?? undefined, // For "Visit Shot" button in TasksPane
   291→    prompt: params.prompt ?? TASK_DEFAULTS.prompt,
   292→    gap_frame_count: params.gap_frame_count ?? TASK_DEFAULTS.gap_frame_count,
   293→    context_frame_count: params.context_frame_count ?? TASK_DEFAULTS.context_frame_count,
   294→    replace_mode: params.replace_mode ?? TASK_DEFAULTS.replace_mode,
   295→    keep_bridging_images: params.keep_bridging_images, // Optional, defaults to undefined (backend handles default)
   296→    enhance_prompt: params.enhance_prompt ?? TASK_DEFAULTS.enhance_prompt,
   297→    model: params.model ?? TASK_DEFAULTS.model,
   298→    num_inference_steps: params.num_inference_steps ?? TASK_DEFAULTS.num_inference_steps,
   299→    guidance_scale: params.guidance_scale ?? TASK_DEFAULTS.guidance_scale,
   300→    seed: params.seed ?? TASK_DEFAULTS.seed,
   301→    negative_prompt: params.negative_prompt ?? TASK_DEFAULTS.negative_prompt,
   302→    priority: params.priority ?? TASK_DEFAULTS.priority,
   303→    parent_generation_id: params.parent_generation_id,
   304→    // UNIFIED: Always include phase_config and advanced_mode for consistent backend processing
   305→    phase_config: phaseConfig,
   306→    advanced_mode: true,
   307→    // Motion settings for UI state restoration
   308→    motion_mode: params.motion_mode ?? TASK_DEFAULTS.motion_mode,
   309→    selected_phase_preset_id: params.selected_phase_preset_id ?? TASK_DEFAULTS.selected_phase_preset_id,
   310→  };
   311→
   312→  assignMappedPayloadFields(orchestratorDetails, params, [
   313→    { from: 'resolution' },
   314→    { from: 'fps' },
   315→    { from: 'use_input_video_resolution' },
   316→    { from: 'use_input_video_fps' },
   317→    { from: 'audio_url' },
   318→  ]);
   319→
   320→  assignMappedPayloadFields(orchestratorDetails, params, [
   321→    {
   322→      from: 'vid2vid_init_strength',
   323→      include: (value) => typeof value === 'number' && value > 0,
   324→    },
   325→  ]);
   326→
   327→  if (params.loop_first_clip) {
   328→    orchestratorDetails.loop_first_clip = true;
   329→  }
   330→
   331→  // Pass based_on for variant creation when looping a clip from "Add to Join"
   332→  if (params.based_on) {
   333→    orchestratorDetails.based_on = params.based_on;
   334→  }
   335→
   336→  // Keep additional_loras for backward compatibility, but LoRAs are now primarily in phase_config
   337→  if (params.loras && params.loras.length > 0) {
   338→    orchestratorDetails.additional_loras = mapPathLorasToStrengthRecord(params.loras);
   339→  }
   340→  
   341→  // Video edit mode - for regenerating portions of a single video
   342→  if (normalized.videoEdit) {
   343→    orchestratorDetails.video_edit_mode = true;
   344→    orchestratorDetails.source_video_url = normalized.videoEdit.source_video_url;
   345→    orchestratorDetails.source_video_fps = normalized.videoEdit.source_video_fps;
   346→    orchestratorDetails.source_video_duration = normalized.videoEdit.source_video_duration;
   347→    orchestratorDetails.source_video_total_frames = normalized.videoEdit.source_video_total_frames;
   348→    orchestratorDetails.portions_to_regenerate = normalized.videoEdit.portions_to_regenerate;
   349→  }
   350→
   351→  const totalJoins = Math.max(clipSequence.length - 1, 0);
   352→  if (totalJoins > 0) {
   353→    const perJoinOverrides: Record<string, unknown>[] = [];
   354→    let hasOverrides = false;
   355→
   356→    for (let index = 0; index < totalJoins; index++) {
   357→      const joinSettings = buildJoinOverrideRecord(params.per_join_settings?.[index]);
   358→
   359→      if (Object.keys(joinSettings).length > 0) {
   360→        hasOverrides = true;
   361→        perJoinOverrides.push(joinSettings);
   362→      } else {
   363→        perJoinOverrides.push({});
   364→      }
   365→    }
   366→
   367→    if (hasOverrides) {
   368→      orchestratorDetails.per_join_settings = perJoinOverrides;
   369→    }
   370→  }
   371→
   372→  const resolutionDisplay = params.resolution
   373→    ? `${params.resolution[0]}x${params.resolution[1]}`
   374→    : undefined;
   375→
   376→  const joinMode = normalized.joinMode;
   377→
   378→  const perJoinOverridesCount = params.per_join_settings?.filter((override) =>
   379→    !!override && Object.keys(override).length > 0
   380→  ).length ?? 0;
   381→
   382→  const familyContract = buildJoinClipsFamilyContract({
   383→    mode: joinMode,
   384→    runId,
   385→    clipUrls: clipSequence.map((clip) => clip.url),
   386→    overridesCount: perJoinOverridesCount,
   387→    hasAudio: Boolean(params.audio_url),
   388→  });
   389→
   390→  const payload = composeTaskFamilyPayload({
   391→    taskFamily: 'join_clips',
   392→    orchestratorDetails,
   393→    orchestrationInput: {
   394→      taskFamily: 'join_clips',
   395→      orchestratorTaskId,
   396→      runId,
   397→      parentGenerationId: params.parent_generation_id,
   398→      shotId: params.shot_id,
   399→      basedOn: params.based_on,
   400→      generationRouting: 'orchestrator',
   401→      siblingLookup: 'run_id',
   402→    },
   403→    taskViewInput: {
   404→      inputImages: clipSequence.map((clip) => clip.url),
   405→      prompt: params.prompt,
   406→      negativePrompt: params.negative_prompt,
   407→      modelName: params.model,
   408→      resolution: resolutionDisplay,
   409→    },
   410→    familyContract,
   411→  });
   412→
   413→  return {
   414→    ...payload,
   415→    parent_generation_id: params.parent_generation_id,
   416→    // Only include tool_type if explicitly passed (Join Clips page passes it, ShotEditor doesn't)
   417→    ...(params.tool_type && { tool_type: params.tool_type }),
   418→  };
   419→}
   420→
   421→/**
   422→ * Creates a join clips task using the unified approach
   423→ * 
   424→ * @param params - Join clips task parameters
   425→ * @returns Promise resolving to the created task
   426→ */
   427→export async function createCanonicalJoinClipsTask(
   428→  params: CanonicalJoinClipsTaskInput,
   429→): Promise<TaskCreationResult> {
   430→  return runTaskCreationPipeline({
   431→    params,
   432→    context: 'JoinClips',
   433→    buildTaskRequest: (requestParams) => {
   434→      const normalized = normalizeJoinClipsParams(requestParams);
   435→      const orchestratorTaskId = generateTaskId("join_clips_orchestrator");
   436→      const runId = requestParams.run_id ?? generateRunId();
   437→      const orchestratorPayload = buildJoinClipsPayload(
   438→        requestParams,
   439→        normalized,
   440→        runId,
   441→        orchestratorTaskId,
   442→      );
   443→
   444→      return composeTaskRequest({
   445→        source: requestParams,
   446→        taskType: 'join_clips_orchestrator',
   447→        params: orchestratorPayload,
   448→      });
   449→    },
   450→  });
   451→}
   452→
   453→// TaskValidationError is used internally - import from taskCreation.ts if needed externally
   454→

    17→ * @returns Whether to show the skeleton (stabilized)
    18→ */
    19→export const useStableSkeletonVisibility = (
    20→  isLoading: boolean,
    21→  hideDelay: number = 120
    22→): boolean => {
    23→  const [showStableSkeleton, setShowStableSkeleton] = useState<boolean>(false);
    24→  const hideTimeoutRef = useRef<number | null>(null);
    25→  const lastLoadingStateRef = useRef<boolean>(false);
    26→  
    27→  useEffect(() => {
    28→    // Only update skeleton state if loading state actually changed
    29→    if (isLoading !== lastLoadingStateRef.current) {
    30→      lastLoadingStateRef.current = isLoading;
    31→      
    32→      if (isLoading) {
    33→        // Immediately show the skeleton when entering loading
    34→        if (hideTimeoutRef.current) {
    35→          window.clearTimeout(hideTimeoutRef.current);
    36→          hideTimeoutRef.current = null;
    37→        }
    38→        setShowStableSkeleton(true);
    39→      } else {
    40→        // Delay hiding slightly to prevent rapid toggle flicker
    41→        hideTimeoutRef.current = window.setTimeout(() => {
    42→          setShowStableSkeleton(false);
    43→          hideTimeoutRef.current = null;
    44→        }, hideDelay);
    45→      }
    46→    }
    47→    
    48→    return () => {
    49→      if (hideTimeoutRef.current) {
    50→        window.clearTimeout(hideTimeoutRef.current);
    51→        hideTimeoutRef.current = null;
    52→      }
    53→    };
    54→  }, [isLoading, hideDelay]);
    55→
    56→  return showStableSkeleton;
    57→};
    58→

1→export type OperationFailurePolicy = 'fail_closed' | 'fail_open' | 'degrade' | 'best_effort';
     2→
     3→interface OperationSuccess<T> {
     4→  ok: true;
     5→  value: T;
     6→  policy: OperationFailurePolicy;
     7→  recoverable: false;
     8→}
     9→
    10→export interface OperationFailure {
    11→  ok: false;
    12→  error: Error;
    13→  message: string;
    14→  recoverable: boolean;
    15→  policy: OperationFailurePolicy;
    16→  errorCode: string;
    17→  cause?: unknown;
    18→}
    19→
    20→export type OperationResult<T> = OperationSuccess<T> | OperationFailure;
    21→
    22→export class OperationResultError extends Error {
    23→  errorCode: string;
    24→  policy: OperationFailurePolicy;
    25→  recoverable: boolean;
    26→  cause?: unknown;
    27→
    28→  constructor(options: {
    29→    message: string;
    30→    errorCode: string;
    31→    policy: OperationFailurePolicy;
    32→    recoverable: boolean;
    33→    cause?: unknown;
    34→    sourceError?: Error;
    35→  }) {
    36→    super(options.message);
    37→    this.name = 'OperationResultError';
    38→    this.errorCode = options.errorCode;
    39→    this.policy = options.policy;
    40→    this.recoverable = options.recoverable;
    41→    this.cause = options.cause;
    42→
    43→    // Preserve the original stack for easier debugging when available.
    44→    if (options.sourceError?.stack) {
    45→      this.stack = options.sourceError.stack;
    46→    }
    47→  }
    48→}
    49→
    50→interface OperationSuccessOptions {
    51→  policy?: OperationFailurePolicy;
    52→}
    53→
    54→interface OperationFailureOptions {
    55→  policy?: OperationFailurePolicy;
    56→  recoverable?: boolean;
    57→  errorCode?: string;
    58→  message?: string;
    59→  cause?: unknown;
    60→}
    61→
    62→export function operationSuccess<T>(value: T, options?: OperationSuccessOptions): OperationSuccess<T> {
    63→  return {
    64→    ok: true,
    65→    value,
    66→    policy: options?.policy ?? 'best_effort',
    67→    recoverable: false,
    68→  };
    69→}
    70→
    71→export function operationFailure(error: unknown, options?: OperationFailureOptions): OperationFailure {
    72→  const normalizedError = error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error));
    73→  return {
    74→    ok: false,
    75→    error: normalizedError,
    76→    message: options?.message ?? normalizedError.message,
    77→    recoverable: options?.recoverable ?? true,
    78→    policy: options?.policy ?? 'best_effort',
    79→    errorCode: options?.errorCode ?? 'operation_failed',
    80→    ...(options?.cause !== undefined ? { cause: options.cause } : {}),
    81→  };
    82→}
    83→
    84→/**
    85→ * Convert a structured operation failure into an Error while preserving machine-readable metadata.
    86→ */
    87→export function toOperationResultError(failure: OperationFailure): OperationResultError {
    88→  return new OperationResultError({
    89→    message: failure.message,
    90→    errorCode: failure.errorCode,
    91→    policy: failure.policy,
    92→    recoverable: failure.recoverable,
    93→    cause: failure.cause,
    94→    sourceError: failure.error,
    95→  });
    96→}
    97→

1→import { useState, useCallback, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
     2→
     3→/**
     4→ * Hook for showing something temporarily with auto-hide.
     5→ *
     6→ * Useful for transient UI hints, tooltips, or feedback that should
     7→ * appear briefly then disappear automatically.
     8→ *
     9→ * @param duration - How long to show before auto-hiding (ms), default 2000
    10→ * @returns { isVisible, show, hide }
    11→ *
    12→ * @example
    13→ * const hint = useTemporaryVisibility(2000);
    14→ *
    15→ * // Show the hint (auto-hides after 2s)
    16→ * hint.show();
    17→ *
    18→ * // Manually hide early
    19→ * hint.hide();
    20→ *
    21→ * // In JSX
    22→ * {hint.isVisible && <div>Temporary hint!</div>}
    23→ */
    24→export function useTemporaryVisibility(duration = 2000) {
    25→  const [isVisible, setIsVisible] = useState(false);
    26→  const timeoutRef = useRef<NodeJS.Timeout | null>(null);
    27→
    28→  const clearPendingTimeout = useCallback(() => {
    29→    if (timeoutRef.current) {
    30→      clearTimeout(timeoutRef.current);
    31→      timeoutRef.current = null;
    32→    }
    33→  }, []);
    34→
    35→  const show = useCallback(() => {
    36→    setIsVisible(true);
    37→    clearPendingTimeout();
    38→    timeoutRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
    39→      setIsVisible(false);
    40→      timeoutRef.current = null;
    41→    }, duration);
    42→  }, [duration, clearPendingTimeout]);
    43→
    44→  const hide = useCallback(() => {
    45→    setIsVisible(false);
    46→    clearPendingTimeout();
    47→  }, [clearPendingTimeout]);
    48→
    49→  // Cleanup on unmount
    50→  useEffect(() => {
    51→    return () => clearPendingTimeout();
    52→  }, [clearPendingTimeout]);
    53→
    54→  return { isVisible, show, hide };
    55→}
    56→
