   293→export function buildIndividualTravelSegmentParams(
   294→  params: IndividualTravelSegmentParams,
   295→  finalResolution: string,
   296→): Record<string, unknown> {
   297→  const state = buildSegmentState(params);
   298→  const orchestratorDetails = buildOrchestratorDetails(params, state, finalResolution);
   299→  const sourceSnapshot = buildTaskPayloadSnapshot(params.originalParams);
   300→  const legacyContractTaskId = extractOrchestratorTaskIdParam(params.originalParams);
   301→  const legacyRunId = extractRunIdParam(params.originalParams);
   302→  const orchestratorTaskId = resolveSnapshotOrchestratorTaskId(sourceSnapshot)
   303→    ?? legacyContractTaskId
   304→    ?? resolveStringCandidate(
   305→      asString(state.orchDetails.orchestrator_task_id),
   306→      asString(state.orig.orchestrator_task_id_ref),
   307→    );
   308→  const runId = resolveSnapshotRunId(sourceSnapshot)
   309→    ?? legacyRunId
   310→    ?? asString(state.orchDetails.run_id);
   311→
   312→  const hasPairShotGenerationId = Boolean(
   313→    params.pair_shot_generation_id
   314→    || params.start_image_variant_id
   315→    || params.end_image_variant_id,
   316→  );
   317→  const segmentRegenerationMode = hasPairShotGenerationId
   318→    ? 'segment_regen_from_pair'
   319→    : 'segment_regen_from_order';
   320→  const generationRouting = params.child_generation_id
   321→    ? 'variant_child'
   322→    : 'child_generation';
   323→
   324→  const familyContract = buildIndividualSegmentFamilyContract({
   325→    segmentRegenerationMode,
   326→    generationRouting,
   327→    segmentIndex: params.segment_index,
   328→    hasEndImage: Boolean(params.end_image_url),
   329→    hasPairShotGenerationId,
   330→  });
   331→
   332→  const composedPayload = composeTaskFamilyPayload({
   333→    taskFamily: 'individual_travel_segment',
   334→    orchestratorDetails,
   335→    orchestrationInput: {
   336→      taskFamily: 'individual_travel_segment',
   337→      orchestratorTaskId,
   338→      runId,
   339→      parentGenerationId: params.parent_generation_id,
   340→      childGenerationId: params.child_generation_id,
   341→      childOrder: params.segment_index,
   342→      shotId: params.shot_id,
   343→      generationRouting,
   344→      siblingLookup: runId ? 'run_id' : 'orchestrator_task_id',
   345→      segmentRegenerationMode,
   346→    },
   347→    taskViewInput: {
   348→      inputImages: state.inputImages,
   349→      prompt: state.basePrompt,
   350→      enhancedPrompt: state.enhancedPrompt,
   351→      negativePrompt: state.negativePrompt,
   352→      modelName: state.modelName,
   353→      resolution: finalResolution,
   354→    },
   355→    familyContract,
   356→  });
   357→
   358→  const taskParams = {
   359→    ...buildTaskParamsPayload(params, state, finalResolution, orchestratorDetails),
   360→    ...composedPayload,
   361→  };
   362→  taskParams.individual_segment_params = buildIndividualSegmentParamsPayload(params, state);
   363→  return taskParams;
   364→}

1→/**
     2→ * RealtimeConnection - Manages Supabase WebSocket connection lifecycle
     3→ *
     4→ * Single responsibility: Connect, reconnect, and emit connection status changes.
     5→ * Does NOT filter events or make business decisions about what to invalidate.
     6→ *
     7→ * State machine: disconnected → connecting → connected ↔ reconnecting → failed
     8→ */
     9→import { RealtimeChannel } from '@supabase/supabase-js';
    10→import { getSupabaseClient } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
    11→import { dataFreshnessManager } from './DataFreshnessManager';
    12→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
    13→import { listenAppEvent } from '@/shared/lib/typedEvents';
    14→import {
    15→  ConnectionState,
    16→  ConnectionStatusCallback,
    17→  RawDatabaseEvent,
    18→  DatabaseTable,
    19→  DatabaseEventType,
    20→  RealtimeConfig,
    21→  DEFAULT_REALTIME_CONFIG,
    22→  INITIAL_CONNECTION_STATE
    23→} from './types';
    24→type RawEventCallback = (event: RawDatabaseEvent) => void;
    25→export class RealtimeConnection {
    26→  private channel: RealtimeChannel | null = null;
    27→  private state: ConnectionState = { ...INITIAL_CONNECTION_STATE };
    28→  private config: RealtimeConfig;
    29→  private reconnectTimeout: NodeJS.Timeout | null = null;
    30→  private subscribeTimeout: NodeJS.Timeout | null = null;
    31→  private statusCallbacks = new Set<ConnectionStatusCallback>();
    32→  private eventCallbacks = new Set<RawEventCallback>();
    33→  private unsubAuthHeal: (() => void) | null = null;
    34→  private activeConnectSequence = 0;
    35→  private connectInFlight: Promise<boolean> | null = null;
    36→  private connectInFlightProjectId: string | null = null;
    37→  constructor(config: Partial<RealtimeConfig> = {}) {
    38→    this.config = { ...DEFAULT_REALTIME_CONFIG, ...config };
    39→    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
    40→      this.unsubAuthHeal = listenAppEvent('realtime:auth-heal', () => this.handleAuthHeal());
    41→    }
    42→  }
    43→  /**
    44→   * Connect to a project's realtime channel.
    45→   * If already connected to a different project, disconnects first.
    46→   */
    47→  async connect(projectId: string): Promise<boolean> {
    48→    if (this.state.projectId === projectId && this.state.status === 'connected') {
    49→      return true;
    50→    }
    51→    if (this.state.projectId && this.state.projectId !== projectId) {
    52→      await this.disconnect();
    53→    }
    54→    return this.startConnect(projectId);
    55→  }
    56→  /**
    57→   * Disconnect from the current project.
    58→   */
    59→  async disconnect(): Promise<void> {
    60→    this.activeConnectSequence += 1;
    61→    this.connectInFlight = null;
    62→    this.connectInFlightProjectId = null;
    63→    this.clearTimeouts();
    64→    if (this.channel) {
    65→      try {
    66→        await this.channel.unsubscribe();
    67→      } catch {
    68→      }
    69→      this.channel = null;
    70→    }
    71→    this.setState({
    72→      status: 'disconnected',
    73→      projectId: null,
    74→      error: null,
    75→      reconnectAttempt: 0,
    76→      nextRetryAt: null,
    77→    });
    78→    dataFreshnessManager.onRealtimeStatusChange('disconnected', 'Disconnected');
    79→  }
    80→  /**
    81→   * Get current connection state.
    82→   */
    83→  getState(): Readonly<ConnectionState> {
    84→    return { ...this.state };
    85→  }
    86→  /**
    87→   * Subscribe to connection status changes.
    88→   */
    89→  onStatusChange(callback: ConnectionStatusCallback): () => void {
    90→    this.statusCallbacks.add(callback);
    91→    callback(this.getState());
    92→    return () => this.statusCallbacks.delete(callback);
    93→  }
    94→  /**
    95→   * Subscribe to raw database events.
    96→   */
    97→  onEvent(callback: RawEventCallback): () => void {
    98→    this.eventCallbacks.add(callback);
    99→    return () => this.eventCallbacks.delete(callback);
   100→  }
   101→  /**
   102→   * Reset connection state (useful for testing or forced reconnect).
   103→   */
   104→  reset(): void {
   105→    this.activeConnectSequence += 1;
   106→    this.connectInFlight = null;
   107→    this.connectInFlightProjectId = null;
   108→    this.clearTimeouts();
   109→    this.state = { ...INITIAL_CONNECTION_STATE };
   110→  }
   111→  /**
   112→   * Clean up resources.
   113→   */
   114→  destroy(): void {

   121→  private startConnect(projectId: string): Promise<boolean> {

   132→      if (this.connectInFlight === connectPromise) {
   133→        this.connectInFlight = null;
   134→        this.connectInFlightProjectId = null;
   135→      }
   136→    });
   137→    return connectPromise;
   138→  }
   139→  private isCurrentConnectAttempt(connectSequence: number): boolean {
   140→    return connectSequence === this.activeConnectSequence;
   141→  }
   142→  private async doConnect(projectId: string, connectSequence: number): Promise<boolean> {
   143→    if (!this.isCurrentConnectAttempt(connectSequence)) {
   144→      return false;
   145→    }
   146→    this.setState({
   147→      status: 'connecting',
   148→      projectId,
   149→      error: null,
   150→      reconnectAttempt: 0,
   151→      nextRetryAt: null,
   152→    });
   153→    try {
   154→      const { data: { session }, error: sessionError } = await getSupabaseClient().auth.getSession();
   155→      if (sessionError || !session?.user) {
   156→        const errorMsg = sessionError?.message || 'No valid session';
   157→        normalizeAndPresentError(new Error(errorMsg), {
   158→          context: 'RealtimeConnection.authCheck',
   159→          showToast: false,
   160→          logData: {
   161→            hasSession: !!session,
   162→            hasUser: !!session?.user,
   163→          },
   164→        });
   165→        this.setState({
   166→          status: 'failed',
   167→          error: errorMsg,
   168→        });
   169→        dataFreshnessManager.onRealtimeStatusChange('error', errorMsg);
   170→        return false;
   171→      }
   172→      if (session.access_token) {
   173→        getSupabaseClient().realtime.setAuth(session.access_token);
   174→      }
   175→    } catch (error) {
   176→      const errorMsg = error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Auth check failed';
   177→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, {
   178→        context: 'RealtimeConnection.authSessionFetch',
   179→        showToast: false,
   180→      });
   181→      this.setState({
   182→        status: 'failed',
   183→        error: errorMsg,
   184→      });
   185→      dataFreshnessManager.onRealtimeStatusChange('error', errorMsg);
   186→      return false;
   187→    }
   188→    if (!this.isCurrentConnectAttempt(connectSequence)) {
   189→      return false;
   190→    }
   191→    const topic = `task-updates:${projectId}`;
   192→    const channel = getSupabaseClient().channel(topic);
   193→    if (!this.isCurrentConnectAttempt(connectSequence)) {
   194→      void channel.unsubscribe().catch(() => {
   195→      });
   196→      return false;
   197→    }
   198→    this.channel = channel;
   199→    this.setupEventHandlers(projectId, channel);
   200→    return new Promise((resolve) => {
   201→      let settled = false;
   202→      const settle = (result: boolean) => {
   203→        if (settled) {
   204→          return;
   205→        }
   206→        settled = true;
   207→        resolve(result);
   208→      };
   209→      const subscribeTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
   210→        if (this.subscribeTimeout === subscribeTimeout) {
   211→          this.subscribeTimeout = null;
   212→        }
   213→        if (!this.isCurrentConnectAttempt(connectSequence)) {
   214→          settle(false);
   215→          return;
   216→        }
   217→        this.handleSubscribeFailure('Timeout', projectId, connectSequence);
   218→        settle(false);
   219→      }, this.config.subscribeTimeout);
   220→      this.subscribeTimeout = subscribeTimeout;
   221→      channel.subscribe((status: string) => {
   222→        if (!this.isCurrentConnectAttempt(connectSequence)) {
   223→          void channel.unsubscribe().catch(() => {
   224→          });
   225→          return;
   226→        }
   227→        if (this.subscribeTimeout === subscribeTimeout) {
   228→          clearTimeout(subscribeTimeout);
   229→          this.subscribeTimeout = null;
   230→        }
   231→        if (status === 'SUBSCRIBED') {
   232→          this.setState({
   233→            status: 'connected',
   234→            error: null,
   235→            reconnectAttempt: 0,
   236→            nextRetryAt: null,
   237→          });
   238→          dataFreshnessManager.onRealtimeStatusChange('connected', 'Connected');
   239→          settle(true);
   240→        } else if (status === 'CHANNEL_ERROR' || status === 'TIMED_OUT') {
   241→          this.handleSubscribeFailure(status, projectId, connectSequence);
   242→          settle(false);
   243→        }
   244→      });
   245→    });
   246→  }
   247→  private setupEventHandlers(projectId: string, channel: RealtimeChannel): void {
   248→    channel
   249→      .on('postgres_changes',
   250→        { event: 'INSERT', schema: 'public', table: 'tasks', filter: `project_id=eq.${projectId}` },
   251→        (payload) => this.emitEvent('tasks', 'INSERT', payload.new, null)
   252→      )
   253→      .on('postgres_changes',
   254→        { event: 'UPDATE', schema: 'public', table: 'tasks', filter: `project_id=eq.${projectId}` },
   255→        (payload) => this.emitEvent('tasks', 'UPDATE', payload.new, payload.old)
   256→      );
   257→    channel
   258→      .on('postgres_changes',
   259→        { event: 'INSERT', schema: 'public', table: 'generations', filter: `project_id=eq.${projectId}` },
   260→        (payload) => this.emitEvent('generations', 'INSERT', payload.new, null)
   261→      )
   262→      .on('postgres_changes',
   263→        { event: 'UPDATE', schema: 'public', table: 'generations', filter: `project_id=eq.${projectId}` },
   264→        (payload) => this.emitEvent('generations', 'UPDATE', payload.new, payload.old)
   265→      )
   266→      .on('postgres_changes',
   267→        { event: 'DELETE', schema: 'public', table: 'generations', filter: `project_id=eq.${projectId}` },
   268→        (payload) => this.emitEvent('generations', 'DELETE', payload.old, null)
   269→      );
   270→    channel
   271→      .on('postgres_changes',
   272→        { event: 'INSERT', schema: 'public', table: 'shot_generations' },
   273→        (payload) => this.emitEvent('shot_generations', 'INSERT', payload.new, null)
   274→      )
   275→      .on('postgres_changes',
   276→        { event: 'UPDATE', schema: 'public', table: 'shot_generations' },
   277→        (payload) => this.emitEvent('shot_generations', 'UPDATE', payload.new, payload.old)
   278→      )
   279→      .on('postgres_changes',
   280→        { event: 'DELETE', schema: 'public', table: 'shot_generations' },
   281→        (payload) => this.emitEvent('shot_generations', 'DELETE', payload.old, null)
   282→      );
   283→    channel
   284→      .on('postgres_changes',
   285→        { event: 'INSERT', schema: 'public', table: 'generation_variants' },
   286→        (payload) => this.emitEvent('generation_variants', 'INSERT', payload.new, null)
   287→      )
   288→      .on('postgres_changes',
   289→        { event: 'UPDATE', schema: 'public', table: 'generation_variants' },
   290→        (payload) => this.emitEvent('generation_variants', 'UPDATE', payload.new, payload.old)
   291→      )
   292→      .on('postgres_changes',
   293→        { event: 'DELETE', schema: 'public', table: 'generation_variants' },
   294→        (payload) => this.emitEvent('generation_variants', 'DELETE', payload.old, null)
   295→      );
   296→  }
   297→  private emitEvent(
   298→    table: DatabaseTable,
   299→    eventType: DatabaseEventType,
   300→    newRecord: unknown,
   301→    oldRecord: unknown
   302→  ): void {
   303→    const event: RawDatabaseEvent = {
   304→      table,
   305→      eventType,
   306→      new: newRecord as Record<string, unknown>,
   307→      old: oldRecord as Partial<Record<string, unknown>> | null,
   308→      receivedAt: Date.now(),
   309→    };
   310→    this.eventCallbacks.forEach((callback) => {
   311→      try {
   312→        callback(event);
   313→      } catch (error) {
   314→        normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'RealtimeConnection.eventCallback', showToast: false });
   315→      }
   316→    });
   317→  }
   318→  private handleSubscribeFailure(reason: string, projectId: string, connectSequence: number): void {
   319→    if (!this.isCurrentConnectAttempt(connectSequence)) {
   320→      return;
   321→    }
   322→    const attempt = this.state.reconnectAttempt + 1;
   323→    const isExhausted = attempt > this.config.maxReconnectAttempts;
   324→    if (isExhausted) {
   325→      normalizeAndPresentError(new Error('Max reconnect attempts reached'), {
   326→        context: 'RealtimeConnection.handleSubscribeFailure',
   327→        showToast: false,
   328→        logData: { reason, attempt, maxReconnectAttempts: this.config.maxReconnectAttempts },
   329→      });
   330→      this.setState({
   331→        status: 'failed',
   332→        error: `Connection failed after ${this.config.maxReconnectAttempts} attempts: ${reason}`,
   333→        reconnectAttempt: attempt,
   334→        nextRetryAt: null,
   335→      });
   336→      dataFreshnessManager.onRealtimeStatusChange('error', 'Max reconnect attempts reached');
   337→    } else {
   338→      const delay = Math.min(
   339→        this.config.baseReconnectDelay * Math.pow(2, attempt - 1),
   340→        this.config.maxReconnectDelay
   341→      );
   342→      const nextRetryAt = Date.now() + delay;
   343→      console.warn(
   344→        `[RealtimeConnection] Subscribe failed: ${reason}. ` +
   345→        `Retrying in ${delay}ms (attempt ${attempt}/${this.config.maxReconnectAttempts})`
   346→      );
   347→      this.setState({
   348→        status: 'reconnecting',
   349→        error: reason,
   350→        reconnectAttempt: attempt,
   351→        nextRetryAt,
   352→      });
   353→      dataFreshnessManager.onRealtimeStatusChange('error', `Reconnecting: ${reason}`);
   354→      this.scheduleReconnect(projectId, delay, connectSequence);
   355→    }
   356→  }
   357→  private scheduleReconnect(projectId: string, delay: number, failedConnectSequence: number): void {
   358→    this.clearTimeouts();
   359→    this.reconnectTimeout = setTimeout(async () => {
   360→      this.reconnectTimeout = null;
   361→      if (!this.isCurrentConnectAttempt(failedConnectSequence)) {
   362→        return;
   363→      }
   364→      if (this.channel) {
   365→        try {
   366→          await this.channel.unsubscribe();
   367→        } catch {
   368→        }
   369→        this.channel = null;
   370→      }
   371→      await this.startConnect(projectId);
   372→    }, delay);
   373→  }
   374→  private handleAuthHeal = (): void => {
   375→    if (
   376→      this.state.projectId &&
   377→      (this.state.status === 'reconnecting' || this.state.status === 'failed')
   378→    ) {
   379→      this.setState({ reconnectAttempt: 0 });
   380→      void this.startConnect(this.state.projectId);
   381→    }
   382→  };
   383→  private setState(updates: Partial<ConnectionState>): void {
   384→    const prevStatus = this.state.status;
   385→    this.state = {
   386→      ...this.state,
   387→      ...updates,
   388→      statusChangedAt: updates.status && updates.status !== prevStatus
   389→        ? Date.now()
   390→        : this.state.statusChangedAt,
   391→    };
   392→    const snapshot = this.getState();
   393→    this.statusCallbacks.forEach((callback) => {
   394→      try {
   395→        callback(snapshot);
   396→      } catch (error) {
   397→        normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'RealtimeConnection.statusCallback', showToast: false });
   398→      }
   399→    });
   400→  }
   401→  private clearTimeouts(): void {
   402→    if (this.reconnectTimeout) {
   403→      clearTimeout(this.reconnectTimeout);
   404→      this.reconnectTimeout = null;
   405→    }
   406→    if (this.subscribeTimeout) {
   407→      clearTimeout(this.subscribeTimeout);
   408→      this.subscribeTimeout = null;
   409→    }
   410→  }
   411→}
   412→let realtimeConnectionInstance: RealtimeConnection | null = null;
   413→/**
   414→ * Lazily create the app-wide realtime connection instance.
   415→ *
   416→ * Avoiding eager module-level construction prevents constructor side effects
   417→ * from being tied to import order.
   418→ */
   419→export function getRealtimeConnection(): RealtimeConnection {
   420→  if (!realtimeConnectionInstance) {
   421→    realtimeConnectionInstance = new RealtimeConnection();
   422→  }
   423→  return realtimeConnectionInstance;
   424→}
   425→/** @internal For test isolation. */
   426→export async function _resetRealtimeConnectionForTesting(): Promise<void> {
   427→  if (realtimeConnectionInstance) {
   428→    realtimeConnectionInstance.destroy();
   429→  }
   430→  realtimeConnectionInstance = null;
   431→}

    18→export function useDeleteGenerationAction({
    19→  projectId,
    20→}: UseDeleteGenerationActionOptions): UseDeleteGenerationActionResult {
    21→  const deleteGenerationMutation = useDeleteGeneration();
    22→  const [pendingDeleteId, setPendingDeleteId] = useState<string | null>(null);
    23→  const [deletingId, setDeletingId] = useState<string | null>(null);
    24→
    25→  const requestDelete = useCallback((id: string) => {
    26→    setPendingDeleteId(id);
    27→  }, []);
    28→
    29→  const cancelDelete = useCallback(() => {
    30→    setPendingDeleteId(null);
    31→  }, []);
    32→
    33→  const confirmDelete = useCallback(async () => {
    34→    if (!pendingDeleteId || !projectId) {
    35→      setPendingDeleteId(null);
    36→      return;
    37→    }
    38→
    39→    const targetId = pendingDeleteId;
    40→    setDeletingId(targetId);
    41→    try {
    42→      await deleteGenerationMutation.mutateAsync({ id: targetId, projectId });
    43→      setPendingDeleteId((current) => (current === targetId ? null : current));
    44→    } catch (error) {
    45→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, {
    46→        context: 'useDeleteGenerationAction.confirmDelete',
    47→        toastTitle: 'Delete failed',
    48→      });
    49→      // Keep the dialog open so users can retry or cancel after a failed delete.
    50→    } finally {
    51→      setDeletingId((current) => (current === targetId ? null : current));
    52→    }
    53→  }, [deleteGenerationMutation, pendingDeleteId, projectId]);
    54→
    55→  return {
    56→    pendingDeleteId,
    57→    deletingId,
    58→    isPending: deleteGenerationMutation.isPending,
    59→    requestDelete,
    60→    cancelDelete,
    61→    confirmDelete,
    62→  };

   140→    enforcement: options?.enforcement ?? 'auto',
   141→  });
   142→}
   143→
   144→/**
   145→ * Canonical migration adapter for legacy structure-video settings.
   146→ * Preserves explicit structure_type values and only falls back to defaults
   147→ * when legacy payloads omit type information.
   148→ */
   149→export function migrateLegacyStructureVideos(
   150→  value: unknown,
   151→  options: LegacyStructureVideoMigrationOptions,
   152→): MigratedLegacyStructureVideo[] {
   153→  const settings = asRecord(value);
   154→  if (!settings) {
   155→    return [];
   156→  }
   157→
   158→  const topLevelStructureType = parseStructureType(
   159→    settings.structure_video_type ?? settings.structureType,
   160→  );
   161→  const topLevelTreatment = parseTreatment(
   162→    settings.structure_video_treatment ?? settings.treatment,
   163→  );
   164→  const topLevelMotionStrength = parseNumber(
   165→    settings.structure_video_motion_strength ?? settings.motionStrength,
   166→  );
   167→  const topLevelUni3cEndPercent = parseNumber(settings.uni3c_end_percent);
   168→
   169→  const rawStructureVideos = Array.isArray(settings.structure_videos)
   170→    ? settings.structure_videos
   171→    : null;
   172→  if (rawStructureVideos) {
   173→    return rawStructureVideos
   174→      .map((entry) => {
   175→        const record = asRecord(entry);
   176→        if (!record) {
   177→          return null;
   178→        }
   179→
   180→        const path = parseString(record.path);
   181→        if (!path) {
   182→          return null;
   183→        }
   184→
   185→        const metadata = asRecord(record.metadata);
   186→        const resourceId = parseString(record.resource_id);
   187→        return {
   188→          path,
   189→          start_frame: parseNumber(record.start_frame) ?? 0,
   190→          end_frame: parseNumber(record.end_frame) ?? options.defaultEndFrame,
   191→          treatment: parseTreatment(record.treatment) ?? topLevelTreatment ?? options.defaultVideoTreatment,
   192→          motion_strength: parseNumber(record.motion_strength) ?? topLevelMotionStrength ?? options.defaultMotionStrength,
   193→          structure_type: parseStructureType(record.structure_type) ?? topLevelStructureType ?? options.defaultStructureType,
   194→          uni3c_end_percent: parseNumber(record.uni3c_end_percent) ?? topLevelUni3cEndPercent ?? options.defaultUni3cEndPercent,
   195→          metadata: metadata as VideoMetadata | null ?? null,
   196→          resource_id: resourceId ?? null,
   197→        } satisfies MigratedLegacyStructureVideo;
   198→      })
   199→      .filter((entry): entry is MigratedLegacyStructureVideo => entry !== null);
   200→  }
   201→
   202→  const singlePath = parseString(settings.structure_video_path ?? settings.path);
   203→  if (!singlePath) {
   204→    return [];
   205→  }
   206→
   207→  const metadata = asRecord(settings.metadata);
   208→  const resourceId = parseString(settings.resource_id ?? settings.resourceId);
   209→  return [{
   210→    path: singlePath,
   211→    start_frame: 0,
   212→    end_frame: options.defaultEndFrame,
   213→    treatment: topLevelTreatment ?? options.defaultVideoTreatment,
   214→    motion_strength: topLevelMotionStrength ?? options.defaultMotionStrength,
   215→    structure_type: topLevelStructureType ?? options.defaultStructureType,
   216→    uni3c_end_percent: topLevelUni3cEndPercent ?? options.defaultUni3cEndPercent,
   217→    metadata: metadata as VideoMetadata | null ?? null,
   218→    resource_id: resourceId ?? null,
   219→  }];
   220→}
   221→

    25→/**

    29→function sanitizeTaskDataForSharing(taskData: Record<string, unknown> | null): Record<string, unknown> | null {
    30→  if (!taskData) return null;
    31→  
    32→  const sanitized = { ...taskData };
    33→
    34→  const redactDeep = (value: unknown, depth: number = 0): unknown => {
    35→    if (depth > 6) return null;
    36→    if (value == null) return value;
    37→    if (Array.isArray(value)) return value.map((v) => redactDeep(v, depth + 1));
    38→    if (typeof value !== 'object') return value;
    39→
    40→    const out: Record<string, unknown> = {};
    41→    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(value)) {
    42→      // Strip any obviously sensitive keys
    43→      if (/(api[_-]?key|token|secret|password|service_role|authorization|stripe)/i.test(k)) {
    44→        continue;
    45→      }
    46→      out[k] = redactDeep(v, depth + 1);
    47→    }
    48→    return out;
    49→  };
    50→  
    51→  // Remove or sanitize sensitive fields from params
    52→  if (sanitized.params) {
    53→    sanitized.params = redactDeep(sanitized.params);
    54→  }
    55→  
    56→  // Remove fields that shouldn't be exposed
    57→  delete sanitized.error_message; // Could contain internal details
    58→  
    59→  return sanitized;
    60→}

   113→export function mergeGenerationsWithTaskData(

   128→      : null;

   131→    return {
   132→      ...generation,
   133→      taskId,
   134→      taskData,
   135→      taskMappingStatus,
   136→      ...(cachedMapping?.queryError ? { taskMappingError: cachedMapping.queryError } : {}),

    28→  
    29→  // Fetch auto-topup preferences.
    30→  // IMPORTANT: Stripe IDs are NOT selected client-side (column privileges revoked).
    31→  const { data, error } = await getSupabase()
    32→    .from('users')
    33→    .select(`
    34→      auto_topup_enabled,
    35→      auto_topup_amount,
    36→      auto_topup_threshold,
    37→      auto_topup_last_triggered,
    38→      auto_topup_setup_completed
    39→    `)
    40→    .eq('id', user.id)
    41→    .single();
    42→
    43→  if (error) {
    44→    throw new Error(`Failed to fetch auto-top-up preferences: ${error.message}`);
    45→  }
    46→
    47→  const hasPaymentMethod = !!data?.auto_topup_setup_completed;
    48→
    49→  return {
    50→    enabled: data?.auto_topup_enabled || false,
    51→    // Setup completed if payment method is configured
    52→    setupCompleted: hasPaymentMethod,
    53→    amount: data?.auto_topup_amount ? data.auto_topup_amount / 100 : 50, // Convert cents to dollars
    54→    threshold: data?.auto_topup_threshold ? data.auto_topup_threshold / 100 : 10, // Convert cents to dollars
    55→    hasPaymentMethod,
    56→    lastTriggered: data?.auto_topup_last_triggered ?? undefined,
    57→    // Note: Stripe IDs are intentionally NOT exposed to frontend
    58→  };
    59→}
    60→
    61→// Update auto-top-up preferences
    62→interface UpdateAutoTopupParams {
    63→  enabled: boolean;
    64→  amount?: number; // in dollars
    65→  threshold?: number; // in dollars
    66→}
    67→
    68→async function updateAutoTopupPreferences(params: UpdateAutoTopupParams): Promise<void> {
    69→  
    70→  const { data: { session }, error: authError } = await getSupabase().auth.getSession();
    71→  
    72→  if (authError || !session) {
    73→    throw new Error('Authentication required');
    74→  }
    75→
    76→  const requestBody = {
    77→    autoTopupEnabled: params.enabled,
    78→    autoTopupAmount: params.amount,
    79→    autoTopupThreshold: params.threshold,
    80→  };
    81→  
    82→  // Call the setup-auto-topup edge function
    83→  const data = await invokeWithTimeout('setup-auto-topup', {
    84→    body: requestBody,
    85→    headers: {
    86→      Authorization: `Bearer ${session.access_token}`,
    87→    },
    88→    timeoutMs: 20000,
    89→  });
    90→  
    91→  if ((data as Record<string, unknown> | null)?.error) {
    92→    throw new Error(((data as Record<string, unknown>).message as string) || 'Failed to update auto-top-up preferences');
    93→  }
    94→  
    95→}
    96→
    97→// Disable auto-top-up (convenience function)
    98→function disableAutoTopup(): Promise<void> {
    99→  return updateAutoTopupPreferences({ enabled: false });
   100→}
   101→
   102→export function useAutoTopup() {
   103→  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
   104→
   105→  // Fetch auto-top-up preferences
   106→  const {
   107→    data: preferences,
   108→    isLoading: isLoadingPreferences,
   109→    error: preferencesError,
   110→  } = useQuery<AutoTopupPreferences>({
   111→    [REDACTED],

   114→    gcTime: 1000 * 60 * 10, // 10 minutes
   115→  });
   116→
   117→  // Update preferences mutation
   118→  const updatePreferencesMutation = useMutation<void, Error, UpdateAutoTopupParams>({
   119→    mutationFn: updateAutoTopupPreferences,
   120→    onSuccess: () => {
   121→      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED] });
   122→      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED] }); // Refresh credits info

   124→    },
   125→    onError: (error, _variables) => {
   126→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'useAutoTopup', showToast: false });
   127→      // Only log errors, don't show toast for save failures
   128→    },
   129→  });
   130→
   131→  // Disable auto-top-up mutation
   132→  const disableMutation = useMutation<void, Error>({

   136→      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED] }); // Refresh credits info

   139→    onError: (error) => {
   140→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'useAutoTopup', showToast: false });
   141→      // Only log errors, don't show toast for disable failures
   142→    },
   143→  });
   144→
   145→  return {
   146→    // Data
   147→    preferences,

   149→    preferencesError,
   150→    
   151→    // Actions
   152→    updatePreferences: updatePreferencesMutation.mutate,
   153→    isUpdatingPreferences: updatePreferencesMutation.isPending,
   154→

1→import { useState, useRef, useCallback } from 'react';
     2→
     3→/**
     4→ * Horizontal pointer-swipe navigation with edge resistance and scroll-safe gesture locking.
     5→ */
     6→
     7→interface UseSwipeNavigationProps {
     8→  /** Called when user swipes left (navigate to next) */
     9→  onSwipeLeft?: () => void;
    10→  /** Called when user swipes right (navigate to previous) */
    11→  onSwipeRight?: () => void;
    12→  /** Disable swipe gestures entirely */
    13→  disabled?: boolean;
    14→  /** Minimum distance in pixels to trigger navigation (default: 50) */
    15→  threshold?: number;
    16→  /** Minimum velocity (px/ms) for quick flick gestures (default: 0.3) */
    17→  velocityThreshold?: number;
    18→  /** Whether there's a next item (affects elastic resistance) */
    19→  hasNext?: boolean;
    20→  /** Whether there's a previous item (affects elastic resistance) */
    21→  hasPrevious?: boolean;
    22→  /** Maximum offset for elastic resistance when at edge (default: 80) */
    23→  maxElasticOffset?: number;
    24→}
    25→
    26→interface UseSwipeNavigationReturn {
    27→  /** Handlers to spread on the swipeable element */
    28→  swipeHandlers: {
    29→    onPointerDown: (e: React.PointerEvent) => void;
    30→    onPointerMove: (e: React.PointerEvent) => void;
    31→    onPointerUp: (e: React.PointerEvent) => void;
    32→    onPointerCancel: (e: React.PointerEvent) => void;
    33→  };
    34→  /** Current horizontal offset for visual feedback (in pixels) */
    35→  swipeOffset: number;
    36→  /** Whether the user is actively swiping */
    37→  isSwiping: boolean;
    38→}
    39→
    40→interface SwipeState {
    41→  startX: number;
    42→  startY: number;
    43→  startTime: number;
    44→  currentX: number;
    45→  pointerId: number;
    46→  isLocked: boolean; // Once we determine direction, lock it
    47→  isHorizontal: boolean | null; // null = undetermined, true = horizontal, false = vertical
    48→}
    49→
    50→function isInteractiveElement(el: HTMLElement | null): boolean {
    51→  const interactiveTags = ['BUTTON', 'INPUT', 'TEXTAREA', 'SELECT', 'A', 'VIDEO', 'CANVAS'];
    52→  const interactiveRoles = ['button', 'slider', 'textbox', 'link', 'scrollbar'];
    53→  
    54→  let current: HTMLElement | null = el;
    55→  while (current) {
    56→    if (interactiveTags.includes(current.tagName)) {
    57→      return true;
    58→    }
    59→
    60→    const role = current.getAttribute('role');
    61→    if (role && interactiveRoles.includes(role)) {
    62→      return true;
    63→    }
    64→
    65→    if (current.getAttribute('data-no-swipe') === 'true') {
    66→      return true;
    67→    }
    68→
    69→    if (current.getAttribute('data-scrollable') === 'true') {
    70→      return true;
    71→    }
    72→
    73→    const style = window.getComputedStyle(current);
    74→    if (
    75→      (style.overflowY === 'scroll' || style.overflowY === 'auto') &&
    76→      current.scrollHeight > current.clientHeight
    77→    ) {
    78→      return true;
    79→    }
    80→
    81→    if (current.tagName === 'CANVAS') {
    82→      return true;
    83→    }
    84→
    85→    if (current.getAttribute('data-scroll-area-viewport')) {
    86→      return true;
    87→    }
    88→
    89→    current = current.parentElement;
    90→  }
    91→
    92→  return false;
    93→}
    94→
    95→export function useSwipeNavigation({
    96→  onSwipeLeft,
    97→  onSwipeRight,
    98→  disabled = false,
    99→  threshold = 50,
   100→  velocityThreshold = 0.3,
   101→  hasNext = true,
   102→  hasPrevious = true,
   103→  maxElasticOffset = 80,
   104→}: UseSwipeNavigationProps): UseSwipeNavigationReturn {
   105→  const [swipeOffset, setSwipeOffset] = useState(0);
   106→  const [isSwiping, setIsSwiping] = useState(false);
   107→  const swipeStateRef = useRef<SwipeState | null>(null);
   108→
   109→  const applyElasticResistance = useCallback((deltaX: number): number => {
   110→    if (deltaX > 0 && !hasPrevious) {
   111→      return Math.sign(deltaX) * Math.min(maxElasticOffset, Math.abs(deltaX) * 0.3);
   112→    }
   113→
   114→    if (deltaX < 0 && !hasNext) {
   115→      return Math.sign(deltaX) * Math.min(maxElasticOffset, Math.abs(deltaX) * 0.3);
   116→    }
   117→
   118→    const maxNormalOffset = 150;
   119→    if (Math.abs(deltaX) > maxNormalOffset) {
   120→      const excess = Math.abs(deltaX) - maxNormalOffset;
   121→      return Math.sign(deltaX) * (maxNormalOffset + excess * 0.2);
   122→    }
   123→    
   124→    return deltaX;
   125→  }, [hasNext, hasPrevious, maxElasticOffset]);
   126→  
   127→  const handlePointerDown = useCallback((e: React.PointerEvent) => {
   128→    if (disabled) return;
   129→    if (!e.isPrimary) return;
   130→
   131→    const target = e.target as HTMLElement;
   132→    if (isInteractiveElement(target)) {
   133→      return;
   134→    }
   135→    
   136→    swipeStateRef.current = {
   137→      startX: e.clientX,
   138→      startY: e.clientY,
   139→      startTime: Date.now(),
   140→      currentX: e.clientX,
   141→      pointerId: e.pointerId,
   142→      isLocked: false,
   143→      isHorizontal: null,
   144→    };
   145→
   146→    try {
   147→      (e.currentTarget as HTMLElement).setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
   148→    } catch {
   149→    }
   150→  }, [disabled]);
   151→  
   152→  const handlePointerMove = useCallback((e: React.PointerEvent) => {
   153→    const state = swipeStateRef.current;
   154→    if (!state || !e.isPrimary || state.pointerId !== e.pointerId) return;
   155→    
   156→    const deltaX = e.clientX - state.startX;
   157→    const deltaY = e.clientY - state.startY;
   158→    const absDeltaX = Math.abs(deltaX);
   159→    const absDeltaY = Math.abs(deltaY);
   160→
   161→    if (!state.isLocked && (absDeltaX > 10 || absDeltaY > 10)) {
   162→      state.isHorizontal = absDeltaX > absDeltaY * 0.8;
   163→      state.isLocked = true;
   164→
   165→      if (!state.isHorizontal) {
   166→        swipeStateRef.current = null;
   167→        setSwipeOffset(0);
   168→        setIsSwiping(false);
   169→        try {
   170→          (e.currentTarget as HTMLElement).releasePointerCapture(e.pointerId);
   171→        } catch { /* intentionally ignored */ }
   172→        return;
   173→      }
   174→    }
   175→
   176→    if (state.isLocked && state.isHorizontal) {
   177→      e.preventDefault();
   178→      state.currentX = e.clientX;
   179→      const resistedOffset = applyElasticResistance(deltaX);
   180→      setSwipeOffset(resistedOffset);
   181→      setIsSwiping(true);
   182→    }
   183→  }, [applyElasticResistance]);
   184→  
   185→  const handlePointerUp = useCallback((e: React.PointerEvent) => {
   186→    const state = swipeStateRef.current;
   187→    if (!state || !e.isPrimary || state.pointerId !== e.pointerId) return;
   188→    
   189→    const deltaX = e.clientX - state.startX;
   190→    const duration = Math.max(Date.now() - state.startTime, 1);
   191→    const velocity = Math.abs(deltaX) / duration;
   192→    const absDeltaX = Math.abs(deltaX);
   193→
   194→    if (state.isLocked && state.isHorizontal) {
   195→      const metDistanceThreshold = absDeltaX >= threshold;
   196→      const metVelocityThreshold = velocity >= velocityThreshold && absDeltaX > 20;
   197→
   198→      if (metDistanceThreshold || metVelocityThreshold) {
   199→        if (deltaX < 0 && hasNext) {
   200→          onSwipeLeft?.();
   201→        } else if (deltaX > 0 && hasPrevious) {
   202→          onSwipeRight?.();
   203→        }
   204→      }
   205→    }
   206→
   207→    try {
   208→      (e.currentTarget as HTMLElement).releasePointerCapture(e.pointerId);
   209→    } catch { /* intentionally ignored */ }
   210→
   211→    swipeStateRef.current = null;
   212→    setSwipeOffset(0);
   213→    setIsSwiping(false);
   214→  }, [threshold, velocityThreshold, hasNext, hasPrevious, onSwipeLeft, onSwipeRight]);
   215→  
   216→  const handlePointerCancel = useCallback((e: React.PointerEvent) => {
   217→    try {
   218→      (e.currentTarget as HTMLElement).releasePointerCapture(e.pointerId);
   219→    } catch { /* intentionally ignored */ }
   220→
   221→    swipeStateRef.current = null;
   222→    setSwipeOffset(0);
   223→    setIsSwiping(false);
   224→  }, []);
   225→  
   226→  return {

   229→      onPointerMove: handlePointerMove,

   231→      onPointerCancel: handlePointerCancel,

    20→interface PendingJoinClipParseResult {
    21→  entries: PendingJoinClipEntry[];
    22→  invalidCount: number;

    24→
    25→function parsePendingJoinClips(raw: string): PendingJoinClipParseResult | null {
    26→  let parsed: unknown;
    27→  try {
    28→    parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    29→  } catch {
    30→    return null;
    31→  }
    32→
    33→  if (!Array.isArray(parsed)) {
    34→    return null;
    35→  }
    36→
    37→  const entries: PendingJoinClipEntry[] = [];
    38→  let invalidCount = 0;
    39→  for (const value of parsed) {
    40→    if (!value || typeof value !== 'object' || Array.isArray(value)) {
    41→      invalidCount += 1;
    42→      continue;
    43→    }
    44→
    45→    const candidate = value as Record<string, unknown>;
    46→    if (
    47→      typeof candidate.videoUrl !== 'string'
    48→      || typeof candidate.generationId !== 'string'
    49→      || typeof candidate.timestamp !== 'number'
    50→      || !Number.isFinite(candidate.timestamp)
    51→    ) {
    52→      invalidCount += 1;
    53→      continue;
    54→    }
    55→
    56→    entries.push({
    57→      videoUrl: candidate.videoUrl,
    58→      generationId: candidate.generationId,
    59→      timestamp: candidate.timestamp,
    60→      ...(typeof candidate.thumbnailUrl === 'string' && candidate.thumbnailUrl.length > 0
    61→        ? { thumbnailUrl: candidate.thumbnailUrl }
    62→        : {}),
    63→      ...(typeof candidate.projectId === 'string' && candidate.projectId.length > 0
    64→        ? { projectId: candidate.projectId }
    65→        : {}),
    66→      ...(typeof candidate.userId === 'string' && candidate.userId.length > 0
    67→        ? { userId: candidate.userId }
    68→        : {}),
    69→    });
    70→  }
    71→
    72→  return { entries, invalidCount };
    73→}

    75→/** Create a throwaway <video> to read duration from a URL. */
    76→function getVideoDurationFromUrl(videoUrl: string): Promise<number> {
    77→  return new Promise<number>(resolve => {
    78→    const videoElement = document.createElement('video');
    79→    videoElement.preload = 'metadata';
    80→    videoElement.onloadedmetadata = () => resolve(videoElement.duration);
    81→    videoElement.onerror = () => resolve(0);
    82→    videoElement.src = videoUrl;
    83→  });
    84→}

    86→/**
    87→ * Reads and consumes pending join clips from localStorage.
    88→ * Returns deferred actions that are applied to clip state later.
    89→ * Placement is intentionally not resolved here because only the consumer has
    90→ * the previous clip array needed to choose fill-vs-append.
    91→ */
    92→export type PendingClipAction = {
    93→  type: 'deferred_insert';
    94→  clip: VideoClip;
    95→};
    96→
    97→interface ConsumePendingJoinClipsOptions {
    98→  projectId?: string | null;

   100→}
   101→
   102→async function toPendingClipActions(
   103→  entries: PendingJoinClipEntry[],
   104→  readVideoDuration: (videoUrl: string) => Promise<number>,
   105→): Promise<PendingClipAction[]> {
   106→  const actions: PendingClipAction[] = [];
   107→
   108→  for (const { videoUrl, thumbnailUrl, generationId } of entries) {
   109→    if (!videoUrl) continue;
   110→
   111→    const durationSeconds = await readVideoDuration(videoUrl);
   112→
   113→    const clip: VideoClip = {
   114→      id: generateUUID(),
   115→      url: videoUrl,
   116→      posterUrl: thumbnailUrl,
   117→      durationSeconds,
   118→      loaded: false,
   119→      playing: false,
   120→      generationId,
   121→    };
   122→
   123→    actions.push({ type: 'deferred_insert', clip });
   124→  }
   125→
   126→  return actions;
   127→}
   128→
   129→export async function consumePendingJoinClips(
   130→  options: ConsumePendingJoinClipsOptions = {},
   131→): Promise<OperationResult<PendingClipAction[]>> {
   132→  const projectId = options.projectId ?? null;
   133→  const readVideoDuration = options.readVideoDuration ?? getVideoDurationFromUrl;
   134→
   135→  try {
   136→    const userId = readUserIdFromStorage();
   137→
   138→    const inMemoryPending = consumeJoinClipsIntents({ projectId, userId });
   139→    if (inMemoryPending.length > 0) {
   140→      const now = Date.now();
   141→      const scopedRecentClips = inMemoryPending.filter(
   142→        (clip) =>
   143→          now - clip.timestamp < PENDING_CLIPS_TTL_MS
   144→          && isPendingJoinClipInScope(clip, { projectId, userId }),
   145→      );
   146→      if (scopedRecentClips.length === 0) {
   147→        localStorage.removeItem(getPendingJoinClipsStorageKey(projectId, userId));
   148→        return operationSuccess([]);
   149→      }
   150→
   151→      const actions = await toPendingClipActions(scopedRecentClips, readVideoDuration);
   152→      localStorage.removeItem(getPendingJoinClipsStorageKey(projectId, userId));
   153→      return operationSuccess(actions);
   154→    }
   155→
   156→    const pendingKeys = getPendingJoinClipsCandidateKeys({ projectId, userId });
   157→    const pendingSource = pendingKeys
   158→      .map((key) => ({ key, raw: localStorage.getItem(key) }))
   159→      .find((item) => typeof item.raw === 'string' && item.raw.length > 0);
   160→
   161→    if (!pendingSource || !pendingSource.raw) {
   162→      return operationSuccess([]);
   163→    }
   164→
   165→    const parsedPendingClips = parsePendingJoinClips(pendingSource.raw);
   166→    if (!parsedPendingClips) {
   167→      normalizeAndPresentError(new Error('Invalid pending join clips payload'), {
   168→        context: 'JoinClipsPage.pendingClipsInvalid',
   169→        showToast: false,
   170→        logData: { [REDACTED] },
   171→      });
   172→      localStorage.removeItem(pendingSource.key);
   173→      return operationFailure(new Error('Invalid pending join clips payload'), {
   174→        policy: 'degrade',
   175→        errorCode: 'pending_join_clips_invalid_payload',
   176→        message: 'Invalid pending join clips payload',
   177→        recoverable: true,
   178→        cause: { [REDACTED] },
   179→      });
   180→    }
   181→
   182→    if (parsedPendingClips.invalidCount > 0) {
   183→      normalizeAndPresentError(new Error('Dropped invalid pending join clip entries'), {
   184→        context: 'JoinClipsPage.pendingClipsPartialRecovery',
   185→        showToast: false,
   186→        logData: {
   187→          [REDACTED],
   188→          totalEntries: parsedPendingClips.entries.length + parsedPendingClips.invalidCount,
   189→          invalidEntries: parsedPendingClips.invalidCount,
   190→        },
   191→      });
   192→    }
   193→
   194→    const now = Date.now();
   195→    const recentClips = parsedPendingClips.entries.filter(
   196→      clip => now - clip.timestamp < PENDING_CLIPS_TTL_MS,
   197→    );
   198→    const scopedRecentClips = recentClips.filter((clip) =>
   199→      isPendingJoinClipInScope(clip, { projectId, userId }),
   200→    );
   201→
   202→    if (scopedRecentClips.length === 0) {
   203→      localStorage.removeItem(pendingSource.key);
   204→      return operationSuccess([], {
   205→        ...(parsedPendingClips.invalidCount > 0 ? { policy: 'degrade' } : {}),
   206→      });
   207→    }
   208→
   209→    const actions = await toPendingClipActions(scopedRecentClips, readVideoDuration);
   210→
   211→    localStorage.removeItem(pendingSource.key);
   212→    return operationSuccess(actions, {
   213→      ...(parsedPendingClips.invalidCount > 0 ? { policy: 'degrade' } : {}),
   214→    });
   215→  } catch (error) {
   216→    normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'JoinClipsPage', showToast: false });
   217→    return operationFailure(error, {
   218→      policy: 'degrade',
   219→      errorCode: 'pending_join_clips_read_failed',
   220→      message: 'Failed to consume pending join clips',
   221→      recoverable: true,
   222→      cause: error,
   223→    });
   224→  }
   225→}
   226→
   227→/**
   228→ * Apply pending clip actions to an existing clips array.
   229→ * Resolves each deferred action by filling the first available empty slot,
   230→ * or appending when no empty slots remain.
   231→ */
   232→export function applyPendingClipActions(
   233→  prevClips: VideoClip[],
   234→  actions: PendingClipAction[],
   235→): VideoClip[] {
   236→  let clips = [...prevClips];
   237→  // Track which indices have been filled by previous actions in this batch
   238→  const filledIndices = new Set<number>();
   239→
   240→  for (const action of actions) {
   241→    const emptyIndex = clips.findIndex(
   242→      (clip, idx) => !clip.url && !filledIndices.has(idx),
   243→    );
   244→
   245→    if (emptyIndex !== -1) {
   246→      clips = clips.map((clip, idx) =>
   247→        idx === emptyIndex
   248→          ? {
   249→              ...clip,
   250→              url: action.clip.url,
   251→              posterUrl: action.clip.posterUrl,
   252→              durationSeconds: action.clip.durationSeconds,
   253→              loaded: false,
   254→              playing: false,
   255→              generationId: action.clip.generationId,
   256→            }
   257→          : clip,
   258→      );
   259→      filledIndices.add(emptyIndex);
   260→    } else {
   261→      clips = [...clips, action.clip];
   262→    }
   263→  }
   264→
   265→  return clips;
   266→}

    91→/**
    92→ * Unified edit settings persistence hook
    93→ *
    94→ * Coordinates:
    95→ * 1. Per-generation settings (generations.params.ui.editSettings)
    96→ * 2. "Last used" settings (useToolSettings + localStorage)
    97→ *
    98→ * Loading behavior:
    99→ * - If generation has persisted settings → use those (including prompt)
   100→ * - If no persisted settings → use "last used" (prompt = '')
   101→ *
   102→ * Saving behavior:
   103→ * - All changes save to generation
   104→ * - Non-prompt changes also update "last used"
   105→ */
   106→export function useEditSettingsPersistence({
   107→  generationId,
   108→  projectId,
   109→  enabled = true,
   110→}: UseEditSettingsPersistenceProps): UseEditSettingsPersistenceReturn {
   111→  // Per-generation settings
   112→  const generationSettings = useGenerationEditSettings({
   113→    generationId,
   114→    enabled,
   115→  });
   116→
   117→  // "Last used" settings
   118→  const lastUsedSettings = useLastUsedEditSettings({
   119→    projectId,
   120→    enabled,
   121→  });
   122→
   123→  // Track initialization state
   124→  const hasInitializedRef = useRef(false);
   125→  const lastGenerationIdRef = useRef<string | null>(null);
   126→  const [isReady, setIsReady] = useState(false);
   127→
   128→  // Reset initialization on generation change
   129→  useEffect(() => {
   130→    if (generationId !== lastGenerationIdRef.current) {
   131→      hasInitializedRef.current = false;
   132→      lastGenerationIdRef.current = generationId;
   133→      setIsReady(false);
   134→    }
   135→  }, [generationId]);
   136→
   137→  // Extract stable references for the initialization effect
   138→  const { isLoading: genIsLoading, hasPersistedSettings, initializeFromLastUsed } = generationSettings;
   139→  const { lastUsed } = lastUsedSettings;
   140→
   141→  // Initialize from "last used" when generation loads without persisted settings
   142→  useEffect(() => {
   143→    if (!genIsLoading && !hasInitializedRef.current && !hasPersistedSettings && generationId) {
   144→      hasInitializedRef.current = true;
   145→      // Apply "last used" settings (without prompt)
   146→      initializeFromLastUsed(lastUsed);
   147→      setIsReady(true);
   148→    } else if (!genIsLoading && !hasInitializedRef.current && hasPersistedSettings) {
   149→      hasInitializedRef.current = true;
   150→      setIsReady(true);
   151→    }
   152→  }, [generationId, genIsLoading, hasPersistedSettings, initializeFromLastUsed, lastUsed]);
   153→
   154→  // Compute effective values
   155→  // editMode is ALWAYS from lastUsed (user-level, not per-generation) so it stays consistent across images/videos
   156→  // Other settings like prompt, loraMode are per-generation
   157→  const effectiveSettings = useMemo(() => {
   158→    if (generationSettings.isLoading) {
   159→      // Still loading, use defaults but editMode from lastUsed
   160→      return {
   161→        ...DEFAULT_EDIT_SETTINGS,
   162→        editMode: lastUsedSettings.lastUsed.editMode,
   163→      };
   164→    }
   165→
   166→    if (generationSettings.hasPersistedSettings) {
   167→      // Has persisted settings, use them BUT override editMode with lastUsed (user-level)
   168→      return {
   169→        ...generationSettings.settings,
   170→        editMode: lastUsedSettings.lastUsed.editMode,
   171→      };
   172→    }
   173→
   174→    // No persisted settings yet.
   175→    // Before the coordinator finishes initialization, we use lastUsed as defaults.
   176→    // After initialization, always prefer the live generationSettings state so controls
   177→    // (like the Img2Img strength slider) never feel "locked" while the debounced save runs.
   178→    if (!isReady) {
   179→      return {
   180→        editMode: lastUsedSettings.lastUsed.editMode,
   181→        loraMode: lastUsedSettings.lastUsed.loraMode,
   182→        customLoraUrl: lastUsedSettings.lastUsed.customLoraUrl,
   183→        numGenerations: lastUsedSettings.lastUsed.numGenerations,
   184→        prompt: generationSettings.settings.prompt || '',
   185→        img2imgPrompt: generationSettings.settings.img2imgPrompt || '',
   186→        img2imgPromptHasBeenSet: generationSettings.settings.img2imgPromptHasBeenSet || false,
   187→        img2imgStrength: lastUsedSettings.lastUsed.img2imgStrength,
   188→        img2imgEnablePromptExpansion: lastUsedSettings.lastUsed.img2imgEnablePromptExpansion,

1→/**
     2→ * Global Settings Write Queue
     3→ *
     4→ * Prevents network exhaustion by serializing and coalescing settings writes.
     5→ *
     6→ * Features:
     7→ * - Global concurrency limit (default: 1 in-flight write)
     8→ * - Per-target debouncing (coalesces rapid updates)
     9→ * - Merge-on-write (latest patch wins per field)
    10→ * - Optional AbortSignal passthrough for caller cancellation
    11→ * - Best-effort flush on page unload
    12→ *
    13→ * @see settings_system.md for the full settings architecture
    14→ */
    15→
    16→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
    17→
    18→export interface QueuedWrite {
    19→  scope: 'user' | 'project' | 'shot';
    20→  entityId: string;
    21→  toolId: string;
    22→  patch: Record<string, unknown>;
    23→  signal?: AbortSignal;
    24→}
    25→
    26→interface PendingWrite {
    27→  write: QueuedWrite;
    28→  resolvers: Array<{ resolve: (value: unknown) => void; reject: (error: unknown) => void }>;
    29→  timerId: NodeJS.Timeout | null;
    30→  enqueuedAt: number;
    31→}
    32→
    33→// Configuration
    34→const DEBOUNCE_MS = 300;
    35→const MAX_CONCURRENT = 1;
    36→
    37→// State
    38→const pendingByTarget = new Map<string, PendingWrite>();
    39→let inFlightCount = 0;
    40→const flushQueue: Array<{ targetKey: string; pending: PendingWrite }> = [];
    41→
    42→// The actual write function - injected to avoid circular imports
    43→let writeFunction: ((write: QueuedWrite) => Promise<unknown>) | null = null;
    44→
    45→function createAbortError(): Error {
    46→  if (typeof DOMException !== 'undefined') {
    47→    return new DOMException('Request was cancelled', 'AbortError');
    48→  }
    49→  const error = new Error('Request was cancelled');
    50→  error.name = 'AbortError';

1→interface BuildVideoLightboxLayoutStateInput {

    15→interface VideoLightboxLayoutState {
    16→  shouldShowSidePanelWithTrim: boolean;
    17→  showPanel: boolean;
    18→  needsFullscreenLayout: boolean;
    19→  needsTasksPaneOffset: boolean;
    20→  panelVariant: 'desktop' | 'mobile';
    21→}
    22→
    23→export function buildVideoLightboxLayoutState(
    24→  input: BuildVideoLightboxLayoutStateInput,
    25→): VideoLightboxLayoutState {
    26→  const shouldShowSidePanelWithTrim = input.shouldShowSidePanel
    27→    || ((!input.isPortraitMode && input.isTabletOrLarger) && input.isAnyVideoEditMode);
    28→
    29→  const showPanel = shouldShowSidePanelWithTrim
    30→    || ((input.showTaskDetails || input.isAnyVideoEditMode || (input.isSegmentSlotMode && input.hasSegmentVideo)) && input.isMobile);
    31→
    32→  const needsFullscreenLayout = input.isMobile
    33→    || input.isFormOnlyMode
    34→    || input.shouldShowSidePanel
    35→    || shouldShowSidePanelWithTrim;
    36→
    37→  const needsTasksPaneOffset = needsFullscreenLayout
    38→    && (input.effectiveTasksPaneOpen || input.isTasksPaneLocked)
    39→    && !input.isPortraitMode
    40→    && input.isTabletOrLarger;
    41→
    42→  const panelVariant = (shouldShowSidePanelWithTrim && !input.isMobile)
    43→    ? 'desktop'
    44→    : 'mobile';
    45→
    46→  return {
    47→    shouldShowSidePanelWithTrim,
    48→    showPanel,
    49→    needsFullscreenLayout,
    50→    needsTasksPaneOffset,
    51→    panelVariant,
    52→  };
    53→}

    16→export function ShotAdditionSelectionProvider({ children }: ShotAdditionSelectionProviderProps) {

1→/**
     2→ * Timeline Frame Calculators
     3→ *
     4→ * Pure functions for timeline frame position calculations:
     5→ * - Gap finding and frame distribution
     6→ * - Normalization (compress gaps, shift to start at 0)
     7→ * - Position calculation for drag-and-drop operations
     8→ *
     9→ * No React hooks or side effects - all functions are stateless.
    10→ */
    11→
    12→import type { ShotGeneration } from '@/shared/hooks/useTimelineCore';
    13→import { calculateAverageSpacing, DEFAULT_FRAME_SPACING } from '@/shared/lib/timelinePositionCalculator';
    14→
    15→/** Maximum allowed gap between timeline frames (5s at 16fps). */
    16→const MAX_FRAME_GAP = 81;
    17→
    18→// ============================================================================
    19→// Types
    20→// ============================================================================
    21→
    22→interface FrameUpdate {
    23→  id: string;
    24→  newFrame: number;
    25→  reason: string;
    26→}
    27→
    28→// ============================================================================
    29→// Normalization
    30→// ============================================================================
    31→
    32→/**
    33→ * Normalize a set of final positions: start at 0, compress gaps > MAX_FRAME_GAP.
    34→ * Returns a map of id -> { newFrame, reason } for items that need updating.
    35→ * @internal Used only within this module by buildAndNormalizeFinalPositions.
    36→ */
    37→function normalizePositions(
    38→  allFinalPositions: Array<{ id: string; frame: number }>
    39→): Map<string, { newFrame: number; reason: string }> {
    40→  const normalizedUpdates = new Map<string, { newFrame: number; reason: string }>();
    41→
    42→  if (allFinalPositions.length === 0) return normalizedUpdates;
    43→
    44→  // Sort by frame position
    45→  const sorted = [...allFinalPositions].sort((a, b) => a.frame - b.frame);
    46→
    47→  let currentFrame = 0;
    48→
    49→  for (let i = 0; i < sorted.length; i++) {
    50→    const item = sorted[i];
    51→
    52→    if (i === 0) {
    53→      if (item.frame !== 0) {
    54→        normalizedUpdates.set(item.id, { newFrame: 0, reason: 'Normalized to start at 0' });
    55→      }
    56→      currentFrame = 0;
    57→    } else {
    58→      const prevItem = sorted[i - 1];
    59→      const originalGap = item.frame - prevItem.frame;
    60→      const normalizedGap = Math.min(originalGap, MAX_FRAME_GAP);
    61→      const normalizedFrame = currentFrame + normalizedGap;
    62→
    63→      if (normalizedFrame !== item.frame) {
    64→        normalizedUpdates.set(item.id, {
    65→          newFrame: normalizedFrame,
    66→          reason: originalGap > MAX_FRAME_GAP
    67→            ? `Gap compressed from ${originalGap} to ${normalizedGap}`
    68→            : 'Shifted to maintain sequence'
    69→        });
    70→      }
    71→      currentFrame = normalizedFrame;
    72→    }
    73→  }
    74→
    75→  return normalizedUpdates;
    76→}
    77→
    78→// ============================================================================
    79→// Frame distribution for drag-and-drop
    80→// ============================================================================
    81→
    82→/**
    83→ * Find a ShotGeneration by canonical shot_generations.id.
    84→ */
    85→export function findGeneration(
    86→  shotGenerations: ShotGeneration[],
    87→  key?: string | null
    88→): ShotGeneration | undefined {
    89→  if (!key) return undefined;
    90→  return shotGenerations.find(sg => sg.id === key);
    91→}
    92→
    93→interface DistributionContext {
    94→  draggedShotGens: ShotGeneration[];
    95→  draggedItemIds: string[];
    96→  newStartIndex: number;
    97→  allItems: Array<{ id: string; timeline_frame: number | null }>;
    98→  shotGenerations: ShotGeneration[];
    99→}
   100→
   101→/**
   102→ * Calculate frame positions for dragged items based on their new position in the list.
   103→ * Returns accumulated updates (not yet deduplicated or normalized).
   104→ */
   105→export function calculateDistributedFrames(ctx: DistributionContext): FrameUpdate[] {
   106→  const { draggedShotGens, draggedItemIds, newStartIndex, allItems, shotGenerations } = ctx;
   107→  const accumulateUpdates: FrameUpdate[] = [];
   108→
   109→  const pushUpdate = (id: string, frame: number, reason: string) => {
   110→    const normalizedFrame = Math.max(0, Math.floor(frame));
   111→    accumulateUpdates.push({ id, newFrame: normalizedFrame, reason });
   112→  };
   113→
   114→  const newEndIndex = newStartIndex + draggedItemIds.length - 1;
   115→  const predecessor = newStartIndex > 0 ? allItems[newStartIndex - 1] : null;
   116→  const successor = newEndIndex < allItems.length - 1 ? allItems[newEndIndex + 1] : null;
   117→
   118→  if (newStartIndex === 0 && successor) {
   119→    // Special case: dropping at position 0
   120→    calculateDropAtPositionZero(
   121→      draggedShotGens, draggedItemIds, newEndIndex, allItems, shotGenerations, successor, pushUpdate
   122→    );
   123→  } else if (predecessor && successor && predecessor.timeline_frame != null && successor.timeline_frame != null) {
   124→    // Between two items - distribute evenly in the gap
   125→    const gap = successor.timeline_frame - predecessor.timeline_frame;
   126→    const numItems = draggedItemIds.length;
   127→    const interval = gap / (numItems + 1);
   128→
   129→    draggedShotGens.forEach((sg, i) => {
   130→      const newFrame = predecessor.timeline_frame! + (interval * (i + 1));
   131→      pushUpdate(sg.id, newFrame, `Distributed in gap (${i + 1}/${numItems})`);
   132→    });
   133→  } else if (predecessor && predecessor.timeline_frame != null) {
   134→    // At end - extend timeline using average spacing of existing items
   135→    const existingFrames = allItems
   136→      .filter(item => item.timeline_frame != null)
   137→      .map(item => item.timeline_frame!);
   138→    const spacing = calculateAverageSpacing(existingFrames, DEFAULT_FRAME_SPACING);
   139→
   140→    draggedShotGens.forEach((sg, i) => {
   141→      const newFrame = predecessor.timeline_frame! + (spacing * (i + 1));
   142→      pushUpdate(sg.id, newFrame, `Extend at end (${i + 1}/${draggedItemIds.length})`);
   143→    });
   144→  } else if (successor && successor.timeline_frame != null) {
   145→    // At start - distribute between 0 and successor
   146→    const gap = successor.timeline_frame;
   147→    const numItems = draggedItemIds.length;
   148→    const interval = gap / (numItems + 1);
   149→
   150→    draggedShotGens.forEach((sg, i) => {
   151→      const newFrame = interval * (i + 1);
   152→      pushUpdate(sg.id, newFrame, `Distributed from start (${i + 1}/${numItems})`);
   153→    });
   154→  } else {
   155→    // First items in timeline - start at 0 and space by default
   156→
   157→    draggedShotGens.forEach((sg, i) => {
   158→      const newFrame = DEFAULT_FRAME_SPACING * i;
   159→      pushUpdate(sg.id, newFrame, `Initial placement (${i + 1}/${draggedItemIds.length})`);
   160→    });
   161→  }
   162→
   163→  return accumulateUpdates;
   164→}
   165→
   166→/**
   167→ * Handle the special case of dropping items at position 0.
   168→ */
   169→function calculateDropAtPositionZero(
   170→  draggedShotGens: ShotGeneration[],
   171→  draggedItemIds: string[],
   172→  newEndIndex: number,
   173→  allItems: Array<{ id: string; timeline_frame: number | null }>,
   174→  shotGenerations: ShotGeneration[],
   175→  successor: { id: string; timeline_frame: number | null },
   176→  pushUpdate: (id: string, frame: number, reason: string) => void
   177→) {
   178→  const displacedFirstItem = successor;
   179→  const oldSecondItem = newEndIndex + 2 < allItems.length ? allItems[newEndIndex + 2] : null;
   180→
   181→  // First dragged item goes to frame 0
   182→  pushUpdate(draggedShotGens[0].id, 0, 'First item at position 0');
   183→
   184→  // Calculate new position for displaced first item
   185→  let displacedNewFrame: number;
   186→  if (oldSecondItem?.timeline_frame != null) {
   187→    displacedNewFrame = Math.floor((0 + oldSecondItem.timeline_frame) / 2);
   188→  } else if (displacedFirstItem.timeline_frame != null) {
   189→    displacedNewFrame = Math.max(DEFAULT_FRAME_SPACING, displacedFirstItem.timeline_frame);
   190→  } else {
   191→    displacedNewFrame = DEFAULT_FRAME_SPACING;
   192→  }
   193→
   194→  // Update displaced item
   195→  const displacedShotGen = findGeneration(shotGenerations, displacedFirstItem.id);
   196→  if (displacedShotGen?.id) {
   197→    pushUpdate(displacedShotGen.id, displacedNewFrame, 'Displaced first item shifted');
   198→  }
   199→
   200→  // Distribute remaining dragged items between 0 and displaced item's new position
   201→  if (draggedItemIds.length > 1) {
   202→    const numRemaining = draggedItemIds.length - 1;
   203→    const gap = displacedNewFrame;
   204→    const interval = gap / (numRemaining + 1);
   205→
   206→    for (let i = 1; i < draggedItemIds.length; i++) {
   207→      const newFrame = interval * i;
   208→      pushUpdate(draggedShotGens[i].id, newFrame, `Distributed after first (${i}/${draggedItemIds.length})`);
   209→    }
   210→  }
   211→}
   212→
   213→// ============================================================================
   214→// Update deduplication
   215→// ============================================================================
   216→
   217→/**
   218→ * Deduplicate frame updates (last write wins per id).
   219→ */
   220→export function deduplicateUpdates(
   221→  updates: FrameUpdate[]
   222→): Map<string, { newFrame: number; reason: string }> {
   223→  const uniqueUpdates = new Map<string, { newFrame: number; reason: string }>();
   224→  updates.forEach(entry => {
   225→    const existing = uniqueUpdates.get(entry.id);
   226→    if (!existing || existing.newFrame !== entry.newFrame) {
   227→      uniqueUpdates.set(entry.id, { newFrame: entry.newFrame, reason: entry.reason });
   228→    }
   229→  });
   230→  return uniqueUpdates;
   231→}
   232→
   233→/**
   234→ * Build the complete picture of final positions (updated + unchanged) for all positioned items,
   235→ * then normalize and merge back into the updates map.
   236→ */
   237→export function buildAndNormalizeFinalPositions(
   238→  uniqueUpdates: Map<string, { newFrame: number; reason: string }>,
   239→  shotGenerations: ShotGeneration[]
   240→): Map<string, { newFrame: number; reason: string }> {
   241→  const allFinalPositions: Array<{ id: string; frame: number }> = [];
   242→
   243→  for (const sg of shotGenerations) {
   244→    if (sg.timeline_frame == null || sg.timeline_frame < 0) continue;
   245→    const update = uniqueUpdates.get(sg.id);
   246→    const finalFrame = update ? update.newFrame : sg.timeline_frame;
   247→    allFinalPositions.push({ id: sg.id, frame: finalFrame });
   248→  }
   249→
   250→  allFinalPositions.sort((a, b) => a.frame - b.frame);
   251→
   252→  if (allFinalPositions.length === 0) return uniqueUpdates;
   253→
   254→  const normalizedUpdates = normalizePositions(allFinalPositions);
   255→
   256→  // Merge normalized updates into uniqueUpdates
   257→  for (const [id, payload] of normalizedUpdates) {
   258→    const existing = uniqueUpdates.get(id);
   259→    if (existing) {
   260→      uniqueUpdates.set(id, { newFrame: payload.newFrame, reason: `${existing.reason} → ${payload.reason}` });

   263→    }
   264→  }

   266→  return uniqueUpdates;
