   112→  video_edit?: JoinClipsVideoEditConfig;
   113→}
   114→
   115→/**
   116→ * Task defaults in snake_case, auto-derived from the tool's settings.ts.
   117→ * joinClipsSettings.defaults already spreads VACE_GENERATION_DEFAULTS,
   118→ * so per-tool overrides (e.g., guidanceScale: 5.0) flow through automatically.
   119→ */
   120→const TASK_DEFAULTS = camelToSnakeKeys(joinClipsSettings.defaults);
   121→
   122→type JoinMode = 'multi_clip_join' | 'video_edit_join';
   123→
   124→interface NormalizedJoinClipsParams {
   125→  clipSequence: JoinClipDescriptor[];
   126→  clipSourceKind: JoinClipsClipSource['kind'];
   127→  joinMode: JoinMode;
   128→  videoEdit?: JoinClipsVideoEditConfig;
   129→}
   130→
   131→const PER_JOIN_OVERRIDE_KEYS = [
   132→  'prompt',
   133→  'gap_frame_count',
   134→  'context_frame_count',
   135→  'replace_mode',
   136→  'model',
   137→  'num_inference_steps',
   138→  'guidance_scale',
   139→  'seed',
   140→  'negative_prompt',
   141→  'priority',
   142→  'resolution',
   143→  'fps',
   144→] as const satisfies readonly (keyof JoinClipsPerJoinSettings)[];
   145→
   146→function buildJoinOverrideRecord(
   147→  override?: JoinClipsPerJoinSettings,
   148→): Record<string, unknown> {
   149→  if (!override) {
   150→    return {};
   151→  }
   152→
   153→  const joinSettings: Record<string, unknown> = {};
   154→  for (const key of PER_JOIN_OVERRIDE_KEYS) {
   155→    const value = override[key];
   156→    if (value !== undefined) {
   157→      joinSettings[key] = value;
   158→    }
   159→  }
   160→
   161→  if (override.loras && override.loras.length > 0) {
   162→    joinSettings.additional_loras = mapPathLorasToStrengthRecord(override.loras);
   163→  }
   164→
   165→  return joinSettings;
   166→}
   167→
   168→/**
   169→ * Build phase config for join clips (always uses VACE since we're joining existing videos).
   170→ * User-selected LoRAs are added to every phase at their specified strength.
   171→ * 
   172→ * @param userLoras - User-selected LoRAs to add to every phase
   173→ * @returns PhaseConfig for VACE model
   174→ */
   175→function buildJoinClipsPhaseConfig(
   176→  userLoras: PathLoraConfig[] = []
   177→): PhaseConfig {
   178→  return buildPhaseConfigWithLoras(userLoras);
   179→}
   180→
   181→/**
   182→ * Builds the ordered clip sequence from the provided parameters.
   183→ */
   184→function buildClipSequenceFromSource(source: JoinClipsClipSource): JoinClipDescriptor[] {
   185→  return source.clips.map((clip) => ({
   186→    url: clip.url,
   187→    ...(clip.name ? { name: clip.name } : {}),
   188→  }));
   189→}
   190→
   191→/**
   192→ * Validates join clips task parameters and returns the normalized clip sequence
   193→ * 
   194→ * @param params - Parameters to validate
   195→ * @throws TaskValidationError if validation fails
   196→ */
   197→function normalizeJoinClipsParams(params: CanonicalJoinClipsTaskInput): NormalizedJoinClipsParams {
   198→  validateRequiredFields(params, [
   199→    'project_id'
   200→  ]);
   201→
   202→  const clipSource = params.clip_source;
   203→  const clipSequence = buildClipSequenceFromSource(clipSource);
   204→
   205→  if (clipSequence.length < 2) {
   206→    throw new TaskValidationError("At least two clips are required to create a join", 'clips');
   207→  }
   208→
   209→  clipSequence.forEach((clip, index) => {
   210→    try {
   211→      validateNonEmptyString(clip.url, `clips[${index}]`, `Clip ${index + 1} URL`);
   212→    } catch {
   213→      throw new TaskValidationError(`Clip at position ${index} is missing a URL`, 'clips');
   214→    }
   215→  });
   216→
   217→  const joinsCount = clipSequence.length - 1;
   218→
   219→  if (params.per_join_settings && params.per_join_settings.length > joinsCount) {
   220→    throw new TaskValidationError(
   221→      "per_join_settings length cannot exceed the number of joins",
   222→      'per_join_settings'
   223→    );
   224→  }
   225→
   226→  const videoEdit = params.video_edit;
   227→  if (params.mode === 'video_edit' && !videoEdit) {
   228→    throw new TaskValidationError(
   229→      "video_edit config is required when mode is video_edit",
   230→      'mode',
   231→    );
   232→  }
   233→  if (videoEdit && !videoEdit.source_video_url) {
   234→    throw new TaskValidationError(
   235→      "video_edit.source_video_url is required when video_edit config is provided",
   236→      'video_edit',
   237→    );
   238→  }
   239→  if (params.mode !== 'video_edit' && videoEdit) {
   240→    throw new TaskValidationError(
   241→      "video_edit config can only be provided when mode is video_edit",
   242→      'mode',
   243→    );
   244→  }
   245→  if (params.mode === 'multi_clip' && clipSource.kind !== 'clips') {
   246→    throw new TaskValidationError(
   247→      "clip_source.kind must be clips when mode is multi_clip",
   248→      'mode',
   249→    );
   250→  }
   251→
   252→  const joinMode: JoinMode = params.mode === 'video_edit'
   253→    ? 'video_edit_join'
   254→    : 'multi_clip_join';
   255→
   256→  return {
   257→    clipSequence,
   258→    clipSourceKind: clipSource.kind,
   259→    joinMode,
   260→    videoEdit,
   261→  };
   262→}
   263→
   264→/**
   265→ * Builds the orchestrator payload for join clips
   266→ * 
   267→ * @param params - Raw join clips parameters
   268→ * @param clipSequence - Normalized list of clips in order
   269→ * @param runId - Generated run ID
   270→ * @param orchestratorTaskId - Generated orchestrator task ID
   271→ * @returns Processed orchestrator payload
   272→ */
   273→function buildJoinClipsPayload(
   274→  params: CanonicalJoinClipsTaskInput,
   275→  normalized: NormalizedJoinClipsParams,
   276→  runId: string,
   277→  orchestratorTaskId: string
   278→): Record<string, unknown> {
   279→  const clipSequence = normalized.clipSequence;
   280→  // Use provided phase config (advanced mode) or build from LoRAs (basic mode)
   281→  const phaseConfig = params.phase_config || buildJoinClipsPhaseConfig(params.loras || []);
   282→  
   283→  const orchestratorDetails: Record<string, unknown> = {
   284→    orchestrator_task_id: orchestratorTaskId,
   285→    clip_list: clipSequence.map(clip => ({
   286→      url: clip.url,
   287→      ...(clip.name ? { name: clip.name } : {}),
   288→    })),
   289→    run_id: runId,
   290→    shot_id: params.shot_id ?? undefined, // For "Visit Shot" button in TasksPane
   291→    prompt: params.prompt ?? TASK_DEFAULTS.prompt,
   292→    gap_frame_count: params.gap_frame_count ?? TASK_DEFAULTS.gap_frame_count,
   293→    context_frame_count: params.context_frame_count ?? TASK_DEFAULTS.context_frame_count,
   294→    replace_mode: params.replace_mode ?? TASK_DEFAULTS.replace_mode,
   295→    keep_bridging_images: params.keep_bridging_images, // Optional, defaults to undefined (backend handles default)
   296→    enhance_prompt: params.enhance_prompt ?? TASK_DEFAULTS.enhance_prompt,
   297→    model: params.model ?? TASK_DEFAULTS.model,
   298→    num_inference_steps: params.num_inference_steps ?? TASK_DEFAULTS.num_inference_steps,
   299→    guidance_scale: params.guidance_scale ?? TASK_DEFAULTS.guidance_scale,
   300→    seed: params.seed ?? TASK_DEFAULTS.seed,
   301→    negative_prompt: params.negative_prompt ?? TASK_DEFAULTS.negative_prompt,
   302→    priority: params.priority ?? TASK_DEFAULTS.priority,
   303→    parent_generation_id: params.parent_generation_id,
   304→    // UNIFIED: Always include phase_config and advanced_mode for consistent backend processing
   305→    phase_config: phaseConfig,
   306→    advanced_mode: true,
   307→    // Motion settings for UI state restoration
   308→    motion_mode: params.motion_mode ?? TASK_DEFAULTS.motion_mode,
   309→    selected_phase_preset_id: params.selected_phase_preset_id ?? TASK_DEFAULTS.selected_phase_preset_id,
   310→  };
   311→
   312→  assignMappedPayloadFields(orchestratorDetails, params, [
   313→    { from: 'resolution' },
   314→    { from: 'fps' },
   315→    { from: 'use_input_video_resolution' },
   316→    { from: 'use_input_video_fps' },
   317→    { from: 'audio_url' },
   318→  ]);
   319→
   320→  assignMappedPayloadFields(orchestratorDetails, params, [
   321→    {
   322→      from: 'vid2vid_init_strength',
   323→      include: (value) => typeof value === 'number' && value > 0,
   324→    },
   325→  ]);
   326→
   327→  if (params.loop_first_clip) {
   328→    orchestratorDetails.loop_first_clip = true;
   329→  }
   330→
   331→  // Pass based_on for variant creation when looping a clip from "Add to Join"
   332→  if (params.based_on) {
   333→    orchestratorDetails.based_on = params.based_on;
   334→  }
   335→
   336→  // Keep additional_loras for backward compatibility, but LoRAs are now primarily in phase_config
   337→  if (params.loras && params.loras.length > 0) {
   338→    orchestratorDetails.additional_loras = mapPathLorasToStrengthRecord(params.loras);
   339→  }
   340→  
   341→  // Video edit mode - for regenerating portions of a single video
   342→  if (normalized.videoEdit) {
   343→    orchestratorDetails.video_edit_mode = true;
   344→    orchestratorDetails.source_video_url = normalized.videoEdit.source_video_url;
   345→    orchestratorDetails.source_video_fps = normalized.videoEdit.source_video_fps;
   346→    orchestratorDetails.source_video_duration = normalized.videoEdit.source_video_duration;
   347→    orchestratorDetails.source_video_total_frames = normalized.videoEdit.source_video_total_frames;
   348→    orchestratorDetails.portions_to_regenerate = normalized.videoEdit.portions_to_regenerate;
   349→  }
   350→
   351→  const totalJoins = Math.max(clipSequence.length - 1, 0);
   352→  if (totalJoins > 0) {
   353→    const perJoinOverrides: Record<string, unknown>[] = [];
   354→    let hasOverrides = false;
   355→
   356→    for (let index = 0; index < totalJoins; index++) {
   357→      const joinSettings = buildJoinOverrideRecord(params.per_join_settings?.[index]);
   358→
   359→      if (Object.keys(joinSettings).length > 0) {
   360→        hasOverrides = true;
   361→        perJoinOverrides.push(joinSettings);
   362→      } else {
   363→        perJoinOverrides.push({});
   364→      }
   365→    }
   366→
   367→    if (hasOverrides) {
   368→      orchestratorDetails.per_join_settings = perJoinOverrides;
   369→    }
   370→  }
   371→
   372→  const resolutionDisplay = params.resolution
   373→    ? `${params.resolution[0]}x${params.resolution[1]}`
   374→    : undefined;
   375→
   376→  const joinMode = normalized.joinMode;
   377→
   378→  const perJoinOverridesCount = params.per_join_settings?.filter((override) =>
   379→    !!override && Object.keys(override).length > 0
   380→  ).length ?? 0;
   381→
   382→  const familyContract = buildJoinClipsFamilyContract({
   383→    mode: joinMode,
   384→    runId,
   385→    clipUrls: clipSequence.map((clip) => clip.url),
   386→    overridesCount: perJoinOverridesCount,
   387→    hasAudio: Boolean(params.audio_url),
   388→  });
   389→
   390→  const payload = composeTaskFamilyPayload({
   391→    taskFamily: 'join_clips',
   392→    orchestratorDetails,
   393→    orchestrationInput: {
   394→      taskFamily: 'join_clips',
   395→      orchestratorTaskId,
   396→      runId,
   397→      parentGenerationId: params.parent_generation_id,
   398→      shotId: params.shot_id,
   399→      basedOn: params.based_on,
   400→      generationRouting: 'orchestrator',
   401→      siblingLookup: 'run_id',
   402→    },
   403→    taskViewInput: {
   404→      inputImages: clipSequence.map((clip) => clip.url),
   405→      prompt: params.prompt,
   406→      negativePrompt: params.negative_prompt,
   407→      modelName: params.model,
   408→      resolution: resolutionDisplay,
   409→    },
   410→    familyContract,
   411→  });
   412→
   413→  return {
   414→    ...payload,
   415→    parent_generation_id: params.parent_generation_id,
   416→    // Only include tool_type if explicitly passed (Join Clips page passes it, ShotEditor doesn't)
   417→    ...(params.tool_type && { tool_type: params.tool_type }),
   418→  };
   419→}
   420→
   421→/**
   422→ * Creates a join clips task using the unified approach
   423→ * 
   424→ * @param params - Join clips task parameters
   425→ * @returns Promise resolving to the created task
   426→ */
   427→export async function createCanonicalJoinClipsTask(
   428→  params: CanonicalJoinClipsTaskInput,
   429→): Promise<TaskCreationResult> {
   430→  return runTaskCreationPipeline({
   431→    params,
   432→    context: 'JoinClips',
   433→    buildTaskRequest: (requestParams) => {
   434→      const normalized = normalizeJoinClipsParams(requestParams);
   435→      const orchestratorTaskId = generateTaskId("join_clips_orchestrator");
   436→      const runId = requestParams.run_id ?? generateRunId();
   437→      const orchestratorPayload = buildJoinClipsPayload(
   438→        requestParams,
   439→        normalized,
   440→        runId,
   441→        orchestratorTaskId,
   442→      );
   443→
   444→      return composeTaskRequest({
   445→        source: requestParams,
   446→        taskType: 'join_clips_orchestrator',
   447→        params: orchestratorPayload,
   448→      });
   449→    },
   450→  });
   451→}
   452→
   453→// TaskValidationError is used internally - import from taskCreation.ts if needed externally
   454→

    86→export interface VideoEnhanceTaskParams {

   109→/**
   110→ * Validates video enhancement task parameters
   111→ */
   112→function validateVideoEnhanceParams(params: VideoEnhanceTaskParams): void {
   113→  validateRequiredFields(params, ['project_id', 'video_url']);
   114→
   115→  if (!params.enable_interpolation && !params.enable_upscale) {
   116→    throw new TaskValidationError(
   117→      "At least one enhancement mode (interpolation or upscale) must be enabled",
   118→      'enable_interpolation'
   119→    );
   120→  }
   121→
   122→  // Validate interpolation params if enabled
   123→  if (params.enable_interpolation && params.interpolation?.num_frames !== undefined) {
   124→    if (params.interpolation.num_frames < 1 || params.interpolation.num_frames > 4) {
   125→      throw new TaskValidationError(
   126→        "num_frames must be between 1 and 4",
   127→        'interpolation.num_frames'
   128→      );
   129→    }
   130→  }
   131→
   132→  // Validate upscale params if enabled
   133→  if (params.enable_upscale && params.upscale?.upscale_factor !== undefined) {
   134→    if (params.upscale.upscale_factor < 1 || params.upscale.upscale_factor > 4) {
   135→      throw new TaskValidationError(
   136→        "upscale_factor must be between 1 and 4",
   137→        'upscale.upscale_factor'
   138→      );
   139→    }
   140→  }
   141→}
   142→
   143→/**
   144→ * Builds the task payload for video enhancement
   145→ */
   146→function buildVideoEnhancePayload(
   147→  params: VideoEnhanceTaskParams
   148→): Record<string, unknown> {
   149→  const payload: Record<string, unknown> = {
   150→    video_url: params.video_url,
   151→    enable_interpolation: params.enable_interpolation,
   152→    enable_upscale: params.enable_upscale,
   153→  };
   154→
   155→  // Add interpolation params with defaults
   156→  if (params.enable_interpolation) {
   157→    payload.interpolation = {
   158→      num_frames: params.interpolation?.num_frames ?? DEFAULT_FILM_PARAMS.num_frames,
   159→      use_calculated_fps: params.interpolation?.use_calculated_fps ?? DEFAULT_FILM_PARAMS.use_calculated_fps,
   160→      video_quality: params.interpolation?.video_quality ?? DEFAULT_FILM_PARAMS.video_quality,
   161→      // Optional params only if provided
   162→      ...(params.interpolation?.use_scene_detection !== undefined && {
   163→        use_scene_detection: params.interpolation.use_scene_detection,
   164→      }),
   165→      ...(params.interpolation?.loop !== undefined && {
   166→        loop: params.interpolation.loop,
   167→      }),
   168→      ...(params.interpolation?.fps !== undefined && {
   169→        fps: params.interpolation.fps,
   170→      }),
   171→      ...(params.interpolation?.video_write_mode !== undefined && {
   172→        video_write_mode: params.interpolation.video_write_mode,
   173→      }),
   174→    };
   175→  }
   176→
   177→  // Add upscale params with defaults
   178→  if (params.enable_upscale) {
   179→    payload.upscale = {
   180→      upscale_factor: params.upscale?.upscale_factor ?? DEFAULT_FLASHVSR_PARAMS.upscale_factor,
   181→      color_fix: params.upscale?.color_fix ?? DEFAULT_FLASHVSR_PARAMS.color_fix,
   182→      output_quality: params.upscale?.output_quality ?? DEFAULT_FLASHVSR_PARAMS.output_quality,
   183→      // Optional params only if provided
   184→      ...(params.upscale?.quality !== undefined && {
   185→        quality: params.upscale.quality,
   186→      }),
   187→      ...(params.upscale?.acceleration !== undefined && {
   188→        acceleration: params.upscale.acceleration,
   189→      }),
   190→      ...(params.upscale?.output_format !== undefined && {
   191→        output_format: params.upscale.output_format,
   192→      }),
   193→      ...(params.upscale?.output_write_mode !== undefined && {
   194→        output_write_mode: params.upscale.output_write_mode,
   195→      }),
   196→      ...(params.upscale?.preserve_audio !== undefined && {
   197→        preserve_audio: params.upscale.preserve_audio,
   198→      }),
   199→    };
   200→  }
   201→
   202→  // Add metadata
   203→  if (params.shot_id) {
   204→    payload.shot_id = params.shot_id;
   205→  }
   206→  // based_on tells complete_task to create a variant on the source generation
   207→  if (params.based_on) {
   208→    payload.based_on = params.based_on;
   209→    payload.parent_generation_id = params.based_on;
   210→    // is_primary=true makes the enhanced version the main display variant
   211→    payload.is_primary = true;
   212→  }
   213→  // source_variant_id tracks which variant was enhanced (for UI display)
   214→  if (params.source_variant_id) {
   215→    payload.source_variant_id = params.source_variant_id;
   216→  }
   217→
   218→  return payload;
   219→}
   220→
   221→/**
   222→ * Result of creating a video enhancement task
   223→ */
   224→interface VideoEnhanceTaskResult {
   225→  task: TaskCreationResult;
   226→}
   227→
   228→/**
   229→ * Creates a video enhancement task
   230→ *
   231→ * @param params - Video enhancement task parameters
   232→ * @returns Promise resolving to the created task
   233→ */
   234→export async function createVideoEnhanceTask(
   235→  params: VideoEnhanceTaskParams
   236→): Promise<VideoEnhanceTaskResult> {
   237→  return runTaskCreationPipeline({
   238→    params,
   239→    context: 'VideoEnhance',
   240→    validate: validateVideoEnhanceParams,
   241→    buildTaskRequest: (requestParams) => {
   242→      const payload = buildVideoEnhancePayload(requestParams);
   243→
   244→      return composeTaskRequest({
   245→        source: requestParams,
   246→        taskType: 'video_enhance',
   247→        params: {
   248→          tool_type: 'video-enhance',
   249→          ...payload,
   250→        },
   251→      });
   252→    },
   253→    onCreated: (task) => ({ task }),
   254→  });
   255→}

    73→  qwen_edit_model?: 'qwen-edit' | 'qwen-edit-2509' | 'qwen-edit-2511';
    74→}
    75→
    76→/**
    77→ * Validates magic edit task parameters
    78→ * @param params - Parameters to validate
    79→ * @throws TaskValidationError if validation fails
    80→ */
    81→function validateMagicEditParams(params: MagicEditTaskParams): void {
    82→  validateRequiredFields(params, ['project_id', 'prompt', 'image_url']);
    83→
    84→  validateNonEmptyString(params.prompt, 'prompt', 'Prompt');
    85→  validateNonEmptyString(params.image_url, 'image_url', 'Image URL');
    86→  validateUrlString(params.image_url, 'image_url', 'Image URL');
    87→
    88→  if (params.seed !== undefined) {
    89→    try {
    90→      validateSeed32Bit(params.seed, 'seed');
    91→    } catch {
    92→      throw new TaskValidationError('Seed must be a 32-bit positive integer', 'seed');
    93→    }
    94→  }
    95→
    96→  if (params.max_wait_seconds !== undefined && params.max_wait_seconds < 1) {
    97→    throw new TaskValidationError('Max wait seconds must be positive', 'max_wait_seconds');
    98→  }
    99→}
   100→
   101→/**
   102→ * Validates batch magic edit parameters
   103→ * @param params - Parameters to validate
   104→ * @throws TaskValidationError if validation fails
   105→ */
   106→function validateBatchMagicEditParams(params: BatchMagicEditTaskParams): void {
   107→  validateRequiredFields(params, ['project_id', 'prompt', 'image_url', 'numImages']);
   108→
   109→  // Validate numImages
   110→  if (params.numImages < 1 || params.numImages > 16) {
   111→    throw new TaskValidationError('Number of images must be between 1 and 16', 'numImages');
   112→  }
   113→
   114→  // Use single task validation for the rest
   115→  validateMagicEditParams({
   116→    project_id: params.project_id,
   117→    prompt: params.prompt,
   118→    image_url: params.image_url,
   119→    negative_prompt: params.negative_prompt,
   120→    resolution: params.resolution,
   121→    seed: params.seed,
   122→    in_scene: params.in_scene,
   123→    shot_id: params.shot_id,
   124→    output_format: params.output_format,
   125→    enable_sync_mode: params.enable_sync_mode,
   126→    max_wait_seconds: params.max_wait_seconds,
   127→    enable_base64_output: params.enable_base64_output,
   128→  });
   129→}
   130→
   131→/**
   132→ * Builds the task params for an image_edit task
   133→ * This follows the format from the example task you provided
   134→ */
   135→function buildMagicEditTaskParams(
   136→  params: MagicEditTaskParams,
   137→  finalResolution: string
   138→): Record<string, unknown> {
   139→  // Build the task params in the format expected by image_edit
   140→  const taskParams: Record<string, unknown> = {
   141→    seed: resolveSeed32Bit({ seed: params.seed, field: 'seed' }),
   142→    image: params.image_url,
   143→    prompt: params.prompt,
   144→    output_format: params.output_format ?? "jpeg",
   145→    qwen_edit_model: params.qwen_edit_model ?? 'qwen-edit',
   146→    enable_sync_mode: params.enable_sync_mode ?? false,
   147→    max_wait_seconds: params.max_wait_seconds ?? 300,
   148→    enable_base64_output: params.enable_base64_output ?? false,
   149→  };
   150→
   151→  // Add optional parameters if provided
   152→  if (params.negative_prompt) {
   153→    taskParams.negative_prompt = params.negative_prompt;
   154→  }
   155→
   156→  if (params.in_scene !== undefined) {
   157→    taskParams.in_scene = params.in_scene;
   158→  }
   159→
   160→  // Add resolution if needed (some edit models may use this)
   161→  if (finalResolution && finalResolution !== "custom") {
   162→    taskParams.resolution = finalResolution;
   163→  }
   164→
   165→  // Always add add_in_position as false for magic edit tasks (unpositioned by default)
   166→  taskParams.add_in_position = false;
   167→
   168→  // Add loras if provided
   169→  if (params.loras && params.loras.length > 0) {
   170→    taskParams.loras = params.loras;
   171→  }
   172→
   173→  setTaskLineageFields(taskParams, {
   174→    shotId: params.shot_id,
   175→    basedOn: params.based_on,
   176→    sourceVariantId: params.source_variant_id,
   177→    createAsGeneration: params.create_as_generation,
   178→    toolType: params.tool_type,
   179→  });
   180→
   181→  // Add hires fix / inference params if provided
   182→  Object.assign(taskParams, buildHiresFixParams(params.hires_fix));
   183→
   184→  return taskParams;
   185→}
   186→
   187→/**
   188→ * Creates a single magic edit task using the unified approach
   189→ * This replaces the direct call to the magic-edit edge function
   190→ * (internal use only - used by createBatchMagicEditTasks)
   191→ *
   192→ * @param params - Magic edit task parameters
   193→ * @returns Promise resolving to the created task
   194→ */
   195→async function createMagicEditTask(params: MagicEditTaskParams): Promise<TaskCreationResult> {
   196→  return runTaskCreationPipeline({
   197→    params,
   198→    context: 'MagicEdit',
   199→    validate: validateMagicEditParams,
   200→    buildTaskRequest: async (requestParams) => {
   201→      const { resolution: finalResolution } = await resolveProjectResolution(
   202→        requestParams.project_id,
   203→        requestParams.resolution,
   204→      );
   205→
   206→      const taskParams = buildMagicEditTaskParams(requestParams, finalResolution);
   207→
   208→      return composeTaskRequest({
   209→        source: requestParams,
   210→        taskType: "qwen_image_edit",
   211→        params: taskParams,
   212→      });
   213→    },
   214→  });
   215→}
   216→
   217→/**
   218→ * Creates multiple magic edit tasks in parallel (batch generation)
   219→ * Used by MediaLightbox unified edit mode for creating multiple variations
   220→ * 
   221→ * @param params - Batch magic edit parameters
   222→ * @returns Promise resolving to array of created tasks
   223→ */
   224→export async function createBatchMagicEditTasks(params: BatchMagicEditTaskParams): Promise<TaskCreationResult[]> {
   225→
   226→  try {
   227→    return await runBatchTaskPipeline({
   228→      batchParams: params,
   229→      validateBatchParams: validateBatchMagicEditParams,
   230→      buildSingleTaskParams: async (batchParams): Promise<MagicEditTaskParams[]> => {
   231→        const { resolution: finalResolution } = await resolveProjectResolution(
   232→          batchParams.project_id,
   233→          batchParams.resolution,
   234→        );
   235→
   236→        return Array.from({ length: batchParams.numImages }, (_, index) => {
   237→          const seedBase = resolveSeed32Bit({ seed: batchParams.seed, field: 'seed' });
   238→          const seed = seedBase + index;
   239→
   240→          return {
   241→            project_id: batchParams.project_id,
   242→            prompt: batchParams.prompt,
   243→            image_url: batchParams.image_url,
   244→            negative_prompt: batchParams.negative_prompt,
   245→            resolution: finalResolution,
   246→            seed,
   247→            in_scene: batchParams.in_scene,
   248→            shot_id: batchParams.shot_id,
   249→            output_format: batchParams.output_format,
   250→            enable_sync_mode: batchParams.enable_sync_mode,
   251→            max_wait_seconds: batchParams.max_wait_seconds,
   252→            enable_base64_output: batchParams.enable_base64_output,
   253→            tool_type: batchParams.tool_type,
   254→            loras: batchParams.loras,
   255→            based_on: batchParams.based_on,
   256→            source_variant_id: batchParams.source_variant_id,
   257→            create_as_generation: batchParams.create_as_generation,
   258→            hires_fix: batchParams.hires_fix,
   259→            qwen_edit_model: batchParams.qwen_edit_model,
   260→          } as MagicEditTaskParams;
   261→        });
   262→      },
   263→      createSingleTask: createMagicEditTask,
   264→      operationName: 'createBatchMagicEditTasks',
   265→    });
   266→
   267→  } catch (error) {
   268→    rethrowTaskCreationError(error, { context: 'BatchMagicEdit' });
   269→  }
   270→}
   271→
   272→// TaskValidationError is used internally - import from taskCreation.ts if needed externally

   293→export function buildIndividualTravelSegmentParams(
   294→  params: IndividualTravelSegmentParams,
   295→  finalResolution: string,
   296→): Record<string, unknown> {
   297→  const state = buildSegmentState(params);
   298→  const orchestratorDetails = buildOrchestratorDetails(params, state, finalResolution);
   299→  const sourceSnapshot = buildTaskPayloadSnapshot(params.originalParams);
   300→  const legacyContractTaskId = extractOrchestratorTaskIdParam(params.originalParams);
   301→  const legacyRunId = extractRunIdParam(params.originalParams);
   302→  const orchestratorTaskId = resolveSnapshotOrchestratorTaskId(sourceSnapshot)
   303→    ?? legacyContractTaskId
   304→    ?? resolveStringCandidate(
   305→      asString(state.orchDetails.orchestrator_task_id),
   306→      asString(state.orig.orchestrator_task_id_ref),
   307→    );
   308→  const runId = resolveSnapshotRunId(sourceSnapshot)
   309→    ?? legacyRunId
   310→    ?? asString(state.orchDetails.run_id);
   311→
   312→  const hasPairShotGenerationId = Boolean(
   313→    params.pair_shot_generation_id
   314→    || params.start_image_variant_id
   315→    || params.end_image_variant_id,
   316→  );
   317→  const segmentRegenerationMode = hasPairShotGenerationId
   318→    ? 'segment_regen_from_pair'
   319→    : 'segment_regen_from_order';
   320→  const generationRouting = params.child_generation_id
   321→    ? 'variant_child'
   322→    : 'child_generation';
   323→
   324→  const familyContract = buildIndividualSegmentFamilyContract({
   325→    segmentRegenerationMode,
   326→    generationRouting,
   327→    segmentIndex: params.segment_index,
   328→    hasEndImage: Boolean(params.end_image_url),
   329→    hasPairShotGenerationId,
   330→  });
   331→
   332→  const composedPayload = composeTaskFamilyPayload({
   333→    taskFamily: 'individual_travel_segment',
   334→    orchestratorDetails,
   335→    orchestrationInput: {
   336→      taskFamily: 'individual_travel_segment',
   337→      orchestratorTaskId,
   338→      runId,
   339→      parentGenerationId: params.parent_generation_id,
   340→      childGenerationId: params.child_generation_id,
   341→      childOrder: params.segment_index,
   342→      shotId: params.shot_id,
   343→      generationRouting,
   344→      siblingLookup: runId ? 'run_id' : 'orchestrator_task_id',
   345→      segmentRegenerationMode,
   346→    },
   347→    taskViewInput: {
   348→      inputImages: state.inputImages,
   349→      prompt: state.basePrompt,
   350→      enhancedPrompt: state.enhancedPrompt,
   351→      negativePrompt: state.negativePrompt,
   352→      modelName: state.modelName,
   353→      resolution: finalResolution,
   354→    },
   355→    familyContract,
   356→  });
   357→
   358→  const taskParams = {
   359→    ...buildTaskParamsPayload(params, state, finalResolution, orchestratorDetails),
   360→    ...composedPayload,
   361→  };
   362→  taskParams.individual_segment_params = buildIndividualSegmentParamsPayload(params, state);
   363→  return taskParams;
   364→}

    15→interface VideoLightboxLayoutState {
    16→  shouldShowSidePanelWithTrim: boolean;

    22→
    23→export function buildVideoLightboxLayoutState(
    24→  input: BuildVideoLightboxLayoutStateInput,
    25→): VideoLightboxLayoutState {
    26→  const shouldShowSidePanelWithTrim = input.shouldShowSidePanel
    27→    || ((!input.isPortraitMode && input.isTabletOrLarger) && input.isAnyVideoEditMode);
    28→
    29→  const showPanel = shouldShowSidePanelWithTrim
    30→    || ((input.showTaskDetails || input.isAnyVideoEditMode || (input.isSegmentSlotMode && input.hasSegmentVideo)) && input.isMobile);
    31→
    32→  const needsFullscreenLayout = input.isMobile
    33→    || input.isFormOnlyMode
    34→    || input.shouldShowSidePanel
    35→    || shouldShowSidePanelWithTrim;
    36→
    37→  const needsTasksPaneOffset = needsFullscreenLayout
    38→    && (input.effectiveTasksPaneOpen || input.isTasksPaneLocked)
    39→    && !input.isPortraitMode
    40→    && input.isTabletOrLarger;
    41→
    42→  const panelVariant = (shouldShowSidePanelWithTrim && !input.isMobile)
    43→    ? 'desktop'
    44→    : 'mobile';
    45→
    46→  return {
    47→    shouldShowSidePanelWithTrim,
    48→    showPanel,
    49→    needsFullscreenLayout,
    50→    needsTasksPaneOffset,
    51→    panelVariant,
    52→  };
    53→}

     3→// --- Timeline write logging ---

     5→type TimelineWritePhase = 'queued' | 'start' | 'end';

     7→interface TimelineWriteEventMeta {

    20→interface TimelineWriteLoggerOptions {

    25→function shortTimelineId(value: string | null | undefined): string | null {

    29→/**
    30→ * Shared queue-phase logger for timeline write serialization.

    33→export function createTimelineWriteQueueLogger(options: TimelineWriteLoggerOptions): TimelineWriteEventHandler {
    34→  const log = options.log ?? console.log;
    35→  return (phase, meta) => {
    36→    const payload: Record<string, unknown> = {
    37→      shotId: shortTimelineId(meta.shotId),
    38→      requestId: meta.requestId,

    54→// --- Timeline write timeout ---

    56→const DEFAULT_TIMELINE_WRITE_TIMEOUT_MS = 15_000;
    57→const TIMELINE_WRITE_TIMEOUT_CODE = 'TIMELINE_WRITE_TIMEOUT';
    58→
    59→interface TimelineWriteTimeoutOptions {
    60→  timeoutMs?: number;
    61→  onTimeout?: (meta: { operation: string; timeoutMs: number; pendingMs: number }) => void;
    62→  upstreamSignal?: AbortSignal;

    64→
    65→class TimelineWriteTimeoutError extends Error {
    66→  readonly code = TIMELINE_WRITE_TIMEOUT_CODE;
    67→
    68→  constructor(operation: string, timeoutMs: number, cause?: unknown) {
    69→    super(`Timeline write "${operation}" timed out after ${timeoutMs}ms`);
    70→    this.name = 'TimelineWriteTimeoutError';
    71→    if (cause !== undefined) {
    72→      (this as { cause?: unknown }).cause = cause;
    73→    }
    74→  }
    75→}
    76→
    77→export function isTimelineWriteTimeoutError(error: unknown): error is TimelineWriteTimeoutError {
    78→  return (
    79→    error instanceof TimelineWriteTimeoutError
    80→    || (
    81→      typeof error === 'object'
    82→      && error !== null
    83→      && 'code' in error
    84→      && (error as { code?: unknown }).code === TIMELINE_WRITE_TIMEOUT_CODE
    85→    )
    86→  );

    88→
    89→export async function runTimelineWriteWithTimeout<T>(
    90→  operation: string,
    91→  task: (signal: AbortSignal) => Promise<T>,
    92→  options?: TimelineWriteTimeoutOptions,
    93→): Promise<T> {
    94→  const timeoutMs = options?.timeoutMs ?? DEFAULT_TIMELINE_WRITE_TIMEOUT_MS;
    95→  const startedAt = Date.now();
    96→  const controller = new AbortController();
    97→  let timedOut = false;
    98→  let abortedByUpstream = false;
    99→
   100→  const upstreamSignal = options?.upstreamSignal;
   101→  const handleUpstreamAbort = () => {
   102→    abortedByUpstream = true;
   103→    controller.abort();
   104→  };
   105→  if (upstreamSignal) {
   106→    if (upstreamSignal.aborted) {
   107→      handleUpstreamAbort();
   108→    } else {
   109→      upstreamSignal.addEventListener('abort', handleUpstreamAbort, { once: true });
   110→    }
   111→  }
   112→
   113→  const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => {
   114→    timedOut = true;
   115→    options?.onTimeout?.({
   116→      operation,
   117→      timeoutMs,
   118→      pendingMs: Date.now() - startedAt,
   119→    });
   120→    controller.abort();
   121→  }, timeoutMs);
   122→
   123→  try {
   124→    return await task(controller.signal);
   125→  } catch (error) {
   126→    if (timedOut || (abortedByUpstream && controller.signal.aborted) || (controller.signal.aborted && isAbortError(error))) {
   127→      throw new TimelineWriteTimeoutError(operation, timeoutMs, error);
   128→    }
   129→    throw error;
   130→  } finally {
   131→    clearTimeout(timeoutId);
   132→    if (upstreamSignal) {
   133→      upstreamSignal.removeEventListener('abort', handleUpstreamAbort);
   134→    }
   135→  }
   136→}

   138→// --- Serialized timeline write queue ---

   140→const shotWriteTail = new Map<string, Promise<void>>();

   142→const shotWriteActive = new Map<string, { requestId: number; operation: string; startedAt: number }>();
   143→let writeRequestCounter = 0;
   144→const DEFAULT_SERIALIZED_TIMELINE_TASK_TIMEOUT_MS = 30_000;

   146→interface TimelineSerializedWriteOptions {

   157→/**
   158→ * Returns true if any serialized timeline write is active or queued for the
   159→ * given shot. Both the timeline drag path and the batch editor path go through
   160→ * runSerializedTimelineWrite, so this covers all writes across both paths.
   161→ * Used by useTimelinePositions.syncFromDatabase to suppress stale syncs while

   164→ * positions back to pre-edit values).

   166→export function isTimelineWriteActive(shotId: string): boolean {
   167→  return (shotWriteDepth.get(shotId) ?? 0) > 0;

   169→
   170→/**
   171→ * Serialize timeline writes per shot to avoid overlapping updates from
   172→ * different UI flows (batch reorder, timeline drag, etc.).
   173→ */
   174→export async function runSerializedTimelineWrite<T>(
   175→  shotId: string,
   176→  operation: string,
   177→  task: (signal: AbortSignal) => Promise<T>,
   178→  onEvent?: TimelineWriteEventHandler,
   179→  options?: TimelineSerializedWriteOptions,

   229→    return await runTimelineWriteWithTimeout(
   230→      operation,
   231→      task,
   232→      {
   233→        timeoutMs,
   234→        onTimeout: ({ pendingMs }) => {
   235→          options?.onTimeout?.({
   236→            shotId,
   237→            operation,
   238→            timeoutMs,
   239→            pendingMs,
   240→            requestId,
   241→          });
   242→        },
   243→      },
   244→    );
   245→  } finally {
   246→    releaseTail();
   247→
   248→    const remainingDepth = Math.max(0, (shotWriteDepth.get(shotId) ?? 1) - 1);
   249→    if (remainingDepth === 0) {
   250→      shotWriteDepth.delete(shotId);
   251→    } else {
   252→      shotWriteDepth.set(shotId, remainingDepth);
   253→    }
   254→
   255→    if (shotWriteTail.get(shotId) === chainedTail) {
   256→      shotWriteTail.delete(shotId);
   257→    }
   258→    if (shotWriteActive.get(shotId)?.requestId === requestId) {
   259→      shotWriteActive.delete(shotId);
   260→    }
   261→
   262→    onEvent?.('end', {
   263→      shotId,
   264→      operation,
   265→      waitMs: startedAt - queuedAt,
   266→      durationMs: Date.now() - startedAt,
   267→      queueDepth: Math.max(0, remainingDepth - 1),
   268→      requestId,
   269→      blockedByOperation: blockedBy?.operation ?? null,
   270→      blockedByDurationMs,
   271→    });
   272→  }

   164→    context: 'createZImageTurboImageToImageTask',
   165→    validate: validateZImageTurboImageToImageParams,
   166→    buildTaskRequest: (pipelineParams) => composeTaskRequest({
   167→      source: pipelineParams,
   168→      taskType: 'z_image_turbo_i2i',
   169→      params: buildTaskParams(pipelineParams),

   172→}
   173→
   174→/**
   175→ * Creates multiple Z Image Turbo image-to-image tasks in parallel (batch generation)
   176→ */
   177→export async function createBatchZImageTurboImageToImageTasks(
   178→  params: BatchZImageTurboImageToImageTaskParams
   179→): Promise<TaskCreationResult[]> {
   180→
   181→  try {
   182→    return await runBatchTaskPipeline({
   183→      batchParams: params,
   184→      validateBatchParams: validateBatchParams,
   185→      buildSingleTaskParams: (batchParams): ZImageTurboImageToImageTaskParams[] => (
   186→        Array.from({ length: batchParams.numImages }, (_, index) => {
   187→          const seed = batchParams.seed ?? Math.floor(Math.random() * 0x7fffffff);
   188→
   189→          return {
   190→            project_id: batchParams.project_id,
   191→            image_url: batchParams.image_url,
   192→            prompt: batchParams.prompt,
   193→            strength: batchParams.strength,
   194→            enable_prompt_expansion: batchParams.enable_prompt_expansion,
   195→            seed: seed + index,
   196→            numImages: 1,
   197→            loras: batchParams.loras,
   198→            shot_id: batchParams.shot_id,
   199→            based_on: batchParams.based_on,
   200→            source_variant_id: batchParams.source_variant_id,
   201→            create_as_generation: batchParams.create_as_generation,
   202→            tool_type: batchParams.tool_type,
   203→          } as ZImageTurboImageToImageTaskParams;
   204→        })
   205→      ),
   206→      createSingleTask: createZImageTurboImageToImageTask,
   207→      operationName: 'createBatchZImageTurboImageToImageTasks',
   208→    });
   209→
   210→  } catch (error) {
   211→    normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'BatchZImageTurboImageToImage', showToast: false });

   106→export function useEditSettingsPersistence({
   107→  generationId,
   108→  projectId,
   109→  enabled = true,

   116→

   132→      lastGenerationIdRef.current = generationId;

   327→        supabase().from('shot_generations')
   328→          .update({ timeline_frame: update.timeline_frame })
   329→          .eq('shot_id', update.shot_id)
   330→          .eq('generation_id', update.generation_id)
   331→      );
   332→
   333→      const results = await Promise.all(promises);
   334→
   335→      const errors = results.filter(r => r.error);
   336→      if (errors.length > 0) {
   337→        throw new Error(`Reorder failed: ${errors.map(e => e.error?.message).join(', ')}`);
   338→      }
   339→
   340→      return { projectId, shotId, updates };
   341→    },
   342→
   343→    onMutate: async (variables) => {
   344→      const { updates, shotId } = variables;
   345→
   346→      await cancelShotGenerationsQuery(queryClient, shotId);
   347→
   348→      const previousFastGens = queryClient.getQueryData<GenerationRow[]>(
   349→        queryKeys.generations.byShot(shotId)
   350→      );
   351→
   352→      if (previousFastGens) {
   353→        const updatedGens = previousFastGens.map(gen => {
   354→          const update = updates.find(u => u.generation_id === gen.generation_id);
   355→          if (update) {
   356→            return { ...gen, timeline_frame: update.timeline_frame };
   357→          }
   358→          return gen;
   359→        });
   360→
   361→        updatedGens.sort((a, b) => (a.timeline_frame || 0) - (b.timeline_frame || 0));
   362→        queryClient.setQueryData(queryKeys.generations.byShot(shotId), updatedGens);
   363→      }
   364→
   365→      return { previousFastGens, shotId };
   366→    },
   367→
   368→    onError: (_err: Error, _variables, context) => {
   369→      if (context?.previousFastGens && context.shotId) {
   370→        rollbackShotGenerationsCache(queryClient, context.shotId, context.previousFastGens);
   371→      }

   373→      toast.error('Failed to reorder images');
   374→    },

   376→    onSuccess: (data) => {

   378→      queryClient.invalidateQueries({

   380→      });
   381→      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED](data.shotId) });
   382→      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED](data.shotId, data.projectId) });
   383→    },
   384→  });
   385→};

   197→

   218→    message.includes('not authenticated') ||
   219→    message.includes('authentication required')

1→/**
     2→ * NetworkStatusManager - Centralized network status management
     3→ *
     4→ * Provides a single source of truth for online/offline status and connection type.
     5→ * Integrates with reconnect and polling flows for network-aware behavior.
     6→ */
     7→
     8→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
     9→import type { NavigatorWithDeviceInfo } from '@/types/browser-extensions';
    10→
    11→interface NetworkStatus {
    12→  isOnline: boolean;
    13→  effectiveType?: '2g' | '3g' | '4g' | 'slow-2g';
    14→  lastTransitionAt: number;
    15→  previousOnlineStatus: boolean;
    16→}
    17→
    18→type NetworkEventType = 'online' | 'offline' | 'connection-change';
    19→
    20→interface NetworkStatusSubscriber {
    21→  (status: NetworkStatus, eventType: NetworkEventType, event?: Event): void;
    22→}
    23→
    24→export class NetworkStatusManager {
    25→  private status: NetworkStatus;
    26→  private subscribers: Set<NetworkStatusSubscriber> = new Set();
    27→  private initialized = false;
    28→
    29→  constructor() {
    30→    const nav = navigator as NavigatorWithDeviceInfo;
    31→    this.status = {
    32→      isOnline: navigator.onLine,
    33→      effectiveType: nav.connection?.effectiveType,
    34→      lastTransitionAt: Date.now(),
    35→      previousOnlineStatus: navigator.onLine,
    36→    };
    37→  }
    38→
    39→  initialize(): void {
    40→    if (this.initialized) return;
    41→
    42→    const handleOnline = (event: Event) => this.handleNetworkChange('online', event);
    43→    const handleOffline = (event: Event) => this.handleNetworkChange('offline', event);
    44→    const handleConnectionChange = (event: Event) => this.handleNetworkChange('connection-change', event);
    45→
    46→    window.addEventListener('online', handleOnline);
    47→    window.addEventListener('offline', handleOffline);
    48→
    49→    const nav = navigator as NavigatorWithDeviceInfo;
    50→    if (nav.connection) {
    51→      nav.connection.addEventListener('change', handleConnectionChange);
    52→    }
    53→
    54→    this.initialized = true;
    55→  }
    56→
    57→  getStatus(): NetworkStatus {
    58→    return { ...this.status };
    59→  }
    60→
    61→  subscribe(callback: NetworkStatusSubscriber): () => void {
    62→    this.subscribers.add(callback);
    63→    return () => this.subscribers.delete(callback);
    64→  }
    65→
    66→  isSlowConnection(): boolean {
    67→    return this.status.effectiveType === '2g' || this.status.effectiveType === 'slow-2g';
    68→  }
    69→
    70→  getRecommendedIntervals(): { fast: number; normal: number; slow: number } {
    71→    if (!this.status.isOnline) {
    72→      return { fast: 60000, normal: 120000, slow: 300000 };
    73→    }
    74→
    75→    if (this.isSlowConnection()) {
    76→      return { fast: 30000, normal: 60000, slow: 180000 };
    77→    }
    78→
    79→    return { fast: 10000, normal: 30000, slow: 60000 };
    80→  }
    81→
    82→  private handleNetworkChange(eventType: NetworkEventType, event?: Event): void {
    83→    const now = Date.now();
    84→    const newIsOnline = navigator.onLine;
    85→    const nav = navigator as NavigatorWithDeviceInfo;
    86→    const newEffectiveType = nav.connection?.effectiveType;
    87→
    88→    const onlineStatusChanged = newIsOnline !== this.status.isOnline;
    89→    const connectionChanged = newEffectiveType !== this.status.effectiveType;
    90→
    91→    if (!onlineStatusChanged && !connectionChanged) {
    92→      return;
    93→    }
    94→
    95→    const previousStatus = { ...this.status };
    96→    this.status = {
    97→      isOnline: newIsOnline,
    98→      effectiveType: newEffectiveType,
    99→      lastTransitionAt: now,
   100→      previousOnlineStatus: previousStatus.isOnline,
   101→    };
   102→
   103→    this.subscribers.forEach((callback) => {
   104→      try {
   105→        callback(this.status, eventType, event);
   106→      } catch (error) {
   107→        normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'NetworkStatusManager', showToast: false });
   108→      }
   109→    });
   110→  }
   111→}
   112→
   113→let networkStatusManager: NetworkStatusManager;
   114→
   115→export function getNetworkStatusManager(): NetworkStatusManager {
   116→  if (!networkStatusManager) {
   117→    networkStatusManager = new NetworkStatusManager();
   118→    networkStatusManager.initialize();
   119→
   120→    if (import.meta.env.DEV && typeof window !== 'undefined') {
   121→      void import('@/shared/services/network/networkStatusDebug').then(({ installNetworkStatusDebugHelpers }) => {
   122→        installNetworkStatusDebugHelpers(networkStatusManager);
   123→      });
   124→    }
   125→  }
   126→
   127→  return networkStatusManager;
   128→}
   129→

   103→  isBackfillLoading: false,
   104→  backfillSkeletonCount: 0,
   105→});
   106→
   107→// Optimized reducer with batched updates
   108→const mediaGalleryStateReducer = (
   109→  state: MediaGalleryState,
   110→  action: MediaGalleryStateAction
   111→): MediaGalleryState => {
   112→  switch (action.type) {
   113→    case 'SET_LIGHTBOX_MEDIA':
   114→      return { ...state, activeLightboxMedia: action.payload };
   115→      
   116→    case 'SET_AUTO_ENTER_EDIT_MODE':
   117→      return { ...state, autoEnterEditMode: action.payload };
   118→      
   119→    case 'SET_SELECTED_IMAGE_FOR_DETAILS':
   120→      return { ...state, selectedImageForDetails: action.payload };
   121→      
   122→    case 'SET_SHOW_TASK_DETAILS_MODAL':
   123→      return { ...state, showTaskDetailsModal: action.payload };
   124→      
   125→    case 'SET_PENDING_LIGHTBOX_TARGET':
   126→      return { ...state, pendingLightboxTarget: action.payload };
   127→      
   128→    case 'MARK_OPTIMISTIC_UNPOSITIONED': {
   129→      // Store composite key: mediaId:shotId
   130→      const { mediaId, shotId } = action.payload;
   131→      const key = `${mediaId}:${shotId}`;
   132→      const newUnpositioned = new Set(state.optimisticUnpositionedIds);
   133→      const newPositioned = new Set(state.optimisticPositionedIds);
   134→      newUnpositioned.add(key);
   135→      newPositioned.delete(key);
   136→      return {
   137→        ...state,
   138→        optimisticUnpositionedIds: newUnpositioned,
   139→        optimisticPositionedIds: newPositioned,
   140→      };
   141→    }
   142→    
   143→    case 'MARK_OPTIMISTIC_POSITIONED': {
   144→      // Store composite key: mediaId:shotId
   145→      const { mediaId, shotId } = action.payload;
   146→      const key = `${mediaId}:${shotId}`;
   147→      const newPositioned = new Set(state.optimisticPositionedIds);
   148→      const newUnpositioned = new Set(state.optimisticUnpositionedIds);
   149→      newPositioned.add(key);
   150→      newUnpositioned.delete(key);
   151→      return {
   152→        ...state,
   153→        optimisticPositionedIds: newPositioned,
   154→        optimisticUnpositionedIds: newUnpositioned,
   155→      };
   156→    }
   157→    
   158→    case 'MARK_OPTIMISTIC_DELETED': {
   159→      const newDeleted = new Set(state.optimisticDeletedIds);
   160→      newDeleted.add(action.payload);
   161→      return { ...state, optimisticDeletedIds: newDeleted };
   162→    }
   163→
   164→    case 'MARK_OPTIMISTIC_DELETED_WITH_BACKFILL': {
   165→      // Combined action: mark deleted AND enable backfill loading in ONE state update
   166→      // This ensures skeleton appears in the same render where item disappears
   167→      const newDeleted = new Set(state.optimisticDeletedIds);
   168→      newDeleted.add(action.payload);
   169→      return { ...state, optimisticDeletedIds: newDeleted, isBackfillLoading: true };
   170→    }
   171→
   172→    case 'REMOVE_OPTIMISTIC_DELETED': {
   173→      const newDeleted = new Set(state.optimisticDeletedIds);
   174→      newDeleted.delete(action.payload);
   175→      return { ...state, optimisticDeletedIds: newDeleted };
   176→    }
   177→    
   178→    case 'RECONCILE_OPTIMISTIC_STATE': {
   179→      const currentImageIds = action.payload;
   180→
   181→      // Clean up optimistic sets - remove entries for images no longer in the list
   182→      // Composite keys are in format mediaId:shotId
   183→      const newUnpositioned = new Set<string>();
   184→      for (const key of state.optimisticUnpositionedIds) {
   185→        const mediaId = key.split(':')[0];
   186→        if (currentImageIds.has(mediaId)) {
   187→          newUnpositioned.add(key);
   188→        }
   189→      }
   190→
   191→      const newPositioned = new Set<string>();
   192→      for (const key of state.optimisticPositionedIds) {
   193→        const mediaId = key.split(':')[0];
   194→        if (currentImageIds.has(mediaId)) {
   195→          newPositioned.add(key);
   196→        }
   197→      }
   198→
   199→      const newDeleted = new Set<string>();
   200→      for (const id of state.optimisticDeletedIds) {
   201→        if (currentImageIds.has(id)) {
   202→          newDeleted.add(id);
   203→        }
   204→      }
   205→      
   206→      return {
   207→        ...state,
   208→        optimisticUnpositionedIds: newUnpositioned,
   209→        optimisticPositionedIds: newPositioned,
   210→        optimisticDeletedIds: newDeleted,
   211→      };
   212→    }
   213→    
   214→    case 'SET_SELECTED_SHOT_ID_LOCAL':
   215→      return { ...state, selectedShotIdLocal: action.payload };
   216→      
   217→    case 'SET_SHOW_TICK_FOR_IMAGE_ID':
   218→      return { ...state, showTickForImageId: action.payload };
   219→      
   220→    case 'SET_SHOW_TICK_FOR_SECONDARY_IMAGE_ID':
   221→      return { ...state, showTickForSecondaryImageId: action.payload };
   222→      
   223→    case 'SET_ADDING_TO_SHOT_IMAGE_ID':
   224→      return { ...state, addingToShotImageId: action.payload };
   225→      
   226→    case 'SET_ADDING_TO_SHOT_WITHOUT_POSITION_IMAGE_ID':
   227→      return { ...state, addingToShotWithoutPositionImageId: action.payload };
   228→      
   229→    case 'SET_DOWNLOADING_IMAGE_ID':
   230→      return { ...state, downloadingImageId: action.payload };
   231→      
   232→    case 'SET_DOWNLOADING_STARRED':
   233→      return { ...state, isDownloadingStarred: action.payload };
   234→      
   235→    case 'SET_MOBILE_ACTIVE_IMAGE_ID':
   236→      return { ...state, mobileActiveImageId: action.payload };
   237→      
   238→    case 'SET_MOBILE_POPOVER_OPEN_IMAGE_ID':
   239→      return { ...state, mobilePopoverOpenImageId: action.payload };
   240→      
   241→    case 'SET_BACKFILL_LOADING':
   242→      return { ...state, isBackfillLoading: action.payload };
   243→      
   244→    case 'SET_BACKFILL_SKELETON_COUNT':
   245→      return { ...state, backfillSkeletonCount: action.payload };
   246→
   247→    case 'RESET_UI_STATE':
   248→      return {
   249→        ...state,
   250→        showTickForImageId: null,
   251→        showTickForSecondaryImageId: null,
   252→        addingToShotImageId: null,
   253→        addingToShotWithoutPositionImageId: null,
   254→        downloadingImageId: null,
   255→        isDownloadingStarred: false,
   256→        mobileActiveImageId: null,
   257→        mobilePopoverOpenImageId: null,
   258→      };
   259→      
   260→    default:
   261→      return state;
   262→  }
   263→};
   264→
   265→interface UseMediaGalleryStateOptimizedProps {
   266→  images: GeneratedImageWithMetadata[];
   267→  currentShotId?: string;
   268→  lastShotId?: string;
   269→  simplifiedShotOptions: { id: string; name: string }[];
   270→  isServerPagination?: boolean;
   271→  serverPage?: number;
   272→}
   273→
   274→interface UseMediaGalleryStateOptimizedReturn {
   275→  // State
   276→  state: MediaGalleryState;
   277→  
   278→  // Actions
   279→  setActiveLightboxMedia: (media: GeneratedImageWithMetadata | null) => void;
   280→  setAutoEnterEditMode: (value: boolean) => void;
   281→  setSelectedImageForDetails: (image: GeneratedImageWithMetadata | null) => void;
   282→  setShowTaskDetailsModal: (show: boolean) => void;
   283→  setPendingLightboxTarget: (target: 'first' | 'last' | null) => void;
   284→  markOptimisticUnpositioned: (imageId: string, shotId: string) => void;
   285→  markOptimisticPositioned: (imageId: string, shotId: string) => void;
   286→  markOptimisticDeleted: (imageId: string) => void;
   287→  markOptimisticDeletedWithBackfill: (imageId: string) => void;
   288→  removeOptimisticDeleted: (imageId: string) => void;
   289→  setSelectedShotIdLocal: (id: string) => void;
   290→  setShowTickForImageId: (id: string | null) => void;
   291→  setShowTickForSecondaryImageId: (id: string | null) => void;
   292→  setAddingToShotImageId: (id: string | null) => void;
   293→  setAddingToShotWithoutPositionImageId: (id: string | null) => void;
   294→  setDownloadingImageId: (id: string | null) => void;
   295→  setIsDownloadingStarred: (downloading: boolean) => void;
   296→  setMobileActiveImageId: (id: string | null) => void;
   297→  setMobilePopoverOpenImageId: (id: string | null) => void;
   298→  setIsBackfillLoading: (loading: boolean) => void;
   299→  setBackfillSkeletonCount: (count: number) => void;
   300→  resetUIState: () => void;
   301→  
   302→  // Refs (unchanged)
   303→  mainTickTimeoutRef: React.MutableRefObject<NodeJS.Timeout | null>;
   304→  secondaryTickTimeoutRef: React.MutableRefObject<NodeJS.Timeout | null>;
   305→  galleryTopRef: React.MutableRefObject<HTMLDivElement | null>;
   306→  safetyTimeoutRef: React.MutableRefObject<NodeJS.Timeout | null>;

   308→
   309→function clearTimer(timeoutRef: React.MutableRefObject<NodeJS.Timeout | null>): void {
   310→  const timeoutId = timeoutRef.current;
   311→  if (!timeoutId) {
   312→    return;
   313→  }
   314→
   315→  clearTimeout(timeoutId);
   316→  timeoutRef.current = null;
   317→}
   318→
   319→export const useMediaGalleryStateOptimized = ({
   320→  images,
   321→  currentShotId,
   322→  lastShotId,
   323→  simplifiedShotOptions,
   324→}: UseMediaGalleryStateOptimizedProps): UseMediaGalleryStateOptimizedReturn => {
   325→  
   326→  // Initialize state with useReducer instead of multiple useState calls
   327→  const [state, dispatch] = useReducer(
   328→    mediaGalleryStateReducer,
   329→    createInitialState(currentShotId, lastShotId, simplifiedShotOptions)
   330→  );
   331→  
   332→  // Memoized action creators to prevent unnecessary re-renders
   333→  const actions = useMemo(() => ({
   334→    setActiveLightboxMedia: (media: GeneratedImageWithMetadata | null) => {
   335→      dispatch({ type: 'SET_LIGHTBOX_MEDIA', payload: media });
   336→    },
   337→    setAutoEnterEditMode: (value: boolean) =>
   338→      dispatch({ type: 'SET_AUTO_ENTER_EDIT_MODE', payload: value }),
   339→    setSelectedImageForDetails: (image: GeneratedImageWithMetadata | null) =>
   340→      dispatch({ type: 'SET_SELECTED_IMAGE_FOR_DETAILS', payload: image }),
   341→    setShowTaskDetailsModal: (show: boolean) =>
   342→      dispatch({ type: 'SET_SHOW_TASK_DETAILS_MODAL', payload: show }),
   343→    setPendingLightboxTarget: (target: 'first' | 'last' | null) => {
   344→      dispatch({ type: 'SET_PENDING_LIGHTBOX_TARGET', payload: target });
   345→    },
   346→    markOptimisticUnpositioned: (imageId: string, shotId: string) => 
   347→      dispatch({ type: 'MARK_OPTIMISTIC_UNPOSITIONED', payload: { mediaId: imageId, shotId } }),
   348→    markOptimisticPositioned: (imageId: string, shotId: string) => 
   349→      dispatch({ type: 'MARK_OPTIMISTIC_POSITIONED', payload: { mediaId: imageId, shotId } }),
   350→    markOptimisticDeleted: (imageId: string) =>
   351→      dispatch({ type: 'MARK_OPTIMISTIC_DELETED', payload: imageId }),
   352→    markOptimisticDeletedWithBackfill: (imageId: string) =>
   353→      dispatch({ type: 'MARK_OPTIMISTIC_DELETED_WITH_BACKFILL', payload: imageId }),
   354→    removeOptimisticDeleted: (imageId: string) => 
   355→      dispatch({ type: 'REMOVE_OPTIMISTIC_DELETED', payload: imageId }),
   356→    setSelectedShotIdLocal: (id: string) => 
   357→      dispatch({ type: 'SET_SELECTED_SHOT_ID_LOCAL', payload: id }),
   358→    setShowTickForImageId: (id: string | null) => 
   359→      dispatch({ type: 'SET_SHOW_TICK_FOR_IMAGE_ID', payload: id }),
   360→    setShowTickForSecondaryImageId: (id: string | null) => 
   361→      dispatch({ type: 'SET_SHOW_TICK_FOR_SECONDARY_IMAGE_ID', payload: id }),
   362→    setAddingToShotImageId: (id: string | null) => 
   363→      dispatch({ type: 'SET_ADDING_TO_SHOT_IMAGE_ID', payload: id }),
   364→    setAddingToShotWithoutPositionImageId: (id: string | null) => 
   365→      dispatch({ type: 'SET_ADDING_TO_SHOT_WITHOUT_POSITION_IMAGE_ID', payload: id }),
   366→    setDownloadingImageId: (id: string | null) => 
   367→      dispatch({ type: 'SET_DOWNLOADING_IMAGE_ID', payload: id }),
   368→    setIsDownloadingStarred: (downloading: boolean) => 
   369→      dispatch({ type: 'SET_DOWNLOADING_STARRED', payload: downloading }),
   370→    setMobileActiveImageId: (id: string | null) => 
   371→      dispatch({ type: 'SET_MOBILE_ACTIVE_IMAGE_ID', payload: id }),
   372→    setMobilePopoverOpenImageId: (id: string | null) => 
   373→      dispatch({ type: 'SET_MOBILE_POPOVER_OPEN_IMAGE_ID', payload: id }),
   374→    setIsBackfillLoading: (loading: boolean) => 
   375→      dispatch({ type: 'SET_BACKFILL_LOADING', payload: loading }),
   376→    setBackfillSkeletonCount: (count: number) =>
   377→      dispatch({ type: 'SET_BACKFILL_SKELETON_COUNT', payload: count }),
   378→    resetUIState: () =>
   379→      dispatch({ type: 'RESET_UI_STATE' }),
   380→  }), []);
   381→  
   382→  // Refs (unchanged from original)
   383→  const mainTickTimeoutRef = useRef<NodeJS.Timeout | null>(null);
   384→  const secondaryTickTimeoutRef = useRef<NodeJS.Timeout | null>(null);
   385→  const galleryTopRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
   386→  const safetyTimeoutRef = useRef<NodeJS.Timeout | null>(null);
   387→
   388→  // Track previous lastShotId to detect when user navigates to a different shot
   389→  const prevLastShotIdRef = useRef<string | undefined>(lastShotId);
   390→  
   391→  // Sync selectedShotIdLocal when:
   392→  // 1. lastShotId changes (user navigated to a different shot)
   393→  // 2. Current selection is invalid (empty or shot no longer exists)
   394→  useEffect(() => {
   395→    const isCurrentSelectionValid = state.selectedShotIdLocal && simplifiedShotOptions.find(shot => shot.id === state.selectedShotIdLocal);
   396→    const lastShotIdChanged = lastShotId && lastShotId !== prevLastShotIdRef.current;
   397→    
   398→    // Update ref for next comparison
   399→    prevLastShotIdRef.current = lastShotId;
   400→    
   401→    // Sync when lastShotId changes (user clicked into a shot)
   402→    if (lastShotIdChanged && lastShotId !== state.selectedShotIdLocal) {
   403→      actions.setSelectedShotIdLocal(lastShotId);
   404→      return;
   405→    }
   406→    
   407→    // Fix invalid selections (empty or shot no longer exists)
   408→    if (!isCurrentSelectionValid) {
   409→      const newSelection = lastShotId || (simplifiedShotOptions.length > 0 ? simplifiedShotOptions[0].id : "");
   410→      if (newSelection && newSelection !== state.selectedShotIdLocal) {
   411→        actions.setSelectedShotIdLocal(newSelection);
   412→      }
   413→    }
   414→  }, [lastShotId, simplifiedShotOptions, state.selectedShotIdLocal, actions]);
   415→
   416→  // Memoize image IDs to prevent unnecessary effect triggers
   417→  const currentImageIds = useMemo(() => 
   418→    new Set(images.map(img => img.id)), 
   419→    [images]
   420→  );
   421→
   422→  // Reconcile optimistic state when images update
   423→  useEffect(() => {
   424→    // Sync activeLightboxMedia with updated images list to ensure fresh data (like name changes)
   425→    if (state.activeLightboxMedia) {
   426→      const activeLightbox = state.activeLightboxMedia;
   427→      const updatedImage = images.find(img => img.id === activeLightbox.id);
   428→      // Only update if the object reference changed (meaning data changed or refetched)
   429→      // and deep equality check on key properties to avoid unnecessary render cycles
   430→      if (updatedImage && updatedImage !== state.activeLightboxMedia) {
   431→        // Check if relevant fields actually changed to prevent loop.
   432→        const nameChanged = updatedImage.name !== state.activeLightboxMedia.name;
   433→        const starredChanged = updatedImage.starred !== state.activeLightboxMedia.starred;
   434→        const urlChanged = updatedImage.url !== state.activeLightboxMedia.url;
   435→
   436→        if (nameChanged || starredChanged || urlChanged) {
   437→          const autoEnterFlag = state.activeLightboxMedia.metadata?.__autoEnterEditMode as boolean | undefined;
   438→          actions.setActiveLightboxMedia({
   439→            ...updatedImage,
   440→            metadata: autoEnterFlag === undefined
   441→              ? updatedImage.metadata
   442→              : { ...updatedImage.metadata, __autoEnterEditMode: autoEnterFlag },
   443→          });
   444→        }
   445→      }
   446→    }
   447→
   448→    // Clean up optimistic sets using the consolidated action
   449→    dispatch({ type: 'RECONCILE_OPTIMISTIC_STATE', payload: currentImageIds });
   450→  }, [currentImageIds, images, actions, state.activeLightboxMedia]);
   451→
   452→  // Cleanup timeouts on unmount
   453→  useEffect(() => {
   454→    return () => {
   455→      clearTimer(mainTickTimeoutRef);
   456→      clearTimer(secondaryTickTimeoutRef);
   457→      clearTimer(safetyTimeoutRef);
   458→    };
   459→  }, []);
   460→
   461→  return {
   462→    state,
   463→    ...actions,
   464→    
   465→    // Refs
   466→    mainTickTimeoutRef,
   467→    secondaryTickTimeoutRef,
   468→    galleryTopRef,
   469→    safetyTimeoutRef,
   470→  };
   471→};
   472→

    32→
    33→/**
    34→ * Authenticates a request using Bearer token (Service Role Key, JWT, or PAT)
    35→ *
    36→ * This function handles authentication methods:
    37→ * 1. Service Role Key - Direct match with SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
    38→ * 2. Personal Access Token (PAT) - Looked up in user_api_tokens table
    39→ * 3. JWT User Auth (optional) - Extract user ID from JWT payload.sub
    40→ *
    41→ * NOTE: We intentionally do NOT accept JWTs with service_role claims.
    42→ * Only the actual service key can be used for service role access.
    43→ * This prevents unsigned/forged JWTs from gaining elevated privileges.
    44→ *
    45→ * @param req - The incoming HTTP request
    46→ * @param supabaseAdmin - Supabase admin client for database queries
    47→ * @param logPrefix - Optional prefix for log messages (e.g., "[FUNCTION-NAME]")
    48→ * @param options - Optional settings for auth behavior
    49→ * @returns AuthResult with authentication details
    50→ */
    51→export async function authenticateRequest(
    52→  req: Request,
    53→  supabaseAdmin: SupabaseClient,
    54→  logPrefix: string = "[AUTH]",
    55→  options: AuthOptions = {}
    56→): Promise<AuthResult> {
    57→  // Extract authorization header
    58→  const authHeader = req.headers.get("Authorization");
    59→  if (!authHeader?.startsWith("Bearer ")) {
    60→    return {
    61→      isServiceRole: false,
    62→      userId: null,
    63→      success: false,
    64→      error: "Missing or invalid Authorization header",
    65→      statusCode: 401
    66→    };
    67→  }
    68→

    70→  const serviceKey = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY");
    71→
    72→  if (!serviceKey) {
    73→    console.error(`${logPrefix} Missing SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY environment variable`);
    74→    return {
    75→      isServiceRole: false,
    76→      userId: null,
    77→      success: false,
    78→      error: "Server configuration error",

    80→    };
    81→  }

    83→  // 1) Check if token matches service-role key directly (SECURE)
    84→  if (token === serviceKey) {
    85→    return {
    86→      isServiceRole: true,
    87→      userId: null,
    88→      success: true

    90→  }
    91→
    92→  // 2) If JWT user auth is enabled, try to decode JWT and extract user ID
    93→  if (options.allowJwtUserAuth) {
    94→    try {

    98→        const padded = payloadB64 + "=".repeat((4 - payloadB64.length % 4) % 4);
    99→        const payload = JSON.parse(atob(padded));

   103→        if (!["service_role", "supabase_admin"].includes(role) && payload.sub) {

   111→      }

1→/**
     2→ * Timeline Frame Calculators
     3→ *
     4→ * Pure functions for timeline frame position calculations:
     5→ * - Gap finding and frame distribution
     6→ * - Normalization (compress gaps, shift to start at 0)
     7→ * - Position calculation for drag-and-drop operations
     8→ *

    11→
    12→import type { ShotGeneration } from '@/shared/hooks/useTimelineCore';
    13→import { calculateAverageSpacing, DEFAULT_FRAME_SPACING } from '@/shared/lib/timelinePositionCalculator';
    14→
    15→/** Maximum allowed gap between timeline frames (5s at 16fps). */
    16→const MAX_FRAME_GAP = 81;
    17→
    18→// ============================================================================
    19→// Types
    20→// ============================================================================
    21→
    22→interface FrameUpdate {
    23→  id: string;
    24→  newFrame: number;
    25→  reason: string;
    26→}
    27→
    28→// ============================================================================
    29→// Normalization
    30→// ============================================================================
    31→
    32→/**
    33→ * Normalize a set of final positions: start at 0, compress gaps > MAX_FRAME_GAP.
    34→ * Returns a map of id -> { newFrame, reason } for items that need updating.
    35→ * @internal Used only within this module by buildAndNormalizeFinalPositions.
    36→ */
    37→function normalizePositions(
    38→  allFinalPositions: Array<{ id: string; frame: number }>
    39→): Map<string, { newFrame: number; reason: string }> {
    40→  const normalizedUpdates = new Map<string, { newFrame: number; reason: string }>();
    41→
    42→  if (allFinalPositions.length === 0) return normalizedUpdates;
    43→
    44→  // Sort by frame position
    45→  const sorted = [...allFinalPositions].sort((a, b) => a.frame - b.frame);
    46→
    47→  let currentFrame = 0;
    48→
    49→  for (let i = 0; i < sorted.length; i++) {
    50→    const item = sorted[i];
    51→
    52→    if (i === 0) {
    53→      if (item.frame !== 0) {
    54→        normalizedUpdates.set(item.id, { newFrame: 0, reason: 'Normalized to start at 0' });
    55→      }
    56→      currentFrame = 0;
    57→    } else {
    58→      const prevItem = sorted[i - 1];
    59→      const originalGap = item.frame - prevItem.frame;
    60→      const normalizedGap = Math.min(originalGap, MAX_FRAME_GAP);
    61→      const normalizedFrame = currentFrame + normalizedGap;
    62→
    63→      if (normalizedFrame !== item.frame) {
    64→        normalizedUpdates.set(item.id, {
    65→          newFrame: normalizedFrame,
    66→          reason: originalGap > MAX_FRAME_GAP
    67→            ? `Gap compressed from ${originalGap} to ${normalizedGap}`
    68→            : 'Shifted to maintain sequence'
    69→        });
    70→      }
    71→      currentFrame = normalizedFrame;
    72→    }
    73→  }
    74→
    75→  return normalizedUpdates;
    76→}

    79→// Frame distribution for drag-and-drop

   113→
   114→  const newEndIndex = newStartIndex + draggedItemIds.length - 1;
   115→  const predecessor = newStartIndex > 0 ? allItems[newStartIndex - 1] : null;
   116→  const successor = newEndIndex < allItems.length - 1 ? allItems[newEndIndex + 1] : null;
   117→
   118→  if (newStartIndex === 0 && successor) {
   119→    // Special case: dropping at position 0
   120→    calculateDropAtPositionZero(
   121→      draggedShotGens, draggedItemIds, newEndIndex, allItems, shotGenerations, successor, pushUpdate
   122→    );
   123→  } else if (predecessor && successor && predecessor.timeline_frame != null && successor.timeline_frame != null) {
   124→    // Between two items - distribute evenly in the gap
   125→    const gap = successor.timeline_frame - predecessor.timeline_frame;
   126→    const numItems = draggedItemIds.length;
   127→    const interval = gap / (numItems + 1);
   128→
   129→    draggedShotGens.forEach((sg, i) => {
   130→      const newFrame = predecessor.timeline_frame! + (interval * (i + 1));
   131→      pushUpdate(sg.id, newFrame, `Distributed in gap (${i + 1}/${numItems})`);
   132→    });
   133→  } else if (predecessor && predecessor.timeline_frame != null) {
   134→    // At end - extend timeline using average spacing of existing items
   135→    const existingFrames = allItems
   136→      .filter(item => item.timeline_frame != null)
   137→      .map(item => item.timeline_frame!);
   138→    const spacing = calculateAverageSpacing(existingFrames, DEFAULT_FRAME_SPACING);
   139→
   140→    draggedShotGens.forEach((sg, i) => {
   141→      const newFrame = predecessor.timeline_frame! + (spacing * (i + 1));
   142→      pushUpdate(sg.id, newFrame, `Extend at end (${i + 1}/${draggedItemIds.length})`);
   143→    });
   144→  } else if (successor && successor.timeline_frame != null) {
   145→    // At start - distribute between 0 and successor
   146→    const gap = successor.timeline_frame;
   147→    const numItems = draggedItemIds.length;
   148→    const interval = gap / (numItems + 1);
   149→
   150→    draggedShotGens.forEach((sg, i) => {
   151→      const newFrame = interval * (i + 1);
   152→      pushUpdate(sg.id, newFrame, `Distributed from start (${i + 1}/${numItems})`);
   153→    });
   154→  } else {
   155→    // First items in timeline - start at 0 and space by default
   156→
   157→    draggedShotGens.forEach((sg, i) => {
   158→      const newFrame = DEFAULT_FRAME_SPACING * i;
   159→      pushUpdate(sg.id, newFrame, `Initial placement (${i + 1}/${draggedItemIds.length})`);
   160→    });
   161→  }
   162→
   163→  return accumulateUpdates;
   164→}
   165→
   166→/**
   167→ * Handle the special case of dropping items at position 0.
   168→ */
   169→function calculateDropAtPositionZero(
   170→  draggedShotGens: ShotGeneration[],
   171→  draggedItemIds: string[],
   172→  newEndIndex: number,
   173→  allItems: Array<{ id: string; timeline_frame: number | null }>,
   174→  shotGenerations: ShotGeneration[],
   175→  successor: { id: string; timeline_frame: number | null },
   176→  pushUpdate: (id: string, frame: number, reason: string) => void
   177→) {
   178→  const displacedFirstItem = successor;
   179→  const oldSecondItem = newEndIndex + 2 < allItems.length ? allItems[newEndIndex + 2] : null;
   180→
   181→  // First dragged item goes to frame 0
   182→  pushUpdate(draggedShotGens[0].id, 0, 'First item at position 0');
   183→
   184→  // Calculate new position for displaced first item
   185→  let displacedNewFrame: number;
   186→  if (oldSecondItem?.timeline_frame != null) {
   187→    displacedNewFrame = Math.floor((0 + oldSecondItem.timeline_frame) / 2);
   188→  } else if (displacedFirstItem.timeline_frame != null) {
   189→    displacedNewFrame = Math.max(DEFAULT_FRAME_SPACING, displacedFirstItem.timeline_frame);
   190→  } else {
   191→    displacedNewFrame = DEFAULT_FRAME_SPACING;
   192→  }
   193→
   194→  // Update displaced item
   195→  const displacedShotGen = findGeneration(shotGenerations, displacedFirstItem.id);
   196→  if (displacedShotGen?.id) {
   197→    pushUpdate(displacedShotGen.id, displacedNewFrame, 'Displaced first item shifted');
   198→  }
   199→
   200→  // Distribute remaining dragged items between 0 and displaced item's new position
   201→  if (draggedItemIds.length > 1) {
   202→    const numRemaining = draggedItemIds.length - 1;
   203→    const gap = displacedNewFrame;
   204→    const interval = gap / (numRemaining + 1);
   205→
   206→    for (let i = 1; i < draggedItemIds.length; i++) {
   207→      const newFrame = interval * i;
   208→      pushUpdate(draggedShotGens[i].id, newFrame, `Distributed after first (${i}/${draggedItemIds.length})`);
   209→    }
   210→  }
   211→}
   212→
   213→// ============================================================================
   214→// Update deduplication
   215→// ============================================================================
   216→
   217→/**
   218→ * Deduplicate frame updates (last write wins per id).
   219→ */
   220→export function deduplicateUpdates(
   221→  updates: FrameUpdate[]
   222→): Map<string, { newFrame: number; reason: string }> {
   223→  const uniqueUpdates = new Map<string, { newFrame: number; reason: string }>();
   224→  updates.forEach(entry => {
   225→    const existing = uniqueUpdates.get(entry.id);
   226→    if (!existing || existing.newFrame !== entry.newFrame) {
   227→      uniqueUpdates.set(entry.id, { newFrame: entry.newFrame, reason: entry.reason });
   228→    }
   229→  });
   230→  return uniqueUpdates;
   231→}
   232→
   233→/**
   234→ * Build the complete picture of final positions (updated + unchanged) for all positioned items,
   235→ * then normalize and merge back into the updates map.
   236→ */
   237→export function buildAndNormalizeFinalPositions(
   238→  uniqueUpdates: Map<string, { newFrame: number; reason: string }>,
   239→  shotGenerations: ShotGeneration[]
   240→): Map<string, { newFrame: number; reason: string }> {
   241→  const allFinalPositions: Array<{ id: string; frame: number }> = [];
   242→
   243→  for (const sg of shotGenerations) {
   244→    if (sg.timeline_frame == null || sg.timeline_frame < 0) continue;
   245→    const update = uniqueUpdates.get(sg.id);
   246→    const finalFrame = update ? update.newFrame : sg.timeline_frame;
   247→    allFinalPositions.push({ id: sg.id, frame: finalFrame });
   248→  }
   249→
   250→  allFinalPositions.sort((a, b) => a.frame - b.frame);
   251→
   252→  if (allFinalPositions.length === 0) return uniqueUpdates;
   253→
   254→  const normalizedUpdates = normalizePositions(allFinalPositions);
   255→
   256→  // Merge normalized updates into uniqueUpdates
   257→  for (const [id, payload] of normalizedUpdates) {
   258→    const existing = uniqueUpdates.get(id);
   259→    if (existing) {
   260→      uniqueUpdates.set(id, { newFrame: payload.newFrame, reason: `${existing.reason} → ${payload.reason}` });
   261→    } else {
   262→      uniqueUpdates.set(id, payload);
   263→    }
   264→  }
   265→
   266→  return uniqueUpdates;
   267→}
   268→

    18→export function initEdgeRuntime(

    37→    ? createClient(supabaseUrl, serviceKey, options.clientOptions)

    44→export async function ensureRequestMethod(

    70→}
    71→
    72→function coerceLooseObject(value: unknown): Record<string, unknown> {
    73→  return isJsonObject(value) ? value : {};

    82→export async function parseJsonBody(
    83→  req: Request,

    85→  options?: ParseJsonBodyOptions,
    86→): Promise<OperationResult<Record<string, unknown>>> {
    87→  const mode = options?.mode ?? 'strict';
    88→  const message = options?.message ?? 'Invalid JSON body';
    89→  const nonObjectMessage = options?.nonObjectMessage ?? 'JSON body must be an object';
    90→
