   157→  }
   158→  if (typeof payload.error === 'string' && payload.error.trim().length > 0) {
   159→    return payload.error;
   160→  }
   161→  return null;
   162→}
   163→
   164→// --- Error response helpers ---
   165→
   166→interface EdgeErrorEnvelopeInput {
   167→  errorCode: string;
   168→  message: string;
   169→  recoverable: boolean;
   170→  retryAfter?: number;
   171→}
   172→
   173→export function edgeErrorResponse(
   174→  input: EdgeErrorEnvelopeInput,
   175→  status: number,
   176→  extraHeaders?: Record<string, string>,
   177→): Response {
   178→  return new Response(
   179→    JSON.stringify({
   180→      error: input.errorCode,
   181→      errorCode: input.errorCode,
   182→      message: input.message,
   183→      recoverable: input.recoverable,
   184→      ...(input.retryAfter !== undefined ? { retryAfter: input.retryAfter } : {}),
   185→    }),
   186→    {
   187→      status,
   188→      headers: {
   189→        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
   190→        'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
   191→        ...(extraHeaders ?? {}),
   192→      },
   193→    },
   194→  );
   195→}
   196→
   197→export function operationFailureResponse(
   198→  failure: OperationFailure,
   199→  status = 500,
   200→  extraHeaders?: Record<string, string>,
   201→): Response {
   202→  return edgeErrorResponse(
   203→    {
   204→      errorCode: failure.errorCode,
   205→      message: failure.message,
   206→      recoverable: failure.recoverable,
   207→    },
   208→    status,
   209→    extraHeaders,
   210→  );
   211→}
   212→
   213→export function parseJsonFailureResponse(
   214→  failure: OperationFailure,
   215→  status = 400,
   216→  extraHeaders?: Record<string, string>,
   217→): Response {
   218→  return edgeErrorResponse(
   219→    {
   220→      errorCode: failure.errorCode,
   221→      message: failure.message,
   222→      recoverable: failure.recoverable,
   223→    },
   224→    status,
   225→    extraHeaders,
   226→  );
   227→}
   228→
   229→export function requestMethodFailureResponse(
   230→  failure: OperationFailure,
   231→  method: string,
   232→): Response {
   233→  return parseJsonFailureResponse(failure, 405, { Allow: method });
   234→}

1→/**
     2→ * Shared Generation Data Transformers
     3→ * 
     4→ * SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for transforming generation data from database to UI format.
     5→ * 
     6→ * This eliminates the need to manually update transformation logic in multiple places
     7→ * when adding new fields. Instead, update once here and all consumers automatically
     8→ * get the new field.
     9→ * 
    10→ * Architecture Benefits:
    11→ * - DRY: No duplicated transformation logic across hooks/components
    12→ * - Type Safety: Centralized TypeScript types ensure consistency
    13→ * - Maintainability: Add new fields in one place instead of 5+
    14→ * - Testability: Can unit test transformations in isolation
    15→ * 
    16→ * NOTE: upscaled_url has been removed - upscaled versions are now stored as
    17→ * generation_variants with variant_type='upscaled' and become the primary variant,
    18→ * so `location` already contains the best available URL.
    19→ */
    20→
    21→import type { GeneratedImageWithMetadata } from '@/shared/components/MediaGallery/types';
    22→import type { GenerationRow } from '@/domains/generation/types';
    23→import type { GenerationMetadata } from '@/domains/generation/types';
    24→import { getSupabaseClient as supabase } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
    25→import { stripQueryParameters } from '@/shared/lib/media/mediaUrl';
    26→import { TOOL_IDS, isToolId } from '@/shared/lib/toolIds';
    27→import { ServerError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/errors';
    28→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
    29→import { expandShotData } from '@/shared/lib/shotData';
    30→import { parseGenerationTaskId } from '@/shared/lib/generationTaskIdParser';
    31→import { filterUuidStrings } from '@/shared/lib/uuid';
    32→
    33→/**
    34→ * Result type for calculateDerivedCounts
    35→ */
    36→export interface DerivedCountsResult {
    37→  /** Count of variants/derivatives per generation */
    38→  derivedCounts: Record<string, number>;
    39→  /** Whether each generation has any unviewed variants (viewed_at IS NULL) */
    40→  hasUnviewedVariants: Record<string, boolean>;
    41→  /** Count of unviewed variants per generation */
    42→  unviewedVariantCounts: Record<string, number>;
    43→  /** True when counts were intentionally returned empty due to a read-path failure. */
    44→  degraded?: boolean;
    45→  /** Machine-readable reason for degraded fallback behavior. */
    46→  errorCode?: 'query_failed';
    47→}
    48→
    49→function createEmptyDerivedCountsResult(): DerivedCountsResult {
    50→  return {
    51→    derivedCounts: {},
    52→    hasUnviewedVariants: {},
    53→    unviewedVariantCounts: {},
    54→  };
    55→}
    56→
    57→/**
    58→ * Calculate derivedCount for generations (how many variants/derivatives exist)
    59→ * Also tracks whether any variants are unviewed (for NEW badge display)
    60→ *
    61→ * Queries both:
    62→ * - generations table (based_on relationships)
    63→ * - generation_variants table (edit variants)
    64→ *
    65→ * @param generationIds - Array of generation IDs to count variants for
    66→ * @returns Object with derivedCounts and hasUnviewedVariants maps
    67→ */
    68→async function calculateDerivedCounts(
    69→  generationIds: string[]
    70→): Promise<DerivedCountsResult> {
    71→  const persistedGenerationIds = filterUuidStrings(generationIds);
    72→  if (persistedGenerationIds.length === 0) {
    73→    return createEmptyDerivedCountsResult();
    74→  }
    75→
    76→  const { derivedCounts, hasUnviewedVariants, unviewedVariantCounts } = createEmptyDerivedCountsResult();
    77→
    78→  // Only count from generation_variants table (actual variants)
    79→  // Note: We intentionally don't count based_on generations here - those are
    80→  // separate images in the gallery, not variants of this image
    81→  const { data: variantCountsData, error: variantCountsError } = await supabase().from('generation_variants')
    82→    .select('generation_id, viewed_at')
    83→    .in('generation_id', persistedGenerationIds);
    84→
    85→  if (variantCountsError) {
    86→    throw new ServerError('Failed to load variant badge counts', {
    87→      context: { generationIdsCount: generationIds.length },
    88→      cause: variantCountsError,
    89→    });
    90→  }
    91→
    92→  if (variantCountsData) {
    93→    for (const item of variantCountsData as Array<{ generation_id: string; viewed_at: string | null }>) {
    94→      const genId = item.generation_id;
    95→      derivedCounts[genId] = (derivedCounts[genId] || 0) + 1;
    96→      if (item.viewed_at === null) {
    97→        hasUnviewedVariants[genId] = true;
    98→        unviewedVariantCounts[genId] = (unviewedVariantCounts[genId] || 0) + 1;
    99→      }
   100→    }
   101→  }
   102→
   103→  return { derivedCounts, hasUnviewedVariants, unviewedVariantCounts };
   104→}
   105→
   106→/**
   107→ * Fail-open variant of calculateDerivedCounts for non-critical UI surfaces.
   108→ * Keeps badge rendering resilient when counts query intermittently fails.
   109→ */
   110→export async function calculateDerivedCountsSafe(
   111→  generationIds: string[]
   112→): Promise<DerivedCountsResult> {
   113→  try {
   114→    return await calculateDerivedCounts(generationIds);
   115→  } catch (error) {
   116→    normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'generationTransformers.calculateDerivedCountsSafe', showToast: false });
   117→    return {
   118→      ...createEmptyDerivedCountsResult(),
   119→      degraded: true,
   120→      errorCode: 'query_failed',
   121→    };
   122→  }
   123→}

   159→  unviewedVariantCount?: number; // Count of unviewed variants

   165→  // Each generation can appear multiple times in the same shot (different positions)
   166→  // Example: { "shot_id_123": [120, 420, null] } means 3 entries: at frame 120, 420, and one unpositioned
   167→  shot_data?: Record<string, (number | null)[]>;
   168→}
   169→
   170→/**
   171→ * Raw shot_generation record from database (before transformation)
   172→ */
   173→export interface RawShotGeneration {
   174→  id: string;
   175→  shot_id: string;
   176→  generation_id: string;
   177→  timeline_frame: number | null;
   178→  metadata?: Record<string, unknown> | null;

   181→  generations?: RawGeneration | RawGeneration[] | null;
   182→}
   183→
   184→/**
   185→ * Options for transformation customization
   186→ */
   187→interface TransformOptions {
   188→  /** Shot image entry ID (from shot_generations table) */
   189→  shotImageEntryId?: string;
   190→  /** Timeline frame position */
   191→  timeline_frame?: number | null;
   192→  /** Additional metadata to merge */

   194→  /** Shot ID for filtering */

   196→  /** Whether to include verbose logging */

   198→}
   199→
   200→/**
   201→ * Extract prompt from various nested param structures
   202→ */
   203→function extractPrompt(params: Record<string, unknown> | null | undefined): string {
   204→  if (!params) return 'No prompt';
   205→
   206→  const originalParams = params.originalParams as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
   207→  const orchestratorDetails = originalParams?.orchestrator_details as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
   208→  const metadataBlock = params.metadata as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
   209→
   210→  return (
   211→    (orchestratorDetails?.prompt as string) ||
   212→    (params.prompt as string) ||
   213→    (metadataBlock?.prompt as string) ||
   214→    'No prompt'
   215→  );
   216→}
   217→
   218→/**
   219→ * Extract thumbnail URL with fallback logic
   220→ * Handles special case for travel-between-images videos where thumbnail might be in params
   221→ */
   222→function extractThumbnailUrl(item: RawGeneration, mainUrl: string): string {
   223→  // Start with database thumbnail_url field
   224→  let thumbnailUrl = item.thumbnail_url;
   225→  const toolType = item.params?.tool_type;
   226→  
   227→  // If no thumbnail in database, check params for travel-between-images videos
   228→  if (!thumbnailUrl && isToolId(toolType) && toolType === TOOL_IDS.TRAVEL_BETWEEN_IMAGES) {
   229→    const originalParams = item.params?.originalParams as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
   230→    const orchestratorDetails = originalParams?.orchestrator_details as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
   231→    const fullPayload = item.params?.full_orchestrator_payload as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
   232→    const originalFullPayload = originalParams?.full_orchestrator_payload as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
   233→
   234→    thumbnailUrl =
   235→      (item.params?.thumbnailUrl as string) ||
   236→      (orchestratorDetails?.thumbnail_url as string) ||
   237→      (fullPayload?.thumbnail_url as string) ||
   238→      (originalFullPayload?.thumbnail_url as string);
   239→  }
   240→  
   241→  // Final fallback to main URL
   242→  return thumbnailUrl || mainUrl;
   243→}
   244→
   245→/**
   246→ * Normalize timeline_frame to position (divide by 50)
   247→ */
   248→function normalizePosition(timelineFrame: number | null | undefined): number | null {
   249→  if (timelineFrame === null || timelineFrame === undefined) return null;
   250→  return Math.floor(timelineFrame / 50);
   251→}
   252→
   253→/**
   254→ * Transform a raw generation record from database to UI format
   255→ * 
   256→ * This is the MAIN transformation function used by most hooks/components
   257→ * 
   258→ * @param item - Raw generation from database query
   259→ * @param options - Optional customization (shot context, metadata, etc.)
   260→ * @returns Transformed generation ready for UI display
   261→ */
   262→export function transformGeneration(
   263→  item: RawGeneration,
   264→  options: TransformOptions = {}
   265→): GeneratedImageWithMetadata {
   266→  const mainUrl = item.location;
   267→  const thumbnailUrl = extractThumbnailUrl(item, mainUrl);
   268→  const taskIdParse = parseGenerationTaskId(item.tasks);
   269→  const taskId = taskIdParse.taskId;
   270→  const prompt = extractPrompt(item.params);
   271→  
   272→  // Extract content_type from params for proper download file extensions
   273→  // Stored as 'image' or 'video', convert to MIME type
   274→  const storedContentType = item.params?.content_type;
   275→  const isVideo = item.type?.includes('video') || storedContentType === 'video' || false;
   276→  let contentType: string | undefined;
   277→  if (storedContentType === 'video') {
   278→    // Default to mp4 for videos, can be overridden by URL extension
   279→    contentType = 'video/mp4';
   280→  } else if (storedContentType === 'image') {
   281→    // Default to png for images, can be overridden by URL extension  
   282→    contentType = 'image/png';
   283→  }
   284→  
   285→  // Compute stable URL identities for caching/comparison
   286→  // Supabase URLs have rotating tokens but the file path is stable
   287→  const urlIdentity = stripQueryParameters(mainUrl);
   288→  const thumbUrlIdentity = stripQueryParameters(thumbnailUrl);
   289→
   290→  // Base transformation - fields common to all generations
   291→  const baseItem: GeneratedImageWithMetadata = {
   292→    id: item.id,
   293→    url: mainUrl,
   294→    thumbUrl: thumbnailUrl,
   295→    urlIdentity,
   296→    thumbUrlIdentity,
   297→    prompt,
   298→    metadata: {
   299→      ...(item.params || {}),
   300→      taskId, // Include task ID in metadata for MediaGalleryItem
   301→      taskIdStatus: taskIdParse.status, // Surface parse health to avoid silent shape drift
   302→      based_on: item.based_on, // Include based_on for lineage tracking
   303→      ...(options.metadata || {}), // Merge any additional metadata
   304→    },
   305→    createdAt: item.created_at,
   306→    updatedAt: item.updated_at,
   307→    isVideo,
   308→    contentType, // For proper download file extensions
   309→    starred: item.starred || false,
   310→    based_on: item.based_on, // Top level for easy access
   311→    position: null, // Will be set if shot context provided
   312→    timeline_frame: null, // Will be set if shot context provided
   313→    name: item.name || (item.params?.name as string | undefined) || undefined,
   314→    derivedCount: item.derivedCount || 0, // Number of generations/variants based on this one
   315→    hasUnviewedVariants: item.hasUnviewedVariants || false, // For NEW badge display
   316→    unviewedVariantCount: item.unviewedVariantCount || 0, // Count for tooltip
   317→    // Parent/child relationship fields
   318→    is_child: item.is_child ?? undefined,
   319→    parent_generation_id: item.parent_generation_id ?? undefined,
   320→    child_order: item.child_order ?? undefined,
   321→  };
   322→
   323→  // Normalize JSONB shot_data into a flat association list.
   324→  const shotGenerations = expandShotData(item.shot_data as Record<string, unknown> | null | undefined);
   325→  
   326→  // If shot context is provided via options, use it
   327→  if (options.shotImageEntryId || options.timeline_frame !== undefined) {
   328→    return {
   329→      ...baseItem,
   330→      shotImageEntryId: options.shotImageEntryId,
   331→      timeline_frame: options.timeline_frame ?? null,
   332→      position: normalizePosition(options.timeline_frame),
   333→    };
   334→  }
   335→
   336→  // Otherwise, process shot associations from query data
   337→  if (shotGenerations.length > 0) {
   338→    // Single shot optimization
   339→    if (shotGenerations.length === 1) {
   340→      const singleShot = shotGenerations[0];
   341→      return {
   342→        ...baseItem,
   343→        shot_id: singleShot.shot_id,
   344→        position: normalizePosition(singleShot.timeline_frame),
   345→        timeline_frame: singleShot.timeline_frame,
   346→      };
   347→    }
   348→    
   349→    // Multiple shots: include all associations
   350→    const allAssociations = shotGenerations.map(shotGen => ({
   351→      shot_id: shotGen.shot_id,
   352→      timeline_frame: shotGen.timeline_frame,
   353→      position: normalizePosition(shotGen.timeline_frame),
   354→    }));
   355→    
   356→    // When filtering by specific shot, use that shot as primary
   357→    let primaryShot = shotGenerations[0];
   358→    if (options.shotId) {
   359→      const matchingShot = shotGenerations.find(shotGen => shotGen.shot_id === options.shotId);
   360→      if (matchingShot) {
   361→        primaryShot = matchingShot;
   362→      }
   363→    }
   364→
   365→    return {
   366→      ...baseItem,
   367→      shot_id: primaryShot.shot_id,
   368→      position: normalizePosition(primaryShot.timeline_frame),
   369→      timeline_frame: primaryShot.timeline_frame,
   370→      all_shot_associations: allAssociations,
   371→    };
   372→  }
   373→  
   374→  return baseItem;
   375→}
   376→
   377→/**
   378→ * Transform for Timeline component's specific needs
   379→ * Maps to GenerationRow format expected by Timeline
   380→ */
   381→export function transformForTimeline(
   382→  shotGen: RawShotGeneration
   383→): GenerationRow & { timeline_frame?: number } {
   384→  const gen = shotGen.generation || shotGen.generations;
   385→  const genData = Array.isArray(gen) ? gen[0] : gen;
   386→  
   387→  if (!genData) {
   388→    return {
   389→      // PRIMARY IDs: id = shot_generations.id (unique per entry), generation_id = actual generation
   390→      id: shotGen.id,
   391→      generation_id: shotGen.generation_id,
   392→      // Deprecated (backwards compat)
   393→      shotImageEntryId: shotGen.id,
   394→      timeline_frame: shotGen.timeline_frame ?? undefined,
   395→    };
   396→  }
   397→  
   398→  return {
   399→    // PRIMARY IDs: id = shot_generations.id (unique per entry), generation_id = actual generation
   400→    id: shotGen.id,
   401→    generation_id: shotGen.generation_id,
   402→    // Deprecated (backwards compat)
   403→    shotImageEntryId: shotGen.id,
   404→    imageUrl: genData.location,
   405→    thumbUrl: genData.location,
   406→    location: genData.location,
   407→    type: genData.type ?? undefined,
   408→    createdAt: genData.created_at,
   409→    timeline_frame: shotGen.timeline_frame ?? undefined,
   410→    metadata: (shotGen.metadata as GenerationMetadata | undefined) ?? undefined,
   411→    starred: genData.starred ?? false,
   412→    based_on: genData.based_on ?? undefined,
   413→    derivedCount: genData.derivedCount ?? 0,
   414→  };
   415→}
   416→
   417→/**
   418→ * Detect if a URL points to a video based on file extension.
   419→ * Used for variants which lack a `type` column.
   420→ */
   421→function isVideoUrl(url: string | null | undefined): boolean {
   422→  if (!url) return false;
   423→  const videoExtensions = ['.mp4', '.webm', '.mov', '.avi', '.mkv'];
   424→  return videoExtensions.some(ext => url.toLowerCase().includes(ext));
   425→}
   426→
   427→/**
   428→ * Transform a raw variant record from generation_variants table to UI format.
   429→ *
   430→ * Mirrors `transformGeneration` but for variants, which have a different
   431→ * schema (no `type` column, different metadata shape).
   432→ *
   433→ * @param variant - Raw variant from database query
   434→ * @param options - Optional overrides (e.g. toolType fallback)
   435→ * @returns Transformed variant ready for UI display
   436→ */
   437→export function transformVariant(
   438→  variant: RawVariant,
   439→  options?: { toolType?: string }
   440→): GeneratedImageWithMetadata {
   441→  const isVideo = isVideoUrl(variant.location);
   442→  const variantParams = (variant.params ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
   443→  const storedContentType = variantParams.content_type as string | undefined;
   444→
   445→  let contentType: string | undefined;
   446→  if (storedContentType === 'video' || isVideo) {
   447→    contentType = 'video/mp4';
   448→  } else {
   449→    contentType = 'image/png';
   450→  }
   451→
   452→  return {
   453→    id: variant.id,
   454→    url: variant.location,
   455→    thumbUrl: variant.thumbnail_url || variant.location,
   456→    isVideo,
   457→    contentType,
   458→    createdAt: variant.created_at,
   459→    starred: false, // Variants don't have starred flag
   460→    metadata: {
   461→      prompt: variantParams.prompt as string | undefined,
   462→      variant_type: variant.variant_type,
   463→      name: variant.name,
   464→      generation_id: variant.generation_id,
   465→      tool_type: (variantParams.tool_type as string) || options?.toolType,
   466→      created_from: variantParams.created_from as string | undefined,
   467→      source_task_id: variantParams.source_task_id as string | undefined,
   468→      content_type: storedContentType,
   469→    },
   470→    shot_id: undefined,
   471→    position: undefined,
   472→    all_shot_associations: undefined,
   473→  };
   474→}
   475→

    10→import { PhaseConfig } from '@/shared/types/phaseConfig';

    23→/**

    75→
    76→interface JoinClipsSharedTaskParams {
    77→  project_id: string;
    78→  shot_id?: string; // Associate task with a shot for "Visit Shot" button in TasksPane
    79→  per_join_settings?: JoinClipsPerJoinSettings[];
    80→  run_id?: string;
    81→  prompt?: string;
    82→  context_frame_count?: number;
    83→  gap_frame_count?: number;
    84→  replace_mode?: boolean; // Replace frames (true) or generate new frames (false)
    85→  keep_bridging_images?: boolean; // Whether to keep anchor images in the bridge
    86→  enhance_prompt?: boolean; // AI enhancement of prompts
    87→  model?: string;
    88→  num_inference_steps?: number;
    89→  guidance_scale?: number;
    90→  seed?: number;
    91→  resolution?: [number, number];
    92→  fps?: number;
    93→  negative_prompt?: string;
    94→  priority?: number;
    95→  loras?: PathLoraConfig[]; // LoRA models to apply (for basic mode)
    96→  phase_config?: PhaseConfig; // Custom phase config (for advanced mode - overrides loras)
    97→  motion_mode?: 'basic' | 'advanced'; // Motion control mode for UI state restoration
    98→  selected_phase_preset_id?: string | null; // Selected preset ID for UI state restoration
    99→  parent_generation_id?: string;
   100→  tool_type?: string; // Tool type identifier for filtering results
   101→  use_input_video_resolution?: boolean; // Use first input video's resolution instead of project resolution
   102→  use_input_video_fps?: boolean; // Use first input video's FPS instead of downsampling to 16fps (default: false)
   103→  vid2vid_init_strength?: number; // Adds noise to input video frames (0 = disabled, higher = more noise/creative freedom)
   104→  loop_first_clip?: boolean; // Loop first clip - use first clip as both start and end
   105→  based_on?: string; // Source generation ID for variant creation (when looping from "Add to Join")
   106→  audio_url?: string;
   107→}
   108→
   109→export interface CanonicalJoinClipsTaskInput extends JoinClipsSharedTaskParams {
   110→  mode: 'multi_clip' | 'video_edit';
   111→  clip_source: JoinClipsClipSource;
   112→  video_edit?: JoinClipsVideoEditConfig;
   113→}
   114→
   115→/**
   116→ * Task defaults in snake_case, auto-derived from the tool's settings.ts.
   117→ * joinClipsSettings.defaults already spreads VACE_GENERATION_DEFAULTS,
   118→ * so per-tool overrides (e.g., guidanceScale: 5.0) flow through automatically.
   119→ */
   120→const TASK_DEFAULTS = camelToSnakeKeys(joinClipsSettings.defaults);
   121→
   122→type JoinMode = 'multi_clip_join' | 'video_edit_join';
   123→
   124→interface NormalizedJoinClipsParams {
   125→  clipSequence: JoinClipDescriptor[];
   126→  clipSourceKind: JoinClipsClipSource['kind'];
   127→  joinMode: JoinMode;
   128→  videoEdit?: JoinClipsVideoEditConfig;
   129→}
   130→
   131→const PER_JOIN_OVERRIDE_KEYS = [
   132→  'prompt',
   133→  'gap_frame_count',
   134→  'context_frame_count',
   135→  'replace_mode',
   136→  'model',
   137→  'num_inference_steps',
   138→  'guidance_scale',
   139→  'seed',
   140→  'negative_prompt',
   141→  'priority',
   142→  'resolution',
   143→  'fps',
   144→] as const satisfies readonly (keyof JoinClipsPerJoinSettings)[];
   145→
   146→function buildJoinOverrideRecord(
   147→  override?: JoinClipsPerJoinSettings,
   148→): Record<string, unknown> {
   149→  if (!override) {
   150→    return {};
   151→  }
   152→
   153→  const joinSettings: Record<string, unknown> = {};
   154→  for (const key of PER_JOIN_OVERRIDE_KEYS) {
   155→    const value = override[key];
   156→    if (value !== undefined) {
   157→      joinSettings[key] = value;
   158→    }
   159→  }
   160→
   161→  if (override.loras && override.loras.length > 0) {
   162→    joinSettings.additional_loras = mapPathLorasToStrengthRecord(override.loras);
   163→  }
   164→
   165→  return joinSettings;
   166→}
   167→
   168→/**
   169→ * Build phase config for join clips (always uses VACE since we're joining existing videos).
   170→ * User-selected LoRAs are added to every phase at their specified strength.
   171→ * 
   172→ * @param userLoras - User-selected LoRAs to add to every phase
   173→ * @returns PhaseConfig for VACE model
   174→ */
   175→function buildJoinClipsPhaseConfig(
   176→  userLoras: PathLoraConfig[] = []
   177→): PhaseConfig {
   178→  return buildPhaseConfigWithLoras(userLoras);
   179→}
   180→
   181→/**
   182→ * Builds the ordered clip sequence from the provided parameters.
   183→ */
   184→function buildClipSequenceFromSource(source: JoinClipsClipSource): JoinClipDescriptor[] {
   185→  return source.clips.map((clip) => ({
   186→    url: clip.url,
   187→    ...(clip.name ? { name: clip.name } : {}),
   188→  }));
   189→}
   190→
   191→/**
   192→ * Validates join clips task parameters and returns the normalized clip sequence
   193→ * 
   194→ * @param params - Parameters to validate
   195→ * @throws TaskValidationError if validation fails
   196→ */
   197→function normalizeJoinClipsParams(params: CanonicalJoinClipsTaskInput): NormalizedJoinClipsParams {
   198→  validateRequiredFields(params, [
   199→    'project_id'
   200→  ]);
   201→
   202→  const clipSource = params.clip_source;
   203→  const clipSequence = buildClipSequenceFromSource(clipSource);
   204→
   205→  if (clipSequence.length < 2) {
   206→    throw new TaskValidationError("At least two clips are required to create a join", 'clips');
   207→  }
   208→
   209→  clipSequence.forEach((clip, index) => {
   210→    try {
   211→      validateNonEmptyString(clip.url, `clips[${index}]`, `Clip ${index + 1} URL`);
   212→    } catch {
   213→      throw new TaskValidationError(`Clip at position ${index} is missing a URL`, 'clips');
   214→    }
   215→  });
   216→
   217→  const joinsCount = clipSequence.length - 1;
   218→
   219→  if (params.per_join_settings && params.per_join_settings.length > joinsCount) {
   220→    throw new TaskValidationError(
   221→      "per_join_settings length cannot exceed the number of joins",
   222→      'per_join_settings'
   223→    );
   224→  }
   225→
   226→  const videoEdit = params.video_edit;
   227→  if (params.mode === 'video_edit' && !videoEdit) {
   228→    throw new TaskValidationError(
   229→      "video_edit config is required when mode is video_edit",
   230→      'mode',
   231→    );
   232→  }
   233→  if (videoEdit && !videoEdit.source_video_url) {
   234→    throw new TaskValidationError(
   235→      "video_edit.source_video_url is required when video_edit config is provided",
   236→      'video_edit',
   237→    );
   238→  }
   239→  if (params.mode !== 'video_edit' && videoEdit) {
   240→    throw new TaskValidationError(
   241→      "video_edit config can only be provided when mode is video_edit",
   242→      'mode',
   243→    );
   244→  }
   245→  if (params.mode === 'multi_clip' && clipSource.kind !== 'clips') {
   246→    throw new TaskValidationError(
   247→      "clip_source.kind must be clips when mode is multi_clip",
   248→      'mode',
   249→    );
   250→  }
   251→
   252→  const joinMode: JoinMode = params.mode === 'video_edit'
   253→    ? 'video_edit_join'
   254→    : 'multi_clip_join';
   255→
   256→  return {
   257→    clipSequence,
   258→    clipSourceKind: clipSource.kind,
   259→    joinMode,
   260→    videoEdit,
   261→  };
   262→}
   263→
   264→/**
   265→ * Builds the orchestrator payload for join clips
   266→ * 
   267→ * @param params - Raw join clips parameters
   268→ * @param clipSequence - Normalized list of clips in order
   269→ * @param runId - Generated run ID
   270→ * @param orchestratorTaskId - Generated orchestrator task ID
   271→ * @returns Processed orchestrator payload
   272→ */
   273→function buildJoinClipsPayload(
   274→  params: CanonicalJoinClipsTaskInput,
   275→  normalized: NormalizedJoinClipsParams,
   276→  runId: string,
   277→  orchestratorTaskId: string
   278→): Record<string, unknown> {
   279→  const clipSequence = normalized.clipSequence;
   280→  // Use provided phase config (advanced mode) or build from LoRAs (basic mode)
   281→  const phaseConfig = params.phase_config || buildJoinClipsPhaseConfig(params.loras || []);
   282→  
   283→  const orchestratorDetails: Record<string, unknown> = {
   284→    orchestrator_task_id: orchestratorTaskId,
   285→    clip_list: clipSequence.map(clip => ({
   286→      url: clip.url,
   287→      ...(clip.name ? { name: clip.name } : {}),
   288→    })),
   289→    run_id: runId,
   290→    shot_id: params.shot_id ?? undefined, // For "Visit Shot" button in TasksPane
   291→    prompt: params.prompt ?? TASK_DEFAULTS.prompt,
   292→    gap_frame_count: params.gap_frame_count ?? TASK_DEFAULTS.gap_frame_count,
   293→    context_frame_count: params.context_frame_count ?? TASK_DEFAULTS.context_frame_count,
   294→    replace_mode: params.replace_mode ?? TASK_DEFAULTS.replace_mode,
   295→    keep_bridging_images: params.keep_bridging_images, // Optional, defaults to undefined (backend handles default)
   296→    enhance_prompt: params.enhance_prompt ?? TASK_DEFAULTS.enhance_prompt,
   297→    model: params.model ?? TASK_DEFAULTS.model,
   298→    num_inference_steps: params.num_inference_steps ?? TASK_DEFAULTS.num_inference_steps,
   299→    guidance_scale: params.guidance_scale ?? TASK_DEFAULTS.guidance_scale,
   300→    seed: params.seed ?? TASK_DEFAULTS.seed,
   301→    negative_prompt: params.negative_prompt ?? TASK_DEFAULTS.negative_prompt,
   302→    priority: params.priority ?? TASK_DEFAULTS.priority,
   303→    parent_generation_id: params.parent_generation_id,
   304→    // UNIFIED: Always include phase_config and advanced_mode for consistent backend processing
   305→    phase_config: phaseConfig,
   306→    advanced_mode: true,
   307→    // Motion settings for UI state restoration
   308→    motion_mode: params.motion_mode ?? TASK_DEFAULTS.motion_mode,
   309→    selected_phase_preset_id: params.selected_phase_preset_id ?? TASK_DEFAULTS.selected_phase_preset_id,
   310→  };
   311→
   312→  assignMappedPayloadFields(orchestratorDetails, params, [
   313→    { from: 'resolution' },
   314→    { from: 'fps' },
   315→    { from: 'use_input_video_resolution' },
   316→    { from: 'use_input_video_fps' },
   317→    { from: 'audio_url' },
   318→  ]);
   319→
   320→  assignMappedPayloadFields(orchestratorDetails, params, [
   321→    {
   322→      from: 'vid2vid_init_strength',
   323→      include: (value) => typeof value === 'number' && value > 0,
   324→    },
   325→  ]);
   326→
   327→  if (params.loop_first_clip) {
   328→    orchestratorDetails.loop_first_clip = true;
   329→  }
   330→
   331→  // Pass based_on for variant creation when looping a clip from "Add to Join"
   332→  if (params.based_on) {
   333→    orchestratorDetails.based_on = params.based_on;
   334→  }
   335→
   336→  // Keep additional_loras for backward compatibility, but LoRAs are now primarily in phase_config
   337→  if (params.loras && params.loras.length > 0) {
   338→    orchestratorDetails.additional_loras = mapPathLorasToStrengthRecord(params.loras);
   339→  }
   340→  
   341→  // Video edit mode - for regenerating portions of a single video
   342→  if (normalized.videoEdit) {
   343→    orchestratorDetails.video_edit_mode = true;
   344→    orchestratorDetails.source_video_url = normalized.videoEdit.source_video_url;
   345→    orchestratorDetails.source_video_fps = normalized.videoEdit.source_video_fps;
   346→    orchestratorDetails.source_video_duration = normalized.videoEdit.source_video_duration;
   347→    orchestratorDetails.source_video_total_frames = normalized.videoEdit.source_video_total_frames;
   348→    orchestratorDetails.portions_to_regenerate = normalized.videoEdit.portions_to_regenerate;
   349→  }
   350→
   351→  const totalJoins = Math.max(clipSequence.length - 1, 0);
   352→  if (totalJoins > 0) {
   353→    const perJoinOverrides: Record<string, unknown>[] = [];
   354→    let hasOverrides = false;
   355→
   356→    for (let index = 0; index < totalJoins; index++) {
   357→      const joinSettings = buildJoinOverrideRecord(params.per_join_settings?.[index]);
   358→
   359→      if (Object.keys(joinSettings).length > 0) {
   360→        hasOverrides = true;
   361→        perJoinOverrides.push(joinSettings);
   362→      } else {
   363→        perJoinOverrides.push({});
   364→      }
   365→    }
   366→
   367→    if (hasOverrides) {
   368→      orchestratorDetails.per_join_settings = perJoinOverrides;
   369→    }
   370→  }
   371→
   372→  const resolutionDisplay = params.resolution
   373→    ? `${params.resolution[0]}x${params.resolution[1]}`
   374→    : undefined;
   375→
   376→  const joinMode = normalized.joinMode;
   377→
   378→  const perJoinOverridesCount = params.per_join_settings?.filter((override) =>
   379→    !!override && Object.keys(override).length > 0
   380→  ).length ?? 0;
   381→
   382→  const familyContract = buildJoinClipsFamilyContract({
   383→    mode: joinMode,
   384→    runId,
   385→    clipUrls: clipSequence.map((clip) => clip.url),
   386→    overridesCount: perJoinOverridesCount,
   387→    hasAudio: Boolean(params.audio_url),
   388→  });
   389→
   390→  const payload = composeTaskFamilyPayload({
   391→    taskFamily: 'join_clips',
   392→    orchestratorDetails,
   393→    orchestrationInput: {
   394→      taskFamily: 'join_clips',
   395→      orchestratorTaskId,
   396→      runId,
   397→      parentGenerationId: params.parent_generation_id,
   398→      shotId: params.shot_id,
   399→      basedOn: params.based_on,
   400→      generationRouting: 'orchestrator',
   401→      siblingLookup: 'run_id',
   402→    },
   403→    taskViewInput: {
   404→      inputImages: clipSequence.map((clip) => clip.url),
   405→      prompt: params.prompt,
   406→      negativePrompt: params.negative_prompt,
   407→      modelName: params.model,
   408→      resolution: resolutionDisplay,
   409→    },
   410→    familyContract,
   411→  });
   412→
   413→  return {
   414→    ...payload,
   415→    parent_generation_id: params.parent_generation_id,
   416→    // Only include tool_type if explicitly passed (Join Clips page passes it, ShotEditor doesn't)
   417→    ...(params.tool_type && { tool_type: params.tool_type }),
   418→  };
   419→}
   420→
   421→/**
   422→ * Creates a join clips task using the unified approach
   423→ * 
   424→ * @param params - Join clips task parameters
   425→ * @returns Promise resolving to the created task
   426→ */
   427→export async function createCanonicalJoinClipsTask(
   428→  params: CanonicalJoinClipsTaskInput,
   429→): Promise<TaskCreationResult> {
   430→  return runTaskCreationPipeline({
   431→    params,
   432→    context: 'JoinClips',
   433→    buildTaskRequest: (requestParams) => {
   434→      const normalized = normalizeJoinClipsParams(requestParams);
   435→      const orchestratorTaskId = generateTaskId("join_clips_orchestrator");
   436→      const runId = requestParams.run_id ?? generateRunId();
   437→      const orchestratorPayload = buildJoinClipsPayload(
   438→        requestParams,
   439→        normalized,
   440→        runId,
   441→        orchestratorTaskId,
   442→      );
   443→
   444→      return composeTaskRequest({
   445→        source: requestParams,
   446→        taskType: 'join_clips_orchestrator',
   447→        params: orchestratorPayload,
   448→      });
   449→    },
   450→  });
   451→}
   452→
   453→// TaskValidationError is used internally - import from taskCreation.ts if needed externally
   454→

   116→  const page = Math.floor(offset / limit) + 1;
   117→  const effectiveProjectId: string | null = projectId ?? null;
   118→  const cacheProjectKey = allProjects ? 'all' : effectiveProjectId;
   119→  const safeCacheProjectKey = cacheProjectKey ?? '__no-project__';
   120→  const visibleTaskTypes = getVisibleTaskTypes();
   121→  const smartPollingConfig = useSmartPollingConfig(taskQueryKeys.paginated(safeCacheProjectKey));
   122→
   123→  const query = useQuery<PaginatedTasksResponse, Error>({
   124→    queryKey: [...taskQueryKeys.paginated(safeCacheProjectKey), page, limit, status, taskType],
   125→    queryFn: createPaginatedTasksQueryFn({

   129→      status,

   131→      visibleTaskTypes,
   132→      limit,
   133→      offset,
   134→      page,
   135→    }, safeCacheProjectKey),
   136→    enabled: allProjects ? !!allProjectIds?.length : !!effectiveProjectId,
   137→    placeholderData: keepPreviousData,

   141→    retry: STANDARD_RETRY,

   144→
   145→  useProcessingRefetchGuard(status, query);

   232→export function applyPendingClipActions(

   245→    if (emptyIndex !== -1) {
   246→      clips = clips.map((clip, idx) =>
   247→        idx === emptyIndex
   248→          ? {
   249→              ...clip,
   250→              url: action.clip.url,
   251→              posterUrl: action.clip.posterUrl,
   252→              durationSeconds: action.clip.durationSeconds,
   253→              loaded: false,
   254→              playing: false,
   255→              generationId: action.clip.generationId,
   256→            }
   257→          : clip,
   258→      );
   259→      filledIndices.add(emptyIndex);

   263→  }

   222→    if (isCircuitBreakerTriggered) {
   223→      this.notifySubscribers();
   224→
   225→      // Show user-facing error toast (throttled to prevent spam)
   226→      if (now - this.lastErrorToastTime > this.ERROR_TOAST_THROTTLE_MS) {
   227→        this.lastErrorToastTime = now;
   228→
   229→        this.reportCircuitBreakerError({
   230→          queryKey: key,
   231→          failureCount: newCount,
   232→          errorType,
   233→          error,
   234→        });
   235→      }
   236→    }
   237→  }
   238→
   239→  private reportCircuitBreakerError(input: {
   240→    queryKey: string;
   241→    failureCount: number;
   242→    errorType: string;
   243→    error: Error;
   244→  }) {
   245→    const userMessage = this.getUserFriendlyErrorMessage(input.errorType, input.failureCount);
   246→    normalizeAndPresentError(new Error('Data may be outdated. Will retry automatically.'), {
   247→      context: 'DataFreshnessManager.onFetchFailure',
   248→      toastTitle: userMessage,
   249→      showToast: true,
   250→      logData: {
   251→        [REDACTED](input.queryKey),
   252→        failureCount: input.failureCount,
   253→        errorType: input.errorType,
   254→        errorMessage: input.error.message,
   255→      },
   256→    });
   257→  }
   258→
   259→  /**
   260→   * Get a user-friendly error message based on error type
   261→   */
   262→  private getUserFriendlyErrorMessage(errorType: string, failureCount: number): string {
   263→    switch (errorType) {
   264→      case 'CONNECTION_CLOSED':
   265→      case 'NETWORK_ERROR':
   266→        return 'Connection issue detected';
   267→      case 'TIMEOUT':
   268→        return 'Server is slow to respond';
   269→      case 'RATE_LIMITED':
   270→        return 'Too many requests - slowing down';
   271→      case 'SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE':
   272→        return 'Service temporarily unavailable';
   273→      case 'AUTH_ERROR':
   274→        return 'Authentication issue - try refreshing';
   275→      default:
   276→        return `Connection issues (${failureCount} failures)`;
   277→    }
   278→  }
   279→
   280→  /**
   281→   * Report a successful fetch (resets circuit breaker)
   282→   */
   283→  onFetchSuccess(queryKey: QueryKeyLike) {
   284→    const [REDACTED](queryKey);
   285→    const existing = this.state.fetchFailures.get(key);
   286→
   287→    if (existing && existing.count > 0) {
   288→      // Reset failure count on success
   289→      this.state.fetchFailures.delete(key);
   290→    }
   291→  }
   292→
   293→  /**
   294→   * Classify error type for better logging and handling
   295→   */
   296→  private classifyError(error: Error): string {
   297→    const message = error.message?.toLowerCase() || '';
   298→
   299→    if (message.includes('connection_closed') || message.includes('err_connection_closed')) {
   300→      return 'CONNECTION_CLOSED';
   301→    }
   302→    if (message.includes('failed to fetch') || message.includes('network')) {
   303→      return 'NETWORK_ERROR';
   304→    }
   305→    if (message.includes('timeout') || message.includes('timed out')) {
   306→      return 'TIMEOUT';
   307→    }
   308→    if (message.includes('abort')) {
   309→      return 'ABORTED';
   310→    }
   311→    if (message.includes('401') || message.includes('unauthorized')) {
   312→      return 'AUTH_ERROR';
   313→    }
   314→    if (message.includes('429') || message.includes('rate limit')) {
   315→      return 'RATE_LIMITED';
   316→    }
   317→    if (message.includes('503') || message.includes('service unavailable')) {
   318→      return 'SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE';
   319→    }
   320→    return 'UNKNOWN';
   321→  }
   322→
   323→  /**
   324→   * Check if data for a query is considered fresh
   325→   */
   326→  isDataFresh(queryKey: QueryKeyLike, freshnessThreshold: number = 30000): boolean {
   327→    return isQueryFresh(this.state.lastEventTimes, queryKey, freshnessThreshold, Date.now());
   328→  }
   329→
   330→  /**
   331→   * Get current freshness state for debugging
   332→   */
   333→  getDiagnostics() {
   334→    const now = Date.now();
   335→    return {
   336→      realtimeStatus: this.state.realtimeStatus,
   337→      timeSinceStatusChange: now - this.state.lastStatusChange,
   338→      trackedQueries: this.state.lastEventTimes.size,
   339→      queryAges: buildQueryAgeDiagnostics(this.state.lastEventTimes, now, this.parseQueryKey),
   340→      subscriberCount: this.subscribers.size,
   341→      timestamp: now
   342→    };
   343→  }
   344→
   345→  /**
   346→   * Subscribe to freshness changes
   347→   * Returns unsubscribe function
   348→   */
   349→  subscribe(callback: () => void): () => void {
   350→    this.subscribers.add(callback);
   351→    return () => this.subscribers.delete(callback);
   352→  }
   353→
   354→  /**
   355→   * Clear all event history (useful for testing or project changes)
   356→   */
   357→  reset() {
   358→    this.state.lastEventTimes.clear();
   359→    this.state.fetchFailures.clear();
   360→    this.state.realtimeStatus = 'disconnected';
   361→    this.state.lastStatusChange = Date.now();
   362→    this.notifySubscribers();
   363→  }
   364→
   365→  /**
   366→   * Manually mark queries as fresh (useful for mutations)
   367→   */
   368→  markQueriesFresh(queryKeys: readonly QueryKeyLike[]) {
   369→    const now = Date.now();
   370→    markQueryKeysFresh(this.state.lastEventTimes, queryKeys, now);
   371→
   372→    this.notifySubscribers();
   373→  }
   374→
   375→  private notifySubscribers() {
   376→    this.subscribers.forEach((callback) => {
   377→      try {
   378→        callback();
   379→      } catch (error) {
   380→        normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'DataFreshnessManager', showToast: false });
   381→      }
   382→    });
   383→  }
   384→}
   385→
   386→// Singleton instance - single source of truth for the entire app
   387→export const dataFreshnessManager = new DataFreshnessManager();
   388→
   389→/** Dev-only helper for wiring debug globals during app bootstrap. */
   390→export function registerDataFreshnessManagerDebugGlobal(): void {
   391→  if (!import.meta.env.DEV || typeof window === 'undefined') {
   392→    return;
   393→  }
   394→
   395→  registerDebugGlobal(
   396→    '__DATA_FRESHNESS_MANAGER__',
   397→    dataFreshnessManager,
   398→    'DataFreshnessManager',
   399→  );
   400→}

     5→type JsonObject = Record<string, unknown>;

     7→function asRecord(value: unknown): JsonObject | null {

   171→    .eq('id', pairShotGenerationId)
   172→    .maybeSingle();
   173→
   174→  if (error) {
   175→    return {
   176→      ok: false,
   177→      error: error.message || 'Failed to verify segment connection',
   178→    };
   179→  }
   180→
   181→  return {
   182→    ok: true,
   183→    connected: !!data && data.shot_id === shotId && (data.timeline_frame ?? -1) >= 0,
   184→  };
   185→};

1→import type { AppError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/errors';
     2→import {
     3→  reportError,
     4→  type ErrorReportOptions,
     5→} from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/coreReporter';
     6→import { presentRuntimeError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeErrorPresenter';
     7→
     8→export interface RuntimeErrorOptions extends ErrorReportOptions {
     9→  toastTitle?: string;
    10→  showToast?: boolean;
    11→}
    12→
    13→/** Normalize unknown errors and route them through the shared presenter. */
    14→export function normalizeAndPresentError(error: unknown, options: RuntimeErrorOptions): AppError {
    15→  const { context, logData, onError, toastTitle, showToast } = options;
    16→  const appError = reportError(error, { context, logData, onError });
    17→
    18→  const shouldShowToast = showToast ?? appError.showToast;
    19→  if (shouldShowToast) {
    20→    presentRuntimeError(appError, toastTitle);
    21→  }
    22→
    23→  return appError;
    24→}
    25→
    26→/** Normalize, present, then throw for caller-level control-flow stops. */
    27→export function normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(error: unknown, options: RuntimeErrorOptions): never {
    28→  throw normalizeAndPresentError(error, options);
    29→}
    30→

    69→  currentImages: GenerationRow[],
    70→): SegmentController {
    71→  const localShotGenPositions = useMemo(() => {
    72→    if (props.generationMode === 'timeline') {
    73→      return undefined;
    74→    }
    75→
    76→    const orderedImages = currentImages.filter(
    77→      (image) => isPositioned(image) && !isVideoGeneration(image)
    78→    );
    79→    if (orderedImages.length === 0) {
    80→      return undefined;
    81→    }
    82→
    83→    const positions = new Map<string, number>();
    84→    orderedImages.forEach((image, index) => {
    85→      if (image.id) {
    86→        positions.set(image.id, index);
    87→      }
    88→    });
    89→    return positions;
    90→  }, [currentImages, props.generationMode]);
    91→
    92→  const shouldFetchSegments = props.generationMode !== 'timeline' &&
    93→    (!props.segmentSlots || (localShotGenPositions && localShotGenPositions.size > 0));
    94→
    95→  const hookResult = useSegmentOutputsForShot(
    96→    shouldFetchSegments ? props.shotId || null : null,
    97→    shouldFetchSegments ? props.projectId || null : null,
    98→    shouldFetchSegments ? localShotGenPositions : undefined
    99→  );
   100→
   101→  const segmentSlots = (localShotGenPositions && localShotGenPositions.size > 0)
   102→    ? (hookResult.segmentSlots.length > 0 ? hookResult.segmentSlots : props.segmentSlots ?? [])
   103→    : (props.segmentSlots ?? hookResult.segmentSlots);
   104→
   105→  const selectedParentId = hookResult.selectedParentId;
   106→  const { hasPendingTask } = usePendingSegmentTasks(
   107→    props.generationMode !== 'timeline' ? props.shotId || null : null,
   108→    props.generationMode !== 'timeline' ? props.projectId || null : null
   109→  );
   110→
   111→  const segmentLightbox = useSegmentLightboxState(segmentSlots, props.onPairClick);
   112→
   113→  return {
   114→    segmentSlots,
   115→    selectedParentId,
   116→    hasPendingTask,
   117→    segmentLightbox,
   118→  };
   119→}
   120→
   121→function useSegmentLightboxState(
   122→  segmentSlots: SegmentSlot[],
   123→  onPairClick?: ShotImageManagerProps['onPairClick']
   124→): SegmentLightboxState {
   125→  const [segmentLightboxIndex, setSegmentLightboxIndex] = useState<number | null>(null);
   126→
   127→  const handleSegmentClick = useCallback((slotIndex: number) => {
   128→    const slot = segmentSlots[slotIndex];
   129→    if (onPairClick && slot) {
   130→      onPairClick(slot.index);
   131→      return;
   132→    }
   133→
   134→    setSegmentLightboxIndex(slotIndex);
   135→  }, [onPairClick, segmentSlots]);
   136→
   137→  const currentSegmentSlot = segmentLightboxIndex !== null ? segmentSlots[segmentLightboxIndex] : null;
   138→  const currentSegmentMedia = currentSegmentSlot?.type === 'child'
   139→    ? currentSegmentSlot.child
   140→    : null;
   141→
   142→  const segmentChildSlotIndices = useMemo(
   143→    () =>
   144→      segmentSlots
   145→        .map((slot, idx) => (slot.type === 'child' && slot.child.location ? idx : null))
   146→        .filter((idx): idx is number => idx !== null),
   147→    [segmentSlots]
   148→  );
   149→
   150→  const handleSegmentLightboxNext = useCallback(() => {
   151→    if (segmentLightboxIndex === null || segmentChildSlotIndices.length === 0) {
   152→      return;
   153→    }
   154→
   155→    const currentPos = segmentChildSlotIndices.indexOf(segmentLightboxIndex);
   156→    const nextPos = (currentPos + 1) % segmentChildSlotIndices.length;
   157→    setSegmentLightboxIndex(segmentChildSlotIndices[nextPos]);
   158→  }, [segmentChildSlotIndices, segmentLightboxIndex]);
   159→
   160→  const handleSegmentLightboxPrev = useCallback(() => {
   161→    if (segmentLightboxIndex === null || segmentChildSlotIndices.length === 0) {
   162→      return;
   163→    }
   164→
   165→    const currentPos = segmentChildSlotIndices.indexOf(segmentLightboxIndex);
   166→    const prevPos = (currentPos - 1 + segmentChildSlotIndices.length) % segmentChildSlotIndices.length;
   167→    setSegmentLightboxIndex(segmentChildSlotIndices[prevPos]);
   168→  }, [segmentChildSlotIndices, segmentLightboxIndex]);
   169→
   170→  const closeSegmentLightbox = useCallback(() => {
   171→    setSegmentLightboxIndex(null);
   172→  }, []);
   173→
   174→  return {
   175→    segmentLightboxIndex,
   176→    currentSegmentSlot,
   177→    currentSegmentMedia,
   178→    segmentChildSlotIndices,
   179→    handleSegmentClick,
   180→    handleSegmentLightboxNext,
   181→    handleSegmentLightboxPrev,
   182→    closeSegmentLightbox,
   183→  };
   184→}
   185→
   186→function useShotImageManagerContainerState(
   187→  props: ShotImageManagerProps,
   188→  isMobile: boolean
   189→): ShotImageManagerContainerState {
   190→  const optimistic = useOptimisticOrder({ images: props.images });
   191→  const setLightboxIndexRef = useRef<(index: number) => void>(() => {});
   192→
   193→  const externalGens = useExternalGenerations({
   194→    selectedShotId: props.selectedShotId,
   195→    optimisticOrder: optimistic.optimisticOrder,
   196→    images: props.images,
   197→    setLightboxIndexRef,
   198→  });
   199→
   200→  const [lightboxSelectedShotId, setLightboxSelectedShotId] = useState<string | undefined>(props.selectedShotId);
   201→
   202→  const selection = useSelection({
   203→    images: optimistic.optimisticOrder,
   204→    isMobile,
   205→    generationMode: props.generationMode,
   206→    onSelectionChange: props.onSelectionChange,
   207→  });
   208→
   209→  const lightbox = useLightbox({
   210→    images: optimistic.optimisticOrder,
   211→    externalGenerations: externalGens.externalGenerations,
   212→    tempDerivedGenerations: externalGens.tempDerivedGenerations,
   213→    derivedNavContext: externalGens.derivedNavContext,
   214→    handleOpenExternalGeneration: externalGens.handleOpenExternalGeneration,
   215→  });
   216→  const segments = useSegmentController(props, lightbox.currentImages);
   217→
   218→  useEffect(() => {
   219→    setLightboxIndexRef.current = lightbox.setLightboxIndex;
   220→  }, [lightbox.setLightboxIndex]);
   221→
   222→  const dragAndDrop = useDragAndDrop({
   223→    images: lightbox.currentImages,
   224→    selectedIds: selection.selectedIds,
   225→    onImageReorder: props.onImageReorder,
   226→    isMobile,
   227→    setSelectedIds: selection.setSelectedIds,
   228→    setLastSelectedIndex: selection.setLastSelectedIndex,
   229→    setOptimisticOrder: optimistic.setOptimisticOrder,
   230→    setIsOptimisticUpdate: optimistic.setIsOptimisticUpdate,
   231→    setReconciliationId: optimistic.setReconciliationId,
   232→    onDragStateChange: props.onDragStateChange,
   233→  });
   234→
   235→  const batchOps = useBatchOperations({
   236→    currentImages: lightbox.currentImages,
   237→    onImageDelete: props.onImageDelete,
   238→    onBatchImageDelete: props.onBatchImageDelete,
   239→    onSelectionChange: props.onSelectionChange,
   240→    setSelectedIds: selection.setSelectedIds,
   241→    setMobileSelectedIds: selection.setMobileSelectedIds,
   242→    setLastSelectedIndex: selection.setLastSelectedIndex,
   243→  });
   244→
   245→  const mobileGestures = useMobileGestures({
   246→    currentImages: lightbox.currentImages,
   247→    mobileSelectedIds: selection.mobileSelectedIds,
   248→    onImageReorder: props.onImageReorder,
   249→    setMobileSelectedIds: selection.setMobileSelectedIds,
   250→    setLightboxIndex: lightbox.setLightboxIndex,
   251→  });
   252→
   253→  const getFramePosition = useMemo(
   254→    () => (index: number) =>
   255→      getFramePositionForIndex(
   256→        index,
   257→        lightbox.currentImages,
   258→        props.batchVideoFrames || DEFAULT_BATCH_VIDEO_FRAMES
   259→      ),
   260→    [lightbox.currentImages, props.batchVideoFrames]
   261→  );
   262→
   263→  const selectionOrder: SelectionOrderController = {
   264→    optimistic,
   265→    selection,

   271→
   272→  const navigation: NavigationController = {

   278→    },
   279→  };
   280→
   281→  return {
   282→    selectionOrder,
   283→    navigation,
   284→    segments,
   285→  };
   286→}

    44→const ShotBatchItemDesktopComponent: React.FC<ShotBatchItemDesktopProps> = ({
    45→  image,

    47→  onDuplicate,

    64→  // Callback to mark all variants for this generation as viewed

    68→    }

    71→  const fullImageUrl = image.imageUrl ?? image.location ?? image.thumbUrl ?? image.thumbnail_url ?? '';
    72→  const fallbackImageUrl = image.thumbUrl ?? image.thumbnail_url ?? image.location ?? fullImageUrl;
    73→
    74→  // Progressive loading for batch item

    77→    imageUrl: fullImageUrl,
    78→    shouldLoad,
    79→  });

    81→  // Calculate aspect ratio for consistent sizing with skeletons
    82→  // getImageAspectRatioStyle expects ImageWithMetadata which is a subset of GenerationRow
    83→  const aspectRatioStyle = getImageAspectRatioStyle(image as { metadata?: { width?: number; height?: number; originalParams?: { orchestrator_details?: { resolution?: string } } } }, projectAspectRatio);
    84→
    85→  // Use image.id (shot_generations.id) - unique per entry
    86→  const sortableId = image.id;

    88→    id: sortableId,

    92→
    93→  // Track touch position to detect scrolling vs tapping

    95→
    96→  const handleTouchStart = (e: React.TouchEvent) => {
    97→    const touch = e.touches[0];
    98→    touchStartRef.current = { x: touch.clientX, y: touch.clientY };
    99→  };
   100→
   101→  const handleTouchEnd = (e: React.TouchEvent) => {
   102→    if (!onMobileTap || !touchStartRef.current) return;
   103→
   104→    const touch = e.changedTouches[0];
   105→    const deltaX = Math.abs(touch.clientX - touchStartRef.current.x);
   106→    const deltaY = Math.abs(touch.clientY - touchStartRef.current.y);
   107→
   108→    // Only trigger tap if movement is minimal (< 10px in any direction)
   109→    // This prevents accidental selection during scrolling
   110→    if (deltaX < 10 && deltaY < 10) {
   111→      e.preventDefault();
   112→      onMobileTap();

   114→
   115→    touchStartRef.current = null;
   116→  };
   117→
   118→  const style = {

   126→  const handleDeleteClick = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {

   130→    // Use id (shot_generations.id) - unique per entry

   150→  return (

   157→      {...(!isDragDisabled ? attributes : {})}

   229→          {/* Action buttons - top center, side by side */}
   230→          <div className="absolute top-1 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 flex items-center gap-1 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity z-10">
   231→            {onDuplicate && timeline_frame !== undefined && (

   249→              >

    37→function resolveEffectiveAspectRatio(
    38→  projectAspectRatio: string,
    39→  positionedImages: Array<{ metadata?: Record<string, unknown> | null }>,
    40→): string {
    41→  if (positionedImages.length === 0) {
    42→    return projectAspectRatio;
    43→  }
    44→
    45→  const firstImage = positionedImages[0];
    46→  const metadata = firstImage.metadata || {};
    47→  const width = typeof metadata.width === 'number' ? metadata.width : null;
    48→  const height = typeof metadata.height === 'number' ? metadata.height : null;
    49→  if (!width || !height) {
    50→    return projectAspectRatio;
    51→  }
    52→
    53→  return findClosestAspectRatio(width / height);
    54→}

    56→  }, [activeVariant, effectiveImageUrl]);

    58→  // Compute effective dimensions that are GUARANTEED to have a value
    59→  // This is computed synchronously during render, so there's no flicker
    60→  // Priority: extracted/loaded dimensions > project aspect ratio > 16:9 default
    61→  const effectiveImageDimensions = useMemo(() => {
    62→    // Use actual dimensions if we have them
    63→    if (imageDimensions) {
    64→      return imageDimensions;
    65→    }
    66→
    67→    // Fallback to project aspect ratio
    68→    if (projectAspectRatio) {
    69→      const resolution = ASPECT_RATIO_TO_RESOLUTION[projectAspectRatio];
    70→      if (resolution && resolution.includes('x')) {
    71→        const [w, h] = resolution.split('x').map(Number);
    72→        if (!isNaN(w) && !isNaN(h) && w > 0 && h > 0) {
    73→          return { width: w, height: h };
    74→        }
    75→      }
    76→    }
    77→
    78→    // Absolute last resort: 16:9 default
    79→    return { width: 1920, height: 1080 };
    80→  }, [imageDimensions, projectAspectRatio]);
    81→
    82→  return {
    83→    effectiveVideoUrl,
    84→    effectiveMediaUrl,
    85→    effectiveImageDimensions,
    86→  };
    87→}
    88→

   444→function usePresentationState(

   463→    isMagicEditMode: input.layout.isMagicEditMode ?? false,
   464→  });

   466→    core: input.core,
   467→    actions: input.actions,

233:};
234:function maybeAttachAbortSignal<T>(query: T, signal?: AbortSignal): T {
235:  if (!signal) {
236:    return query;

244:async function raceWithAbort<T>(promise: Promise<T>, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<T> {
245:  if (!signal) {
246:    return promise;

248:  throwIfAborted(signal);
249:  return await new Promise<T>((resolve, reject) => {
250:    const onAbort = () => {

     4→
     5→type RelativeTimestampPreset = 'default' | 'task' | 'processing' | 'completed';
     6→
     7→interface UseUpdatingTimestampOptions {
     8→  date?: string | Date | null;
     9→  abbreviate?: (str: string) => string;
    10→  disabled?: boolean;
    11→  preset?: RelativeTimestampPreset;
    12→}
    13→
    14→const relativeTimestampFormatters: Record<
    15→  RelativeTimestampPreset,
    16→  (date: Date, abbreviate: (str: string) => string) => string
    17→> = {
    18→  default: (date, abbreviate) => abbreviate(formatDistanceToNow(date, { addSuffix: true })),
    19→  task: (date) => {
    20→    const abbreviated = abbreviateRelativeTime(formatDistanceToNow(date, { addSuffix: true }));
    21→    return abbreviated || '<1 min ago';
    22→  },
    23→  processing: (date) => `Processing for ${formatRelativeDuration(date, { includeDays: false })}`,
    24→  completed: (date) => `Completed ${formatRelativeDuration(date)} ago`,
    25→};
    26→
    27→export function useRelativeTimestamp({
    28→  date,
    29→  abbreviate = abbreviateRelativeTime,
    30→  disabled = false,
    31→  preset = 'default',
    32→}: UseUpdatingTimestampOptions = {}): string | null {
    33→  const formatter = relativeTimestampFormatters[preset];
    34→
    35→  return useLiveRelativeTimestamp({
    36→    dateInput: date,
    37→    disabled,
    38→    formatter: (parsedDate) => formatter(parsedDate, abbreviate),
    39→  });
    40→}
    41→
    42→export function useUpdatingTimestamp(options: UseUpdatingTimestampOptions = {}): string | null {
    43→  return useRelativeTimestamp(options);
    44→}
    45→
    46→export function useTaskTimestamp(date?: string | Date | null) {
    47→  return useRelativeTimestamp({
    48→    date,
    49→    preset: 'task',
    50→  });
    51→}

1→import { debugConfig } from './debug/debugConfig';
     2→import { toJson } from '@/shared/lib/supabaseTypeHelpers';
     3→
     4→// Lightweight logging helper that can be enabled/disabled via Vite env
     5→// Usage:
     6→//   import { log, time, timeEnd } from '@/shared/lib/logger';
     7→//   log('MyTag', 'Some message', optionalData);
     8→//   time('MyTag', 'expensive-operation');
     9→//   ...do work...
    10→//   timeEnd('MyTag', 'expensive-operation');
    11→//
    12→// Logs are only printed when `VITE_DEBUG_LOGS` is set to `true`.
    13→// This avoids polluting the console in production while still allowing
    14→// rich diagnostics for performance investigations.
    15→//
    16→// Log persistence (to system_logs table):
    17→//   Set `VITE_PERSIST_LOGS=true` to buffer and send logs to system_logs.
    18→//   When enabled, ALL console.log/warn/error calls are captured automatically.
    19→//   Logs are batched and flushed every 10s or when buffer hits 50 entries.
    20→//   Query with: SELECT * FROM system_logs WHERE source_type = 'browser'
    21→//   Or use: debug.py logs --latest
    22→//
    23→// All logs share the same shape so they can be filtered easily.
    24→// Tag format guideline (keep short & consistent):
    25→//   [Area][Specific] e.g. [TaskPoller], [Render:GenerationsPane]
    26→
    27→// ===== CONFIGURATION =====
    28→
    29→const FLUSH_INTERVAL_MS = 10000; // Flush every 10 seconds
    30→const FLUSH_BUFFER_SIZE = 100;   // Flush when buffer hits this size
    31→
    32→function generateSessionId(): string {
    33→  const timestamp = Date.now();
    34→  const runtimeCrypto = globalThis.crypto;
    35→
    36→  if (runtimeCrypto?.randomUUID) {
    37→    return `browser-${timestamp}-${runtimeCrypto.randomUUID().slice(0, 8)}`;
    38→  }
    39→
    40→  if (runtimeCrypto?.getRandomValues) {
    41→    const randomBytes = new Uint8Array(4);
    42→    runtimeCrypto.getRandomValues(randomBytes);
    43→    const randomHex = Array.from(randomBytes, (byte) => byte.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    44→    return `browser-${timestamp}-${randomHex}`;
    45→  }
    46→
    47→  return `browser-${timestamp}-no-crypto`;
    48→}
    49→
    50→const SESSION_ID = generateSessionId();
    51→
    52→// Store original console methods BEFORE any interception
    53→const originalConsole = {
    54→  log: console.log.bind(console),
    55→  warn: console.warn.bind(console),
    56→  error: console.error.bind(console),
    57→};
    58→
    59→// ===== LOG BUFFER =====
    60→
    61→interface BufferedLog {
    62→  timestamp: string;
    63→  source_type: 'browser';
    64→  source_id: string;
    65→  log_level: 'DEBUG' | 'INFO' | 'WARNING' | 'ERROR';
    66→  message: string;
    67→  task_id: string | null;
    68→  metadata: Record<string, unknown>;
    69→}
    70→
    71→const logBuffer: BufferedLog[] = [];
    72→let flushTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;
    73→let isFlushScheduled = false;
    74→let loggerRuntimeInitialized = false;
    75→let unloadHandlerRegistered = false;
    76→
    77→// ===== HELPERS =====
    78→
    79→function getEnvFlag(viteKey: string): string | undefined {
    80→  const env = (import.meta as ImportMeta & { env?: Record<string, unknown> }).env;
    81→  const viteValue = env?.[viteKey];
    82→  if (typeof viteValue === 'string') {
    83→    return viteValue;
    84→  }
    85→  if (typeof process !== 'undefined') {
    86→    return (process as { env?: Record<string, string | undefined> }).env?.[viteKey];
    87→  }
    88→  return undefined;
    89→}
    90→
    91→function shouldLog(): boolean {
    92→  const flag = getEnvFlag('VITE_DEBUG_LOGS');
    93→  return flag === 'true' || flag === '1';
    94→}
    95→
    96→function shouldPersist(): boolean {
    97→  const flag = getEnvFlag('VITE_PERSIST_LOGS');
    98→  return flag === 'true' || flag === '1';
    99→}

    72→function downloadBlobWithXHR(

   165→  downloadBlobAsFile(blob, downloadFilename);

   233→        url: accessibleImageUrl,
   234→      });
   235→    }
   236→
   237→    let blob: Blob;
   238→    try {
   239→      blob = await response.blob();
   240→    } catch (error) {
   241→      throw toDownloadServiceError({
   242→        error,
   243→        context,
   244→        url: accessibleImageUrl,
   245→        fallbackMessage: 'Failed to read download payload',
   246→      });
   247→    }
   248→
   249→    const extension = inferMediaExtension(image, blob);
   250→    const filename = `${String(i + 1).padStart(3, '0')}.${extension}`;
   251→    zip.file(filename, blob);
   252→    options.onProgress?.(i + 1, sortedImages.length);
   253→  }
   254→
   255→  const zipBlob = await zip.generateAsync({ type: 'blob' });
   256→  const archiveFilename = buildArchiveFileName();
   257→  downloadBlobAsFile(zipBlob, archiveFilename);
   258→  return { count: sortedImages.length, archiveFilename };
   259→}
   260→

    37→function useShotNavigationHandlers({

    42→  reportError,
    43→}: UseShotNavigationHandlersArgs) {

    54→    }

    56→
    57→  const handleVisitShotFromNotifier = useCallback((shotId: string) => {

    59→    if (!shot) {

    61→        context: 'MediaGallery.handleVisitShotFromNotifier',
    62→        showToast: false,
    63→        logData: { shotId, scope: 'simplifiedShotOptions' },
    64→      });

    66→    }
    67→
    68→    const fullShot = allShots.find((candidate) => candidate.id === shotId);
    69→    if (!fullShot) {
    70→      reportError(new Error('Shot entity not found for notifier navigation'), {
    71→        context: 'MediaGallery.handleVisitShotFromNotifier',
    72→        showToast: false,
    73→        logData: { shotId, scope: 'allShots' },
    74→      });
    75→      return;
    76→    }
    77→
    78→    try {

    85→      });
    86→    }
    87→  }, [simplifiedShotOptions, allShots, navigateToShot, reportError]);
    88→
    89→  return {
    90→    handleNavigateToShot,
    91→    handleVisitShotFromNotifier,
    92→  };
    93→}

   119→  };
   120→}

   128→}
   129→
   130→function useTaskDetailsHandler({

   134→  setActiveLightboxMedia,

   154→    reportError,
   155→  ]);
   156→
   157→  return { handleShowTaskDetails };
   158→}
   159→
   160→export function useMediaGalleryHandlers({

   172→  reportError: reportErrorProp,
   173→}: UseMediaGalleryHandlersArgs) {
   174→  const reportError = useCallback((error: unknown, options: RuntimeErrorOptions) => {
   175→    if (reportErrorProp) {

   177→      return;
   178→    }
   179→    normalizeAndPresentError(error, options);

1→import { useEffect, useRef, useCallback, RefObject } from 'react';
     2→
     3→type EventType = 'click' | 'mousedown' | 'touchstart';
     4→
     5→interface UseClickOutsideOptions {
     6→  /** Event type(s) to listen for (default: ['mousedown']) */
     7→  events?: EventType[];
     8→  /** Whether the hook is enabled (default: true) */
     9→  enabled?: boolean;
    10→  /** Delay before attaching listeners (ms) - prevents catching the click that opened the element */
    11→  delay?: number;
    12→  /** Use capture phase for event listeners */
    13→  capture?: boolean;
    14→}
    15→
    16→/**
    17→ * Hook that calls a callback when user clicks/touches outside the referenced element.
    18→ *
    19→ * @param callback - Function to call when click outside is detected
    20→ * @param options - Configuration options
    21→ * @returns ref - Attach this to the element you want to detect clicks outside of
    22→ *
    23→ * @example
    24→ * // Basic usage - click outside to close
    25→ * const ref = useClickOutside(() => setIsOpen(false));
    26→ * return <div ref={ref}>...</div>;
    27→ *
    28→ * @example
    29→ * // With options - touch support for iPad
    30→ * const ref = useClickOutside(
    31→ *   () => setSelectedEndpoint(null),
    32→ *   { events: ['touchstart'], enabled: isTablet && selectedEndpoint !== null }
    33→ * );
    34→ *
    35→ * @example
    36→ * // With existing ref
    37→ * const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
    38→ * useClickOutside(() => setIsActive(false), { enabled: isActive }, containerRef);
    39→ */
    40→export function useClickOutside<T extends HTMLElement = HTMLDivElement>(
    41→  callback: () => void,
    42→  options: UseClickOutsideOptions = {},
    43→  existingRef?: RefObject<T>
    44→): RefObject<T> {
    45→  const {
    46→    events = ['mousedown'],
    47→    enabled = true,
    48→    delay = 0,
    49→    capture = false,
    50→  } = options;
    51→
    52→  const internalRef = useRef<T>(null);
    53→  const ref = existingRef || internalRef;
    54→  const callbackRef = useRef(callback);
    55→
    56→  // Keep callback ref up to date
    57→  useEffect(() => {
    58→    callbackRef.current = callback;
    59→  }, [callback]);
    60→
    61→  const handleEvent = useCallback((event: Event) => {
    62→    if (ref.current && !ref.current.contains(event.target as Node)) {
    63→      callbackRef.current();
    64→    }
    65→  }, [ref]);
    66→
    67→  useEffect(() => {
    68→    if (!enabled) return;
    69→
    70→    const subscribe = () => {
    71→      events.forEach((eventType) => {
    72→        document.addEventListener(eventType, handleEvent, { capture });
    73→      });
    74→    };
    75→
    76→    const unsubscribe = () => {
    77→      events.forEach((eventType) => {
    78→        document.removeEventListener(eventType, handleEvent, { capture });
    79→      });
    80→    };
    81→
    82→    // Delay subscription to avoid catching the event that triggered this state
    83→    const timeoutId = delay > 0 ? setTimeout(subscribe, delay) : null;
    84→    if (!timeoutId) subscribe();
    85→
    86→    return () => {
    87→      if (timeoutId) clearTimeout(timeoutId);
    88→      unsubscribe();
    89→    };
    90→  }, [enabled, events, handleEvent, delay, capture]);
    91→
    92→  return ref;
    93→}
    94→

1→import { useState, useCallback, useRef, useEffect } from 'react';
     2→
     3→interface UseOperationTrackingResult {
     4→  /** Whether a shot operation is currently in progress (suppresses query refetch) */
     5→  isShotOperationInProgress: boolean;
     6→  /** Whether a drag operation is in progress in the timeline */
     7→  isDraggingInTimeline: boolean;
     8→  /** Set the dragging state */
     9→  setIsDraggingInTimeline: (dragging: boolean) => void;
    10→  /** Signal that a shot operation has occurred (temporarily disables refetch) */
    11→  signalShotOperation: () => void;
    12→}
    13→
    14→/**
    15→ * Tracks mutation operations to prevent query race conditions.
    16→ *
    17→ * When a shot mutation completes, we briefly disable query refetch to:
    18→ * - Prevent "AbortError" from cancelled queries
    19→ * - Allow timeline position updates to complete without interference
    20→ * - Avoid UI flicker from rapid state changes
    21→ *
    22→ * Also tracks drag state to suppress realtime invalidations during drag.
    23→ */
    24→export function useOperationTracking(): UseOperationTrackingResult {
    25→  const [isShotOperationInProgress, setIsShotOperationInProgress] = useState(false);
    26→  const [isDraggingInTimeline, setIsDraggingInTimeline] = useState(false);
    27→  const operationTimeoutRef = useRef<NodeJS.Timeout | null>(null);
    28→
    29→  // Helper to signal that a shot operation has occurred
    30→  const signalShotOperation = useCallback(() => {
    31→
    32→    // Clear any existing timeout
    33→    if (operationTimeoutRef.current) {
    34→      clearTimeout(operationTimeoutRef.current);
    35→    }
    36→
    37→    // Set flag to disable query
    38→    setIsShotOperationInProgress(true);
    39→
    40→    // Clear flag after timeline has had time to complete position updates
    41→    // 100ms is enough for React's batch updates + timeline's immediate state updates
    42→    operationTimeoutRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
    43→      setIsShotOperationInProgress(false);
    44→      operationTimeoutRef.current = null;
    45→    }, 100);
    46→  }, []);
    47→
    48→  // Cleanup timeout on unmount
    49→  useEffect(() => {
    50→    return () => {
    51→      if (operationTimeoutRef.current) {
    52→        clearTimeout(operationTimeoutRef.current);
    53→      }
    54→    };
    55→  }, []);
    56→
    57→  return {
    58→    isShotOperationInProgress,
    59→    isDraggingInTimeline,
    60→    setIsDraggingInTimeline,
    61→    signalShotOperation,
    62→  };
    63→}
    64→

     6→/**
     7→ * Edge function: grant-credits
     8→ *
     9→ * Grants credits to a user (admin only, or welcome bonus)
    10→ *
    11→ * POST /functions/v1/grant-credits
    12→ * Headers: Authorization: Bearer <JWT>
    13→ * Body: {
    14→ *   userId: string,
    15→ *   amount: number,
    16→ *   description?: string,

    27→const corsHeaders = {
    28→  'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
    29→  'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'authorization, x-client-info, apikey, content-type',
    30→};
    31→
    32→serve(async (req) => {
    33→  // Handle CORS preflight requests
    34→  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
    35→    return new Response('ok', { headers: corsHeaders });
    36→  }
    37→
    38→  if (req.method !== "POST") {
    39→    return new Response("Method not allowed", {
    40→      status: 405,
    41→      headers: corsHeaders,
    42→    });
    43→  }
    44→
    45→  // ─── 1. Parse body ──────────────────────────────────────────────
    46→  let body: unknown;
    47→  try {
    48→    body = await req.json();
    49→  } catch {
    50→    return new Response("Invalid JSON body", {
    51→      status: 400,
    52→      headers: corsHeaders,
    53→    });
    54→  }
    55→
    56→  const { userId, amount, description, isWelcomeBonus = false } = body;
    57→  if (!userId || !amount || typeof amount !== 'number' || amount <= 0) {
    58→    return new Response("userId and positive amount are required", {
    59→      status: 400,
    60→      headers: corsHeaders,
    61→    });
    62→  }
    63→
    64→  const supabaseUrl = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_URL");
    65→  const supabaseServiceKey = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY");
    66→
    67→  if (!supabaseUrl || !supabaseServiceKey) {
    68→    console.error("Missing required environment variables");
    69→    return new Response("Server configuration error", {
    70→      status: 500,
    71→      headers: corsHeaders,
    72→    });
    73→  }
    74→
    75→  // Admin client (service role) for unrestricted queries
    76→  const adminClient = createClient(supabaseUrl, supabaseServiceKey);
    77→  const logger = new SystemLogger(adminClient, 'grant-credits');
    78→
    79→  // ─── 2. Authenticate request using shared auth module ───────────
    80→  const auth = await authenticateRequest(req, adminClient, "[GRANT-CREDITS]", { allowJwtUserAuth: true });
