    82→  if (!auth.success) {
    83→    return new Response(auth.error || "Authentication failed", {
    84→      status: auth.statusCode || 401,
    85→      headers: corsHeaders,
    86→    });
    87→  }
    88→
    89→  const isServiceRole = auth.isServiceRole;
    90→  const currentUserId = auth.userId;
    91→
    92→  // For welcome bonus, allow authenticated users; for admin grants, require service role
    93→  if (!isWelcomeBonus && !isServiceRole) {
    94→    return new Response("Service role access required for admin grants", {
    95→      status: 403,
    96→      headers: corsHeaders,
    97→    });
    98→  }
    99→
   100→  try {
   101→    // ─── 3. Check and handle welcome bonus ──────────────────────────
   102→    if (isWelcomeBonus) {
   103→      // Ensure the user is requesting welcome bonus for themselves (unless service role)
   104→      if (!isServiceRole && currentUserId !== userId) {
   105→        return new Response("Users can only request welcome bonus for themselves", {
   106→          status: 403,
   107→          headers: corsHeaders,
   108→        });
   109→      }
   110→
   111→      // Ensure the user row exists before attempting atomic claim
   112→      const { error: checkError } = await adminClient
   113→        .from('users')
   114→        .select('id')
   115→        .eq('id', userId)
   116→        .single();
   117→
   118→      if (checkError && checkError.code === 'PGRST116') { // no rows found
   119→        logger.info('No user row found, creating default user record', { user_id: userId });
   120→
   121→        const { error: insertError } = await adminClient
   122→          .from('users')
   123→          .upsert({
   124→            id: userId,
   125→            name: '',
   126→            email: '',
   127→            credits: 0,
   128→            given_credits: false,
   129→          }, { onConflict: 'id' });
   130→
   131→        if (insertError && insertError.code !== '23505') { // ignore duplicate key
   132→          logger.error('Failed to create user row', { error: insertError.message, user_id: userId });
   133→          return new Response(`Could not create user record: ${insertError.message}`, {
   134→            status: 500,
   135→            headers: corsHeaders,
   136→          });
   137→        }
   138→      } else if (checkError) {
   139→        logger.error('Error checking user', { error: checkError.message, user_id: userId });
   140→        return new Response(`User not found: ${checkError.message}`, {
   141→          status: 400,
   142→          headers: corsHeaders,
   143→        });
   144→      }
   145→
   146→      // Atomic check-and-set: only matches if given_credits is currently false.
   147→      // If two requests race, only one will match and get a row back.
   148→      const { data: claimedUser, error: claimError } = await adminClient
   149→        .from('users')
   150→        .update({ given_credits: true })
   151→        .eq('id', userId)
   152→        .eq('given_credits', false)
   153→        .select('id')
   154→        .single();
   155→
   156→      if (claimError || !claimedUser) {
   157→        logger.info('Welcome bonus already granted, skipping', { user_id: userId, claimError: claimError?.message });
   158→        await logger.flush();
   159→        return new Response("Welcome bonus already given to this user", {
   160→          status: 400,
   161→          headers: corsHeaders,
   162→        });
   163→      }
   164→
   165→      // given_credits is now true — we own the grant. Insert credit into ledger.
   166→      const { data: ledgerEntry, error: ledgerError } = await adminClient
   167→        .from('credits_ledger')
   168→        .insert({
   169→          user_id: userId,
   170→          amount: amount * 100, // Convert dollars to cents
   171→          type: 'manual',
   172→          metadata: {
   173→            description: 'Welcome bonus',
   174→            granted_by: isServiceRole ? 'service_role' : 'system',
   175→            granted_at: new Date().toISOString(),
   176→            is_welcome_bonus: true,
   177→          },
   178→        })
   179→        .select()
   180→        .single();
   181→
   182→      if (ledgerError) {
   183→        // Roll back the claim so the user can retry and receive their bonus
   184→        await adminClient.from('users').update({ given_credits: false }).eq('id', userId);
   185→        logger.error("Error granting welcome credits, rolled back claim", { error: ledgerError.message, user_id: userId });
   186→        await logger.flush();
   187→        return new Response(`Failed to grant welcome credits: ${ledgerError.message}`, {
   188→          status: 500,
   189→          headers: corsHeaders,
   190→        });
   191→      }
   192→
   193→      logger.info('Welcome bonus granted', { amount, user_id: userId });
   194→      await logger.flush();
   195→
   196→      return new Response(JSON.stringify({
   197→        success: true,
   198→        transaction: ledgerEntry,
   199→        message: `Welcome bonus of $${amount} granted successfully!`,
   200→        isWelcomeBonus: true,
   201→      }), {
   202→        status: 200,
   203→        headers: { 
   204→          "Content-Type": "application/json",
   205→          ...corsHeaders,
   206→        },
   207→      });
   208→    }
   209→
   210→    // ─── 6. Handle regular admin credit grant ───────────────────────
   211→    
   212→    const { data: ledgerEntry, error: ledgerError } = await adminClient
   213→      .from('credits_ledger')
   214→      .insert({
   215→        user_id: userId,
   216→        amount: amount * 100, // Convert dollars to cents
   217→        type: 'manual',
   218→        metadata: {
   219→          description: description || 'Admin credit grant',
   220→          granted_by: 'service_role',
   221→          granted_at: new Date().toISOString(),
   222→        },
   223→      })
   224→      .select()
   225→      .single();
   226→
   227→    if (ledgerError) {

   229→      await logger.flush();
   230→      return new Response(`Failed to grant credits: ${ledgerError.message}`, {
   231→        status: 500,
   232→        headers: corsHeaders,
   233→      });
   234→    }
   235→
   236→    logger.info('Credits granted', { amount, user_id: userId, granted_by: 'service_role' });
   237→    await logger.flush();
   238→
   239→    return new Response(JSON.stringify({
   240→      success: true,
   241→      transaction: ledgerEntry,
   242→      message: `Successfully granted $${amount} credits to user ${userId}`,

   244→      status: 200,
   245→      headers: { 
   246→        "Content-Type": "application/json",
   247→        ...corsHeaders,
   248→      },
   249→    });
   250→
   251→  } catch (error) {
   252→    logger.error("Unexpected error", { error: error.message });
   253→    await logger.flush();
   254→    return new Response(`Internal server error: ${error.message}`, {

   252→/**
   253→ * Aggregate daily buckets into weekly buckets (Mon-Sun weeks)
   254→ */
   255→function aggregateByWeek(buckets: DayBucket[]): DayBucket[] {
   256→  const weekMap = new Map<string, DayBucket>();
   257→
   258→  for (const bucket of buckets) {
   259→    const date = new Date(bucket.date + "T00:00:00Z");
   260→    // Get Monday of this week
   261→    const day = date.getUTCDay();
   262→    const diff = day === 0 ? -6 : 1 - day; // Monday = 1
   263→    const monday = new Date(date);
   264→    monday.setUTCDate(date.getUTCDate() + diff);
   265→    const [REDACTED]().substring(0, 10);
   266→
   267→    if (!weekMap.has(weekKey)) {
   268→      weekMap.set(weekKey, { date: weekKey, images_generated: 0, images_edited: 0, videos_generated: 0 });
   269→    }
   270→    const week = weekMap.get(weekKey)!;
   271→    week.images_generated += bucket.images_generated;
   272→    week.images_edited += bucket.images_edited;
   273→    week.videos_generated += bucket.videos_generated;
   274→  }
   275→
   276→  return Array.from(weekMap.values()).sort((a, b) => a.date.localeCompare(b.date));
   277→}

1→/**
     2→ * Stable Skeleton Visibility Hook
     3→ * 
     4→ * Prevents rapid skeleton flicker when multiple queries resolve at different times.
     5→ * Shows skeleton immediately when loading starts, delays hiding slightly to prevent toggle flicker.
     6→ * 
     7→ * @see VideoTravelToolPage.tsx - Main page component that uses this hook
     8→ */
     9→
    10→import { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
    11→
    12→/**
    13→ * Hook that stabilizes skeleton visibility to avoid rapid flicker.
    14→ * 
    15→ * @param isLoading - Current loading state from queries
    16→ * @param hideDelay - Delay in ms before hiding skeleton (default: 120ms)
    17→ * @returns Whether to show the skeleton (stabilized)
    18→ */
    19→export const useStableSkeletonVisibility = (
    20→  isLoading: boolean,
    21→  hideDelay: number = 120
    22→): boolean => {
    23→  const [showStableSkeleton, setShowStableSkeleton] = useState<boolean>(false);
    24→  const hideTimeoutRef = useRef<number | null>(null);
    25→  const lastLoadingStateRef = useRef<boolean>(false);
    26→  
    27→  useEffect(() => {
    28→    // Only update skeleton state if loading state actually changed
    29→    if (isLoading !== lastLoadingStateRef.current) {
    30→      lastLoadingStateRef.current = isLoading;
    31→      
    32→      if (isLoading) {
    33→        // Immediately show the skeleton when entering loading
    34→        if (hideTimeoutRef.current) {
    35→          window.clearTimeout(hideTimeoutRef.current);
    36→          hideTimeoutRef.current = null;
    37→        }
    38→        setShowStableSkeleton(true);
    39→      } else {
    40→        // Delay hiding slightly to prevent rapid toggle flicker
    41→        hideTimeoutRef.current = window.setTimeout(() => {
    42→          setShowStableSkeleton(false);
    43→          hideTimeoutRef.current = null;
    44→        }, hideDelay);
    45→      }
    46→    }
    47→    
    48→    return () => {
    49→      if (hideTimeoutRef.current) {
    50→        window.clearTimeout(hideTimeoutRef.current);
    51→        hideTimeoutRef.current = null;
    52→      }
    53→    };
    54→  }, [isLoading, hideDelay]);
    55→
    56→  return showStableSkeleton;
    57→};
    58→

   217→  taskParams.make_primary_variant = params.make_primary_variant ?? true;
   218→  return taskParams;
   219→}
   220→
   221→function buildIndividualSegmentParamsPayload(
   222→  params: IndividualTravelSegmentParams,
   223→  state: SegmentBuildState,
   224→): UnknownRecord {
   225→  const segmentPostProcess = resolveSegmentPostProcessValues(params, state);
   226→
   227→  const individualSegmentParams: UnknownRecord = {
   228→    input_image_paths_resolved: state.inputImages,
   229→    start_image_url: params.start_image_url,
   230→    base_prompt: state.basePrompt,
   231→    negative_prompt: state.negativePrompt,
   232→    num_frames: state.numFrames,
   233→    seed_to_use: state.finalSeed,
   234→    random_seed: params.random_seed ?? false,
   235→    amount_of_motion: state.amountOfMotion,
   236→    motion_mode: segmentPostProcess.motionMode,
   237→    advanced_mode: state.advancedMode,
   238→    additional_loras: state.additionalLoras,
   239→    after_first_post_generation_saturation: segmentPostProcess.afterFirstPostGenerationSaturation,
   240→    after_first_post_generation_brightness: segmentPostProcess.afterFirstPostGenerationBrightness,
   241→    phase_config: state.phaseConfig,
   242→  };
   243→
   244→  Object.assign(
   245→    individualSegmentParams,
   246→    composeOptionalFields([
   247→      {
   248→        key: 'end_image_url',
   249→        value: params.end_image_url,
   250→        include: (value) => typeof value === 'string' && value.length > 0,
   251→      },
   252→      {
   253→        [REDACTED],
   254→        value: params.start_image_generation_id,
   255→        include: (value) => typeof value === 'string' && value.length > 0,
   256→      },
   257→      {
   258→        [REDACTED],
   259→        value: params.end_image_generation_id,
   260→        include: (value) => typeof value === 'string' && value.length > 0,
   261→      },
   262→      {
   263→        [REDACTED],
   264→        value: params.pair_shot_generation_id,
   265→        include: (value) => typeof value === 'string' && value.length > 0,
   266→      },
   267→      {
   268→        [REDACTED],
   269→        value: params.start_image_variant_id,
   270→        include: (value) => typeof value === 'string' && value.length > 0,
   271→      },
   272→      {
   273→        [REDACTED],
   274→        value: params.end_image_variant_id,
   275→        include: (value) => typeof value === 'string' && value.length > 0,
   276→      },
   277→      {
   278→        key: 'enhanced_prompt',
   279→        value: state.enhancedPrompt,
   280→        include: (value) => typeof value === 'string' && value.length > 0,
   281→      },
   282→      {
   283→        [REDACTED],
   284→        value: params.selected_phase_preset_id,
   285→        include: (value) => typeof value === 'string' && value.length > 0,
   286→      },
   287→    ]),
   288→  );
   289→
   290→  return individualSegmentParams;
   291→}
   292→
   293→export function buildIndividualTravelSegmentParams(
   294→  params: IndividualTravelSegmentParams,
   295→  finalResolution: string,
   296→): Record<string, unknown> {
   297→  const state = buildSegmentState(params);
   298→  const orchestratorDetails = buildOrchestratorDetails(params, state, finalResolution);
   299→  const sourceSnapshot = buildTaskPayloadSnapshot(params.originalParams);
   300→  const legacyContractTaskId = extractOrchestratorTaskIdParam(params.originalParams);
   301→  const legacyRunId = extractRunIdParam(params.originalParams);
   302→  const orchestratorTaskId = resolveSnapshotOrchestratorTaskId(sourceSnapshot)
   303→    ?? legacyContractTaskId
   304→    ?? resolveStringCandidate(
   305→      asString(state.orchDetails.orchestrator_task_id),
   306→      asString(state.orig.orchestrator_task_id_ref),
   307→    );
   308→  const runId = resolveSnapshotRunId(sourceSnapshot)
   309→    ?? legacyRunId
   310→    ?? asString(state.orchDetails.run_id);
   311→
   312→  const hasPairShotGenerationId = Boolean(
   313→    params.pair_shot_generation_id
   314→    || params.start_image_variant_id
   315→    || params.end_image_variant_id,
   316→  );
   317→  const segmentRegenerationMode = hasPairShotGenerationId
   318→    ? 'segment_regen_from_pair'
   319→    : 'segment_regen_from_order';
   320→  const generationRouting = params.child_generation_id
   321→    ? 'variant_child'
   322→    : 'child_generation';
   323→
   324→  const familyContract = buildIndividualSegmentFamilyContract({
   325→    segmentRegenerationMode,
   326→    generationRouting,
   327→    segmentIndex: params.segment_index,
   328→    hasEndImage: Boolean(params.end_image_url),
   329→    hasPairShotGenerationId,
   330→  });
   331→
   332→  const composedPayload = composeTaskFamilyPayload({
   333→    taskFamily: 'individual_travel_segment',
   334→    orchestratorDetails,
   335→    orchestrationInput: {
   336→      taskFamily: 'individual_travel_segment',
   337→      orchestratorTaskId,
   338→      runId,
   339→      parentGenerationId: params.parent_generation_id,
   340→      childGenerationId: params.child_generation_id,
   341→      childOrder: params.segment_index,
   342→      shotId: params.shot_id,
   343→      generationRouting,
   344→      siblingLookup: runId ? 'run_id' : 'orchestrator_task_id',
   345→      segmentRegenerationMode,
   346→    },
   347→    taskViewInput: {
   348→      inputImages: state.inputImages,
   349→      prompt: state.basePrompt,
   350→      enhancedPrompt: state.enhancedPrompt,
   351→      negativePrompt: state.negativePrompt,
   352→      modelName: state.modelName,
   353→      resolution: finalResolution,
   354→    },
   355→    familyContract,
   356→  });
   357→
   358→  const taskParams = {
   359→    ...buildTaskParamsPayload(params, state, finalResolution, orchestratorDetails),
   360→    ...composedPayload,
   361→  };
   362→  taskParams.individual_segment_params = buildIndividualSegmentParamsPayload(params, state);
   363→  return taskParams;
   364→}
   365→

1→import { formatDistanceToNow } from 'date-fns';
     2→import { abbreviateRelativeTime, formatRelativeDuration } from '@/shared/lib/timeFormatting';
     3→import { useLiveRelativeTimestamp } from './useLiveRelativeTimestamp';

     6→
     7→interface UseUpdatingTimestampOptions {

    13→
    14→const relativeTimestampFormatters: Record<
    15→  RelativeTimestampPreset,
    16→  (date: Date, abbreviate: (str: string) => string) => string
    17→> = {
    18→  default: (date, abbreviate) => abbreviate(formatDistanceToNow(date, { addSuffix: true })),
    19→  task: (date) => {
    20→    const abbreviated = abbreviateRelativeTime(formatDistanceToNow(date, { addSuffix: true }));
    21→    return abbreviated || '<1 min ago';
    22→  },
    23→  processing: (date) => `Processing for ${formatRelativeDuration(date, { includeDays: false })}`,
    24→  completed: (date) => `Completed ${formatRelativeDuration(date)} ago`,
    25→};
    26→
    27→export function useRelativeTimestamp({
    28→  date,
    29→  abbreviate = abbreviateRelativeTime,
    30→  disabled = false,
    31→  preset = 'default',
    32→}: UseUpdatingTimestampOptions = {}): string | null {
    33→  const formatter = relativeTimestampFormatters[preset];
    34→
    35→  return useLiveRelativeTimestamp({
    36→    dateInput: date,
    37→    disabled,
    38→    formatter: (parsedDate) => formatter(parsedDate, abbreviate),
    39→  });
    40→}
    41→
    42→export function useUpdatingTimestamp(options: UseUpdatingTimestampOptions = {}): string | null {
    43→  return useRelativeTimestamp(options);
    44→}

    47→  return useRelativeTimestamp({
    48→    date,
    49→    preset: 'task',

   315→    // FIX: Use ref to get current value and avoid callback recreation
   316→    // Ensure required fields are always present by seeding with defaults
   317→    const currentSettings: SteerableMotionSettings = {
   318→      ...DEFAULT_STEERABLE_MOTION_SETTINGS,
   319→      ...(shotSettingsRef.current.settings?.steerableMotionSettings ?? {}),
   320→    };
   321→    shotSettingsRef.current.updateFields({
   322→      steerableMotionSettings: {
   323→        ...currentSettings,
   324→        ...settings
   325→      }
   326→    });
   327→  }, [shotSettingsRef]);
   328→
   329→  // =============================================================================
   330→  // PHASE CONFIG
   331→  // =============================================================================
   332→  const handlePhaseConfigChange = useCallback((config: PhaseConfig) => {
   333→    // Auto-set model_switch_phase to 1 when num_phases is 2
   334→    const adjustedConfig = config.num_phases === 2 
   335→      ? { ...config, model_switch_phase: 1 }
   336→      : config;
   337→    
   338→    // Clear preset reference when user manually edits config - the config no longer matches the preset
   339→    shotSettingsRef.current.updateFields({
   340→      phaseConfig: adjustedConfig,
   341→      selectedPhasePresetId: null
   342→    });
   343→  }, [shotSettingsRef]);
   344→
   345→  const handlePhasePresetSelect = useCallback((presetId: string, config: PhaseConfig, presetMetadata?: PresetMetadata) => {
   346→    
   347→    // DEEP CLONE: Create completely new config to prevent shared references
   348→    // This ensures modifying LoRA strengths in one phase doesn't affect other phases
   349→    const deepClonedConfig: PhaseConfig = {
   350→      ...config,
   351→      steps_per_phase: [...config.steps_per_phase],
   352→      phases: config.phases.map(phase => ({
   353→        ...phase,
   354→        loras: phase.loras.map(lora => ({ ...lora })) // Deep clone each LoRA
   355→      }))
   356→    };
   357→    
   358→    // Update preset ID, phase config, and generation type mode (if preset specifies one)
   359→    const updates: Partial<VideoTravelSettings> = {
   360→      selectedPhasePresetId: presetId,
   361→      phaseConfig: deepClonedConfig
   362→    };
   363→    
   364→    // Also apply the preset's generation type mode if it has one
   365→    const presetGenerationTypeMode = presetMetadata?.generationTypeMode;
   366→    if (presetGenerationTypeMode === 'i2v' || presetGenerationTypeMode === 'vace') {
   367→      updates.generationTypeMode = presetGenerationTypeMode;
   368→    }
   369→    
   370→    shotSettingsRef.current.updateFields(updates);
   371→  }, [shotSettingsRef]);
   372→
   373→  const handlePhasePresetRemove = useCallback(() => {
   374→    
   375→    // Clear preset ID but keep the current config
   376→    shotSettingsRef.current.updateField('selectedPhasePresetId', null);
   377→  }, [shotSettingsRef]);
   378→
   379→  // Handler for restoring defaults in Advanced mode - respects current I2V/VACE mode
   380→  const handleRestoreDefaults = useCallback(() => {
   381→    const currentSettings = shotSettingsRef.current.settings;
   382→    const isVaceMode = currentSettings?.generationTypeMode === 'vace';
   383→    const defaultPresetId = isVaceMode ? BUILTIN_DEFAULT_VACE_ID : BUILTIN_DEFAULT_I2V_ID;
   384→    
   385→    // Update preset ID to match the restored config
   386→    shotSettingsRef.current.updateField('selectedPhasePresetId', defaultPresetId);
   387→    
   388→    // Force rebuild regardless of current mode (user explicitly clicked "Restore Defaults")
   389→    rebuildPhaseConfig({ force: true });
   390→  }, [shotSettingsRef, rebuildPhaseConfig]);
   391→
   392→  // =============================================================================

   395→  const handleGenerationModeChange = useCallback((mode: 'batch' | 'timeline' | 'by-pair') => {
   396→    
   397→    // Optimistically update the cache for THIS shot immediately

    23→ */
    24→export function useTemporaryVisibility(duration = 2000) {
    25→  const [isVisible, setIsVisible] = useState(false);
    26→  const timeoutRef = useRef<NodeJS.Timeout | null>(null);
    27→
    28→  const clearPendingTimeout = useCallback(() => {
    29→    if (timeoutRef.current) {
    30→      clearTimeout(timeoutRef.current);
    31→      timeoutRef.current = null;
    32→    }
    33→  }, []);
    34→

    36→    setIsVisible(true);

    38→    timeoutRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
    39→      setIsVisible(false);
    40→      timeoutRef.current = null;
    41→    }, duration);
    42→  }, [duration, clearPendingTimeout]);
    43→
    44→  const hide = useCallback(() => {
    45→    setIsVisible(false);
    46→    clearPendingTimeout();
    47→  }, [clearPendingTimeout]);
    48→
    49→  // Cleanup on unmount
    50→  useEffect(() => {
    51→    return () => clearPendingTimeout();
    52→  }, [clearPendingTimeout]);
    53→
    54→  return { isVisible, show, hide };

   131→
   132→  const snappedEnd = targetFrame >= rightLimit - EDGE_SNAP_THRESHOLD
   133→    ? rightLimit
   134→    : Math.min(rightLimit, targetFrame);
   135→
   136→  let newEnd = Math.max(snappedEnd, params.effectiveOutputStart + MIN_DURATION_FRAMES);
   137→  newEnd = Math.min(params.fullMax, Math.max(newEnd, params.fullMin + MIN_DURATION_FRAMES));
   138→  return { start: params.effectiveOutputStart, end: newEnd };
   139→}
   140→
   141→function useStripTapToPlace(params: UseStripTapToPlaceParams) {
   142→  const {
   143→    enabled,
   144→    selectedEndpoint,
   145→    outerContainerRef,
   146→    onRangeChange,
   147→    stripLeftPercent,
   148→    stripWidthPercent,
   149→    fullMin,
   150→    fullMax,
   151→    fullRange,
   152→    effectiveOutputStart,
   153→    effectiveOutputEnd,
   154→    siblingRanges,
   155→    setSelectedEndpoint,
   156→  } = params;
   157→
   158→  return useCallback((e: React.TouchEvent) => {
   159→    if (!enabled || !selectedEndpoint || !outerContainerRef.current || !onRangeChange) return;
   160→
   161→    const touch = e.changedTouches[0];
   162→    const rect = outerContainerRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
   163→    const nextRange = computeRangeFromTap({
   164→      selectedEndpoint,
   165→      touchX: touch.clientX,
   166→      rect,
   167→      stripLeftPercent,
   168→      stripWidthPercent,
   169→      fullMin,
   170→      fullMax,
   171→      fullRange,
   172→      effectiveOutputStart,
   173→      effectiveOutputEnd,
   174→      siblingRanges,
   175→    });
   176→
   177→    if (nextRange) {
   178→      onRangeChange(nextRange.start, nextRange.end);
   179→    }
   180→
   181→    setSelectedEndpoint(null);
   182→  }, [
   183→    enabled,
   184→    selectedEndpoint,
   185→    outerContainerRef,
   186→    onRangeChange,
   187→    stripLeftPercent,
   188→    stripWidthPercent,
   189→    fullMin,
   190→    fullMax,
   191→    fullRange,
   192→    effectiveOutputStart,
   193→    effectiveOutputEnd,
   194→    siblingRanges,
   195→    setSelectedEndpoint,
   196→  ]);
   197→}
   198→
   199→/**
   200→ * Hook for tablet touch gesture handling on timeline strips.
   201→ *
   202→ * Manages:
   203→ * - Endpoint selection (tap on resize handle to select, tap elsewhere to place)
   204→ * - Double-tap detection (to toggle strip active state)
   205→ * - Single-tap frame preview (delegates to parent via callback)
   206→ * - Scroll vs tap discrimination (ignores touches that moved beyond threshold)
   207→ */
   208→export function useTabletEndpointSelection(
   209→  options: UseTabletEndpointSelectionOptions,
   210→): UseTabletEndpointSelectionReturn {
   211→  const {
   212→    enabled,
   213→    isStripActive,
   214→    isTablet,
   215→    stripLeftPercent,
   216→    stripWidthPercent,
   217→    fullMin,
   218→    fullMax,
   219→    fullRange,
   220→    effectiveOutputStart,
   221→    effectiveOutputEnd,
   222→    siblingRanges,
   223→    outerContainerRef,
   224→    onRangeChange,
   225→    onDoubleTap,
   226→    onSingleTap,
   227→  } = options;
   228→
   229→  const [selectedEndpoint, setSelectedEndpoint] = useState<'left' | 'right' | null>(null);
   230→  const touchStartPosRef = useRef<{ x: number; y: number } | null>(null);
   231→  const lastTapTimeRef = useRef<number>(0);
   232→
   233→  // Tap-to-place hint visibility
   234→  const tapToPlaceHint = useTemporaryVisibility(2000);
   235→
   236→  // Show/hide tap-to-place hint when endpoint selection changes
   237→  useEffect(() => {
   238→    if (selectedEndpoint && enabled) {
   239→      tapToPlaceHint.show();
   240→    } else {
   241→      tapToPlaceHint.hide();
   242→    }
   243→  }, [selectedEndpoint, enabled, tapToPlaceHint]);
   244→
   245→  // iPad: touch outside to deselect endpoint
   246→  useClickOutside(
   247→    () => setSelectedEndpoint(null),
   248→    { events: ['touchstart'], enabled: !!selectedEndpoint && !!enabled, delay: 100 },
   249→    outerContainerRef as React.RefObject<HTMLDivElement>
   250→  );
   251→
   252→  /** Clear endpoint selection (for use by parent click-outside handlers) */
   253→  const clearSelection = useCallback(() => {
   254→    setSelectedEndpoint(null);
   255→  }, []);
   256→
   257→  // Touch start handler for resize handle endpoints
   258→  const handleEndpointTouchStart = useCallback((_endpoint: 'left' | 'right', e: React.TouchEvent) => {
   259→    if (!enabled) return;
   260→    const touch = e.touches[0];
   261→    touchStartPosRef.current = { x: touch.clientX, y: touch.clientY };
   262→  }, [enabled]);
   263→
   264→  // Touch end handler for resize handle endpoints
   265→  const handleEndpointTouchEnd = useCallback((_endpoint: 'left' | 'right', e: React.TouchEvent) => {
   266→    if (!enabled || !touchStartPosRef.current) return;
   267→
   268→    const touch = e.changedTouches[0];
   269→    const deltaX = Math.abs(touch.clientX - touchStartPosRef.current.x);
   270→    const deltaY = Math.abs(touch.clientY - touchStartPosRef.current.y);
   271→    touchStartPosRef.current = null;
   272→
   273→    if (deltaX > SCROLL_THRESHOLD || deltaY > SCROLL_THRESHOLD) return;
   274→
   275→    e.preventDefault();
   276→    e.stopPropagation();
   277→    setSelectedEndpoint(prev => prev === _endpoint ? null : _endpoint);
   278→  }, [enabled]);
   279→
   280→  const handleStripTapToPlace = useStripTapToPlace({
   281→    enabled,
   282→    selectedEndpoint,
   283→    outerContainerRef,
   284→    onRangeChange,
   285→    stripLeftPercent,
   286→    stripWidthPercent,
   287→    fullMin,
   288→    fullMax,
   289→    fullRange,
   290→    effectiveOutputStart,
   291→    effectiveOutputEnd,
   292→    siblingRanges,
   293→    setSelectedEndpoint,
   294→  });
   295→
   296→  // Track touch start for tap detection on strip body
   297→  const handleStripTouchStart = useCallback((e: React.TouchEvent) => {
   298→    if (!enabled) return;
   299→    const touch = e.touches[0];
   300→    touchStartPosRef.current = { x: touch.clientX, y: touch.clientY };
   301→  }, [enabled]);
   302→
   303→  // Touch end handler for strip body - dispatches to tap-to-place, double-tap, or single-tap
   304→  const handleStripTouchEnd = useCallback((e: React.TouchEvent) => {
   305→    if (!touchStartPosRef.current) return;
   306→
   307→    const touch = e.changedTouches[0];
   308→    const deltaX = Math.abs(touch.clientX - touchStartPosRef.current.x);
   309→    const deltaY = Math.abs(touch.clientY - touchStartPosRef.current.y);
   310→    touchStartPosRef.current = null;
   311→
   312→    if (deltaX > SCROLL_THRESHOLD || deltaY > SCROLL_THRESHOLD) return;
   313→
   314→    const target = e.target as HTMLElement;
   315→    if (target.closest('button') || target.closest('[data-resize-handle]')) return;
   316→
   317→    // If endpoint selected and strip active, place it
   318→    if (selectedEndpoint && isStripActive && enabled) {
   319→      handleStripTapToPlace(e);
   320→      return;
   321→    }
   322→
   323→    // Double-tap detection for iPad
   324→    const now = Date.now();
   325→    const timeSinceLastTap = now - lastTapTimeRef.current;
   326→    lastTapTimeRef.current = now;
   327→
   328→    if (timeSinceLastTap < DOUBLE_TAP_DELAY && isTablet) {
   329→      e.preventDefault();
   330→      setSelectedEndpoint(null);
   331→      onDoubleTap();
   332→    } else if (isTablet && !isStripActive) {
   333→      // Single tap - delegate to parent for frame preview
   334→      e.preventDefault();
   335→      onSingleTap(touch as unknown as Touch);
   336→    }
   337→  }, [enabled, selectedEndpoint, handleStripTapToPlace, isTablet, isStripActive, onDoubleTap, onSingleTap]);
   338→
   339→  return {
   340→    selectedEndpoint,
   341→    clearSelection,
   342→    tapToPlaceHintVisible: tapToPlaceHint.isVisible,
   343→    handleEndpointTouchStart,
   344→    handleEndpointTouchEnd,
   345→    handleStripTouchStart,
   346→    handleStripTouchEnd,
   347→  };
   348→}
   349→
   350→/** Returned clearSelection function type for parent click-outside handlers */
   351→export type { UseTabletEndpointSelectionReturn };
   352→

1→/**
     2→ * Shared Generation Data Transformers
     3→ * 
     4→ * SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for transforming generation data from database to UI format.
     5→ * 
     6→ * This eliminates the need to manually update transformation logic in multiple places
     7→ * when adding new fields. Instead, update once here and all consumers automatically
     8→ * get the new field.
     9→ * 
    10→ * Architecture Benefits:
    11→ * - DRY: No duplicated transformation logic across hooks/components
    12→ * - Type Safety: Centralized TypeScript types ensure consistency
    13→ * - Maintainability: Add new fields in one place instead of 5+
    14→ * - Testability: Can unit test transformations in isolation
    15→ * 
    16→ * NOTE: upscaled_url has been removed - upscaled versions are now stored as
    17→ * generation_variants with variant_type='upscaled' and become the primary variant,
    18→ * so `location` already contains the best available URL.
    19→ */
    20→
    21→import type { GeneratedImageWithMetadata } from '@/shared/components/MediaGallery/types';
    22→import type { GenerationRow } from '@/domains/generation/types';
    23→import type { GenerationMetadata } from '@/domains/generation/types';
    24→import { getSupabaseClient as supabase } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
    25→import { stripQueryParameters } from '@/shared/lib/media/mediaUrl';
    26→import { TOOL_IDS, isToolId } from '@/shared/lib/toolIds';
    27→import { ServerError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/errors';
    28→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
    29→import { expandShotData } from '@/shared/lib/shotData';
    30→import { parseGenerationTaskId } from '@/shared/lib/generationTaskIdParser';
    31→import { filterUuidStrings } from '@/shared/lib/uuid';
    32→
    33→/**
    34→ * Result type for calculateDerivedCounts
    35→ */
    36→export interface DerivedCountsResult {
    37→  /** Count of variants/derivatives per generation */
    38→  derivedCounts: Record<string, number>;
    39→  /** Whether each generation has any unviewed variants (viewed_at IS NULL) */
    40→  hasUnviewedVariants: Record<string, boolean>;
    41→  /** Count of unviewed variants per generation */
    42→  unviewedVariantCounts: Record<string, number>;
    43→  /** True when counts were intentionally returned empty due to a read-path failure. */
    44→  degraded?: boolean;
    45→  /** Machine-readable reason for degraded fallback behavior. */
    46→  errorCode?: 'query_failed';
    47→}
    48→
    49→function createEmptyDerivedCountsResult(): DerivedCountsResult {
    50→  return {
    51→    derivedCounts: {},
    52→    hasUnviewedVariants: {},
    53→    unviewedVariantCounts: {},
    54→  };
    55→}
    56→
    57→/**
    58→ * Calculate derivedCount for generations (how many variants/derivatives exist)
    59→ * Also tracks whether any variants are unviewed (for NEW badge display)
    60→ *
    61→ * Queries both:
    62→ * - generations table (based_on relationships)
    63→ * - generation_variants table (edit variants)
    64→ *
    65→ * @param generationIds - Array of generation IDs to count variants for
    66→ * @returns Object with derivedCounts and hasUnviewedVariants maps
    67→ */
    68→async function calculateDerivedCounts(
    69→  generationIds: string[]
    70→): Promise<DerivedCountsResult> {
    71→  const persistedGenerationIds = filterUuidStrings(generationIds);
    72→  if (persistedGenerationIds.length === 0) {
    73→    return createEmptyDerivedCountsResult();
    74→  }
    75→
    76→  const { derivedCounts, hasUnviewedVariants, unviewedVariantCounts } = createEmptyDerivedCountsResult();
    77→
    78→  // Only count from generation_variants table (actual variants)
    79→  // Note: We intentionally don't count based_on generations here - those are
    80→  // separate images in the gallery, not variants of this image
    81→  const { data: variantCountsData, error: variantCountsError } = await supabase().from('generation_variants')
    82→    .select('generation_id, viewed_at')
    83→    .in('generation_id', persistedGenerationIds);
    84→
    85→  if (variantCountsError) {
    86→    throw new ServerError('Failed to load variant badge counts', {
    87→      context: { generationIdsCount: generationIds.length },
    88→      cause: variantCountsError,
    89→    });
    90→  }
    91→
    92→  if (variantCountsData) {
    93→    for (const item of variantCountsData as Array<{ generation_id: string; viewed_at: string | null }>) {
    94→      const genId = item.generation_id;
    95→      derivedCounts[genId] = (derivedCounts[genId] || 0) + 1;
    96→      if (item.viewed_at === null) {
    97→        hasUnviewedVariants[genId] = true;
    98→        unviewedVariantCounts[genId] = (unviewedVariantCounts[genId] || 0) + 1;
    99→      }
   100→    }
   101→  }
   102→
   103→  return { derivedCounts, hasUnviewedVariants, unviewedVariantCounts };
   104→}
   105→
   106→/**
   107→ * Fail-open variant of calculateDerivedCounts for non-critical UI surfaces.
   108→ * Keeps badge rendering resilient when counts query intermittently fails.
   109→ */
   110→export async function calculateDerivedCountsSafe(
   111→  generationIds: string[]
   112→): Promise<DerivedCountsResult> {
   113→  try {
   114→    return await calculateDerivedCounts(generationIds);
   115→  } catch (error) {
   116→    normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'generationTransformers.calculateDerivedCountsSafe', showToast: false });
   117→    return {
   118→      ...createEmptyDerivedCountsResult(),
   119→      degraded: true,
   120→      errorCode: 'query_failed',
   121→    };
   122→  }
   123→}

   200→/**
   201→ * Extract prompt from various nested param structures
   202→ */
   203→function extractPrompt(params: Record<string, unknown> | null | undefined): string {
   204→  if (!params) return 'No prompt';
   205→
   206→  const originalParams = params.originalParams as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
   207→  const orchestratorDetails = originalParams?.orchestrator_details as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
   208→  const metadataBlock = params.metadata as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
   209→
   210→  return (
   211→    (orchestratorDetails?.prompt as string) ||
   212→    (params.prompt as string) ||
   213→    (metadataBlock?.prompt as string) ||
   214→    'No prompt'
   215→  );
   216→}

   218→/**
   219→ * Extract thumbnail URL with fallback logic
   220→ * Handles special case for travel-between-images videos where thumbnail might be in params
   221→ */
   222→function extractThumbnailUrl(item: RawGeneration, mainUrl: string): string {
   223→  // Start with database thumbnail_url field
   224→  let thumbnailUrl = item.thumbnail_url;
   225→  const toolType = item.params?.tool_type;
   226→  
   227→  // If no thumbnail in database, check params for travel-between-images videos
   228→  if (!thumbnailUrl && isToolId(toolType) && toolType === TOOL_IDS.TRAVEL_BETWEEN_IMAGES) {
   229→    const originalParams = item.params?.originalParams as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
   230→    const orchestratorDetails = originalParams?.orchestrator_details as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
   231→    const fullPayload = item.params?.full_orchestrator_payload as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
   232→    const originalFullPayload = originalParams?.full_orchestrator_payload as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
   233→
   234→    thumbnailUrl =
   235→      (item.params?.thumbnailUrl as string) ||
   236→      (orchestratorDetails?.thumbnail_url as string) ||
   237→      (fullPayload?.thumbnail_url as string) ||
   238→      (originalFullPayload?.thumbnail_url as string);
   239→  }
   240→  
   241→  // Final fallback to main URL
   242→  return thumbnailUrl || mainUrl;
   243→}

   248→function normalizePosition(timelineFrame: number | null | undefined): number | null {
   249→  if (timelineFrame === null || timelineFrame === undefined) return null;
   250→  return Math.floor(timelineFrame / 50);
   251→}

   253→/**

   262→export function transformGeneration(

   277→  if (storedContentType === 'video') {
   278→    // Default to mp4 for videos, can be overridden by URL extension
   279→    contentType = 'video/mp4';
   280→  } else if (storedContentType === 'image') {
   281→    // Default to png for images, can be overridden by URL extension  
   282→    contentType = 'image/png';
   283→  }
   284→  
   285→  // Compute stable URL identities for caching/comparison
   286→  // Supabase URLs have rotating tokens but the file path is stable
   287→  const urlIdentity = stripQueryParameters(mainUrl);
   288→  const thumbUrlIdentity = stripQueryParameters(thumbnailUrl);
   289→
   290→  // Base transformation - fields common to all generations
   291→  const baseItem: GeneratedImageWithMetadata = {
   292→    id: item.id,
   293→    url: mainUrl,
   294→    thumbUrl: thumbnailUrl,
   295→    urlIdentity,
   296→    thumbUrlIdentity,
   297→    prompt,
   298→    metadata: {
   299→      ...(item.params || {}),
   300→      taskId, // Include task ID in metadata for MediaGalleryItem
   301→      taskIdStatus: taskIdParse.status, // Surface parse health to avoid silent shape drift
   302→      based_on: item.based_on, // Include based_on for lineage tracking
   303→      ...(options.metadata || {}), // Merge any additional metadata
   304→    },
   305→    createdAt: item.created_at,
   306→    updatedAt: item.updated_at,
   307→    isVideo,
   308→    contentType, // For proper download file extensions
   309→    starred: item.starred || false,
   310→    based_on: item.based_on, // Top level for easy access
   311→    position: null, // Will be set if shot context provided
   312→    timeline_frame: null, // Will be set if shot context provided
   313→    name: item.name || (item.params?.name as string | undefined) || undefined,
   314→    derivedCount: item.derivedCount || 0, // Number of generations/variants based on this one
   315→    hasUnviewedVariants: item.hasUnviewedVariants || false, // For NEW badge display
   316→    unviewedVariantCount: item.unviewedVariantCount || 0, // Count for tooltip
   317→    // Parent/child relationship fields
   318→    is_child: item.is_child ?? undefined,
   319→    parent_generation_id: item.parent_generation_id ?? undefined,
   320→    child_order: item.child_order ?? undefined,
   321→  };
   322→
   323→  // Normalize JSONB shot_data into a flat association list.
   324→  const shotGenerations = expandShotData(item.shot_data as Record<string, unknown> | null | undefined);
   325→  
   326→  // If shot context is provided via options, use it
   327→  if (options.shotImageEntryId || options.timeline_frame !== undefined) {
   328→    return {
   329→      ...baseItem,
   330→      shotImageEntryId: options.shotImageEntryId,
   331→      timeline_frame: options.timeline_frame ?? null,
   332→      position: normalizePosition(options.timeline_frame),
   333→    };
   334→  }
   335→
   336→  // Otherwise, process shot associations from query data
   337→  if (shotGenerations.length > 0) {
   338→    // Single shot optimization
   339→    if (shotGenerations.length === 1) {
   340→      const singleShot = shotGenerations[0];
   341→      return {
   342→        ...baseItem,
   343→        shot_id: singleShot.shot_id,
   344→        position: normalizePosition(singleShot.timeline_frame),
   345→        timeline_frame: singleShot.timeline_frame,
   346→      };
   347→    }
   348→    
   349→    // Multiple shots: include all associations
   350→    const allAssociations = shotGenerations.map(shotGen => ({
   351→      shot_id: shotGen.shot_id,
   352→      timeline_frame: shotGen.timeline_frame,
   353→      position: normalizePosition(shotGen.timeline_frame),
   354→    }));
   355→    
   356→    // When filtering by specific shot, use that shot as primary
   357→    let primaryShot = shotGenerations[0];
   358→    if (options.shotId) {
   359→      const matchingShot = shotGenerations.find(shotGen => shotGen.shot_id === options.shotId);
   360→      if (matchingShot) {
   361→        primaryShot = matchingShot;
   362→      }
   363→    }
   364→
   365→    return {
   366→      ...baseItem,
   367→      shot_id: primaryShot.shot_id,
   368→      position: normalizePosition(primaryShot.timeline_frame),
   369→      timeline_frame: primaryShot.timeline_frame,
   370→      all_shot_associations: allAssociations,
   371→    };
   372→  }
   373→  
   374→  return baseItem;
   375→}
   376→
   377→/**
   378→ * Transform for Timeline component's specific needs
   379→ * Maps to GenerationRow format expected by Timeline
   380→ */
   381→export function transformForTimeline(
   382→  shotGen: RawShotGeneration
   383→): GenerationRow & { timeline_frame?: number } {
   384→  const gen = shotGen.generation || shotGen.generations;
   385→  const genData = Array.isArray(gen) ? gen[0] : gen;
   386→  
   387→  if (!genData) {
   388→    return {
   389→      // PRIMARY IDs: id = shot_generations.id (unique per entry), generation_id = actual generation
   390→      id: shotGen.id,
   391→      generation_id: shotGen.generation_id,
   392→      // Deprecated (backwards compat)
   393→      shotImageEntryId: shotGen.id,
   394→      timeline_frame: shotGen.timeline_frame ?? undefined,
   395→    };
   396→  }
   397→  
   398→  return {
   399→    // PRIMARY IDs: id = shot_generations.id (unique per entry), generation_id = actual generation
   400→    id: shotGen.id,
   401→    generation_id: shotGen.generation_id,
   402→    // Deprecated (backwards compat)
   403→    shotImageEntryId: shotGen.id,
   404→    imageUrl: genData.location,
   405→    thumbUrl: genData.location,
   406→    location: genData.location,
   407→    type: genData.type ?? undefined,
   408→    createdAt: genData.created_at,
   409→    timeline_frame: shotGen.timeline_frame ?? undefined,
   410→    metadata: (shotGen.metadata as GenerationMetadata | undefined) ?? undefined,
   411→    starred: genData.starred ?? false,
   412→    based_on: genData.based_on ?? undefined,
   413→    derivedCount: genData.derivedCount ?? 0,
   414→  };
   415→}
   416→
   417→/**
   418→ * Detect if a URL points to a video based on file extension.
   419→ * Used for variants which lack a `type` column.
   420→ */
   421→function isVideoUrl(url: string | null | undefined): boolean {
   422→  if (!url) return false;
   423→  const videoExtensions = ['.mp4', '.webm', '.mov', '.avi', '.mkv'];
   424→  return videoExtensions.some(ext => url.toLowerCase().includes(ext));
   425→}
   426→
   427→/**
   428→ * Transform a raw variant record from generation_variants table to UI format.
   429→ *
   430→ * Mirrors `transformGeneration` but for variants, which have a different
   431→ * schema (no `type` column, different metadata shape).
   432→ *
   433→ * @param variant - Raw variant from database query
   434→ * @param options - Optional overrides (e.g. toolType fallback)
   435→ * @returns Transformed variant ready for UI display
   436→ */
   437→export function transformVariant(
   438→  variant: RawVariant,
   439→  options?: { toolType?: string }
   440→): GeneratedImageWithMetadata {
   441→  const isVideo = isVideoUrl(variant.location);
   442→  const variantParams = (variant.params ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
   443→  const storedContentType = variantParams.content_type as string | undefined;
   444→
   445→  let contentType: string | undefined;
   446→  if (storedContentType === 'video' || isVideo) {
   447→    contentType = 'video/mp4';
   448→  } else {
   449→    contentType = 'image/png';
   450→  }
   451→
   452→  return {
   453→    id: variant.id,
   454→    url: variant.location,
   455→    thumbUrl: variant.thumbnail_url || variant.location,
   456→    isVideo,
   457→    contentType,
   458→    createdAt: variant.created_at,
   459→    starred: false, // Variants don't have starred flag
   460→    metadata: {
   461→      prompt: variantParams.prompt as string | undefined,
   462→      variant_type: variant.variant_type,
   463→      name: variant.name,
   464→      generation_id: variant.generation_id,
   465→      tool_type: (variantParams.tool_type as string) || options?.toolType,
   466→      created_from: variantParams.created_from as string | undefined,
   467→      source_task_id: variantParams.source_task_id as string | undefined,
   468→      content_type: storedContentType,
   469→    },
   470→    shot_id: undefined,
   471→    position: undefined,
   472→    all_shot_associations: undefined,
   473→  };
   474→}
   475→

    22→  all_shot_associations?: Array<{ shot_id: string; timeline_frame: number | null; position: number | null }>;
    23→}
    24→
    25→function normalizePosition(timelineFrame: number | null | undefined): number | null {
    26→  if (timelineFrame === null || timelineFrame === undefined) {
    27→    return null;
    28→  }
    29→  return Math.floor(timelineFrame / 50);
    30→}
    31→
    32→function normalizePrompt(params: unknown): string | undefined {
    33→  const record = params as Record<string, unknown> | null;
    34→  if (!record) {
    35→    return undefined;
    36→  }
    37→
    38→  if (typeof record.prompt === 'string') {
    39→    return record.prompt;
    40→  }
    41→
    42→  const originalParams = record.originalParams as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
    43→  const orchestratorDetails = originalParams?.orchestrator_details as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
    44→  return typeof orchestratorDetails?.prompt === 'string' ? orchestratorDetails.prompt : undefined;
    45→}
    46→
    47→export async function fetchDerivedItemsFromRepository(
    48→  sourceGenerationId: string | null,
    49→): Promise<DerivedItem[]> {
    50→  if (!sourceGenerationId) {
    51→    return [];
    52→  }
    53→
    54→  const [generationsResult, variantsResult] = await Promise.all([
    55→    supabase().from('generations')
    56→      .select(`
    57→        id,
    58→        location,
    59→        thumbnail_url,
    60→        type,
    61→        created_at,
    62→        params,
    63→        starred,
    64→        tasks,
    65→        based_on,
    66→        shot_data
    67→      `)
    68→      .eq('based_on', sourceGenerationId)
    69→      .order('starred', { ascending: false, nullsFirst: false })
    70→      .order('created_at', { ascending: false }),
    71→    supabase().from('generation_variants')
    72→      .select('id, location, thumbnail_url, created_at, variant_type, name, params, is_primary, viewed_at')
    73→      .eq('generation_id', sourceGenerationId)
    74→      .in('variant_type', EDIT_VARIANT_TYPES)
    75→      .eq('is_primary', false)
    76→      .order('created_at', { ascending: false }),
    77→  ]);
    78→
    79→  if (generationsResult.error) {
    80→    normalizeAndReportError(generationsResult.error, {
    81→      context: 'generation.derivedItems.repository.generations',
    82→      showToast: false,
    83→    });
    84→  }
    85→  if (variantsResult.error) {
    86→    normalizeAndReportError(variantsResult.error, {
    87→      context: 'generation.derivedItems.repository.variants',
    88→      showToast: false,
    89→    });
    90→  }
    91→
    92→  const childGenerations = generationsResult.data || [];
    93→  const editVariants = variantsResult.data || [];
    94→
    95→  const generationIds = childGenerations.map((row) => row.id);
    96→  const { derivedCounts } = await calculateDerivedCountsSafe(generationIds);
    97→
    98→  const generationItems: DerivedItem[] = childGenerations.map((item) => {
    99→    const shotGenerations = expandShotData(
   100→      (item as { shot_data?: Record<string, unknown> | null }).shot_data,
   101→    );
   102→    const allAssociations = shotGenerations.length > 1
   103→      ? shotGenerations.map((sg) => ({
   104→          shot_id: sg.shot_id,
   105→          timeline_frame: sg.timeline_frame,
   106→          position: normalizePosition(sg.timeline_frame),
   107→        }))
   108→      : undefined;
   109→
   110→    const primaryShot = shotGenerations[0];
   111→
   112→    return {
   113→      id: item.id,
   114→      thumbUrl: item.thumbnail_url || item.location,
   115→      url: item.location,
   116→      createdAt: item.created_at,
   117→      derivedCount: derivedCounts[item.id] || 0,
   118→      starred: item.starred || false,
   119→      prompt: normalizePrompt(item.params),
   120→      itemType: 'generation',
   121→      basedOn: item.based_on,
   122→      shot_id: primaryShot?.shot_id,
   123→      timeline_frame: primaryShot?.timeline_frame,
   124→      all_shot_associations: allAssociations,
   125→    };
   126→  });
   127→
   128→  const variantItems: DerivedItem[] = editVariants.map((variant) => ({
   129→    id: variant.id,
   130→    thumbUrl: variant.thumbnail_url || variant.location,
   131→    url: variant.location,
   132→    createdAt: variant.created_at,
   133→    derivedCount: 0,
   134→    starred: false,
   135→    prompt: normalizePrompt(variant.params),
   136→    itemType: 'variant',
   137→    variantType: variant.variant_type,
   138→    variantName: variant.name,
   139→    viewedAt: variant.viewed_at,
   140→  }));
   141→
   142→  return [...generationItems, ...variantItems].sort((a, b) => {
   143→    if (a.starred && !b.starred) return -1;
   144→    if (!a.starred && b.starred) return 1;
   145→    return new Date(b.createdAt).getTime() - new Date(a.createdAt).getTime();
   146→  });
   147→}
   148→

1→/**
     2→ * NetworkStatusManager - Centralized network status management
     3→ *
     4→ * Provides a single source of truth for online/offline status and connection type.
     5→ * Integrates with reconnect and polling flows for network-aware behavior.
     6→ */
     7→
     8→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
     9→import type { NavigatorWithDeviceInfo } from '@/types/browser-extensions';
    10→
    11→interface NetworkStatus {
    12→  isOnline: boolean;
    13→  effectiveType?: '2g' | '3g' | '4g' | 'slow-2g';
    14→  lastTransitionAt: number;
    15→  previousOnlineStatus: boolean;
    16→}
    17→
    18→type NetworkEventType = 'online' | 'offline' | 'connection-change';
    19→
    20→interface NetworkStatusSubscriber {
    21→  (status: NetworkStatus, eventType: NetworkEventType, event?: Event): void;
    22→}
    23→
    24→export class NetworkStatusManager {
    25→  private status: NetworkStatus;
    26→  private subscribers: Set<NetworkStatusSubscriber> = new Set();
    27→  private initialized = false;
    28→
    29→  constructor() {
    30→    const nav = navigator as NavigatorWithDeviceInfo;
    31→    this.status = {
    32→      isOnline: navigator.onLine,
    33→      effectiveType: nav.connection?.effectiveType,
    34→      lastTransitionAt: Date.now(),
    35→      previousOnlineStatus: navigator.onLine,
    36→    };
    37→  }
    38→
    39→  initialize(): void {
    40→    if (this.initialized) return;
    41→
    42→    const handleOnline = (event: Event) => this.handleNetworkChange('online', event);
    43→    const handleOffline = (event: Event) => this.handleNetworkChange('offline', event);
    44→    const handleConnectionChange = (event: Event) => this.handleNetworkChange('connection-change', event);
    45→
    46→    window.addEventListener('online', handleOnline);
    47→    window.addEventListener('offline', handleOffline);
    48→
    49→    const nav = navigator as NavigatorWithDeviceInfo;
    50→    if (nav.connection) {
    51→      nav.connection.addEventListener('change', handleConnectionChange);
    52→    }
    53→
    54→    this.initialized = true;
    55→  }
    56→
    57→  getStatus(): NetworkStatus {
    58→    return { ...this.status };
    59→  }
    60→
    61→  subscribe(callback: NetworkStatusSubscriber): () => void {
    62→    this.subscribers.add(callback);
    63→    return () => this.subscribers.delete(callback);
    64→  }
    65→
    66→  isSlowConnection(): boolean {
    67→    return this.status.effectiveType === '2g' || this.status.effectiveType === 'slow-2g';
    68→  }
    69→
    70→  getRecommendedIntervals(): { fast: number; normal: number; slow: number } {
    71→    if (!this.status.isOnline) {
    72→      return { fast: 60000, normal: 120000, slow: 300000 };
    73→    }
    74→
    75→    if (this.isSlowConnection()) {
    76→      return { fast: 30000, normal: 60000, slow: 180000 };
    77→    }
    78→
    79→    return { fast: 10000, normal: 30000, slow: 60000 };
    80→  }
    81→
    82→  private handleNetworkChange(eventType: NetworkEventType, event?: Event): void {
    83→    const now = Date.now();
    84→    const newIsOnline = navigator.onLine;
    85→    const nav = navigator as NavigatorWithDeviceInfo;
    86→    const newEffectiveType = nav.connection?.effectiveType;
    87→
    88→    const onlineStatusChanged = newIsOnline !== this.status.isOnline;
    89→    const connectionChanged = newEffectiveType !== this.status.effectiveType;
    90→
    91→    if (!onlineStatusChanged && !connectionChanged) {
    92→      return;
    93→    }
    94→
    95→    const previousStatus = { ...this.status };
    96→    this.status = {
    97→      isOnline: newIsOnline,
    98→      effectiveType: newEffectiveType,
    99→      lastTransitionAt: now,
   100→      previousOnlineStatus: previousStatus.isOnline,
   101→    };
   102→
   103→    this.subscribers.forEach((callback) => {
   104→      try {
   105→        callback(this.status, eventType, event);
   106→      } catch (error) {
   107→        normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'NetworkStatusManager', showToast: false });
   108→      }
   109→    });
   110→  }
   111→}
   112→
   113→let networkStatusManager: NetworkStatusManager;
   114→
   115→export function getNetworkStatusManager(): NetworkStatusManager {
   116→  if (!networkStatusManager) {
   117→    networkStatusManager = new NetworkStatusManager();
   118→    networkStatusManager.initialize();
   119→
   120→    if (import.meta.env.DEV && typeof window !== 'undefined') {
   121→      void import('@/shared/services/network/networkStatusDebug').then(({ installNetworkStatusDebugHelpers }) => {
   122→        installNetworkStatusDebugHelpers(networkStatusManager);
   123→      });
   124→    }
   125→  }
   126→
   127→  return networkStatusManager;
   128→}
   129→

1→/**
     2→ * Timeline Frame Calculators
     3→ *
     4→ * Pure functions for timeline frame position calculations:
     5→ * - Gap finding and frame distribution
     6→ * - Normalization (compress gaps, shift to start at 0)
     7→ * - Position calculation for drag-and-drop operations
     8→ *
     9→ * No React hooks or side effects - all functions are stateless.

    15→/** Maximum allowed gap between timeline frames (5s at 16fps). */
    16→const MAX_FRAME_GAP = 81;
    17→
    18→// ============================================================================
    19→// Types
    20→// ============================================================================
    21→
    22→interface FrameUpdate {
    23→  id: string;
    24→  newFrame: number;
    25→  reason: string;
    26→}
    27→
    28→// ============================================================================
    29→// Normalization
    30→// ============================================================================
    31→
    32→/**
    33→ * Normalize a set of final positions: start at 0, compress gaps > MAX_FRAME_GAP.
    34→ * Returns a map of id -> { newFrame, reason } for items that need updating.
    35→ * @internal Used only within this module by buildAndNormalizeFinalPositions.
    36→ */
    37→function normalizePositions(
    38→  allFinalPositions: Array<{ id: string; frame: number }>
    39→): Map<string, { newFrame: number; reason: string }> {
    40→  const normalizedUpdates = new Map<string, { newFrame: number; reason: string }>();
    41→
    42→  if (allFinalPositions.length === 0) return normalizedUpdates;
    43→
    44→  // Sort by frame position
    45→  const sorted = [...allFinalPositions].sort((a, b) => a.frame - b.frame);
    46→
    47→  let currentFrame = 0;
    48→
    49→  for (let i = 0; i < sorted.length; i++) {
    50→    const item = sorted[i];
    51→
    52→    if (i === 0) {
    53→      if (item.frame !== 0) {
    54→        normalizedUpdates.set(item.id, { newFrame: 0, reason: 'Normalized to start at 0' });
    55→      }
    56→      currentFrame = 0;
    57→    } else {
    58→      const prevItem = sorted[i - 1];
    59→      const originalGap = item.frame - prevItem.frame;
    60→      const normalizedGap = Math.min(originalGap, MAX_FRAME_GAP);
    61→      const normalizedFrame = currentFrame + normalizedGap;
    62→
    63→      if (normalizedFrame !== item.frame) {
    64→        normalizedUpdates.set(item.id, {
    65→          newFrame: normalizedFrame,
    66→          reason: originalGap > MAX_FRAME_GAP
    67→            ? `Gap compressed from ${originalGap} to ${normalizedGap}`
    68→            : 'Shifted to maintain sequence'
    69→        });
    70→      }
    71→      currentFrame = normalizedFrame;
    72→    }
    73→  }
    74→
    75→  return normalizedUpdates;
    76→}
    77→
    78→// ============================================================================
    79→// Frame distribution for drag-and-drop
    80→// ============================================================================
    81→
    82→/**
    83→ * Find a ShotGeneration by canonical shot_generations.id.
    84→ */
    85→export function findGeneration(
    86→  shotGenerations: ShotGeneration[],
    87→  key?: string | null
    88→): ShotGeneration | undefined {
    89→  if (!key) return undefined;
    90→  return shotGenerations.find(sg => sg.id === key);
    91→}
    92→
    93→interface DistributionContext {
    94→  draggedShotGens: ShotGeneration[];
    95→  draggedItemIds: string[];
    96→  newStartIndex: number;
    97→  allItems: Array<{ id: string; timeline_frame: number | null }>;
    98→  shotGenerations: ShotGeneration[];
    99→}
   100→
   101→/**
   102→ * Calculate frame positions for dragged items based on their new position in the list.
   103→ * Returns accumulated updates (not yet deduplicated or normalized).
   104→ */
   105→export function calculateDistributedFrames(ctx: DistributionContext): FrameUpdate[] {
   106→  const { draggedShotGens, draggedItemIds, newStartIndex, allItems, shotGenerations } = ctx;
   107→  const accumulateUpdates: FrameUpdate[] = [];
   108→
   109→  const pushUpdate = (id: string, frame: number, reason: string) => {
   110→    const normalizedFrame = Math.max(0, Math.floor(frame));
   111→    accumulateUpdates.push({ id, newFrame: normalizedFrame, reason });
   112→  };
   113→
   114→  const newEndIndex = newStartIndex + draggedItemIds.length - 1;
   115→  const predecessor = newStartIndex > 0 ? allItems[newStartIndex - 1] : null;
   116→  const successor = newEndIndex < allItems.length - 1 ? allItems[newEndIndex + 1] : null;
   117→
   118→  if (newStartIndex === 0 && successor) {
   119→    // Special case: dropping at position 0
   120→    calculateDropAtPositionZero(
   121→      draggedShotGens, draggedItemIds, newEndIndex, allItems, shotGenerations, successor, pushUpdate
   122→    );
   123→  } else if (predecessor && successor && predecessor.timeline_frame != null && successor.timeline_frame != null) {
   124→    // Between two items - distribute evenly in the gap
   125→    const gap = successor.timeline_frame - predecessor.timeline_frame;
   126→    const numItems = draggedItemIds.length;
   127→    const interval = gap / (numItems + 1);
   128→
   129→    draggedShotGens.forEach((sg, i) => {
   130→      const newFrame = predecessor.timeline_frame! + (interval * (i + 1));
   131→      pushUpdate(sg.id, newFrame, `Distributed in gap (${i + 1}/${numItems})`);
   132→    });
   133→  } else if (predecessor && predecessor.timeline_frame != null) {
   134→    // At end - extend timeline using average spacing of existing items
   135→    const existingFrames = allItems
   136→      .filter(item => item.timeline_frame != null)
   137→      .map(item => item.timeline_frame!);
   138→    const spacing = calculateAverageSpacing(existingFrames, DEFAULT_FRAME_SPACING);
   139→
   140→    draggedShotGens.forEach((sg, i) => {
   141→      const newFrame = predecessor.timeline_frame! + (spacing * (i + 1));
   142→      pushUpdate(sg.id, newFrame, `Extend at end (${i + 1}/${draggedItemIds.length})`);
   143→    });
   144→  } else if (successor && successor.timeline_frame != null) {
   145→    // At start - distribute between 0 and successor
   146→    const gap = successor.timeline_frame;
   147→    const numItems = draggedItemIds.length;
   148→    const interval = gap / (numItems + 1);
   149→
   150→    draggedShotGens.forEach((sg, i) => {
   151→      const newFrame = interval * (i + 1);
   152→      pushUpdate(sg.id, newFrame, `Distributed from start (${i + 1}/${numItems})`);
   153→    });
   154→  } else {
   155→    // First items in timeline - start at 0 and space by default
   156→
   157→    draggedShotGens.forEach((sg, i) => {
   158→      const newFrame = DEFAULT_FRAME_SPACING * i;
   159→      pushUpdate(sg.id, newFrame, `Initial placement (${i + 1}/${draggedItemIds.length})`);
   160→    });
   161→  }
   162→
   163→  return accumulateUpdates;
   164→}
   165→
   166→/**
   167→ * Handle the special case of dropping items at position 0.
   168→ */
   169→function calculateDropAtPositionZero(
   170→  draggedShotGens: ShotGeneration[],
   171→  draggedItemIds: string[],
   172→  newEndIndex: number,
   173→  allItems: Array<{ id: string; timeline_frame: number | null }>,
   174→  shotGenerations: ShotGeneration[],
   175→  successor: { id: string; timeline_frame: number | null },
   176→  pushUpdate: (id: string, frame: number, reason: string) => void
   177→) {
   178→  const displacedFirstItem = successor;
   179→  const oldSecondItem = newEndIndex + 2 < allItems.length ? allItems[newEndIndex + 2] : null;
   180→
   181→  // First dragged item goes to frame 0
   182→  pushUpdate(draggedShotGens[0].id, 0, 'First item at position 0');
   183→
   184→  // Calculate new position for displaced first item
   185→  let displacedNewFrame: number;
   186→  if (oldSecondItem?.timeline_frame != null) {
   187→    displacedNewFrame = Math.floor((0 + oldSecondItem.timeline_frame) / 2);
   188→  } else if (displacedFirstItem.timeline_frame != null) {
   189→    displacedNewFrame = Math.max(DEFAULT_FRAME_SPACING, displacedFirstItem.timeline_frame);
   190→  } else {
   191→    displacedNewFrame = DEFAULT_FRAME_SPACING;
   192→  }
   193→
   194→  // Update displaced item
   195→  const displacedShotGen = findGeneration(shotGenerations, displacedFirstItem.id);
   196→  if (displacedShotGen?.id) {
   197→    pushUpdate(displacedShotGen.id, displacedNewFrame, 'Displaced first item shifted');
   198→  }
   199→
   200→  // Distribute remaining dragged items between 0 and displaced item's new position
   201→  if (draggedItemIds.length > 1) {
   202→    const numRemaining = draggedItemIds.length - 1;
   203→    const gap = displacedNewFrame;
   204→    const interval = gap / (numRemaining + 1);
   205→
   206→    for (let i = 1; i < draggedItemIds.length; i++) {
   207→      const newFrame = interval * i;
   208→      pushUpdate(draggedShotGens[i].id, newFrame, `Distributed after first (${i}/${draggedItemIds.length})`);
   209→    }
   210→  }
   211→}
   212→
   213→// ============================================================================
   214→// Update deduplication
   215→// ============================================================================
   216→
   217→/**
   218→ * Deduplicate frame updates (last write wins per id).
   219→ */
   220→export function deduplicateUpdates(
   221→  updates: FrameUpdate[]
   222→): Map<string, { newFrame: number; reason: string }> {
   223→  const uniqueUpdates = new Map<string, { newFrame: number; reason: string }>();
   224→  updates.forEach(entry => {
   225→    const existing = uniqueUpdates.get(entry.id);
   226→    if (!existing || existing.newFrame !== entry.newFrame) {
   227→      uniqueUpdates.set(entry.id, { newFrame: entry.newFrame, reason: entry.reason });
   228→    }
   229→  });
   230→  return uniqueUpdates;
   231→}
   232→
   233→/**
   234→ * Build the complete picture of final positions (updated + unchanged) for all positioned items,
   235→ * then normalize and merge back into the updates map.
   236→ */
   237→export function buildAndNormalizeFinalPositions(
   238→  uniqueUpdates: Map<string, { newFrame: number; reason: string }>,
   239→  shotGenerations: ShotGeneration[]
   240→): Map<string, { newFrame: number; reason: string }> {
   241→  const allFinalPositions: Array<{ id: string; frame: number }> = [];
   242→
   243→  for (const sg of shotGenerations) {
   244→    if (sg.timeline_frame == null || sg.timeline_frame < 0) continue;
   245→    const update = uniqueUpdates.get(sg.id);
   246→    const finalFrame = update ? update.newFrame : sg.timeline_frame;
   247→    allFinalPositions.push({ id: sg.id, frame: finalFrame });
   248→  }
   249→
   250→  allFinalPositions.sort((a, b) => a.frame - b.frame);
   251→
   252→  if (allFinalPositions.length === 0) return uniqueUpdates;
   253→
   254→  const normalizedUpdates = normalizePositions(allFinalPositions);
   255→
   256→  // Merge normalized updates into uniqueUpdates
   257→  for (const [id, payload] of normalizedUpdates) {
   258→    const existing = uniqueUpdates.get(id);
   259→    if (existing) {
   260→      uniqueUpdates.set(id, { newFrame: payload.newFrame, reason: `${existing.reason} → ${payload.reason}` });
   261→    } else {
   262→      uniqueUpdates.set(id, payload);
   263→    }
   264→  }
   265→
   266→  return uniqueUpdates;
   267→}

    13→    const authManager = getAuthStateManager();
    14→    let unsubscribe: (() => void) | null = null;
    15→
    16→    if (authManager) {
    17→      unsubscribe = authManager.subscribe('Layout', (_event, session) => {
    18→        setSession(session);
    19→      });
    20→    }
    21→
    22→    const supabaseResult = getSupabaseClientResult();
    23→    if (!supabaseResult.ok) {
    24→      normalizeAndPresentError(supabaseResult.error, {
    25→        context: 'useAuthGuard.supabaseUnavailable',
    26→        showToast: false,
    27→      });
    28→      if (isMounted && !authManager) {
    29→        setSession(null);
    30→      }
    31→      return () => {
    32→        isMounted = false;
    33→        if (unsubscribe) unsubscribe();
    34→      };
    35→    }
    36→
    37→    const client = supabaseResult.client;
    38→    void client.auth
    39→      .getSession()
    40→      .then(({ data: { session } }) => {
    41→        if (isMounted) {
    42→          setSession(session);
    43→        }
    44→      })
    45→      .catch((error) => {
    46→        normalizeAndPresentError(error, {
    47→          context: 'useAuthGuard.getSession',
    48→          showToast: false,
    49→        });
    50→        if (isMounted) {
    51→          setSession(null);
    52→        }
    53→      });
    54→
    55→    if (!authManager) {
    56→      const { data: { subscription } } = client.auth.onAuthStateChange((_event, session) => {
    57→        setSession(session);
    58→      });
    59→      unsubscribe = () => subscription?.unsubscribe();
    60→    }
    61→
    62→    return () => {
    63→      isMounted = false;
    64→      if (unsubscribe) unsubscribe();
    65→    };
    66→  }, []);
    67→
    68→  return { session };
    69→}

   239→export async function getPrimaryTaskIdForGeneration(

   250→
   251→export async function getPrimaryTaskMappingsForGenerations(
   252→  generationIds: string[],
   253→  options?: GenerationTaskRepositoryOptions,
   254→): Promise<Map<string, GenerationTaskMapping>> {
   255→  if (generationIds.length === 0) {
   256→    return new Map();
   257→  }
   258→
   259→  const requestedIds = Array.from(new Set(generationIds));
   260→  const supabaseResult = (options?.supabaseRegistry ?? supabaseClientRegistry).getClientResult();
   261→  if (!supabaseResult.ok) {
   262→    const failures = new Map<string, GenerationTaskMapping>();
   263→    requestedIds.forEach((generationId) => {
   264→      failures.set(generationId, {
   265→        generationId,
   266→        taskId: null,
   267→        status: 'query_failed',
   268→        queryError: supabaseResult.error.message,
   269→      });
   270→    });
   271→    return failures;
   272→  }
   273→
   274→  const supabase = supabaseResult.client;
   275→  const query = supabase
   276→    .from('generations')
   277→    .select('id, tasks, project_id')
   278→    .in('id', requestedIds);
   279→
   280→  const { data, error } = await query;
   281→
   282→  if (error) {
   283→    const failures = new Map<string, GenerationTaskMapping>();
   284→    requestedIds.forEach((generationId) => {
   285→      failures.set(generationId, {
   286→        generationId,
   287→        taskId: null,
   288→        status: 'query_failed',
   289→        queryError: error.message,
   290→      });
   291→    });
   292→    return failures;
   293→  }
   294→
   295→  const rowsById = new Map((data || []).map((row) => [row.id, row]));
   296→
   297→  const mappings = new Map<string, GenerationTaskMapping>();
   298→  for (const generationId of requestedIds) {
   299→    const row = rowsById.get(generationId);
   300→
   301→    if (!row) {
   302→      mappings.set(generationId, {
   303→        generationId,
   304→        taskId: null,
   305→        status: 'missing_generation',
   306→      });
   307→      continue;
   308→    }
   309→
   310→    if (options?.projectId && row.project_id !== options.projectId) {
   311→      mappings.set(generationId, {
   312→        generationId,
   313→        taskId: null,
   314→        status: 'scope_mismatch',
   315→      });
   316→      continue;
   317→    }
   318→
   319→    const parsed = parseGenerationTaskId(row.tasks);
   320→    mappings.set(generationId, {
   321→      generationId,
   322→      taskId: parsed.taskId,
   323→      status: parsed.status,
   324→    });
   325→  }
   326→
   327→  return mappings;
   328→}

   335→    status: mapping?.status ?? 'not_loaded',
   336→    ...(mapping?.queryError ? { queryError: mapping.queryError } : {}),
   337→  };
   338→}

    45→      SELECT id FROM projects WHERE user_id = auth.uid()
    46→    )
    47→  );
    48→
    49→-- Users can delete their own generations
    50→CREATE POLICY "Users can delete their own generations" ON generations
    51→  FOR DELETE
    52→  USING (
    53→    project_id IN (
    54→      SELECT id FROM projects WHERE user_id = auth.uid()
    55→    )
    56→  );
    57→
    58→-- Service role can do everything
    59→CREATE POLICY "Service role can manage all generations" ON generations
    60→  FOR ALL
    61→  TO service_role
    62→  USING (true)
    63→  WITH CHECK (true);
    64→
    65→-- ============================================================================
    66→-- 3. Fix shared_generations INSERT policy to verify ownership
    67→-- ============================================================================
    68→
    69→-- Drop the weak policy
    70→DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Users can create shares for their generations" ON shared_generations;
    71→
    72→-- Create secure policy that verifies user owns the generation
    73→CREATE POLICY "Users can create shares for their generations" ON shared_generations
    74→  FOR INSERT
    75→  WITH CHECK (
    76→    -- User must set creator_id to their own ID
    77→    auth.uid() = creator_id
    78→    -- AND the generation must belong to them (through project)
    79→    AND EXISTS (
    80→      SELECT 1 
    81→      FROM generations g
    82→      JOIN projects p ON p.id = g.project_id
    83→      WHERE g.id = generation_id
    84→      AND p.user_id = auth.uid()
    85→    )
    86→  );
    87→
    88→-- ============================================================================
    89→-- 4. Comments
    90→-- ============================================================================
    91→
    92→COMMENT ON POLICY "Users can insert generations for their projects" ON generations IS 
    93→  'Ensures users can only create generations in their own projects. Critical for copy-to-account security.';
    94→
    95→COMMENT ON POLICY "Users can create shares for their generations" ON shared_generations IS 
    96→  'Verifies user owns the generation before allowing them to create a share. Prevents sharing other users'' content.';
    97→
    98→
